title: Lifestyle Assistant
description:
Bolton Clarke Group one of Australia’s largest independent, not-for-profit providers of home care, retirement living and residential aged care, operating nationally and internationally. Bolton Clarke Residential group now has 88 Aged Care Homes across QLD, NSW, VIC, SA & WA, with the inclusion of the Allity, McKenzie & Acacia Living Group.

The Role

We are seeking a warm, enthusiastic, and creative Lifestyle Assistant to join our dedicated team.

This role is perfect for someone who is passionate about enhancing the wellbeing of older Australians through meaningful activities, social engagement, and genuine connection.

As a valued member of our Lifestyle team, you will:

  • Support the planning and delivery of engaging recreational and social programs

  • Build positive, supportive relationships with residents

  • Help create a vibrant, inclusive, and enjoyable environment

  • Contribute to resident wellbeing through companionship, conversation, and participation in activities

Be the friendly face that brings joy and enrichment to the lives of our residents.

To be successful

You are someone who brings energy, compassion, and creativity to your work. You’ll also bring:

  • Previous experience in aged care

  • Certificate III in Aged Care or equivalent

  • Certificate IV in Leisure and Health (highly desirable)

  • Current First Aid Certificate (with CPR)

  • The ability to build strong, positive relationships

  • Confidence engaging residents in daily programs and activities

  • A genuine passion for supporting and enriching the lives of older people

  • Great communication and teamwork skills, along with basic computer literacy

  • Prior to commencement - complete a National Police Check and or a NDIS Workers Check

If you’re someone who loves making meaningful connections and creating moments of joy, we’d love to hear from you. Join us in making a difference every day!

About this location:

Bolton Clarke’s Fernhill Home provides high-quality aged care in a friendly, secure and comfortable residential environment.

Why Work For Bolton Clarke:


  • Excellent work/life balance with shifts that suit your personal needs
  • A caring team environment with strong clinical and allied health support
  • Career progression and development opportunities
  • Generous salary packaging and not-for-profit tax benefits – claim up to $18,550 tax free
  • Private health insurance and gym discounts
  • An Employee Assistance Program for staff and family

Apply Now: Our application process takes 10 minutes to apply, please follow the below link to start your application.

Our commitment to diversity: At Bolton Clarke we expect our staff to respect and value differences in age, disability, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, intersex status and family or marital status.

Appointment to this position and ongoing employment is subject to your commitment to supporting diversity and inclusion.

If you have any further queries, please contact Goldi Kayastha Giri (workwithus@boltonclarke.com.au)

title: Product Owner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner based in Ireland.

This role offers the opportunity to shape engaging digital products within a fast-paced and innovative iGaming environment. As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for transforming business needs into clear product initiatives and actionable development tasks. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, QA, Design, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions. The position requires a strong understanding of user needs, agile delivery, and continuous product improvement. You will play a key role in prioritizing features, optimizing workflows, and ensuring that every release creates value for both users and the business. This is a fully remote opportunity with an international team culture focused on ownership, collaboration, and growth.

Accountabilities:

As a Product Owner, you will take ownership of product execution by translating strategic objectives and business requirements into well-defined solutions that development teams can deliver effectively. You will work closely with multiple stakeholders to ensure product priorities are clear, aligned, and focused on maximizing value.

  • Own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring user stories, requirements, and development tasks are clearly defined and prioritized.
  • Translate business needs into actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and detailed tickets for engineering teams.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities to support smooth delivery and maximize product impact.
  • Investigate product challenges, analyze user behavior and performance insights, and recommend solutions to enhance the overall experience.
  • Validate requirements, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs before development begins.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, QA specialists, Designers, and business teams to align priorities and deliver high-quality features.
  • Support QA processes by ensuring delivered solutions meet business expectations and product standards.
  • Contribute to continuous product improvement by identifying opportunities for optimization and innovation.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has experience working in product roles within digital environments and is comfortable managing agile product delivery processes. You are analytical, proactive, and able to connect business goals with technical execution while collaborating effectively with diverse teams.

    • 2+ years of experience in Product Owner or similar Product roles, preferably within the iGaming industry.
    • Strong experience working with Agile development teams and product delivery frameworks.
    • Ability to transform business ideas into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and development requirements.
    • Strong problem-solving mindset with curiosity to understand user needs and identify improvement opportunities.
    • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate, challenge assumptions, and influence stakeholders.
    • Proactive ownership mindset with the ability to independently identify solutions and drive initiatives forward.
    • Experience using product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
    • Ability to analyze product performance and user behavior is a plus.
    • Experience with FullStory, BI dashboards, product analytics tools, or experimentation frameworks such as A/B testing is a plus.
    • Basic understanding of software development processes and engineering workflows is beneficial.
    • Agile certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner, or similar are considered an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working environment with flexibility to work from anywhere.
      • Schedule aligned with European working hours (10:00–18:00 CEST/CET).
      • Company-provided equipment, including laptop, headphones, and mouse.
      • Opportunities for career development, training, and professional growth.
      • Quarterly performance reviews with opportunities for recognition, salary increases, and career progression.
      • Fitness reimbursement from the start of employment.
      • Access to a health budget after one year to support personal well-being.
      • Dedicated self-development budget for courses and professional learning.
      • 22 days of annual leave, increasing by one additional day per year up to 26 days.
      • Additional birthday leave after one year of employment.

title: Undersköterska till Vardaga  Gruvan
description:
Nu söker vi på Gruvan en undersköterska till en av våra demensavdelningar. Vår verksamhet bedrivs mitt i centrala Karlstad och vi har ett härligt team på plats redo för att ta emot en ny kollega. Här får du en möjlighet att vara med och påverka det dagliga arbetet på riktigt. Vi erbjuder utbildning och flera förmåner. Är det dig vi letar efter?

Det här får du hos oss:

  • Utbildning som gör ditt arbete enklare, till exempel vårdhygien, bemötande vid demenssjukdom och ergonomi.

  • Förmånsportal med rabatter och erbjudanden.

  • En coachande och stöttande chef som jobbar tillsammans med dig i vardagen.

  • Tydliga arbetssätt och rutiner som förenklar ditt jobb.

  • Karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter.

Gruvan är ett gammalt posthus med karaktär som ligger mitt i centrala Karlstad, granne med Domkyrkan. Boendet är i tre våningar med 11 lägenheter på varje våning. Vi har en härlig takterrass som vi gärna vistas på när vädret tillåter.

  • Vi är ett demenscertifierat boende, vilket betyder att alla vi som arbetar här är utbildade i demens och bemötande via Vardagas Demensakademi.

  • Vi tillämpar grundschema som baseras på omsorgstagarens behov. Schemat är rullande om 4 veckor.

  • Du har en gruppchef som större delen av sin tid arbetar nära dig i verksamheten. Att bli gruppchef kan även vara en karriärmöjlighet för dig som undersköterska.

  • Vi jobbar hela tiden för att hitta på nya, spännande aktiviteter för våra boende. På Gruvan har vi en aktivitetspedagog anställd som håller i dagliga aktiviteter.

Som undersköterska är du oerhört viktig!

Din uppgift är att ge livskvalitet. Med hjälp av dig kan våra boende behålla sitt levnadssätt och sina vanor. Du ser varje person och tolkar vad de behöver. Samtidigt lär du dig mycket om omvårdnad, åldrande och hur man bemöter människor.

Du står närmast den boende och har därmed en nyckelroll i teamet med sjuksköterska, arbetsterapeut och fysioterapeut. Du medverkar också vid vårdplanering och skriver social dokumentation.

Din erfarenhet och kunskap

Vi söker dig som är utbildad undersköterska och har arbetat några år inom äldreomsorgen. God datorvana samt erfarenhet av dokumentation är också meriterande. Mycket goda kunskaper i det svenska språket i tal och skrift är ett krav, men i övrigt är inte ditt CV det viktigaste. Om du delar våra värderingar och har rätt egenskaper, ger vi dig stöd och möjlighet att växa.

Övrigt

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning

Omfattning: Mellan 80-100 %

Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, vi tillämpar provanställning

Tillträdes datum: Enligt överenskommelse Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-08-31 Registerkontroll: Utdrag ur belastningsregister skall uppvisas vid en eventuell anställning Har du frågor? Kontakta gärna: lina.romlin@vardaga.se Observera att det inte går att ansöka via E-post.

Facklig kontakt: Kommunal, kommunal.se

Ansökan

Välkommen att ansöka via knappen ”Skicka ansökan” nedan. Vänta inte med att ansöka då vi gör urval löpande.

Om du blir kallad till en intervju behöver du kunna styrka att du har rätt att arbeta i Sverige, genom att uppvisa att du har medborgarskap inom EU/EES eller ett giltigt arbetstillstånd.

Inbjudan till chattintervju med Hubert AI

Som ett led i vårt arbete mot en rättvis och kompetensbaserad rekryteringsprocess har vi i denna process valt att samarbete med Hubert.ai

Efter ansökan kommer du att bjudas in till in en chatt-baserad intervju med vår virtuella rekryteringsassistent Hubert.

Genomför den gärna så fort du har möjlighet. Intervjun tar cirka 15 min att slutföra.

Kolla gärna denna artikel innan intervjun för tips och tricks: https://www.hubert.ai/insights/tips-och-rad-infor-din-forsta-hubert-intervju Mer information om hur vi kommer behandla dina personuppgifter och dina rättigheter som registrerad hittar du här.

På Vardagas drygt 100 boenden runt om i Sverige erbjuder vi en äldreomsorg där varje dag är lika viktig. Hos oss möter du expertis och trygghet på varje äldreboende, korttidsboende, i hemtjänst och dagverksamhet. Vi ska vara kvalitetsledande i allt vi gör och vår vision är att göra världen lite bättre, en människa i taget. Våra medarbetare arbetar med varje individs livskvalitet och trygghet i fokus. Vardaga ingår i företagsgruppen Ambea. www.vardaga.se

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Spain.

This role offers the opportunity to design and build the foundation of an AI-native operating environment used across a global organization.
You will create scalable infrastructure that enables intelligent agents to operate reliably, securely, and transparently.
The position combines advanced AI engineering, platform development, governance, and automation to solve complex operational challenges.
You will own the architecture, execution layer, evaluation systems, and tooling required to make AI workflows trustworthy.
Working in a fully remote and highly autonomous environment, you will influence how teams adopt and benefit from AI at scale.
This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building foundational systems, solving open-ended problems, and shaping the future of AI-powered work.

Accountabilities

The AI Platform Engineer will be responsible for building and operating the infrastructure that enables reliable, measurable, and governed AI systems across the organization.

  • Design, build, and maintain the AI execution platform, including event-triggered workflows, model-agnostic runtimes, durable state management, human review processes, rollback mechanisms, and comprehensive run logging.
  • Own the architecture decisions required to bring AI agent systems into production and ensure the platform operates reliably at scale.
  • Develop the evaluation layer that determines whether AI systems are safe, accurate, and ready for production use.
  • Create golden test suites, behavioral evaluations, safety checks, and CI gates that prevent unreliable AI capabilities from being deployed.
  • Build and manage a portfolio of AI agents supporting business workflows such as reporting, drafting, analysis, triage, and knowledge management.
  • Develop meta-level systems that monitor agent performance, identify improvements, and continuously enhance the platform.
  • Implement governance mechanisms directly into the platform, including risk tiers, least-privilege permissions, tool access controls, audit logging, and human approval workflows.
  • Ensure high-risk AI actions are technically restricted through system design rather than relying only on policies or prompts.
  • Design responsible communication systems that optimize notifications, minimize interruptions, and increase user trust and adoption.
  • Build platform tooling, including validators, compilers, context distribution systems, and integrations across repositories and collaboration environments.
  • Create data pipelines and reporting systems that measure AI adoption, operational impact, maturity levels, and return on investment.
  • Instrument AI workflows to track usage, efficiency gains, costs, and measurable business value.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an experienced AI platform engineer with a strong background in production-grade AI systems, infrastructure ownership, and reliable software engineering practices.

    • Proven experience building and deploying production LLM agent systems used by real users, beyond prototypes or demonstrations.
    • Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including golden datasets, behavioral assertions, judge criteria, safety testing, and automated quality gates.
    • Experience designing and implementing reliable AI workflows where correctness, traceability, and governance are critical.
    • Deep API integration experience with business systems and experience creating MCP servers.
    • Strong infrastructure engineering skills using Python, cloud platforms such as GCP, cloud data warehouses, and infrastructure-as-code tools.
    • Ability to independently design, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production systems end to end.
    • Experience with LLM observability, tracing, cost tracking, and transforming AI execution data into actionable insights.
    • Strong understanding of security principles, access controls, permissions management, and system-level risk prevention.
    • Experience building internal platforms, developer tools, or automation systems that achieved strong adoption among non-engineering teams.
    • Strong product mindset and ability to design AI experiences that respect user attention and build trust.
    • Experience working with agentic development tools and the ability to explain workflows, permissions, approval points, logging strategies, and lessons learned from failures.
    • Public contributions such as open-source AI frameworks, MCP servers, evaluation tools, or technical writing in AI reliability are considered a strong advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.
      • Remote-first culture with coworking support through a WeWork membership or coworking allowance.
      • Employee equity ownership program.
      • Technology allowance to create an ideal home office setup with equipment of your choice.
      • Comprehensive health benefits, including full employee health insurance coverage and dependent coverage support.
      • Annual company off-site gatherings focused on collaboration, connection, and team building.
      • Flexible and asynchronous work environment built on trust and autonomy.
      • Annual professional development budget for courses, books, conferences, and learning opportunities.
      • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team across multiple countries and cultures.
      • Chance to contribute to open-source-driven products used by a large developer community.
      • High-impact role with significant ownership over AI infrastructure strategy and execution.

title: Foster Care Specialist
description:
Foster Care Specialist

  • Location: Mary Holland Campus and Servicing Area
  • Pay: $22.00+ (Experience Considered) + Eligible for 10% Bilingual Differential

About CSI

Our story begins in Omaha in 1892, when, due to epidemics, poverty and the difficulties of pioneer life, many children were left in need of parental care. CSI met the need in a revolutionary way – putting the well-being of children first and working to be a voice for the voiceless. We seek to champion children and families by providing the mental, emotional and physical spaces they need to feel empowered and to thrive. Child Saving Institute is looking for someone who has a mind full of wonder and a heart-filled desire to make a difference! We’re on a mission to champion what’s best for each child and family.

About the Role

In the community-based program foster care role you provide direct support, case management, and community-based services to foster families and the children placed in their care. This role works in home-, school-, and community-based settings and is expected to flex across multiple CSI foster care and community-based programs in Iowa, Nebraska, or other states as program needs require. The Specialist's primary role is to support placement stability, coordinate services, and connect foster families and children with the resources needed for long-term success.

Essential Job Duties:

    • Provide home-, school-, and/or community-based support to foster families and children, with a minimum of 50% of time spent in direct service provision.
    • Conduct regular home visits to monitor placement stability, safety, and the well-being of children in foster care.
    • Complete case notes, service plans, and home visit reports in accordance with agency protocol and applicable state licensing/regulatory requirements (e.g., Iowa DHS, Nebraska DHHS).
    • Coordinate with case managers, courts, biological families, schools, and other service providers to support permanency planning and advocate on behalf of children and families.
    • Assist foster families in accessing training, respite, and community resources; help build informal support systems.
    • Participate in team meetings, court hearings, and permanency planning meetings as needed.
    • Respond to placement disruptions or crises and provide crisis intervention and stabilization support.
    • Support foster family recruitment and retention efforts as assigned.
    • Travel across program sites and, as assigned, across state lines to provide coverage and support to multiple CSI programs.
    • Collect statistics and implement quality improvement procedures as defined by program assignment.

Other Duties:

    • Drive to and from appointments and home visits across the assigned service area, including travel between states as program needs require.
    • Participate in supervision sessions as required.
    • Complete all training necessary to perform the position, including any state-specific foster care training or certification requirements.
    • Show flexibility regarding work schedule (to be determined by supervisor). Evening and weekend work is required.
    • Facilitate a team atmosphere by working in partnership with staff across multiple programs and states.
    • Represent the agency and programs in a positive manner to clients, foster families, community organizations, and the public in general.
    • Plan, organize, and support trainings for foster families as assigned.
    • Other tasks as assigned.

Job Requirements:

    • Bachelor's degree in social work or related field. Lived experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
    • A minimum of one year's experience in Human Services or foster care preferred.
    • Minimum age of 21 years.
    • Basic computer skills, including ability to effectively use an electronic client and other databases.
    • Required knowledge of and skills in: the child welfare and foster care system, permanency planning, trauma-informed care, family functioning, and child development.
    • Working knowledge of foster care licensing and regulatory requirements across multiple states, or demonstrated ability to quickly learn state-specific requirements.
    • Ability to work autonomously and make appropriate decisions in crisis situations.
    • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
    • Ability and willingness to travel regularly between multiple states as program needs require.

Vehicle Requirements:

    • Own transportation that meets agency vehicle inspection requirements.
    • Valid driver's license with no more than 6 points.
    • Proof of insurance that meets agency requirements.

Environment:

title: UX Designer - Infrastructure
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX Designer - Infrastructure based in Portugal.

This role offers the opportunity to design intuitive experiences for complex open-source infrastructure products used by organizations worldwide.
You will work at the intersection of user experience, technology, and engineering to simplify advanced cloud and data center solutions.
The position combines UX strategy, research, design systems, and close collaboration with technical teams.
You will help shape tools that enable organizations to build, manage, and scale modern infrastructure environments.
Working in a globally distributed team, you will contribute to products that influence the future of enterprise technology and open-source innovation.
This opportunity is ideal for a technically curious designer who enjoys solving complex problems and creating impactful user experiences.

Accountabilities

The UX Designer will be responsible for creating user-centered experiences for infrastructure products while collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to improve usability, consistency, and overall product quality.

  • Design intuitive workflows and interfaces for complex infrastructure tools used to build and manage cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define product direction and improve user experiences.
  • Apply UX research methods, usability principles, and design heuristics to solve complex product challenges.
  • Translate technical complexity into clear, efficient, and accessible user experiences.
  • Contribute to the evolution and adoption of design systems that improve consistency across products.
  • Understand broader product ecosystems, technical constraints, and user needs to make informed design decisions.
  • Support cross-functional design initiatives and contribute to shared design practices across teams.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles and help improve design maturity throughout the organization.
  • Conduct user research, gather insights, and incorporate feedback into product improvements.
  • Communicate design concepts clearly to engineers, designers, executives, and other stakeholders.
  • Stay informed about emerging UX trends, research methods, and innovative design approaches.
  • Participate in international team gatherings and collaborative sessions to align on strategy and execution.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a technically minded UX professional with strong communication skills, a passion for technology, and experience designing solutions for complex products.

    • Strong knowledge and passion for user experience, product design, and technology.
    • Experience designing digital products, especially complex platforms, developer tools, enterprise applications, or technical products.
    • Ability to conduct user research and apply insights to improve product decisions.
    • Strong understanding of UX methodologies, design principles, and usability best practices.
    • Experience creating and maintaining design systems or reusable design patterns.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, designers, and leadership teams.
    • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain and defend design decisions clearly.
    • Curiosity, adaptability, and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
    • Interest in working with real technology, infrastructure, and technically complex environments.
    • Ability to think strategically while maintaining attention to detail and execution quality.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in User Experience, Design, STEM, or a related field is preferred, though alternative career paths are considered.
    • Ability and willingness to travel internationally several times per year for company events.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position with the flexibility to work from home.
      • Global and distributed work environment with regular in-person team gatherings.
      • Annual personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000.
      • Annual compensation reviews based on performance and market conditions.

      • Recognition and rewards programs.
      • Paid annual holiday leave.
      • Maternity and paternity leave support.

title: Dokumentalist til Rigsarkivet i København
description:
Synes du, at det er spændende at gå på jagt i arkiver? Vil du være med til at sikre borgernes ret til indsigt i egne personoplysninger? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Dokumentationsenheden på Rigsarkivet i København.

Om Rigsarkivet

Med næsten 1000 års analog og digital samfundsdokumentation er Rigsarkivet Danmarks hukommelse og videncenter for det danske samfunds udvikling. Vi indsamler, bevarer og leverer originale dokumenter og data, der understøtter videns- og retssamfundets behov og skaber nye indsigter og forståelser af vores samfund. I Rigsarkivet bliver du del af en ambitiøs og moderne organisation. I tæt samarbejde med vores brugere arbejder vi kontinuerligt på at være en vigtig spiller i den offentlige digitale infrastruktur, så vores store mængde data skaber størst mulig værdi for borgere, forskere, virksomheder og offentlige myndigheder.

Jobbet
Du bliver en del af Rigsarkivets Dokumentationsenhed, der består af 23 engagerede medarbejdere fordelt på fire adresser i København, Odense, Viborg og Aabenraa.

I Dokumentationsenheden løser vi sager vedr. tidlig pension og borgernes ret til indsigt i oplysninger om dem selv i henhold til egenacces-bestemmelserne i arkivloven.

Dine opgaver bliver at identificere oplysninger i Rigsarkivets samlinger om borgere til borgere, som har begæret indsigt i oplysninger om dem selv. Du vil få en grundig oplæring, og du vil have mulighed for løbende sparring med dygtige kolleger.

Om dig
Vi lægger ikke så meget vægt på, hvilken uddannelsesmæssig baggrund du har, som på dine faglige kvalifikationer. Du kan navigere i Rigsarkivets samlinger og læse håndskrevne materialer, eller ønsker at lære det. Du har erfaring med forvaltningsopgaver, offentlig sagsbehandling og erfaring med borgerkontakt.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til databeskyttelsesreglerne, herunder GDPR. Det er ligeledes fordelagtigt, at du har erfaring med Rigsarkivets systemer, fx Daisy.

Du har en struktureret og selvstændig tilgang og bruger dine faglige evner til at sikre en hurtig, korrekt og effektiv sagsbehandling. Du sætter pris på humor og åben kommunikation i hverdagen.

Om os

Vi har en god holdånd i Dokumentationsenheden, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af de fire lokationer i henholdsvis København, Odense, Aabenraa og Viborg. Møder foregår delvis fysisk, delvis online.

Vi har en venlig og uformel omgangstone, og sparring og humor er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Din faglige udvikling sikrer vi gennem samarbejde og sparring med hjælpsomme kollegaer.

Vi har til huse centralt i København med Hovedbanegården lige om hjørnet. Hos os betyder tilstedeværelse sammen med vores kollegaer meget, og vi mener, at samarbejde og videndeling på tværs af Rigsarkivet er afgørende for et godt arbejdsmiljø. Samtidig vil vi gerne sikre fleksibilitet for vores medarbejdere, og hjemmearbejde aftales løbende mellem chef og medarbejder, når det er foreneligt med opgavevaretagelsen.

Det er vigtigt for os, at du får en god start i Rigsarkivet. De første uger er der lagt et introduktions-program, hvor du får rig mulighed for at lære dine nye kollegaer og organisationen at kende samt komme godt i gang med dine arbejdsopgaver.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Du ansættes som dokumentalist i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og OAO-s og HK/Stat med indplacering i løngruppe 3, sats 1. Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitlig 37 timer om ugen. Vi har fleksible arbejdstider og vægter, at arbejds- og privatliv hænger godt sammen.

Arbejdsstedet er Rigsarkivet i København, Kalvebod Brygge 34, 1560 København.

Jobbet ønskes besat pr. 1. november 2026. Der er tale om en fast stilling.

Vi indhenter straffeattest.

Din ansøgning
Send en motiveret ansøgning, CV og dokumentation for relevant uddannelse og erfaring via Rigsarkivets rekrutteringssystem. Du bliver guidet igennem rekrutteringsprocessen, når du trykker ’Søg stillingen’ nederst på denne side.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 25. august. Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 37.

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte enhedschef Katrine Tovgaard-Olsen på 41 71 73 02.

Du kan også læse mere om Rigsarkivet på .

Rigsarkivet tilstræber at få så bred en sammensætning af medarbejdere som muligt. Derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset personlig baggrund til at søge.

title: Investment Reporting - Analyst / Associate
description:
About the Role

iCapital is looking for an Analyst / Associate to join the Investment Reporting team. Join a high-performing investment reporting team responsible for delivering accurate, insightful, and timely quarterly reporting across private equity, real estate, secondary, credit fund-of-funds, and feeder fund strategies. This role offers exposure to institutional clients, underlying fund sponsors, portfolio company performance, valuation drivers, and cross-functional reporting workflows.

  • Prepare and review quarterly fund-level client reporting for private equity, real estate, secondary, credit fund-of-funds, and feeder fund vehicles under management.
  • Review, interpret, and synthesize reporting materials from underlying private markets sponsors, translating key investment updates into clear client-facing performance commentary.
  • Analyze fund and portfolio company performance data, including valuation movements, performance drivers, capital activity, and portfolio developments for inclusion in investor reports.
  • Partner with fund administrators and internal stakeholders to validate quantitative reporting data and ensure consistency, accuracy, and completeness across client materials.
  • Coordinate internal compliance review and approval processes to support timely and controlled report distribution.
  • Ensure quarterly reports and related investor communications are delivered on schedule to clients, relationship managers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Draft clear and professional capital call and distribution notices for investors.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with underlying sponsors to monitor portfolio company activity, valuation developments, and relevant fund updates.
  • Support periodic investment portfolio and valuation reviews in collaboration with investment, operations, and reporting teams.
  • Act as a private markets product specialist for relationship managers and clients, responding to questions on fund performance, capital calls, distributions, and other fund-related activity.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in investment reporting, investor communications, fund operations, private equity, hedge funds, real estate, credit, or a related financial services environment; strong recent graduates with relevant internship or academic experience will also be considered.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex investment and performance information into clear, polished, client-facing content.
  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with financial data, fund performance metrics, and portfolio company information.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; strong Excel skills and experience manipulating, reviewing, and presenting data are highly valued.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within tight reporting deadlines.
  • Proactive problem-solver with strong ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to take initiative in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated professional who wants to build deep private markets expertise, gain exposure to institutional-quality investor reporting, and contribute to a collaborative team supporting sophisticated investment products.

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office 4 days a week with the flexibility to work remotely 1 day ( Friday).

title: Sairaanhoitaja (määräaikainen), Provesta Petäjä ja Provesta Honka, Kempele
description:
Sairaanhoitaja (määräaikainen), Provesta Petäjä ja Provesta Honka, Kempele

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme kotia, joka tekee huomisesta paremman!

Haemme sairaanhoitajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 10.8.2026-31.7.2027 Kempeleessä sijaitseviin toimintayksikköihimme mielenterveyskuntoutujien sekä kehitysvammaisten asiakkaiden asumispalveluihin.

Sairaanhoitajana huolehdit asukkaiden hyvinvoinnista, lääkehoidon toteuttamisesta sekä voinnin arvioinnista. Arjen työ on liikkuvaa ja monipuolista. Teet työssäsi asiakkaiden kokonaisvaltaista arjen ohjausta ja elämän tukemista asiakkaan omassa kodissa, yksikössä yhteisissä tiloissa ja asioinneissa yksikön ulkopuolella. Tuot myös aktiivisesti ajankohtaista tietoa työyhteisön käyttöön mielenterveystyöstä, kuntoutuksesta ja kehitysvammaisten asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä.

Olet koulutukseltasi sairaanhoitaja (AMK). Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta tiimityöskentelystä ja omaat osaamista mielenterveyskuntoutujien tai kehitysvammaisten asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä. Tiimissämme viihtyy positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva, huumorintajuinen, oma-aloitteinen ja asiakkaiden ja työyhteisön hyvän kohtaamisen omaava kuntoutuksen ammattilainen. Neuvomme ja opastamme sinua mielellämme työssäsi ja tuemme toisiamme.

Työ on kaksivuorotyötä ja työvuorot ovat pääsääntöisesti arkisin. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja määräaikainen ajalla 10.8.2026-31.7.2027. Sairaanhoitajan tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukainen.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitetturikosrekisteriote.

Haethan tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Toimithan nopeasti, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:
Minna Värttö Yksikön esihenkilö Provesta Honka
puh. 040 823 2354 (arkisin klo 8–16)
minna.vartto@mehilainen.fi

Koti, joka tekee huomisesta paremman.

Ykköskodeissa tarjoamme yksilöllistä kuntoutusta ja kodin, josta voi ponnistaa jälleen kohti itsenäisempää elämää. Tarjoamme tukea tarvitsevalle kodin, jossa häntä autetaan kuntoutumaan ja saamaan ote itsenäisestä elämästä. Toimintamme keskiössä on laadukas hoito ja tuki, joita ohjaavat asukkaan yksilölliset tarpeet, toiveet sekä kuntoutuspolku, jota kuljemme yhdessä hänen kanssaan.

Ykköskodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja hyvinvointialueasiakkaidemme hyväksi. Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

title: Creative Director
description:
About Ogilvy

Ogilvy, part of WPP, was founded in 1948 by David Ogilvy. David created a culture that deeply respects and cares about its people and clients. Our mission is to inspire people and brands to make an impact and we are committed to attracting, growing, and retaining the best talent in the industry.

Ogilvy Health UK is made up of healthcare communication specialists across the disciplines of medical education and communications; brain sciences; brand promotion; digital and social; strategic planning; public relations; and creative/design. We believe we are like no other: we blaze new trails; we encourage a culture of creativity and innovation; we challenge, and we change; and we recognise and reward our team.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit .

Ogilvy Health is seeking a Creative Director with a strong art direction background to lead creative work on key accounts within our healthcare portfolio. This individual will balance hands-on creative leadership with team development, ensuring both exceptional work and a thriving creative culture.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Leadership

  • Own and drive creative direction across key accounts, ensuring big, effective ideas that meet client and patient/HCP needs
  • Bring strong conceptual thinking to every brief—pushing beyond the expected to deliver work that's both strategically sound and creatively distinctive
  • Maintain hands-on involvement in art direction, from concept through execution, across digital, print, and campaign work

Team Development

  • Mentor and grow art directors, designers, and copywriters on the team
  • Foster a collaborative, high-standards creative environment
  • Provide constructive feedback and creative direction that elevates the work and the people making it

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Client Service to align creative solutions with business objectives and timelines
  • Work hand-in-hand with Strategy to ensure ideas are rooted in insight and built to perform
  • Present and defend creative concepts confidently to clients and internal stakeholders

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in advertising/agency creative roles, with proven experience as an Art Director progressing into creative leadership
  • Healthcare/pharma experience preferred (HCP and/or DTC)
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual and visual storytelling ability
  • Experience managing and developing junior creative talent
  • Excellent collaborator who thrives in cross-functional, client-facing environments
  • Comfortable navigating regulatory/compliance considerations inherent to healthcare marketing

How We’ll Support You

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.

Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.

We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. For us, diversity, equity and inclusion is integrated into everything that we do. We believe that for creativity to flourish, everything about how we work must have diversity at its core. Your race, colour, ethnic, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, have no bearing on our hiring decisions, but we encourage everyone to feel free to express their true selves in an environment we are consistently striving to make as inclusive as possible.

We aim to facilitate an accessible and positive application experience for all candidates. If you require any adjustments from us to support you through the process or expect to require any adjustments to working conditions to be able to best perform in the role, please let us know. We are happy to consider all reasonable adjustments.

If you live with a disability and you would like to take advantage of our offer of a guaranteed interview under the Disability Confident Scheme, please ensure you fill out our voluntary Equal Opportunities Questionnaire when applying.

title: IT LAB Team Leader (7년 이상)
description:
About

IT LAB은 빠른 실행과 혁신을 지향하는 소수 정예 기술 조직으로서, JYP의 DX (Digital Transformation) 및 AX (AI Transformation) 전략을 주도합니다. 전사 각 부서와 긴밀히 협력하며 업무 프로세스의 비효율을 개선하고, 기술의 사업적 활용 방안을 함께 논의합니다. 나아가, 그 전략을 직접 설계하고 실행함으로써 JYP의 미래 성장을 견인합니다. IT LAB은 글로벌 성장에 걸맞은 엔터테인먼트와 기술의 시너지를 창출하며, 창의성과 논리성의 균형 속에서 새로운 가치를 만들어가는 조직입니다.

IT LAB Team Leader는 '위'보다는 '앞'에 서서 기술 조직을 이끄는 리더입니다. CTO와 긴밀히 협업하며 직원/아티스트 대상 내부 서비스 개선 및 확장 방향성을 논의하고, 전사적 업무 프로세스의 생산성을 높이기 위해 지속적으로 노력합니다. 기술 경력뿐 아니라 뛰어난 대인관계 스킬을 요구하는 포지션으로, 팀 내 기획자/디자이너/개발자 등 전문 인력들과 수시로 소통하며 그들의 조직 기여도를 최대화하고 개인적 성장을 돕습니다.

Responsibilities

- 중장기적으로 내부 서비스의 안정성/확장성/효율성을 지속적으로 강화하기 위한 기술 로드맵 수립 및 수행
- 리더십과 지속적으로 대화하며 전사 사업 방향성과 align된 기술 전략 설정 및 새로운 Initiative 제안
- 사내 다양한 유관 부서와 교류하며 업무 프로세스에 대한 기술적 솔루션 제시
- 정교한 피드백과 멘토링을 통한 구성원 성장 지원 및 조직 임팩트 극대화

Requirements

- 개발 경력 7년 이상, 또는 컴퓨터 공학 연관 전공자
- 우수한 논리적/입체적 사고력, 문제 추상화 능력 보유자
- 제품의 기획부터 개발, 운영까지 모든 사이클을 관리해 본 경험 보유자
- 새로운 기술 트렌드를 지속적으로 연구하고, 이를 시스템에 공격적으로 적용할 수 있는 역량
- 수동적인 업무 수행을 지양하고, 항상 '왜?'에 대해 고민하며 더 나은 '코드 추상화'를 도모하는 태도
