title: Product Manager - Institutional API & Digital Asset Accounts
description:
About us:

Luno has spent over a decade making digital assets safe to own. Since 2013, we've helped millions of people across more than 40 countries buy, store and invest in crypto, working with regulators in every market and holding all customer crypto 1:1. That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on

The financial system is moving on-chain, and the businesses, banks and payment companies in our markets need infrastructure they can trust. Luno is building institutional access, wallet and account infrastructure, and local-currency stablecoin issuance on the same rails that have served retail customers for twelve years.

About the team

You'll join the Institutional Access & Issuance portfolio, leading the pod that builds Luno as a Service — the B2B infrastructure layer that lets any business serve its own customers on Luno's rails, with or without a direct relationship between Luno and those end customers. You'll report to the Group Product Manager and work with dedicated engineering and UX partners.

The role in a nutshell:

You will own the infrastructure layer that lets any business serve its own customers on Luno’s rails. Partners keep their brand, their interface and their customer relationship; underneath runs the custody, settlement and compliance machinery Luno has designed. One build carries three commercial motions: direct institutional customers, group business lines consuming the API as clients, and B2B partners embedding digital asset accounts into their own products. This is an externally facing role: your customers are the partners and institutions integrating against what you ship, and their developers will judge your product by its API surface.

Your mission will be:

  • The institutional API end-to-end: client account creation and management, wallet management, mint/burn exposure, yield distribution logic, and reporting, through one coherent, sellable surface
  • Digital asset accounts: accounts a partner operates for their customers at scale, without those customers needing a direct Luno relationship
  • The platform primitives underneath: organisations, users, permissions and subaccounts from partner to client to end user, plus usage metering and attribution as a first-class capability, not an afterthought
  • Run partner integrations as a product discipline: from commercial framing through technical scoping to go-live, with the first consumers of the API treated as design partners
  • Commercial packaging and pricing: working with commercial teams to build a recurring B2B infrastructure revenue line: API access, wallet fees, transaction fees.
  • Sequence the roadmap so the infrastructure serves every consumer: what ships for the first partner must also carry the direct institutional experience built on top of it

A little about you:

  • You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with meaningful time on platform or API products in fintech, crypto or B2B infrastructure
  • You are technically fluent: you can debate an API design, an authentication model or an account hierarchy with engineers and hold your own
  • You think in primitives and consumers: you can design one capability so that several products, partners and business lines can build on it without rework
  • You've run B2B partner integrations directly — commercial conversation through technical scoping to go-live — and you treat developer experience as the product, not a wrapper around it
  • You have strong commercial instincts: pricing, packaging and unit economics are part of how you define the product, not something handed over afterwards
  • You understand digital asset infrastructure - custody, wallets, on/off-chain settlement - or have the demonstrated ability to learn regulated financial infrastructure fast
  • You use AI as part of how you work, in discovery, analysis, writing and prototyping, and you can show where it's changed your output, not just your tooling

Life at Luno:

  • Remote but reachable work policy gives you the freedom to choose between working from home or the office.
  • Plus the option to buy and sell up to 5 days leave
  • Improve body and mind, with excellent private medical insurance
  • Access to Learnably and our additional learning platforms for your personal and professional development
  • 6 months primary caregiver leave
  • Paw-ternity leave for your furry friend
  • Annual Inspiration Day, in addition to your annual leave which increases based on your length of service!
  • A collaborative, friendly work community, with regular social events and virtual cooking, dancing, drawing and house planting classes hosted by our Lunauts
  • Free lunch and snacks
  • 0 fees up to a certain amount with Luno from the day you start.*

*Offer only available on Luno Instant Buy, not Luno Exchange

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Java Developer (replacement) Allianz (K2)
description:
Forma współpracy: kontrakt B2B

Stawka (B2B PLN netto + VAT/h): 120-140

Tryb: zdalny

Poszukujemy osoby o profilu Java Developer, która posiada min. 4 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia.

Wiodący stack technologiczny: Java 17, Spring Boot, Angular (mile widziany), REST API, Architektura Mikroserwisowa, Oracle Database, Git, Maven, JUnit, Agile/Scrum

Projekt który będziemy gotowi Ci zaproponować dotyczy rozwoju i utrzymaniu produktu ubezpieczeń na życie, zapewniającego kompleksową ochronę życia i zdrowia klientów. Rozwiązanie wspiera pełny cykl obsługi produktów ubezpieczeniowych, od kalkulacji składki i oceny ryzyka, przez zawarcie oraz obsługę polis, aż po procesy związane z likwidacją roszczeń.

Wymagania:

  • Minimum 4 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w programowaniu w Java.
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość Java 17 oraz Spring Boot.
  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i rozwoju aplikacji opartych o architekturę mikroserwisową.
  • Praktyczna znajomość REST API oraz relacyjnych baz danych (Oracle).
  • Umiejętność tworzenia wysokiej jakości, skalowalnego i łatwego w utrzymaniu kodu.
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z systemami zintegrowanymi oraz w środowisku Agile/Scrum.
  • Gotowość do pracy z Angular lub chęć rozwijania kompetencji w tym obszarze (znajomość Angular będzie dodatkowym atutem).

Współpracując z naszą organizacją będziesz mógł/mogła liczyć na:

  • Ugruntowaną pozycją rynkową
  • Projekty, w których będziesz miał/miała wpływ na ich rozwój
  • Współpracę z atrakcyjnymi klientami biznesowymi z różnych branż (m.in.: finanse, bankowość, ubezpieczenia, healthcare, robotyzacja, energetyka, media)
  • Bieżące informacje projektowe oraz stały dostęp do dokumentacji niezbędnej do realizacji zadań (np. Git, Gitflow, Angular, Docker, Primaris x TechTalks, Primaris Leadership Academy)
  • Świetną atmosferę współpracy podczas realizacji projektów wśród zaangażowanych ludzi z pasją

Cały proces nawiązywania współpracy oraz onboarding prowadzony jest zdalnie.

Proces nawiązywania współpracy składa się z:

  • rozmowy telefonicznej (do 30 min)
  • zdalnej video rozmowy - weryfikacji techniczno-biznesowej z naszym specjalistą/specjalistką (60-90 min)
  • zdalnego spotkania z Product Owner projektu (30-60 min)

Primaris Services to ponad 250 ekspertów na pokładzie i 15 lat doświadczenia w branży IT na rynku polskim oraz zagranicznym. Realizujemy ambitne projekty o wysokiej złożoności z różnych obszarów - m.in. bankowości, ubezpieczeń, healthcare, robotyzacji, energetyki, mediów (mamy ponad 40 aktywnych klientów). Rośniemy w siłę oraz ciągle poszerzamy portfolio zarówno naszych usług jak i klientów.
Zakres naszej działalności obejmuje budowę systemów od zera, ich rozwój oraz utrzymanie, wdrożenia produktowe, alokacje całych Zespołów, a także pojedynczych Ekspertów w strukturach Klienta.
Ponadto od kilku lat działamy bardzo intensywnie jako złoty Partner firmy UiPath (obszar Robotic Process Automation) budując roboty i sprzedając licencje u naszych Klientów. Co miesiąc nawiązujemy współpracę z 7 nowymi osobami. Wierzymy, że ludzie z pasją to klucz do naszego wspólnego sukcesu! Właśnie dlatego ciągle poszukujemy nowych, zdolnych osób, które powiększą grono naszych współpracowników.

title: GRA Clerk
description:
BE PART OF THE WORLD’S LARGEST LOGISTICS COMPANY

Deutsche Post DHL Group is the world’s leading logistics and mail company.

We’re one of the world’s largest employers, operating in over 220 countries and territories. We’re Europe’s largest postal service, partner for eCommerce and pioneers in secure digital communication. We’re number one in contract logistics and international express delivery, and a leader in the forwarding business.

Join us and you’ll be working for a global company that’s focused on service, quality, and sustainability, and using the power of global trade to connect people and improve lives.

And not just for our customers, but for every member of our Group too.

At DHL Supply Chain South Africa, we’re looking for…

GRA Clerk

Job Purpose:

To manage and control duties to agreed levels of performance and to contribute to the continuous improvement of the inventory process. To co-ordinate functions in order to maximise utilisation - productivity and customer service. Service delivery - on time & in full - accurately. Ensure customer service is the highest standard and that losses to the company are kept to a minimum. To always maintain the integrity of the company. To adhere to inventory processes whilst ensuring all Health and Safety, Legal and Security requirements are met. To comply with the standard operating procedures of the goods receiving function and KPI measures in place. Perform administrative tasks in line with operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform administrative tasks in line with relative SOP
  • Extract and report submission for outstanding POD’s and comments of received POD’s to be processed on report. (Submission to be done by 10am)
  • Report on outstanding RSO’s.
  • Daily report of POD’s received from customers/transporters (to track if POD’s are received as from other parties as per agreement).
  • Send report for heat logs (to keep track of credits not yet processed).
  • Check documents in against exit documents - advise transport department of any missing invoices.
  • Investigate with transport department of any missing invoices
  • Reconcile returns/uplifts to tally sheets and record forced uplifts - allocate reason codes for returned stock.
  • Process returns /uplifts into the system accurately according to the relevant SOP, within 24hrs
  • Process POD’s daily.
  • Attend to customer queries and requests. Adhere to 72-hour resolution for customer query. If not resolved escalate to superior.
  • Process credits daily. If no feedback provided in 24 hours escalate to superior.
  • Audit, file and scan all POD’s processed for the day and upload to Oculus or any customer POD potals
  • Send end of day report for processed, audit and filed and POD’s awaiting for heat logs.
  • Audit and filing report sent to document storage supplier and request for box collection once or twice a week.
  • Meeting of KPI’s (POD’s on RSO and Outstanding reports for more than 14 days to be cleared)
  • All POD’s outstanding to be investigated and requested from the relevant parties. Include management and supervisor.
  • If POD’s not received in time request from Transporters and/or backdoor checking suppliers to avoid not adhering to KPI’s.
  • Retrieval of invoices from the Creeds portal
  • RSO clean up and Uplift clean up in Pride/TOMS gets done weekly.
  • Processing on TOMS
  • Keep the damages cage neat and ensure frequent processing of return orders.
  • Ability to control and manage debrief and returns process

Qualifications & Experience

  • Accuracy - consistency in output
  • Understand and communicate with all external customers, understand their requirements and needs
  • Ability and Flexibility to work shifts and overtime when required
  • Ability to work within a rapidly changing environment
  • Assist with other ad-hoc duties and administration function
  • Works in conjunction with all departments.
  • The incumbent is a Company representative and must at all times conduct themselves accordingly
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Ability to build relationships
  • Analysis and problem-solving ability
  • Ability to handle confrontational situations and demonstrate fairness

DPDHL Core Competencies & Skills

  • Maintains effective relationships with customers
  • Develops and delivers high quality / innovative products, services or solutions
  • Focuses on customer needs and gains their commitment
  • Gains management / colleague support to meet customer needs
  • Ensures strategies / plans are aligned and reflect other’s views
  • Develop strategies / plans aligned to broader organizational strategy
  • Communicates strategy
  • Establishes clear, challenging and achievable objectives
  • Aligns resources and the organization within own area of responsibility to achieve objectives
  • Regularly reviews and communicates progress against objectives and adjusts as needed
  • Champions continuous improvement and innovation
  • Inspires results and respect by empowerment, accountability recognition and rewards recognizing the contribution of others
  • Provides employees, colleagues and business partners with candid and regular feedback
  • Provides employees with development opportunities
  • Supports employees with career opportunities
  • Inspires others to develop themselves
  • Conveys a clear sense of personal goals and values
  • Actively seeks feedback to improve performance
  • Develop new skills and modifies behaviors based on feedback
  • Takes personal responsibility for career and development

Languages

· English - verbal and written.

title: starszy specjalista compliance
description:
To masz na bank:

  • Umowa o pracę (pierwsza na 12 miesięcy)

  • Lokalizacja: praca hybrydowa w biurze w Warszawie (ul. Aleja Jana Pawła II 17), w biurze we Wrocławiu (ul. Robotnicza 11) lub w Poznaniu (ul. Kolorowa 10)

  • Zespół/Lider: Departament Zapewniania Zgodności, Jarosław Kaszyk - menedżer Zespołu Doradztwa Komercjalizacji - Bankowość korporacyjna, śmiało sprawdź z kim możesz pracować: Jarosław Kaszyk | LinkedIn

  • Cel pracy: Nadzór nad zgodnością procesów w bankowości korporacyjnej i inwestycyjnej.Doradztwo compliance i analiza ryzyka jako element drugiej linii obrony.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym. Choć jesteśmy zupełnie różni to mamy jeden cel – wszystko robimy na bank. Mamy też możliwość integracji z innymi pracownikami np. dzięki ponad 20 Klubom Zainteresowań. Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • Nadzór nad zgodnością procesów w bankowości korporacyjnej i inwestycyjnej

  • Doradztwo compliance i analiza ryzyka jako element drugiej linii obrony

  • Analiza i ocena ryzyk niefinansowych, w tym reputacyjnych, dla klientów, transakcji i działań wizerunkowych

  • Przygotowywanie uzasadnień eksperckich oraz opinii compliance i rekomendacji dla biznesu

  • Współpraca z jednostkami biznesowymi przy analizie planowanych transakcji

  • Identyfikacja błędów, nieprawidłowości i słabości kontrolnych

  • Wsparcie monitoringu klientów i transakcji

  • Ocena transakcji pod kątem ryzyka reputacyjnego i greenwashingu

  • Współpraca z zespołem ESG (opinie, treści www, wsparcie raportowania CSRD)

  • Raportowanie w sposób syntetyczny i dostosowany do odbiorcy

  • Przygotowywanie materiałów wizualnych oraz prowadzenie szkoleń wewnętrznych

  • Wspieranie procesów komórki zgodności

  • Tworzenie i rozwój narzędzi wspierających pracę (workflow, automatyzacja)

  • Analiza operacyjna i identyfikacja obszarów do poprawy

Aplikuj do nas, jeśli:

  • Masz min. 3 lata doświadczenia w sektorze bankowym lub usługach finansowych, w obszarze compliance lub oceny ryzyk niefinansowych

  • Posiadasz wykształcenie wyższe (preferowane: bankowość, prawo, ekonomia, administracja)

  • Posiadasz wiedzę z zakresu CSRD, Taksonomii UE oraz zagadnień zrównoważonego finansowania

  • Potrafisz łączyć perspektywę regulacyjną, procesową i ryzyka compliance w środowisku bankowym

  • Posługujesz się językiem angielskim na poziomie zaawansowanym

  • Dobrze zarządzasz priorytetami i terminowo realizujesz zadania

  • Potrafisz myśleć krytycznie i przeprowadzać kompleksowe analizy

  • Umiesz formułować obiektywne wnioski i rekomendacje

  • Sprawnie współpracujesz z różnymi interesariuszami

  • Masz doświadczenie w pracy w rozproszonym zespole i znasz zwinne metody pracy

  • Bardzo dobrze posługujesz się pakietem MS Office (w szczególności MS Word i Excel).

Mile widziane:

  • Znajomość MiFID.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę

  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym w (lokalizacja na początku oferty)

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego)

  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego

  • kartę Multisport

  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach;

  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku

  • wyprawkę dla dzieci

  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala

  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań

  • przez początkowy okres pracy będzie towarzyszył Ci Buddy, który pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania.

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach:

1. wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu.

2. spotkaj się (online) z rekruterem/-ką i managerem/-ką.

3. pracuj z nami w naszym zespole!.

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania.

Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: LVI-eristäjä, Päijät-Häme
description:
Etsimme LVI-eristäjää asikkaallemme suorarekryllä!

Etsitkö vakaata ja hyvää työpaikkaa, jossa pääset tekemään mielenkiintoisia LVI-eristäjän töitä teollisuudessa?

Asiakkaamme etsii itsenäiseen työhön pystyvää LVI-eristäjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työsuhde solmitaan suoraan asiakkaan kanssa.


Toimeksiantajamme on vakavarainen jo yli 30-vuotta toiminut yritys joka tarjoaa mm. teollisuuserityksiä kemian,- elintarvike- ja prosessiteollisuuteen sekä energiatuotantoon.

Tehtävän kuvaus

LVI-eristyksien tekoa teollisuudessa Päijät-Hämeen alueella.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* LVI-alan koulutus - työ on vastuullista ja peruskoulutuksen pitää olla kunnossa.
* Kokemusta karttunut LVI-eristyksistä ja plussana kokemus teollisuudesta - etsimme ammattilaista, jolta asiat sujuvat eikä tarvitse olla vahtimassa
* Voimassa olevat ammattikortit (työturvallisuuskortti)- jos ei ole, niin asia on hoidettava kuntoon ennen töiden aloitusta.
* Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
* Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
* Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, etta tyosopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tarkeaa, etta viihdyt tyossasi.

Asiakasyritykseltä saat tässä tehtävässä:

* Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan (voit liittää hakemukseen palkkatoiveen)
* Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen suoraan asiakasyrityksessä

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain järjestelmässä tehdyt hakemukset. Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaaville henkilöille sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteisiin Lilli Mäyrä / lilli.mayra(at)visiohr.fi. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Päijät-Hämeessä työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Lahdesta käsin Ville, JP ja Lilli.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Päijät-Häme on osa Visio Henkilostoratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilostopalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua pelia ja tarjoamme toita niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyo perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

title: Workplace Experience Coordinator
description:
About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

About the Role

We're looking for a Workplace Experience Coordinator to join our Facilities team in Prague - Emplifi's largest global hub. This is not a traditional facilities role. You'll be a business partner who owns the day-to-day experience of 100+ people: anticipating problems before they surface, keeping the office running seamlessly, and making Prague a place people are genuinely proud to work in.

What You'll Do Here

Prague Office Operations (Local Ownership)

  • Daily Excellence: Ensure the Prague office is a functional, safe, and inspiring
    environment for our teams
  • Reception Coordination: Coordinate reception activities when required, including managing deliveries and incoming mail, handling postal services and post office visits as required, welcoming and assisting visitors, and ensuring meeting rooms are prepared with refreshments for guests
  • Building & Facility Coordination: Liaise with building management, main reception, maintenance staff, and other facility service providers to support smooth office operations
  • Vendor Management & Transitions: Manage and coordinate external service
    providers, support the team in switching or auditing vendors to ensure the best value for the company
  • Health & Safety: Maintain local H&S standards, fire safety protocols, and ensure all office equipment is regularly serviced
  • Supply Chain: Oversee procurement for office supplies, kitchen stock, and snacks, maintaining high standards while optimizing costs
  • Internal Logistics: Coordinate physical office needs, including internal moves,
    furniture adjustments, and managing storage spaces

People, Culture & Finance Cooperation

  • Community Building: Organize local office events, wellness workshops, and celebratory moments (e.g., Kids' Day, Holiday events), including coordinating event communications and announcements on Slack and the company Event Calendar
  • Financial Administration: Manage the local office budget, process invoices, and ensure the "4-eyes principle" is followed for all facility-related payments
  • Onboarding: Provide a warm welcome and office orientation for all new hires in the Prague office as well as remote locations virtually

What You'll Bring to Us

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in office management, facilities, or high-level administration
  • You are a professional who doesn't need to be micromanaged; you see a problem and own the solution
  • You enjoy working in a close-knit team where responsibilities are shared, and everyone supports each other
  • Fluency in Czech and English is essential (daily communication with local employees, vendors, and global stakeholders)
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and a natural ability to learn new software for space and subscription management
  • You have a basic understanding of (or a strong curiosity about) how AI tools can help automate routine administrative tasks; you don't need to be an expert, but you should be open-minded about using AI to improve efficiency and streamline workflows

What We Offer

  • International and fast-paced environment
  • Chance to work with the world's biggest brands at the CX tech leader
  • Agile and open-minded culture, with high levels of trust and flexibility
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development
  • Possibility to learn new and cutting-edge technologies, in an environment that encourages new ideas
  • AI-first workplace, with access to leading AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more), empowering you to work smarter, innovate faster, and build AI skills for the future
  • Flexible working environment
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Sick Days & Community Service Days
  • Multisport card
  • Maternity and Parental Benefit
  • Work in an international environment in our modern offices in Karlín, with our big terrace and our own grill
  • There's more as well! Speak with us to find out all the details!

At Emplifi, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone is valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, gender identities, and LGBTQ+ communities.

Emplifi offers a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment where every employee has the opportunity to thrive and is encouraged to be who they are.

We welcome and encourage applicants with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request at any stage of the recruitment process.

title: Kopie van Anesthesioloog (0,8-1,0 fte)
description:
Tergooi MC staat voor hoogwaardige, patiëntgerichte zorg in de regio Gooi en Vechtstreek. In ons moderne ziekenhuis, midden in het groen, werken ruim 3000 collega’s- waaronder meer dan 200 medisch specialisten- dagelijks samen om de beste zorg te bieden.

De vakgroep anesthesiologie bestaat uit 11 anesthesiologen waarvan vier ook werkzaam zijn bij de pijngeneeskunde. Wij zijn een collegiale vakgroep met aandacht voor samenwerking, kwaliteit van zorg en humor.

Je bent actief op ons operatiecomplex met 10 OK’s en op de polikliniek Preoperatieve Screening. Je voert alle voorkomende anesthesiologische werkzaamheden uit, waarbij alle snijdende specialismen zijn vertegenwoordigd, behalve de cardiochirurgie en intracraniële chirurgie.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste allround anesthesioloog, die het vak in de volle breedte uitoefent. Een anesthesioloog die beschikt over organisatorische en/of bestuurlijke kwaliteiten en ervaring. Een anesthesioloog die bereid is om actief bij te dragen aan kwaliteitsprojecten en/of managementtaken.

title: Kassa-myyjä, Helsinki Kontula (määräaikainen 20h/vko)
description:
Hei!

Nyt on maailman paras ostaja hankkinut hyllyt täyteen laatutuotteita ja meillä on tarjolla työpaikkoja asiakaspalveluhenkisille ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttiville työkavereille! Haluatko sinä mukaan ystävälliseen porukkaamme?

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Kattavan valikoimamme ansiosta pääset laittamaan esille esimerkiksi pukeutumiseen, vapaa-aikaan sekä kodin arkeen ja kunnostamiseen liittyviä tuotteita ja opastamaan asiakkaitamme monenlaisissa kysymyksissä.

Tehtävä on 4 kuukauden mittainen määräaikaisuus. Työ alkaa 31.8.2026 ja työaika on 20h/vko. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!

Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

  • Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
  • Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
  • Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
  • Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
  • Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
  • Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.

Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

title: Software Craftsperson/Java/Angular
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Craftsperson/Java/Angular based in Belgium.

This role is designed for engineers who are passionate about building high-quality, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.
The position combines strong Java backend expertise with modern Angular frontend development in a collaborative engineering environment.
You will work with advanced development practices, including Extreme Programming, test-driven development, and continuous delivery.
By embracing AI-powered engineering workflows, you will help accelerate development while maintaining strong standards of quality and craftsmanship.
This opportunity is ideal for developers who value technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.

Accountabilities

The Software Craftsperson will take ownership of feature development and contribute to building reliable software products through disciplined engineering practices and close collaboration.

  • Own feature-level design, development, testing, and delivery across backend and frontend applications.
  • Build clean, maintainable, and scalable software using modern engineering principles and best practices.
  • Develop backend services using Java while applying strong object-oriented programming concepts and design patterns.
  • Create responsive and scalable frontend applications using Angular and TypeScript.
  • Participate in product teams that manage the full development lifecycle, from technical decisions to production delivery.
  • Apply Extreme Programming practices such as pair programming, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and test-first development.
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and stakeholders to deliver solutions aligned with business and user needs.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, identify issues early, and enhance engineering workflows.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to engineering improvements, knowledge sharing, and mentoring within the team.
  • Participate in modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD workflows and collaborative software development processes.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a software engineer with strong Java and Angular experience, a passion for software craftsmanship, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative remote environment.

    • 3+ years of professional experience developing applications with Java.
    • Strong knowledge of Java fundamentals, object-oriented programming, design principles, and design patterns.
    • Experience working with Java frameworks such as Micronaut or Spring.
    • Solid understanding of Java Collections, multithreading concepts, and Hibernate ORM.
    • Experience using build tools such as Gradle or Maven.
    • Ability to write effective unit tests using JUnit.
    • Hands-on experience developing scalable applications with Angular and TypeScript.
    • Strong understanding of Angular concepts, including components, state management, data binding, routing, directives, and pipes.
    • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
    • Experience working with relational databases and fundamental SQL concepts.
    • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices.
    • Knowledge of Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP), RxJS, Microsoft Azure, observability, and monitoring practices is a plus.
    • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Augment, or Claude Code.
    • Ability to apply prompt engineering techniques and assess AI-generated code quality.
    • Strong ownership mindset, communication skills, curiosity, and commitment to continuous improvement.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, remote-first work environment with structured flexibility.
      • Opportunity to work with modern engineering practices focused on software craftsmanship and AI-native development.
      • Twice-yearly in-person coworking sprints with travel expenses covered.
      • Annual team retreat with covered travel costs.
      • Dedicated learning and development budget.
      • Conference participation and speaking sponsorship opportunities.
      • Comprehensive medical and term insurance coverage.
      • Employee-friendly leave policies.
      • Home office support fund.
      • Collaborative culture focused on learning, experimentation, and technical excellence.

title: Jämtkraft söker IT-chef
description:
Vill du arbeta i en verksamhet som är avgörande för att samhället ska fungera varje dag?

Jämtkraft söker nu en IT-chef som vill ta helhetsansvar för vår IT samt vara med och utveckla framtidens energisystem.

Din roll hos oss

Som IT-chef har du en nyckelroll i att se till att vår IT fungerar stabilt, säkert och effektivt men också att den utvecklas i takt med verksamheten.

Du leder ett kompetent team och arbetar nära organisationen för att säkerställa att IT skapar värde i allt från daglig drift till långsiktig utveckling.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har mångårig och gedigen bakgrund inom IT.
  • Är en erfaren ledare som gillar att utveckla både människor och verksamhet.
  • Har erfarenhet av att leda chefer, vilket är meriterande.
  • Förstår och har erfarenhet av hur IT skapar affärs- och verksamhetsnytta.
  • Trivs i en roll där du samverkar, prioriterar och tar ansvar.
  • Har B-körkort.

Du är en jordnära och pragmatisk person som får saker att hända. Du motiveras av att arbeta i en organisation där IT verkligen spelar en avgörande roll.

Om Jämtkraft

Jämtkraft är ett jämtländskt energibolag som producerar, distribuerar och säljer el och fjärrvärme. Vi agerar på både den fysiska och den finansiella elmarknaden för våra kunders räkning. Energin vi producerar kommer från förnybara energikällor som sol, vind, vatten och skog. Jämtkraft ägs av kommunerna Östersund, Krokom och Åre och tillsammans är vi cirka 470 medarbetare.

Varför Jämtkraft?

Hos oss får du:

  • Ett utmanande uppdrag i en samhällsviktig verksamhet.
  • Möjlighet att påverka och utveckla IT på riktigt.
  • Arbeta tillsammans med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor.
  • En stabil arbetsgivare med långsiktigt perspektiv.

Övrigt

  • Stationering är i Östersund och vi ser att du bor eller kommer bosätta dig i regionen.
  • Innan anställning kommer du genomgå säkerhetsprövning och drogtest.

Din ansökan

Har du frågor om tjänsten eller undrar hur processen ser ut framöver är du välkommen att kontakta Pontus Andersson på pontus.andersson@onepartnergroup.se (mailto:pontus.andersson@onepartnergroup.se)

I denna process jobbar vi med löpande urval och tillsättning, vilket betyder att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. När du har visat intresse för tjänsten matchar vi din ansökan med tjänsten och vi kontaktar dig via mail eller telefon för återkoppling. Är du aktuell för tjänsten träffas vi på en intervju och under processen sker även referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll.

Gällande ansökan så sker det via annonsen på OnePartnerGroups hemsida, vi hanterar inte ansökningar via mail på grund av GDPR.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Engineer
description:
This is a unique and exciting opportunity to join the team as an Engineer at the #1 Hotel in Los Angeles, as voted by Travel and Leisure: Oceana in Santa Monica, CA. This oceanfront, all-suite hotel reopened in July 2019 after undergoing a $35 Million complete transformation, and we are now seeking motivated, enthusiastic professionals to become integral members of our team.

As an Engineer, you are responsible for performing ongoing facility maintenance and completing repairs on equipment to keep the property operating and repairing any problems when they are discovered before they have a chance to worsen. If you have at least four years of maintenance experience at a luxury hotel or resort, we want you to apply today. We will schedule in-person and digital interviews for qualified candidates over the next few weeks.

Apply today! Then check your phone and email messages often for a message about scheduling a short phone interview.

The How…

You will use your four-plus years to maintain and repair a four-star or five-star hotel. Your day-to-day work focuses on common maintenance issues, including but not limited to fixing machinery, plumbing, heating, and wiring and inspecting the building to confirm safety standards.

You strongly desire to ensure our guests and employees a clean and safe environment. Your natural disposition toward personal and public safety, operating from a place of integrity, honesty, and ethics, supports our efforts to keep the hotel ranked as the premier luxury hotel in Los Angeles.

Your friendly, efficient, and high-touch approach is perfect for engaging with guests and team members. You appropriately address maintenance concerns and escalate issues promptly. Still, you can maintain and enforce company standards regarding operational processes and procedures related to the hotel’s maintenance program.

The Details…

You will work a full-time hospitality schedule defined by operational needs, including weekends and holidays.

Willing to conform to hotel dress and grooming standards, which include wearing the hotel-issued uniform, no visible tattoos while wearing a uniform, no unnatural hair colors, no piercings other than one pair of earrings, and neatly groomed facial hair.

We offer many benefits to meet your needs, including medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance options. The company provides auto-enrollment in its 401(k) plan after 60 days of employment. New employees accrue 40 hours of vacation in the first year and earn 80 hours of paid sick leave per year. Eligible employees also receive holiday pay (if working) or paid holidays (if scheduled off) for six yearly holidays*.

After you apply, please listen to voicemails, answer calls from unknown numbers, and check emails for a message from us regarding the next step.

*To be eligible for holiday pay, employees must have completed 90 days of employment and worked the last scheduled day before and the first day after the holiday.

Hotel Oceana Santa Monica is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We will consider all qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories, for employment in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Network Security
description:
Job Description

Join our Cyber Security Engineering unit, where innovation and security drive us. We are transforming technology with modern Network Security, integrations and cloud services. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Network Security Engineering team. This role involves architecting, designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures to protect our global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on expertise. This role requires a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, Network Security technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple globally dispersed stakeholders and teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the development, optimization and integration of network security policies, rules and monitoring across platforms such as NDR, SSE, SD‑WAN and proxy solutions
  • Design and improve network security solutions across branches, stores and data centers, ensuring strong alignment with business and security needs
  • Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments and threat modelling, and drive hardening initiatives across our network landscape
  • Modernize network security by transitioning from legacy systems to modern SSE and ZTNA solutions, supported by clear roadmaps, policies and plans
  • Monitor and enhance the performance, availability and reliability of network security solutions, ensuring compliance with ISO, NIST, GDPR and internal standards
  • Design, configure and troubleshoot network security devices and services across on‑prem and cloud environments, providing advanced Level‑3 support when needed

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You’ll join a friendly and collaborative Network Security Engineering team of seven, soon to be eight, working closely with colleagues across Business Tech. Your daily partners will include network SMEs, Cyber Security Advisors, Core Platforms and Global Infrastructure Services, as well as teams supporting stores, warehouses and new market entries. You’ll also connect with external partners and contribute to cross‑functional projects where network and cyber security come together. This is a highly collaborative environment where your expertise will help shape our security posture and uplift the team’s cyber maturity.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, with a focus on network environments
  • Strong, practical knowledge of: Network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, SWG, SASE, VPN, CASB, ZTNA), Cloud platforms: Azure, GCP, Security architecture methodologies and governance frameworks
  • Expertise in network security solutions and products provided by Cisco, HP Aruba, Zscaler and Citrix NetScaler (proven by certificates)
  • Strong knowledge of risk assessment and security control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST).
  • Familiarity with security maturity models including C2M2
  • Excellent ability to translate security requirements into implementable engineering solutions.
  • Strong understanding of IP networking and protocols, including IPsec, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, and QoS.
  • Understand regulatory and compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, Schrems, etc.).
  • Independent problem-solving, addressing complex security challenges with minimal supervision.

Preferred qualifications:

  • CCNP (Security) or higher-level certifications such as the CCIE.
  • CISSP or OSCP security certifications.
  • Azure Security Engineer, or GCP Security Engineer certification.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira/Confluence)

WHO WE ARE

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

Benefits

  • All our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program (HIP)
  • All our employees receive a staff discount card, which is usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET.
  • Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation and wellness allowance 4000 SEK/yearly
  • Access to Benify, for discounts on e.g. Gym memberships, travel, hotels and many other great deals.
  • Compensation boost during parental leave

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application

title: 국내 온/오프라인 MD
description:
About

Beauty for Everyone — Love And Kind Artistry
라카코스메틱스는 모든 사람의 고유한 아름다움을 존중하며, 한국 최초의 젠더 뉴트럴 메이크업 브랜드 Laka를 이끌어온 K뷰티 기업입니다.

2018년 브랜드 론칭 이후, Laka는 '컬러는 원래 모두의 것'이라는 슬로건 아래 성별의 틀을 벗어난 독창적인 철학과 감각적인 비주얼로 국내 메이크업 시장에 새로운 패러다임을 제시해 왔습니다. 론칭 6개월 만에 전국 올리브영 700여 개 매장에 입점하며 브랜드 가치를 입증했고, 아시아를 넘어 북미 시장까지 진출하여 글로벌 팬덤을 확장해 나가고 있습니다. 최근에는 성수동 플래그십 스토어 오픈을 기점으로 온·오프라인을 아우르는 몰입형 브랜드 경험까지 설계하며 그 행보를 이어가고 있습니다.

우리는 포용적 뷰티의 가치를 전 세계로 확산시키며, 아시아를 넘어 진정한 글로벌 뷰티 아이콘으로 자리매김하는 것을 목표로 나아가고 있습니다.

탄탄한 제품력과 팬덤을 바탕으로 글로벌 시장의 입지를 넓혀가는 라카코스메틱스와 함께, 밀도 있는 성장을 만들어갈 동료를 기다립니다!

Responsibilities

• 국내 온/오프라인 채널 운영 및 판매 전략 수립(자사몰, 올리브영, 스마트스토어, 플래그십 스토어,카카오톡 선물하기)
• 파트너사와의 커뮤니케이션을 통한 협상 주도 및 장기 파트너십 구축
• 채널 주요 상품 및 프로모션 기획과 행사 운영을 통한 매출 성장 관리
• 매출, 재고, 행사 성과 등 데이터 분석 및 기반 계획 수립
• 마케팅 / 프로덕트 / SCM 등 유관 부서와 협업하여 채널 전략 실행

Requirements

• 화장품 또는 소비재 카테고리에서 관련 업무 경험이 있으신 분
• 데이터 기반으로 매출, 재고, 행사 성과 등을 분석하고 관리해본 경험이 있으신 분
• 채널 손익 구조에 대한 이해 바탕으로 데이터 기반의 의사결정이 가능하신 분
• 유관부서와 원활한 커뮤니케이션으로 업무를 조율하고 운영해본 경험이 있는 분

Preferred

• 올리브영, 네이버 등 온/오프라인 유통 채널 동시 운영 경험이 있으신 분
• 카페 24로 자사몰 운영 경험이 있으신 분
• 마케팅 캠페인과 채널 운영을 연결하여 고객 유입 및 매출 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분
• K-뷰티 및 글로벌 뷰티 산업 트렌드에 관심이 높으신 분

Benefits

• 점심 식대: 월 30만원 (비플제로페이 포인트 지급)
• 설·추석 명절 상여 지급

title: Kokki, varuskuntaravintola Falkonetti, Niinisalo
description:
Haluaisitko kokata hyvää ruokaa isänmaallisesti merkittävässä työympäristössä? Etsimme KOKKIA Varuskuntaravintola Falkonettiin hyvän ruoan erikoisjoukkoihin, jotka huolehtivat Porin prikaatin ruokahuollosta Niinisalossa.

Mistä tässä on kyse?

Armeija ei marssi tyhjällä vatsalla ja ruoka on tärkeässä roolissa varusmiesten jaksamisen kannalta. Sinä ja kaikki muut varuskuntaravintola Falkonetin työkaverisi olette avainroolissa, jotta varusmiehillä riittää puhtia suorittaa varusmiespalvelusta. Asiakkaamme todella arvostavat kokin työtä - syöväthän he neljästi päivässä sinun ja työkavereidesi tekemää hyvää ruokaa.

Kokin työ varuskuntaravintolassa on monipuolista ja ruoat valmistamme isoissa padoissa Leijonan omaa reseptiikkaa käyttäen. Teet joustavasti sekä aamu- että iltakokin vuoroja ja tehtäviisi kuuluu myös esim. dieetti-, salaatti- ja esivalmistelukokin tehtäviä, salityöskentelyä, pakkausta ja astiahuoltoa. Olemme siellä missä asiakkaammekin, ja joskus se tarkoittaa myös soppakauhaan tarttumissa Puolustusvoimien harjoituksissa keskellä korpikuusimetsää.

Meillä pöydät täyttyvät asiakkaista vuoden jokaisena päivänä, joten sinun ei tarvitse miettiä sesonkivaihteluita tai kesälomautuksia. Työaikasi vaihtelevat ma-su klo 5-20 välillä. Tarvitset oman kulkuneuvon pystyäksesi tekemään kaikkia vuoroja.

Olennaiset rekrytointikriteerit:

- Kokin tutkinto antaa sinulle valmiudet valmistaa hyvää ja terveellistä ruokaa. Sinulta löytyy hygieniapassi.

- Aiemman työkokemuksen pituuden voit korvata halulla oppia ja tekevällä työasenteellasi.

- Sovit työporukkaamme, jos sinulla on tekevä työasenne ja oppimishalukkuutta.

- Työkielemme on suomi ja reseptiikkamme on saatavilla vain suomeksi. Odotamme sinulta hyvää suomen kielen taitoa.

- Työpisteesi sijaitsee varuskunta-alueella, ja asiakkaamme vaatii alueella työskenteleviltä turvallisuusselvityksen tekemistä. Leijonalla työsuhteen solmimisen ehtona on hyväksytty turvallisuusselvitys - autamme sinua tämän tekemisessä.

Hakuohjeet ja hakemiseen valmistautuminen

Leijonalla lisämaustetta työhömme tuovat asiakkaamme ja toimintaympäristö. Armeija-maailma voi olla sinulle vielä hieman etäinen ja siksi suosittelemme sinun kurkkaavan Leijonan [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/leijonacatering/) tai [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/leijonacatering/) -tililtä, miltä työpäivämme näyttävät.

Olemme tehneet kokin paikan hakemisen sinulle helpoksi ja hakemukseen emme vaadi CV:tä. Kerrothan hakemuslomakkeella kuitenkin itsestäsi ja miksi tämä paikka kiinnostaa sinua. Älä aikaile hakemisen kanssa, vaan paina HAE nappia nyt tai ihan viimeistään 19.8.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.




Tarjoamme


- E-passietu

- Edullinen työpaikkaruokailu

- Laaja työterveyshuolto

- Vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus

- Tulospalkkio



Leijona Catering Oy

Omaa elämää on helppo suunnitella, kun työpaikkaan voi luottaa kuin muuriin, palkka on ajoissa tilillä ja työajat kalenterissa. Leijona Catering valmistaa päivittäin jopa 80 000 annosta hyvää ruokaa niille, jotka pitävät yhteiskunnan käynnissä – Puolustusvoimissa, Rikosseuraamuslaitoksessa ja viranomaiskentillä. Olipa edessä kakkua tai rokkaa, ydintehtävämme on turvata ruokahuollon jatkuvuus kaikissa olosuhteissa. Meitä hyvän ruuan erikoisjoukkolaisia on jo yli 550, ja työskentelemme ympäri Suomea 60 toimipisteessä. Keittiössä ja kentällä – työtämme ohjaavat arvot #rintarottingilla, #ketteräkehittäjä ja #keitämmeyhdessä. Suomi tarvitsee toimintavarmuutta, ja se tarvitsee hyvän ruuan tekijöitä. Koska joka päivä, joka ikinen syö.

Lue lisää: [www.leijonacatering.fi](http://www.leijonacatering.fi)



Puhelin: 0104320320 Sähköposti: rekrytointi@leijonacatering.fi Sijainti: Varastotie, Niinisalo

title: Senior Executive Compensation Analyst
description:
The Senior Executive Compensation Analyst supports the design, analysis, and administration of Sandisk’s executive compensation programs reporting into the Head of Executive Compensation. This role delivers data-driven insights, market intelligence, governance support, and program execution to support Sandisk’s executive talent strategy, partnering closely with senior leaders, HR Business Partners, Stock Administration, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and external consultants to ensure executive compensation programs are competitive, compliant, and aligned with business and shareholder priorities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Act as a trusted thought partner and advisor to Total Rewards leadership, HR Business Partners, and senior executives on executive compensation matters.
  • Translate business strategy, performance outcomes, and talent priorities into data-driven analyses, benchmarking, and governance-aligned recommendations.
  • Provide consultative guidance on executive offers, retention strategies, promotions, and transitions, balancing enterprise consistency, market competitiveness, and governance considerations.
  • Handle highly sensitive information with discretion and sound judgment and communicate effectively with senior leadership.

Executive Compensation Strategy & Analytics

  • Conduct executive market benchmarking and peer group analysis using external surveys and public disclosures to assess competitive positioning across executive pay levels, incentive design, and governance practices.
  • Model executive compensation scenarios covering base pay, annual incentives, long-term incentives, and total direct compensation, evaluating outcomes relative to market, internal guidelines, and governance considerations.
  • Develop clear, executive-ready insights and materials that support informed decision-making by leadership.

Compensation Committee & Proxy Support

  • Prepare meeting materials for the Compensation and Talent Committee (CTC) of the Board of Directors aligned with the CTC Charter, including incentive design, compensation recommendations, equity budgeting, and scenario modeling.
  • Support development of proxy disclosure, including CD&A narrative and SEC-required compensation tables, in coordination with Legal, Finance, Investor Relations, and external advisors to ensure accuracy, compliance, and consistency across disclosures and communications. Partner cross-functionally to ensure accuracy, compliance, and consistency across disclosures and communications.

Program Administration & Governance

  • Ensure the effective execution of executive compensation programs, including annual incentives, equity awards, and merit and promotion cycles, through close partnership with HR Business Partners, HR Operations, IT, Payroll, Stock Administration, Legal, and senior leadership.
  • Monitor external governance and regulatory trends and recommend program or policy enhancements.

REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, HR, Accounting, or related field.
  • 6–10+ years of experience in executive compensation, compensation analytics, or total rewards within a public technology company.

SKILLS:

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills with strong executive communication capability.
  • Experience using executive compensation surveys (e.g., Radford, Willis Towers Watson, Mercer).
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally within a highly regulated business environment.

PREFERRED:

  • CECP certification preferred.

title: Business Director
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Business Director do at WPP Production?

By understanding WPP Production's full breadth of services, our Business Directors bring smart solutions to clients, helping them transition and transform their business. You are a hunter and team builder who drives client business, as well as grows WPP Production's opportunities and revenue.

You add value by maintaining and growing client relationships and are valued by senior clients for your partnership and strategic guidance. You are a driver of growth, who identifies new business opportunities and manages new business pitches to grow your portfolio of business. A storyteller who can drive and lead business with the ability to write and present decks with flare and precision. An exceptional leader of clients, complex teams and individuals, you epitomise our brand values, are passionate about the business and inspire others to continually push to be better. You partner with the Global Client MD (GCMD) and Global Client Lead (GCL) as well as the wider team helping to deliver the right strategic messaging and expectations for delivery excellence.

Key areas of responsibility

Growth and account planning

  • Support GCMD and GCL in driving agency revenue growth across new business
  • Drive organic strategic business growth through strong relationships, a solid knowledge of your clients’ business, strategic direction and competitive landscape
  • Focus on cross selling our capabilities and services to extend our offering to clients
  • Partner with the Commercial Team and Client Operations Director to formulate plans to manage and leverage opportunities to drive client business and partnership
  • Drive and maintain a client business development plan, comms and contact strategy (per client) and identify specific opportunities and actions
  • Play a key role in new business pitches

Relationship management

  • Build client relationships based on plan agreed with GCMD/ GCL
  • Seen as a trusted advisor on WPP Production's capabilities and provides guidance and counsel to clients to help them achieve their business objectives by developing the right production strategy
  • Responsible for day-to-day management of overall client engagement and relationship health
  • Monitor client satisfaction metrics and associated performance measures. Ensure negative feedback is escalated to GCMD, is addressed directly with clients and corrective action plans are implemented
  • Deep understanding of client dynamics and objectives, manage client expectations for the agency and course correct potential client issues. Briefing GCMD/GCL and agreeing a quarterly plan
  • Working closely with the GCL to understand contractual obligations and commercial arrangement and how these impact our ways of working as well as profitability
  • Provide strategic insights to clients on a monthly/quarterly basis
  • Partner with Client Director and/or Client Operations Director to drive account governance including Quarterly and Annual Business reviews and ensure flawless delivery

Collaboration

  • Work with GCMD/GCL and Client Operations Director to understand who the right capability experts are to bring in to unlock opportunities for growth
  • Partner with Client Delivery to develop and maintain high levels of team effectiveness and satisfaction
  • Maintain high level of trust and respect among department heads in Creative, Production, Operations, Technology, Finance and SMEs
  • Partner with Client Delivery to navigate when there are conflicting priorities
  • Work with Global ExCo and WPP Production Marketing Team to tell the story of WPP Production by delivering compelling case studies and content sound bites

Leadership

  • Create a culture of fresh-thinking, collaboration, respect, equality, diversity and inclusion, with a focus on learning, development and growth
  • Contribute to WPP Production's culture by exhibiting ownership, professionalism, passion and leading by example
  • Regardless of reporting lines and disciplines inspires the wider portfolio team to deliver their best
  • Empower the team to take ownership and find solutions, supporting them by removing any barriers to success
  • In partnership with GCMD and GCL, hire and retain the best talent
  • Understand how data and the use of data can change how we approach content creation and elevate the types of conversations and recommendations we have with clients
  • Have an active interest in sustainability and help drive change within WPP Production to think and act more sustainably

Financials

  • Support GCMD/GCL with P&Ls, budgets and forecasting
  • Ultimately responsible for monthly financial management and agreed contribution margins
  • Partner with the Client Delivery, Finance and Commercial Teams to review revenue and plan against regular revenue analyses provided by the finance team to achieve monthly commitments
  • Knowledge of profit levers and use them to drive profitability across your account portfolio

Requirements:

  • Experience in a Client Services industry, working in a marketing, integrated campaigns/digital agency and/or consultancy environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to grow revenue through strategic and organic growth and new business with a motivation to meet specific financial targets.
  • Strong business and financial acumen.
  • Expert client relationship skills – multi-stakeholder environment, matrix reporting, industry POV.
  • Experience driving positive and/or turning around Client Satisfaction Scores.
  • Ability to build partnerships across disciplines, networks and teams.
  • Ability to write clear, cohesive and focused client communications including strategic presentations with strong storytelling skills. Also training Sr ADs and ADs to develop these skills.
  • Authentically passionate about great work, teams and business.
  • Curiosity and insatiable need for continual learning that is infectious.
  • AI Proficiency: A strong grasp of the marketing technology landscape, specifically GenAI, Agentic workflows, and how they will disrupt traditional production hierarchies.
  • Proven consultative skills with a proactive and strategic approach to client engagement, serving as a trusted advisor.

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Opinto-ohjauksen lehtori
description:
Euran kunnan sivistyspalveluissa on haettavana vakinainen opinto-ohjauksen lehtorin virka 1.9.2026 alkaen (1. sijoituspaikka Euran yhteiskoulu).

Euran yhteiskoulussa on lukuvuonna 2026-2027 noin 360 yläkoulun oppilasta sekä noin 40 opettajaa ja ohjaajaa. Tietoja koulusta löytyy kotisivulta euranyhteiskoulu.fi.

Haemme koulullemme oppilaslähtöistä ammattilaista ja hyvää työkaveria joukkoomme. Edellytämme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, ratkaisukeskeisyyttä sekä intoa ja kykyä kehittää sekä omaa opetustaan että koko koulua.

Opinto-ohjauksen lehtorin työnkuvaan kuuluu opetusta, henkilökohtaista ohjausta ja pienryhmäohjausta, yhteydenpitoa sidosryhmiin sekä ohjauksen suunnittelua ja kehittämistä. Arvostamme hyviä organisointitaitoja ja kykyä tukea oppilaiden opiskelua sekä auttaa jatko-opiskelupaikan löytämisessä. Arvostamme oppilaslähtöistä ja innostavaa otetta ohjaukseen ja oppilashuoltoon sekä rauhallista ja harkitsevaa kasvatusotetta.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuutta kehittää oppilaanohjausta yhdessä työparin ja lukion opinto-ohjaajan kanssa tiimin jäsenenä, mukavan työyhteisön sekä henkilöstöetuna e-passin.

Kelpoisuusehdot määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen (986/98) mukaan ja palkkaus sekä työaika OVTES:n mukaan (+ Eura-lisä).

Haku tapahtuu sähköisesti osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi. Alkuperäiset tutkinto- ja työtodistukset tulee esittää mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä. Todistusjäljennöksiä ei ole tarpeen liittää hakemukseen.

Virkaan valitun on ennen valinnan vahvistamista esitettävä nähtäväksi lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote ja toimitettava hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan. Tehtävän täyttämisessä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

title: HR Operations Advisor
description:
The HR Operations Advisor runs the day-to-day HR operations, systems, and lifecycle administration at TGP. The role is product owner of our core HR tools (HiBob, SharePoint, LearnUpon), owns the processes, SOPs, and people analytics behind them, and is the first point of contact for employees; supporting across the talent lifecycle, and ensuring compliance across TGP’s global footprint.

Responsibilities

PEOPLE & EMPLOYEE RELATIONS
  • First point of contact for employees globally on day-to-day HR, policy, and talent queries.
  • Support with first-level ER matters including informal complaints, investigations, disciplinary and grievance procedures, escalating as appropriate.
  • Coordinate performance improvement plans and support development pathways in partnership with line managers and HRBPs.
  • Manage onboarding and offboarding administration, including right to work checks, system entries, exit interviews, and access management.
  • Maintain sickness absence records, return-to-work processes, and wellbeing compliance reporting.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality in handling all sensitive employee data.

TALENT, LEARNING & ENGAGEMENT
  • Coordinate performance management cycles including objective setting, mid-year reviews, and year-end evaluations.
  • Administer leadership development programmes and maintain associated records and impact tracking.
  • Support the annual talent review and succession planning process, ensuring accurate data and coordination.
  • Coordinate mandatory compliance training (e.g. data protection, safeguarding) and track completion.

RECRUITMENT ADMINISTRATION
  • Coordinate end-to-end recruitment administration: job adverts, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and ATS maintenance.
  • Liaise with hiring managers to arrange interview panels and ensure a positive candidate experience.
  • Prepare and issue offer letters, contracts, and pre-employment documentation; conduct right to work, reference, and role-specific checks.
  • Maintain recruitment trackers and provide status updates to the Global Recruitment Manager and hiring managers.

HR OPERATIONS & SYSTEMS
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity in the HRIS across the full employee lifecycle.
  • Support the Compensation & Benefits team to ensure data is accurately maintained in HiBob.
  • Product owner of our HR tools and systems (HiBob, Sharepoint, LearnUpon)
  • Own the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of HR processes, SOPs, and policies — keeping them current, consistent across jurisdictions, and aligned to TGP's operating standards.
  • Drive automation initiatives and adoption of emerging HR technologies to streamline operations and enhance overall efficiencies across the people function.

REPORTING & COMPLIANCE
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc people data reports; ensure timely responses to internal data requests.
  • Build and maintain people analytics dashboards — surfacing trends in headcount, attrition, engagement, recruitment, and learning to inform decisions by the CPO, HRBPs, and business leaders.
  • Track costs for training, development, and wellbeing activities and provide accurate headcount and attrition data inputs.

Requirements

  • 3+ Experience in an HR advisory or HR operations role, ideally within a multi-country or large organisation.
  • Experience handling first-line HR queries and supporting employee relations matters.
  • Experience in recruitment administration, including end-to-end coordination of hiring and onboarding processes.
  • Proven ability to manage HR systems, maintain accurate employee data, and produce reports and people insights.
  • Experience supporting annual people processes such as performance reviews, talent management, learning and development, and compensation cycles
  • Degree (or equivalent) in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related field preferred.
  • Working towards CIPD Level 3 or above.
  • Strong communication, organisational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Highly detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable working with confidential information.
  • Proficiency in HR systems, Microsoft Office, and Excel; experience with data visualisation tools would be advantageous.

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package including salary sacrifice pension, life assurance, private medical insurance, and optical and dental cover, alongside access to an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) to support your overall wellbeing

title: Trainee Solicitor
description:
This is a unique opportunity to complete your two-year traineeship with Postcode Lottery. Rather than following the traditional four-seat rotation, you will gain broad, hands-on experience across a wide range of legal, regulatory and governance matters. Working closely with teams across the business, you will develop a comprehensive understanding of the role of an in-house legal team within a highly regulated organisation. You will join our Legal and Licence Team, supporting the Head of Legal together with our Privacy and Commercial Solicitors. You will also work alongside our Compliance Manager, helping to ensure that Postcode Lottery complies with the Gambling Act 2005, the Licence Conditions and Codes of Practice (LCCP) and other applicable legislation. In addition to your work within Legal and Licence, you will have the opportunity to support our Charities Team on charity governance matters, giving you exposure to another specialist area of practice. We appreciate that as an External Lottery Manager, we deal with legal matters that you will not have come across in your degree or during your diploma. We are not looking for an expert; we are looking for someone who is keen to learn and fits in with the ethos of our company and our team.

Interviews will be held face-to-face Wednesday 26th & Thursday 27th August 2026, if you are not able to make these dates please state upon your application.

Key activities and responsibilities you will expect:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret information, identify risks and apply sound judgement to a range of legal and regulatory matters.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to draft clear, accurate legal documentation and build effective relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail, enabling you to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to build positive working relationships across teams and provide a professional, customer-focused service.
  • A genuine eagerness to learn and develop, demonstrating curiosity, adaptability and a proactive approach to building your legal knowledge and experience within an in-house legal team.

title: Staff Engineer, Reliability Infrastructure Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer to lead strategy, planning, build and maintenance of SSD environmental test chambers supporting our Enterprise Product Quality organization. This role is responsible for test chamber capacity planning, capital purchases, maintenance strategy, utilization optimization, and deep technical engagement on test chamber failure analysis.
The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with environmental chambers, strong ability to coordinate with global team across multiple time zones including India, Israel & Malaysia and the ability to work effectively with external vendors to resolve complex reliability and infrastructure issues impacting product quality and test throughput.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

ENVIRONMENTAL CHAMBER OPERATIONS & MAINTENANCE

  • Define and drive maintenance strategies (preventive, corrective, lifecycle management) for environmental chambers and associated test infrastructure.
  • Establish standard operating procedures, health metrics, and readiness criteria for chambers used in SSD qualification and reliability testing.
  • Build continuous improvement strategies based on lessons learned.

FAILURE ANALYSIS & DEBUG

  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for chamber-related downtime or performance issues.
  • Diagnose issues spanning thermal, power, mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
  • Work with external vendors and internal teams to implement corrective actions to drive cross-functional debug efforts to identify root causes and implement robust fixes.

VENDOR & EXTERNAL PARTNER MANAGEMENT

  • Serve as the primary technical interface with environmental chamber vendors and test equipment suppliers.
  • Lead vendor technical reviews, failure escalations, and corrective action plans.
  • Evaluate vendor solutions, technologies, and roadmaps to influence future purchases and capabilities.

TEST INFRASTRUCTURE STRATEGY & PLANNING

  • Own end-to-end planning for SSD environmental test chambers including capital planning and justification for new chamber purchases, capacity and utilization planning aligned with product roadmaps, long term infrastructure and scaling strategy.
  • Partner with Product Quality, Reliability, Validation, and Operations teams to forecast test demand and align infrastructure investments.

GLOBAL LAB ALIGNMENT

  • Work closely with global teams to ensure labs and equipment are aligned to product plans, update schedules, and best practices.
  • Act as the main point of contact for making sure labs and equipment are staying aligned to company policies and procedures.
  • Identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement and automation.

Required:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of engineering experience, with significant focus on test infrastructure, environmental testing, Reliability, or validation environments.
  • Hands-on experience working with environmental test chambers (thermal, humidity, stress testing, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of chamber maintenance, calibration, failure modes, and operational best practices.
  • Proven experience analyzing and troubleshooting tester or infrastructure failures in a lab or production-like environment.
  • Experience working directly with external vendors to resolve technical issues and drive improvements.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across multiple teams and influence technical decisions, test infrastructure demand planning .

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting SSD or storage product qualification, validation, or reliability testing.
  • Familiarity with enterprise-class reliability methodologies (HTOL, temperature cycling, burn-in, stress testing, Reliability Demonstration Testing).
  • Background in scaling test infrastructure for high-volume or multiproduct environments.
