title: Kontorchef til prøver, eksamen og test på undervisningsområdet
company: Styrelsen for Undervisning og Kvalitet, København
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre, at afviklingen af hundredtusindvis af prøver og test på grundskole-, gymnasie- og voksenområdet hvert år sker effektivt og efter reglerne, at prøver og test løbende udvikles og at bidrage til at gøre det lettere for institutionerne at give god undervisning og afvikle gode prøver? Så er stillingen som kontorchef i Kontor for Prøver, Eksamen og Test i Styrelsen for Undervisning og Kvalitet måske noget for dig.

Et velfungerende prøve-, eksamens- og testområde er afgørende både for elever og kursister og for de skoler og institutioner, hvor prøver og test aflægges. Prøver og test indebærer således en vigtig og løbende evaluering af undervisningen og af den enkelte elevs og kursists faglige dygtighed, ligesom prøverne – og den samlede eksamen – danner grundlag for optagelse på ungdomsuddannelser og videregående uddannelser.

Som kontorchef i Kontor for Prøver, Eksamen og Test spiller du derfor, sammen med de dygtige medarbejdere i kontoret, en vigtig rolle. En succesfuld varetagelse af rollen forudsætter navnlig, at man kan:

  • Lede den samlede prøve- og eksamensadministration, herunder udpegning af opgavekommissioner, klargøring af materiale til skriftlige prøver, beskikkelse af censorer.
  • Styrke styrelsens samlede test- og prøvefaglige viden og i tæt samarbejde med øvrige kontorer lede de udviklingsopgaver, der knytter sig til den løbende udvikling af test og prøver, herunder aktuelt ift. folkeskolens prøver i forlængelse af nye fagplaner, prøver i forbindelse med den nye erhvervs- og professionsorienterede gymnasieuddannelse epx og udvikling af prøverne mhp. håndtering af AI og digitale hjælpemidler, mv.
  • Sætte sig ind i og administrere korrekt i henhold til det samlede regelkompleks, der går på tværs af de forskellige uddannelseslove, og levere en fagligt velfunderet politisk betjening på prøve-, eksamens- og testområdet.
  • Bistå med forretningsmæssig viden ifm. udvikling af de IT-systemer, der understøtter afvikling af prøver og test.


Om dig
Vi leder efter en kontorchef, der:

  • Kan påtage sig ledelsen af en forretningskritisk driftsopgave – og meget gerne med kendskab til prøveområdet eller erfaring fra lignende opgaver.
  • Har fokus på at skabe resultater og styr på detaljen.
  • Har politisk tæft og kommunikerer klart i skrift og tale.
  • Formår at omsætte styrelsens ledelsesgrundlag til god ledelse i det daglige.
  • Formår at skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer internt såvel som eksternt.
  • Understøtter en ambitiøs og effektiv arbejdsplads præget af trivsel og høj motivation.
Vi forventer, at du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse og erfaring med ledelse.

Du leder kontoret i tæt samarbejde med teamledere, du refererer til styrelsens ene vicedirektør, men arbejder sammen med hele direktionen, ligesom et godt samarbejde med en række øvrige kontorer og centre i styrelsen og ministeriet er en forudsætning for at skabe gode resultater. Endelig har du en række faglige relationer til departementet såvel som aktører i undervisningssektoren. Gode samarbejdsevner er derfor en afgørende kompetence.



Om os
Kontor for Prøver, Eksamen og Test består foruden kontorchef og tre teamledere af cirka 35 dygtige medarbejdere. Kontoret har bl.a. ansvaret for:

  • At folkeskolens prøver, de gymnasiale prøver og prøver på det forberedende og voksenuddannelsesområdet tilrettelægges, så de kan dokumentere, hvor dygtige elever og kursister er i forhold til væsentlige mål og krav fastsat for det enkelte fag. Kontoret har desuden ansvaret for, at prøverne løbende udvikles og bliver afviklet effektivt, sikkert og stabilt.
  • Indholdet af folkeskolens nationale færdighedstest i grundskolen. Kontoret er ansvarlig for, at opgaverne til de nationale færdighedstest har høj faglig kvalitet, at testene giver en objektiv og effektiv vurdering af elevernes faglige niveau inden for afgrænsede områder af fagene, og at testenes indhold og rammer løbende tilpasses ændringer i fagenes indhold.
  • En række øvrige opgaver knyttet til løbende udvikling og drift, herunder understøttelse af udviklingsprojekter, ministerbetjening, økonomistyring, bekendtgørelsesarbejde, vejledning af institutioner, elever og kursister, mv.


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 1/lønramme 37. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår forhandles efter rammeaftale om kontraktansættelse af chefer i staten. Stillingen ønskes besat på et 5-årigt åremål på overenskomstvilkår. Hvis du i forvejen er tjenestemand, vil ansættelse som tjenestemand være en mulighed.

Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse, at du kan opnå en sikkerheds-godkendelse via PET-graden ”Hemmeligt”, og at sikkerhedsgodkendelsen kan opretholdes under hele din ansættelse.

Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt.

Ansættelsessted: Kalvebod Brygge 47, 1560 København V.



Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning, cv og eksamensbevis senest tirsdag den 18. august 2026. Du søger stillingen via linket i annoncen. Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 34 og 35. Hvis du går videre til 2. samtale, kan du blive bedt om at besvare en case og udfylde en præferenceprofil og en kognitiv test, der vil indgå som en del af den samlede vurdering.



Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte vicedirektør Birte Iversen på telefon 2077 5861. Send evt. en sms, så vil du blive ringet op. Du kan også læse mere om Undervisningsministeriet på vores hjemmeside uvm.dk.

Styrelsen for Undervisning og Kvalitet er en styrelse i Undervisningsministeriets koncern. Vi ønsker en sammensætning af medarbejdere, der afspejler det omgivende samfund. Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset baggrund opfordres til at søge stillingen, såfremt de matcher kravene nævnt ovenfor. Vi vurderer udelukkende ansøgere på baggrund af kvalifikationer.

title: ANIOS Spoedeisende Psychiatrie Amsterdam
description:
Wil jij als ANIOS werken in het hart van Amsterdam, waar je veel leert over diagnostiek, crisishandelingen en het betrekken van naasten? Bij ons werk je in een dynamische omgeving, krijg je uitstekende supervisie en bouw je in korte tijd een brede klinische basis op.

Wat ga je doen?
Je zorgt voor de diagnostiek, behandelingen, detoxificatie en medische correspondentie over de cliënten. Je werkt zowel zelfstandig als multidisciplinair en neemt deel aan diverse afdelingsvergaderingen. Je draagt vanuit jouw kennis, ervaring en de praktijk bij aan het verder ontwikkelen van het zorgaanbod.

Op de werkplek wordt goede begeleiding geboden door de psychiaters en overige teamleden. De experts van de Spoedeisende Psychiatrie bieden op donderdagochtend onderwijs aan de ANIOS die er werkzaam zijn. Het onderwijs betreft allerlei facetten van het werken bij de crisisdienst, onder andere het systemisch werken, persoonlijkheidsstoornissen, verslaving, suïcidaliteit en triage.

De werkplek is een combinatie van de vier verschillende crisisteams (Centrum, Oud West, Noord, Diemen) met de Meldkamer die zich in Amsterdam Centrum bevindt. In de crisisteams bieden we acute zorg en intensieve behandelingen thuis. Bij alle vacatures wordt er ongeveer 50% in de diensten buiten kantoortijden gewerkt en voor 50% tijdens kantoortijden.

Wij bieden jou

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden en salariëring zijn volgens de CAO GGZ FG 65 (Min: €5.294,- Max: €6.918,- op basis van 36 uur)
  • Je kunt bij ons veel kunt leren over diagnostiek, handelen in crisissituaties en het betrekken van het systeem bij de behandeling. Op alle werkplekken is er een goede begeleiding vanuit psychiaters en overige teamleden, je werkt er multidisciplinair en je krijgt regulier onderwijs aangeboden.
  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst van 6 maanden, met mogelijke verlenging naar een jaar voor 32 of 36 uur;
  • Een uitgebreid intern trainings- en opleidingsaanbod. Als ANIOS volg je altijd de DIM training (De-escalerende Interventie Methode). Je kunt bijvoorbeeld ook de gezondheidsrechtcursus WVGGZ volgen, die digitaal en klassikaal gegeven wordt;
  • Eindejaarsuitkering en vakantietoeslag van 8,33%
  • Wij hebben aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden, zo wordt het OV-woon-werkverkeer geheel vergoed.
  • Voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en als je elders de opleiding tot huisarts wilt volgen, leer je hier de cliënt als persoon te zien. Je doet ervaring op met gesprekstechniek en de-escalatie.
  • Je krijgt toegang tot Nrgize: een platform met allerlei (deels gratis) sportieve activiteiten: van boksclinics, bootcamps tot windsurfen.

Het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Wat breng je mee?
Je bent een BIG-geregistreerd basisarts met affiniteit met de cliëntendoelgroep. Bij voorkeur heb je kennis van de GGZ en van wet- en regelgeving WGBO en WvVGGZ. Het werk kenmerkt zich door hectische momenten waarbij een flexibele houding en de vaardigheid om snel te kunnen schakelen noodzakelijk is. Je bent een stevige persoonlijkheid die beschikt over inlevingsvermogen en creativiteit en je kunt met crisissituaties omgaan.

Verder ontvangen wij jouw sollicitatie heel graag, als je:

  • Een passende afgeronde opleiding op wo niveau hebt;
  • Flexibel bent en affiniteit hebt met werken in een team in ontwikkeling.

Werken bij ons
De Spoedeisende Psychiatrie Amsterdam (SPA) is onderdeel van Arkin en een samenwerkingsverband van Arkin en GGZ inGeest. Het behandelaanbod van de Spoedeisende Psychiatrie ziet er als volgt uit:

  • Op het verzoek van diverse verwijzers binnen Amsterdam waaronder politie, ambulance GGD-huisartsen, kunnen 7 dagen per week 24 uur per dag acute psychiatrische beoordelingen en, indien nodig, behandeling van patiënten verzorgd worden. Het betreft daarbij altijd personen die in een crisis verkeren, waarbij het vermoeden op psychiatrische problematiek bestaat. Patiënten worden zowel binnen de locatie van de SPA, SEH, politiebureau, thuis bij patiënt en elders gezien. Tijdens kantooruren wordt zorg geleverd door de verschillende crisisteams en kunnen naast de al genoemde activiteiten ook kortdurende crisis behandelingen worden verzorgd;
  • De crisisteams verzorgen zowel acute zorg als intensieve zorg thuis om opnames te voorkomen en of te verkorten;
  • De Geïntegreerde Crisisdienst Jeugd (GCDJ) kan 7 x 24 uur ingeroepen worden ten behoeve van kinderen die acute zorg en aandacht behoeven. Buiten kantooruren neemt de GCDJ bovendien de zorg over van verschillende stedelijke jeugdhulpverleningsinstanties.

Voor behandeling wordt de meest geschikte vorm op de meest geschikte locatie geboden. Dit betekent dat na de crisisinterventie (samen met de cliënt) wordt nagegaan waar de patiënt naar doorverwezen kan worden.

De houding van de medewerkers in de dagelijkse praktijk wordt het beste weer gegeven door 'Can do': 'niet kletsen, maar doen'.

Spoedeisende Psychiatrie Amsterdam (SPA) biedt 24/7 eerste hulp aan jongeren en volwassenen met (zeer) ernstige acute problematiek op psychisch, psychosociaal en psychopathologisch gebied, al dan niet in combinatie met een verslaving.

Meer weten over deze vacature?
Ben je enthousiast geworden van de vacature, reageer dan snel via de Sollicitatie button! Voor verdere informatie kun je contact opnemen met Eefje Suk Psychiater SPA via eefje.suk@ggzspa.nl of 06-21897737.

De vacature staat open t/m 31 augustus. Starten kan in september of oktober.

Wij zoeken het liefst zelf naar nieuwe collega’s, dat vinden we wel zo persoonlijk. Acquisitie wordt dan ook niet op prijs gesteld.

title: NORDMARK søger en bogholder til barselsvikariat
description:
Har du styr på tallene, trives du med ansvar, og har du lyst til at blive en vigtig del af et lille team, hvor alle gør en forskel? Vi søger en bogholder til et barselsvikariat fra medio august 2026 og ca. 11 måneder frem.

Om virksomheden

NORDMARK er en højteknologisk industrivirksomhed med base i Sæby, der har specialiseret sig i præcisionsbearbejdning af store og komplekse emner til både vindindustrien og den tunge industri. Virksomheden har mange års erfaring inden for CNC-fræsning, CNC-drejning og injektorboring og beskæftiger ca. 100 medarbejdere på fabrikken i Sæby. Økonomifunktionen er et lille, tæt team på 3 medarbejdere, hvor alle byder ind, når der er brug for en ekstra hånd.

En vigtig rolle

Som barselsvikar for vores bogholder bliver du en nøgleperson i virksomheden. Du får ansvaret for håndtering af den daglige økonomi og bliver samtidig en naturlig del af vores lille økonomiteam bestående af en Controller og CFO og måske dig. Vi sætter pris på, at man byder ind, når der er brug for en ekstra hånd – uanset om det gælder bogholderiet, telefonen eller et møde, der skal bestilles mad til.

Hos os er der ikke langt fra idé til handling, og du får stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag. Vikariatet løber fra medio august 2026 og ca. 11 måneder frem, og du får en grundig oplæring, så du hurtigt kan overtage opgaverne selvstændigt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Din kerne er bogføring, fakturering, betalinger og afstemninger, som du holder løbende ajour, så økonomien følger med forretningen. Sagerne er sjældent ens: nogle klarer du hurtigt, mens andre kræver, at du rykker en kunde eller finder ud af, hvorfor en betaling ikke stemmer med fakturaen, og bliver ved, til tallene passer. Dine arbejdsopgaver inkluderer følgende:

  • Daglig bogføring.

  • Betalinger og bankafstemninger.

  • Debitor- og kreditorstyring samt kunderyk.

  • Moms, Intrastat og øvrige indberetninger.

  • Løbende registreringer, bilag og dokumentation i økonomisystemet.

  • Opfølgning på produktionens timeregistrering

  • Telefonpasning og lettere administrative opgaver.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har enten en relevant uddannelse inden for økonomi, regnskab eller lignende, eller har opbygget tilsvarende faglig tyngde gennem solid, praktisk erfaring med bogholderi og administrative økonomiopgaver.

  • Arbejder sikkert med bogføring, kreditor- og debitorhåndtering, fakturering, betalinger, betalingsopfølgning, kunderyk og afstemninger.

  • Har forståelse for moms, Intrastat og øvrige relevante indberetninger og er tryg ved at arbejde i økonomisystemer.

  • Har forståelse for internationale transaktioner, da virksomheden handler på tværs af lande.

  • Kan kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

  • Er selvstændig, ansvarsbevidst og trives med en bred opgaveportefølje.

  • Møder både kolleger og gæster med godt humør og en positiv indstilling.

  • Kendskab til Business Central er en fordel

Vi tilbyder

Hos Nordmark bliver du en del af en virksomhed, hvor relationer, tillid og samarbejde er en vigtig del af kulturen. Vi tror på frihed under ansvar, en uformel omgangstone og en arbejdsplads, hvor alle bliver hørt.

Du får en alsidig stilling med stor selvstændighed, gode kolleger og en hverdag, hvor to dage sjældent er ens. Løn aftales efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontaktoplysninger

Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Der er tale om et barselsvikariat af ca. 11 måneders varighed. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send gerne din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anders Frydkjær på tlf. 27827417.

title: Solutions Architect (Insurance) - Fully Remote
description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

  • International Environment
  • 100% Remote
  • Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

  • We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
  • We’re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
  • We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
  • We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
  • We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
  • We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
  • We’ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
  • We’re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

About the Role

A cloud technology-focused individual providing design and delivery expertise for forward-looking solutions in a modern cloud-based insurance environment. The successful candidate will work directly with clients, assessing their needs, designing tailored solutions, and supporting business initiatives in alignment with defined roadmaps. This role is technology agnostic but emphasizes solutions leveraging heavily on AWS and/or GCP environments, incorporating elements of open-source, PaaS, and SaaS components.

What You Will Do

  • Engage with clients to understand their requirements and advise on appropriate solution architectures
  • Collaborate with Product Managers to ensure alignment between client needs and solution design
  • Work closely with Delivery Managers to oversee the architecture approach during solution deployment
  • Explore a range of possibilities and creative alternatives to identify the most effective solutions
  • Ensure that designed solutions are implemented in accordance with client expectations and company standards
  • Assist in identifying, specifying, and selecting off-the-shelf components to meet client needs
  • Provide ongoing support and guidance to clients throughout the implementation process
  • Maintain awareness of industry trends and emerging technologies to continuously improve solutions

Required Skills and Knowledge

  • At least 6 years of professional experience in solution architecture design and delivery roles in the insurance vertical with exposure to multiple lines of business
  • Experienced in delivering cloud-based technology product solutions in an enterprise environment
  • Ability to assist in defining and socialising a product/enterprise roadmap
  • Ability to translate client requirements into actionable steps and solution architectures
  • Understand business architecture models & patterns
  • Has designed and implemented innovative and creative solutions to business problems
  • Can think "outside the box", but also be able to understand the business constraints that lead to “in the box” approaches
  • Understand the optimum approaches for cloud-based applications with high availability and highly scalable solutions
  • Experienced in designing solutions in a Relational DB and noSQL environment
  • Experienced in designing for API & Micro-services centric environments
  • Demonstrated capability to self-learn new technology trends and approaches
  • Ideally has experience or understanding of the benefits of low-code platforms
  • While the Solution Architect is not expected to build the solutions experience of multiple development languages & various DB engines will be advantageous
  • Exposure to authentication and authorisation concepts (SSO, SAML integration, identity federation etc)
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

Required Competencies

  • Must be equally comfortable discussing the solution strategies and enterprise roadmap with people at all levels of our organisation and CxO to project-level teams in our clients
  • Strong analytical skills & ability to understand and collect business requirements from corporate clients.
  • Strong ability to build the value proposition and solution documents, and in some cases, the business case for a corporate client.
  • Relationship management experience with corporate clients.
  • Excellent organisational, interpersonal & communication skills and an ability to engage audiences
  • Excellent decision-making and judgment skills
  • Understanding of insurance business processes across all areas and at least two lines of business
  • Maintains direction and focus through proactive planning and organized approaches to work
  • Certification in one architecture discipline (TOGAF, Zachman, etc.) is a distinct advantage
  • Certification in one cloud environment is a distinct advantage with a broad knowledge and experience of the cloud platform’s capabilities
  • A high proficiency in working in English as your primary language

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Annual Leaves
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Anniversary Bonus
  • Stock Options (after 6 months)
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan

CoverGo Company Video

title: Head Chef | Wynyard Pavilion
description:
Lead the kitchen at one of Auckland’s premier waterfront venues

Located in the heart of Auckland’s CBD, Wynyard Pavilion is a vibrant waterfront destination known for its stunning views, exceptional atmosphere and diverse dining experiences. We’re looking for an experienced Head Chef to lead our kitchen team and take the venue to the next level.

This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate culinary leader who thrives in a high-volume environment and is ready to make their mark within one of NZ Venue Co.’s flagship venues.

About the opportunity:

Wynyard Pavilion operates a large-scale kitchen capable of delivering up to $60k+ in food sales per week during peak periods, alongside a busy functions calendar and consistent high-volume trade.

The venue features a pizza oven and offers the opportunity for a creative Head Chef to drive menu development, maintain high food standards and continue building an exceptional dining experience for our guests.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 5+ years’ experience in a Head Chef or similar senior kitchen leadership role

  • Proven experience managing a large, high-volume kitchen operation

  • Strong commercial understanding, including food costs, labour and kitchen performance

  • A leader who is passionate about developing menus and elevating the venue offering

  • Experience managing functions and large-scale service environments

  • A hands-on chef who leads from the front and inspires their team

The ideal candidate will be:

  • Someone who is willing to grow and build a long-term career with a large hospitality group

  • A culinary leader who can drive the menu and take the venue to new heights

  • A team-focused individual who works closely with their team to create consistency, collaboration and a positive kitchen culture

Why join NZ Venue Co.?

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus of up to $20K paid quarterly

  • Lead one of Auckland’s most recognised waterfront venues

  • Opportunity to make your mark in a high-profile CBD location

  • Career growth opportunities across NZ Venue Co.

  • Be part of a supportive and passionate hospitality group

  • Staff discounts across 240+ venues in Australia & NZ

We’re looking for a true team player who is ready to lead, inspire and create something special at Wynyard Pavilion.

Apply now and take the next step in your culinary leadership career.

title: Product Owner
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Owner based in Germany.

This role offers the opportunity to shape engaging digital products within a fast-paced and innovative iGaming environment. As a Product Owner, you will be responsible for transforming business needs into clear product initiatives and actionable development tasks. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, QA, Design, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions. The position requires a strong understanding of user needs, agile delivery, and continuous product improvement. You will play a key role in prioritizing features, optimizing workflows, and ensuring that every release creates value for both users and the business. This is a fully remote opportunity with an international team culture focused on ownership, collaboration, and growth.

Accountabilities:

As a Product Owner, you will take ownership of product execution by translating strategic objectives and business requirements into well-defined solutions that development teams can deliver effectively. You will work closely with multiple stakeholders to ensure product priorities are clear, aligned, and focused on maximizing value.

  • Own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring user stories, requirements, and development tasks are clearly defined and prioritized.
  • Translate business needs into actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and detailed tickets for engineering teams.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities to support smooth delivery and maximize product impact.
  • Investigate product challenges, analyze user behavior and performance insights, and recommend solutions to enhance the overall experience.
  • Validate requirements, challenge assumptions, and evaluate trade-offs before development begins.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, QA specialists, Designers, and business teams to align priorities and deliver high-quality features.
  • Support QA processes by ensuring delivered solutions meet business expectations and product standards.
  • Contribute to continuous product improvement by identifying opportunities for optimization and innovation.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has experience working in product roles within digital environments and is comfortable managing agile product delivery processes. You are analytical, proactive, and able to connect business goals with technical execution while collaborating effectively with diverse teams.

    • 2+ years of experience in Product Owner or similar Product roles, preferably within the iGaming industry.
    • Strong experience working with Agile development teams and product delivery frameworks.
    • Ability to transform business ideas into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and development requirements.
    • Strong problem-solving mindset with curiosity to understand user needs and identify improvement opportunities.
    • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate, challenge assumptions, and influence stakeholders.
    • Proactive ownership mindset with the ability to independently identify solutions and drive initiatives forward.
    • Experience using product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
    • Ability to analyze product performance and user behavior is a plus.
    • Experience with FullStory, BI dashboards, product analytics tools, or experimentation frameworks such as A/B testing is a plus.
    • Basic understanding of software development processes and engineering workflows is beneficial.
    • Agile certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner, or similar are considered an advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working environment with flexibility to work from anywhere.
      • Schedule aligned with European working hours (10:00–18:00 CEST/CET).
      • Company-provided equipment, including laptop, headphones, and mouse.
      • Opportunities for career development, training, and professional growth.
      • Quarterly performance reviews with opportunities for recognition, salary increases, and career progression.
      • Fitness reimbursement from the start of employment.
      • Access to a health budget after one year to support personal well-being.
      • Dedicated self-development budget for courses and professional learning.
      • 22 days of annual leave, increasing by one additional day per year up to 26 days.
      • Additional birthday leave after one year of employment.

title: Maanrakentaja Turkuun (aloitus heti)
description:
Reilumpaa ja palkitsevampaa työnvälitystä! Vuonna 2018 perustetun yrityksemme tavoitteena on tarjota mielenkiintoisia työmahdollisuuksia Uudellamaalla sekä Varsinais-Suomessa. Kauttamme löydät eri pituisia tehtäviä niin raskailta aloilta kuin toimistoympäristössä. Kurota siis hunajapurkkiin ja löydä uusi työsi!

Meidät löydät livenä sekä netistä. Tule moikkaamaan!


Tehtävänkuvaus

Haemme asiakkaallemme maanrakennustyöntekijää Turkuun. Töitä on osaavalle tekijälle tarjolla pitkäksi aikaa. Työt sijoittuvat arkipäiville. Kohteet sijaitsevat Turussa.

Toivomme sinulta

Olet tehnyt maanrakennustöitä aikaisemmin ja maanrakennusalan keskeisimmät työvaiheet ovat sinulla hallussa. Kaivinkoneen perämiehen työt on sinulle tuttua ja osaat käyttää putki- ja tasolasereita, ja toimit työmaalla työturvallisuuden huomioon ottaen. Tehtävässä edellytetään kuvienlukutaitoa. Arvostamme oma-aloitteista ja huolellista asennetta.

Työtehtäväsi

Tehtäviisi kuuluu monipuoliset maanrakennustyöt, kuten sadevesi- ja salaojaputkien asentaminen sekä kaivinkoneenkuljettajan perämiehenä toimiminen.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme aina osaamiseen perustuvan, kuitenkin vähintään TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen. Kunnolliset työvälineet ovat kunnian asia, ja tiimimme tukee sinua kaikissa työsuhdeasioissa. Löydät meiltä aina jatkoa edelliseen pestiin, ja kauttamme on useasti päädytty asiakasyrityksen vakituiseksi työntekijäksi.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?

Hae tehtävää heti, tai vinkkaa kaverillesi! Täytä lyhyt hakulomake, ja muista liittää mahdollinen CV ja muut liitteet. Lisätietoja tehtävästä voi kysyä lähettämällä meille sähköpostia (niklas.remmer@contiopalvelut.fi), tai soittamalla arkisin (9-15) 0407205545. Hakuprosessista vastaa Niklas Remmer.

Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!


Contio Henkilöstöpalvelut

Sähköposti: niklas.remmer@contiopalvelut.fi Sijainti: Turku

title: Trading Intern
description:
Flow Traders is looking for entrepreneurial, competitive, and analytical students to join our Trading department as an Intern. What better way to find out if a career in Trading is something for you, than by experiencing it yourself as a Trading Intern!

You will get a 360-degree view of our role in the financial markets, how our Traders seize opportunities, and how they work together as a team to optimize and improve their trading desk. This Trading internship is about immersing yourself in the financial markets and experiencing trading up close. You do not need to have a financial background; we will teach you all you need to know.

Experience with a scientific programming language or excel is a definite advantage. Working closely with Traders and Quantitative Researchers, you will add value by working on real trading projects. You will solve problems, create new tools and/or design new strategies. You will test your project in a trading simulation.

What You Will Do

  • Learn directly from industry leaders on the APAC Trading floor
  • Participate in educational courses and trading simulations
  • Design trading strategies through project-based work using quantitative modelling and trading applications
  • Work through real life trading problems with our Traders and Quantitative Researchers
  • Gain insight into Flow Traders’ core business
  • Participate in intern activities and become a part of our “One Team” culture

Internship Duration

  • June 2027 - July 2027/ December 2027 - January 2028
  • This is a full-time paid internship and will last for 6 weeks
  • The internship is only open for students based in the APAC region. A similar program is offered in our Amsterdam and New York offices for students living in Europe and the US respectively.
  • Flight and accommodation will be provided to all successful overseas applicants.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Graduating between August 2027 and December 2028 with a Degree in Finance, Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or related disciplines from a university in APAC

title: Muurari Jyväskylään
description:
Osaava muurari, hae meille töihin!

Etsimme asiakkaallemme ammattitaitoista muuraria Jyväskylän alueelle!

Työtehtäväsi sisältävät vaihtelevia muuraustöitä niin uudiskohteissa kuin saneerauskohteissakin. Sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta muuraustöistä. Tehtävissä menestyminen edellyttää huolellisuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti. Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääasiassa Jyväskylässä, mutta mahdollisuus on työskennellä myös muualla Keski-Suomessa mikäli sinulla on auto käytettävissäsi. Työssä tarvitaan voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

* Rakennusalan koulutusta ja aiempaa kokemusta rakennusalalta sekä muuraustöistä
* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia
* Reipasta työskentelyotetta ja kykyä tehdä fyysistä työtä

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

* TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 15,55 - 20 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.
* Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka tukee sinua kaikissa työsuhteeseen liittyvissä asioissa
* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä eri asiakasyrityksillä ja projekteissa, joissa voit kehittyä ja laajentaa osaamistasi



Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

* Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

* Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.

* Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

* Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!

title: Team Lead, Platform Engineering (2x Openings)
description:
About The Role

Volta builds and operates large scale GPU compute infrastructure for AI workloads. Our platform is Kubernetes-native, spans multiple regions, and delivers virtual machines, storage, and networking through a fully automated infrastructure stack.

Platform Engineering is organized as capability teams, each owning a defined part of the stack: compute, storage, the control plane and API layer, confidential computing, networking, and the customer-facing surface. You will lead one of them.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You set technical direction for your team's area, carry accountability for what it delivers, and manage the people doing the work. You are expected to stay close enough to the code to take on the hard problems yourself.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead a platform engineering team: technical direction, design reviews, code review, and day-to-day delivery.

  • Set the technical direction for your team's area of the stack, and design and build the platform layers it owns as product requirements take shape.

  • Represent platform engineering in roadmap planning: translate product requirements into scoped, sequenced technical work, communicate trade-offs, and keep delivery on track.

  • Work closely with the bring-up teams to surface operational pain points and turn them into scalable platform features.

  • Collaborate with the security engineering team to integrate security guidance at the platform layer and ensure findings are remediated effectively.

  • Coordinate with the other platform engineering leads on shared architecture, joint initiatives, and cross-team and cross-timezone delivery.

  • Own reliability, observability, security, and interface and versioning standards for the services your team ships.

  • Stay hands-on: take on complex or high-risk engineering work directly alongside the team.

  • Run post-mortems and close structural gaps after incidents, not just the immediate issue.

  • Manage the team: 1:1s, performance conversations, hiring interviews, and onboarding.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in cloud platform or infrastructure engineering, with at least 2 years leading an engineering team.

  • Strong backend or systems programming background in a production environment. Our working languages are Python, Go, and Rust; we welcome strong engineers from other compiled or object-oriented languages (for example C++, C#, or Java) who are ready to work across our stack as it evolves.

  • Kubernetes at depth: cluster operations, CNI networking, scheduling, and workload management in production.

  • GPU infrastructure experience: provisioning, resource allocation, and surfacing capacity through a platform or API layer.

  • Solid networking fundamentals: L2/L3, VLANs, overlay networks, and multi-tenant isolation in cloud environments.

  • Service architecture skills: designing, operating, and versioning production-grade control-plane services and APIs across IaaS and above, holding the team to clean, industry-standard interface and breaking-change practices.

  • Security awareness: trust boundaries, least privilege, and secure defaults when building platform services.

  • Proven people management: running 1:1s, delivering performance feedback, and taking accountability for a team's delivery and wellbeing.

  • Clear communicator who can translate technical complexity for product and leadership stakeholders.

Nice to Have (But Not Essential)

None of these are required. Several map to specific teams, so strength in one or more helps us match you to the right one:

  • Fluency with AI-assisted development, and interest in scaling agent-assisted workflows across the team (agentic CLI tools, MCP, skills, APIs) to amplify delivery.

  • Familiarity with confidential computing technologies: TEEs, AMD SEV, Intel TDX, or Confidential Containers (CoCo).

  • Experience building SaaS or PaaS layers on top of an IaaS platform.

  • Familiarity with RDMA, InfiniBand, or RoCE networking in GPU or HPC clusters.

  • Experience working distributed across time zones with counterparts in other regions.

  • Exposure to serverless or inference serving infrastructure.

    REQ-15

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Saudi Arabia.

This role offers the opportunity to design and build the foundation of an AI-native operating environment used across a global organization.
You will create scalable infrastructure that enables intelligent agents to operate reliably, securely, and transparently.
The position combines advanced AI engineering, platform development, governance, and automation to solve complex operational challenges.
You will own the architecture, execution layer, evaluation systems, and tooling required to make AI workflows trustworthy.
Working in a fully remote and highly autonomous environment, you will influence how teams adopt and benefit from AI at scale.
This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building foundational systems, solving open-ended problems, and shaping the future of AI-powered work.

Accountabilities

The AI Platform Engineer will be responsible for building and operating the infrastructure that enables reliable, measurable, and governed AI systems across the organization.

  • Design, build, and maintain the AI execution platform, including event-triggered workflows, model-agnostic runtimes, durable state management, human review processes, rollback mechanisms, and comprehensive run logging.
  • Own the architecture decisions required to bring AI agent systems into production and ensure the platform operates reliably at scale.
  • Develop the evaluation layer that determines whether AI systems are safe, accurate, and ready for production use.
  • Create golden test suites, behavioral evaluations, safety checks, and CI gates that prevent unreliable AI capabilities from being deployed.
  • Build and manage a portfolio of AI agents supporting business workflows such as reporting, drafting, analysis, triage, and knowledge management.
  • Develop meta-level systems that monitor agent performance, identify improvements, and continuously enhance the platform.
  • Implement governance mechanisms directly into the platform, including risk tiers, least-privilege permissions, tool access controls, audit logging, and human approval workflows.
  • Ensure high-risk AI actions are technically restricted through system design rather than relying only on policies or prompts.
  • Design responsible communication systems that optimize notifications, minimize interruptions, and increase user trust and adoption.
  • Build platform tooling, including validators, compilers, context distribution systems, and integrations across repositories and collaboration environments.
  • Create data pipelines and reporting systems that measure AI adoption, operational impact, maturity levels, and return on investment.
  • Instrument AI workflows to track usage, efficiency gains, costs, and measurable business value.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an experienced AI platform engineer with a strong background in production-grade AI systems, infrastructure ownership, and reliable software engineering practices.

    • Proven experience building and deploying production LLM agent systems used by real users, beyond prototypes or demonstrations.
    • Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including golden datasets, behavioral assertions, judge criteria, safety testing, and automated quality gates.
    • Experience designing and implementing reliable AI workflows where correctness, traceability, and governance are critical.
    • Deep API integration experience with business systems and experience creating MCP servers.
    • Strong infrastructure engineering skills using Python, cloud platforms such as GCP, cloud data warehouses, and infrastructure-as-code tools.
    • Ability to independently design, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production systems end to end.
    • Experience with LLM observability, tracing, cost tracking, and transforming AI execution data into actionable insights.
    • Strong understanding of security principles, access controls, permissions management, and system-level risk prevention.
    • Experience building internal platforms, developer tools, or automation systems that achieved strong adoption among non-engineering teams.
    • Strong product mindset and ability to design AI experiences that respect user attention and build trust.
    • Experience working with agentic development tools and the ability to explain workflows, permissions, approval points, logging strategies, and lessons learned from failures.
    • Public contributions such as open-source AI frameworks, MCP servers, evaluation tools, or technical writing in AI reliability are considered a strong advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.
      • Remote-first culture with coworking support through a WeWork membership or coworking allowance.
      • Employee equity ownership program.
      • Technology allowance to create an ideal home office setup with equipment of your choice.
      • Comprehensive health benefits, including full employee health insurance coverage and dependent coverage support.
      • Annual company off-site gatherings focused on collaboration, connection, and team building.
      • Flexible and asynchronous work environment built on trust and autonomy.
      • Annual professional development budget for courses, books, conferences, and learning opportunities.
      • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team across multiple countries and cultures.
      • Chance to contribute to open-source-driven products used by a large developer community.
      • High-impact role with significant ownership over AI infrastructure strategy and execution.

title: Global Learning Program Manager
description:
Position Title:

Global Learning Program Manager

Position Type:

Regular

Hiring Range:

$70,600 - $84,700 annual; compensation will be based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.

Pay Frequency:

Annual

1. POSITION PURPOSE


The Global Learning Program Manager is part of the Global Engagement team who lead global programs and strategy, and promote global diversity and intercultural learning for the University. Key programs and responsibilities in Global Engagement include international students and scholars, education abroad, international partnerships and strategic initiatives, University-sponsored international travel approval for the University, and campus programming that supports global diversity and intercultural learning.


The Global Learning Program Manager is part of a small dynamic team that includes the Director and Assistant Director of Global Learning, and part of the larger team in Global Engagement that leads programs and initiatives for students, faculty and staff that enhances global perspectives and global learning at the University. Global Learning in Global Engagement is the central hub for SCU student experiences abroad and a key department with responsibility for executing the goals of SCU’s strategic plan, Our programs provide students with global learning outcomes that exemplify an SCU Impact 2030 Priority One: Reach on a Global Scale. Global Learning Programs in Global Engagement include:

  • Study Abroad

  • Summer Study Abroad

  • Global Internships

  • Fulbright UK Summer Institutes

  • Global Explorations Faculty-Led

  • Undergraduate Research Abroad

  • Global Engagement Discovery Fellowships

  • Exchange and Visiting International Students

SCU’s Global Engagement is committed to work/life balance and building a globally inclusive community. If you are hired, this is what Santa Clara University will offer you with a few of our benefit highlights:

  • 15 days vacation accrued in year 1 of employment, and 20 days accrued vacation after 3 years; 14 holidays, 4 personal days accrued each year, all fully paid

  • Option for a flexible work arrangement

  • Paid Family Leave Insurance. Staff eligible after earning at least $3,000 and have paid into CA State Disability in the last 18 months

  • Retirement contribution of 10% base salary and auto 5% employee contribution (which can be opted out or adjusted) for employees to make additional retirement contributions

  • Tuition remission for 100% of tuition for employees after 1 year and for dependents after 3 years.

  • Commuter benefits for public transit FSA up to $340/month

  • Dependent care FSA up to $7,500/year

  • Free access to campus fitness center and pool

  • Free library access, including free online access NYT, Wallstreet Journal, San Jose Mercury News, Chronicle of Higher Education

  • University-sponsored health and wellness workshops and events, such as chair massages on campus (reasonable additional fee), mindfulness and meditation, reiki sound meditation, personal finance workshops and 1:1 financial consulting, nutrition workshops, etc.

  • And of course, medical, dental, vision, LTD, Life and healthcare FSA benefits

  • Detailed information on SCU’s excellent benefits is available here:

2. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Overseeing Advising Framework (40%)
Employing developmentally and culturally appropriate advising frameworks and methods for students and families

  • Demonstrates understanding of all undergraduate major/minor/Core requirements, Global Learning program courses for all approved programs (approximately 60 academic year and 30 summer programs) and advises students on course planning, integration and selection.

  • Provides advising to diverse student and campus populations, including targeted group advising, supervision of peer-advising, and individual advising appointments.

  • Advises prospective, current and returned participants and their families in areas such as University policy, programs, health and safety, financing, course planning and curriculum requirements

  • Stays current with changes in University policies, Global Learning program portfolio, scholarship opportunities and undergraduate degree programs

  • Maintains awareness of health, safety, risk management issues in education abroad

  • Develops advising materials and resources, including writing and designing content for the Global Learning Advising Module in Camino.

  • Identifies new opportunities to improve upon the existing advising program based on best practices

  • Serves as primary lead responding to the globallearning@scu.edu inbox


Program Management (50%)

Work as part of a team by assuming primary or secondary responsibility for one or more specific programs managed by the Global Learning Team


a. Peer Advisor Program Management and Supervision:

  • In collaboration with the Director of Global Learning, provides day-to-day management of the Peer Advisor Program, including hiring, training and supervision of six Peer Advisors.

  • Manages Peer Advisor schedules and advising appointment schedules.

  • Develops training curriculum, e.g., videos, quizzes for Peer Advisor Program

b. Outreach/Advising/Application Program Management

  • Plans and manages the annual Global Opportunities Expo fair; Coordinates event logistics and partners with vendors, campus collaborators, and Global Learning program student alumni to support successful programming.

  • Actively participates in Global Learning application review and selection process

  • Creates and manages promotional materials, newsletters, social media content, and digital campaigns that reflect SCU’s values of diversity and cura personalis.

  • Writes/Manages/Sends weekly newsletter sent to all prospective/interested students

  • Writes/Manages/Sends parent/family newsletter for all interested parents/families

  • May engage in social media communications (YouTube channel, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, etc.)


c. ​Pre-departure Orientation Program Management

  • Responsible for organization of pre-departure orientation programming that is mandatory for all students participating in Global Learning programs including: health and safety, verification of mandatory pre-departure forms; organization of on-line and in-person mandatory sessions; student communication including reminders and make-up sessions


d. Evaluation/Re-entry/Returning Student Program Management

  • Manages reentry programming for all students after return to campus from Global Learning programs including focus on academic and career integration

  • Manages the dissemination and collection of the mandatory Global Learning programs evaluation and SCU Global Learning assessment components, including communication to students who do not submit by the deadline

e. Tracks programming attendance and participation outcomes to guide strategic improvements and ensure inclusive outreach.

f. Analyzes student participation data, assessment results, and trends in Global Learning to guide improvements and emphasize the ability to use data to measure program outcomes.

g. Conducts site visits to programs abroad and/or participates in education abroad meetings focused on best practices, e.g., The Forum, normally once annually


Cross-Departmental Communications and Collaboration (10%)
Collaborates with academic departments, student organizations, Drahmann Center, Residential Learning, LEAD, Honors, Athletics, RLCs, International Students and Scholars, Young Scholars Program, Transfer Student Welcome. Leads or participates in programming, working groups or designated committees that promote Global Engagement to faculty, staff and students across campus.

  • Arranges student participation and may represent Global Learning to support campus-wide events such as, Family Weekend, Preview Days, Orientation, and Welcome Weekend

  • Responsible for marketing the Peer Advising program to students and other constituencies

  • Supports Director and Assistant Director in generating content for the website

  • Updates content provided by Director/Assistant Director in Terra Dotta. Recommend design and format updates to improve user experience with Terra Dotta with an understanding of data integrity necessary for staff.

  • Leads or actively participates in programs or initiatives within Global Engagement that contribute broadly to the internationalization of the campus and collaborates with colleagues within Global Engagement and other departments to achieve effective outcomes for events and initiatives

General Expectations for Global Engagement

  • Knowledgeable about intercultural/global learning

  • Builds relationships across campus to further Global Engagement’s institution-wide responsibility for campus internationalization

  • Excellent cross-cultural, written and oral communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with students, parents, faculty, staff, overseas universities and organizations

  • Leads/actively participates in programs or initiatives within Global Engagement that contribute to the internationalization of the campus

  • Effective team player across teams and areas within Global Engagement

  • Actively promotes and supports Global Engagement’s Mission, Vision, Values.

  • Adheres to the highest ethical and professional standards of conduct.

  • Demonstrates flexibility and openness to new ideas; acclimates to new situations and contingencies; assists in other areas when appropriate.

  • Takes initiative to improve procedures, processes and services; identifies issues, problems, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Adheres to and champions Global Engagement performance expectations

  • Demonstrates the ability and willingness to communicate effectively with people of diverse backgrounds and experiences to create a collaborative, collegial, and caring community.

  • Other duties as assigned; These duties are customary for this position, but are not to be construed as all-inclusive. Duties may be added, deleted and assigned based on management discretion and institutional needs.

PROVIDES WORK DIRECTION

Not Applicable

GENERAL GUIDELINES

  • Recommends initiatives and implements changes to improve quality and services.

  • Identifies and determines cause of problems; develops and presents recommendations for improvement of established processes and practices.

  • Maintains contact with customers and solicits feedback for improved services.

  • Maximizes productivity through use of appropriate tools; planned training and performance initiatives.

  • Researches and develops resources that create timely and efficient workflow.

  • Prepares progress reports; informs supervisor of project status; and deviation from goals. Ensures completeness, accuracy and timeliness of all operational functions.

  • Prepares and submits reports as requested and required.

  • Develops and implements guidelines to support the functions of the unit.

3. QUALIFICATIONS


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The items below are representative of the knowledge, skills, abilities, education, and experience required or preferred.

This position requires the ability to effectively establish and maintain cooperative working relationships within a diverse multicultural environment and to promote and contribute to an inclusive and respectful workplace.


a. Knowledge

  • Knowledge about integrating developmental and multicultural advising for individuals and groups and learning resources services and programs

  • Direct experience working with diverse student populations and supporting

  • diversity and inclusion initiatives

  • Experience facilitating orientation and information sessions

b. Skills

  • Excellent cross-cultural, written, oral and presentation communication skills

  • Google suite, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Terra Dotta and website experience desired

  • Process management and time management skills

  • Ability to compose and give effective presentations

  • Ability to communicate effectively with multiple audiences and de-escalate charged situations

  • Results oriented

  • Sound professional judgment

  • A team player

c. Abilities

  • Ability to handle confidential information appropriately according to state and federal laws, as well as campus procedures

  • Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships within a diverse multicultural environment

  • Interact effectively with a broad range of constituents including students, parents, faculty, on-campus staff, overseas staff and institutions

  • Work effectively as both part of the Global Learning team and also the Global Engagement Team

  • Execute change and follow through on activities and initiatives

  • Maintain confidentiality and handle matters with sensitivity and tact

  • Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism

  • Coordinate a variety of responsibilities to accomplish assignments within set deadlines

  • Work occasional evenings and weekends

d. Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required


e. Years of Experience

Required: 3-5 years of work experience or equivalent in:

  • Student advising, or

  • Program administration in a university or educational organization related to students

Preferred: Two years working in a university setting; working with education abroad; working with other academic or co-curricular programs.

title: Account Director - 13 Month Mat Cover FTC
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

The Role

Please note this is a Mat Civer- 13 months FTC contract

Our Account Director (AD) is a knowledgeable and trusted Client lead, accountable for end-to-end project delivery, management of client and agency relationships, and leadership of a diverse and dynamic team, including direct line management responsibility for one or more Account Managers/Executives, supporting their growth and development. Responsible for operational discipline, delivery, resource optimisation and profitability management across Clients and projects, the AD is the key point person for the projects they lead — accountable for delivering on time, on specification and on budget, with particular fluency in print and digital production at scale, luxury and premium brand standards, and moving image/content production.

You are calm, collected and steady under pressure — a safe pair of hands who brings order and confidence to high-volume, fast-moving production environments. You are not a creative by background, but you are fluent enough in creative process and language to hold your own in conversation with creative partners, challenge and support their thinking from a production lens, and be seen by both client and agency as the production expert in the room. You possess strong problem-solving skills, a passion for production, marketing and advertising, and a desire to learn. Highly organised and accountable, you build trusting Client and team relationships, collaborate across multi-disciplined teams, and draw on the expertise of WPP Production's resources and capabilities to ensure we execute flawlessly, at scale, and to the elevated standards luxury and premium clients expect.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Communication

  • Responsible for managing the day-to-day client relationship with a focus on Client delivery
  • Oversee the on-time delivery of high-volume print and digital projects and ensure smooth delivery and swift resolution of issues to maintain client confidence in WPP Production's capabilities
  • The key day-to-day Client Delivery contact with clients, agencies and all associated WPP Production teams — recognised by both sides as the go-to production authority
  • Deep understanding of the client's brand, category and audience — including luxury/premium sensitivities around brand tone, positioning and exclusivity — to deliver high satisfaction levels; share feedback with wider team and escalate delivery concerns to Senior Account Director / Client Director
  • Act as the primary client contact for project delivery, structuring regular status and communications with clients, defining scope and approach, setting and managing expectations and deliverables, and troubleshooting issues calmly and confidently as they arise
  • Work with client brands, creative and agency partners to ensure a clear understanding of the production brief, deliverables and timeline for each project across print, digital and moving image, and relay those details to the team as necessary
  • Confidently engage in discussions around creative concepts and direction with agency/creative partners — not to direct the creative, but to represent production feasibility, timing, budget and scale considerations credibly and constructively
  • Accountable for ensuring all team members are aware of timelines and deliverables

Collaboration

  • Partner with Client Services, Production and Finance to ensure a smooth process, proper resource allocation and superior results
  • Directly manage, mentor and develop a team member(s), setting clear objectives, providing regular feedback, and fostering a culture of ownership and accountability
  • Develop and maintain high levels of team effectiveness, trust, communication, collaboration, productivity, diversity and engagement
  • Demonstrate strong collaboration skills with internal agency teams (including creative teams — Art Directors, Designers, Copywriters) and key external partners to ensure quality and adherence to production and brand guidelines for key deliverables
  • Act as a trusted production sounding board to external creative and account teams, balancing creative ambition with production feasibility, timelines, budget and scale

Process

  • Manage medium-to-complex projects independently and with a team, from initiation through to completion, across print, digital and moving image production
  • Bring proven experience of managing production at scale — high volumes of assets, multiple markets/formats, and complex versioning/adaptation requirements — with calm, methodical oversight
  • Work collaboratively with all internal team members to facilitate the development of effective strategies and briefs that lead to great work
  • Understand and anticipate client needs, taking them into account when framing and making delivery decisions
  • Possess an understanding of project and client management techniques and bring process innovation to how we manage our engagements
  • Manage client objectives, budget, expectations, deliverables and timelines and communicate changes/direction to team members
  • Keep projects on track through clear team status, task lists, timing schedules, risk register, trackers, status and contact reports
  • Participate actively and knowledgeably articulate status internally and during client interactions
  • Leverage our on-site, onshore, offshore network to deliver great work in the most efficient and effective way
  • Identify improvements to existing workflow and processes
  • Identify potential project risks and develop contingency plans; escalate to Senior Account Director / Client Director as needed
  • Review team structure and resources on an ongoing basis to ensure client is serviced appropriately
  • Ensure the highest quality and elevated attention to detail is always delivered to clients, consistent with luxury and premium brand standards

Leadership

  • Create a culture of fresh-thinking, collaboration, respect, equality, diversity and inclusion, with a focus on learning, development and growth
  • Provide day-to-day management, coaching and performance guidance to direct report(s), ensuring clarity of role, workload and development path
  • Contribute to WPP Production's culture by exhibiting ownership, professionalism, passion and leading by example
  • Remain calm, composed and solutions-focused under pressure, setting the tone for the wider team
  • Take ownership and find solutions, whilst supporting the wider team by removing barriers to success
  • Retain the best talent

Financials

  • Demonstrate strong commercial abilities and business and financial acumen
  • Own project budgets and tracking of all ongoing costs throughout the project lifecycle, reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects, and resolve budget discrepancies between disciplines, vendors and clients
  • Manage POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets — including high-volume print/digital production costs
  • Manage financial aspects of assigned accounts including development of SOWs and change orders, estimates, profitability analysis and utilisation, working with Finance where appropriate
  • Responsible for monthly billing and tracking of all production budgets
  • Ensure a thorough understanding of commercial arrangements and SLAs across assigned accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the broader team
  • Protect margins
  • Proactively seek and identify new revenue opportunities across your clients

Requirements

  • Project / Client management related experience within an interactive or integrated agency, with a strong understanding of print and digital production processes, and good working knowledge of video, content, social and other key channels
  • Proven experience managing production at scale — high-volume, multi-format, multi-market print and digital campaigns
  • Good understanding of production and the creative development process, content production, technology, quality assurance testing and marketing methodologies
  • Not required to be a creative themselves, but must be comfortable and credible discussing creative concepts, direction and feasibility with creative partners, clients and agencies, acting as the trusted production voice in those conversations
  • Experience with luxury and premium accounts/brands — comfortable navigating elevated standards, brand guidelines, sign-off processes and attention to detail these clients expect, along with sensitivity around brand tone, positioning and exclusivity
  • Experience with retail clients — understanding of retail marketing cycles (seasonal campaigns, store openings, product launches), multi-market/multi-territory rollouts, and the fast turnarounds retail calendars often demand
  • Familiarity with moving image production — understanding of film/video production processes, from pre-production through to shoot, edit, post-production and final delivery/versioning
  • Ability to manage complex projects with varying components, demonstrating ability to deliver on time and on budget
  • Prior experience managing, mentoring or supervising junior team members
  • A calm, collected, and unflappable demeanour — able to stay composed and clear-headed under pressure and at pace
  • Experience of building solid client relationships, including with senior/brand-side stakeholders in luxury and premium environments
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and relationships cross-functionally
  • An appreciation for how great work gets done and a commitment to ensuring flawless execution and delivery
  • Proven ability to collaborate with dynamic cross-functional teams, including close work with creative teams (Art Directors, Designers, Copywriters), to deliver on projects
  • Demonstrates an ability to solve problems with solutions that work for all stakeholders without compromising quality of deliverables or the project
  • Must be commercially astute, able to build scopes, create budgets and track profitability
  • Proven negotiation skills
  • Strong client relationship skills including presenting to clients and the ability to think on your feet
  • Strong written/oral communication skills
  • Experience of working with offshore teams a plus
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, wireframing/workflow tools, online project management/collaboration/ticketing tools e.g. JIRA, Smartsheet, Trello, Miro etc.

#LI-BS2

#LI-Hybrid

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

Please contact

title: [아이디어스] Data Analyst (7년 이상)
description:
About

■ 백패커(아이디어스, ​텀블벅, ​텐바이텐)는?

백패커는 ​아시아 최대 ​핸드메이드 마켓 플레이스인 아이디어스(idus),
창작자 ​프로젝트 ​기반 크라우드펀딩 ​서비스 텀블벅(Tumblbug),
No.1 디자인 ​전문 커머스 ​텐바이텐 ​(10x10)을 만드는 ​사람들이 ​모인 ​곳입니다.

아이디어스는 ​작품을 ​통해 손끝으로 온기와 ​가치를 전하는 ​작가님들이 ​활동하는 플랫폼으로,
단순 ​유통을 넘어 ​핸드메이드 ​문화를 선도하고 창작의 ​가치를 알리며 ​핸드메이드 마켓 플레이스에서 독보적인 선두 자리를 고수하고 있습니다.

수공예 악세사리부터 의류, 패션잡화, 디자인/인테리어 소품, 수제 먹거리까지 총 50만 개 이상의 다양한 카테고리의 작품들을 판매하며,
재구매 고객이 80% 이상에 달하는 등, 단순한 구매자를 넘은 팬층을 보유하고 있어요.

텀블벅은 누구나 새로운 시도를 즐길 수 있는 세상을 만들기 위한 크라우드 펀딩 플랫폼입니다.
작은 영감이 베스트셀러가 되고, 작은 아이디어가 브랜드 창업이 되는 일을 현실화 하며,
문화예술부터 패션, 출판, 리빙, 게임, 문화 등 다양한 분야 창작자들의 필수적인 펀딩 플랫폼으로 자리매김했습니다.

텐바이텐은 '디자인 감성채널'이라는 목표 아래, 여러 감각적인 디자인/IP 문구를 전문으로 하는 커머스 플랫폼입니다.
고객 취향 큐레이팅을 제안하며 유명 캐릭터, 브랜드, 아티스트 상품을 세상에 내보이기도하고,
여러 오프라인 행사를 통해 일상을 색다른 즐거움으로 채우는 특별한 가치를 만들어가고 있습니다.

백패커팀의 인재상, '모험과 험난한 여정 끝의 새로운 발견을 기대하는 배낭 여행자'는 우리의 일하는 문화와 방식을 담고 있습니다.
배낭여행자가 남들이 가보지 않은 험난한 길을 선택하고, 목적지를 향해 밤낮 가리지 않는 여정을 지속하듯
백패커팀도 남다른 비전/미션을 향해 발걸음을 내딛고 있으며,
높은 몰입도/그릿을 지닌 동료들과 함께 밤낮 없는 도전적 여정을 지속하고 있습니다.

우리는 이 과정을 통해 새로운 발견, 즉 성장과 성과를 만들어 낼 수 있다고 믿습니다.
모험과 험난한 여정, 새로운 발견이 기다리는 백패커의 여정이 보편적인 길이 아니기에 누구나 지원할 수 있는 회사는 아닙니다.

하지만, 이 여정에 가슴 뛰는 도전적인 DNA를 지닌 분들이라면 Backpackr안에서 압축적 경험과 성장, 새로운 발견을 기대할 수 있습니다.

Shall We Backpacking?

■ 개인의 성장 가능성
• 데이터를 기반한 전사 전략 수립부터 분석 문화 구축까지 경험할 수 있어요.
• 회사의 주요 KPI 설계, 데이터 거버넌스 수립 등 데이터 기반 의사결정 체계를 직접 만들어갈 수 있어요.
• 적극적인 AI 활용 지원 환경에서 데이터 분석 업무의 효율성을 성장 시키는 경험을 쌓을 수 있어요.

Responsibilities

■ 이런 일을 해요

• 프로덕트·사업 전반의 핵심 지표를 설계하고, 데이터로 의사결정을 지원해요.
• 퍼널·코호트·리텐션 분석으로 사용자 행동과 제품 변화의 효과를 측정해요.
• A/B 테스트를 설계·검증해 기능·정책 변화의 인과적 효과를 판단해요.
• 매출·GMV·마케팅 성과 등 사업 지표를 분석해 경영진의 전략적 의사결정을 뒷받침해요.
• 분석 결과를 PO·마케터·리더십 각 직군의 언어로 전달해요.
• 팀의 시니어로서 주니어 멤버가 분석 방향을 잡는 과정을 함께 고민하고, 분석 기준을 세워가요.

Requirements

■ 이런 분을 찾고 있어요

• 제품 기반 서비스에서 데이터 분석 7년 이상 또는 그에 준하는 역량을 갖추신 분
• 복잡한 분석을 위한 SQL 작성과 BI 툴(Redash·Tableau) 활용이 능숙하신 분
• A/B 테스트 설계와 통계적 유의성 검증 경험이 있는 분
• 분석 결과를 유관부서와 논리적으로 소통하고 설득할 수 있는 분

Preferred

■ 이런 경험이 있으면 더 좋아요

• 주니어 분석가와 협업하거나, 분석 방법·기준을 공유해본 경험
• LLM·AI 도구를 분석 워크플로우에 통합해본 경험
• 데이터 파이프라인 설계·ETL 자동화(Digdag 등) 경험
• 빠른 변화 속에서 우선순위를 정하고실행해본 경험

Benefits

[Health]
• 야근 시 저녁 식대 지원
• VIP급 건강검진 (연 1회)
• 본인 및 직계가족 1인의 실손 의료보험 지원

[Growth]
• 구성원 성장 지원, 업무 연관 교육 & 도서 구입 지원

[Culture]
• '님문화'와 '존댓말'로 서로 존중하는 커뮤니케이션
• 전사 주요 이슈를 경영진의 보이스로 직접 들을 수 있는 타운홀 미팅
• 수평적인 정보공유, 오픈 채널을 통한 전사 성과 및 업무 정보 공유

[Family]
• 축하와 위로가 필요한 순간, 기쁨과 슬픔을 나눌 수 있는 경조 지원
※ e.g. 충분한 휴식을 지원하는 경조휴가 및 상조 용품/서비스 지원 등

[기타]
