title: Technical Program Manager, Integrations
description:
We’re Heidi

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The Role

Heidi operates across US, UK, Australia, Asia Pacific and beyond — and integrations are the connective tissue that makes it work everywhere. This PM role is a central platform function: the common layer through which every Heidi product (Scribe, Comms, Evidence) interfaces with the external systems clinicians already live in.

EMRs. Scheduling systems. Document stores. Clinical references. Secure messaging. Wherever clinicians already work, Heidi should plug in without making them think.

The integration stack is real and in motion: SMART on FHIR launches inside the chart, structured write-back into Epic, Cerner, Athena, MEDITECH Expanse, Veradigm, Best Practice. HL7 ADT feeds for patient demographics. Pre-charting from appointment data. The Integration Marketplace — surfacing Scribe, Comms and Evidence integrations in one place — is being rebuilt now, and you’ll own where it goes next.

You’ll own the integration framework, the customer-facing marketplace, and the roadmap that decides which connector ships next and how deep it goes. A small dedicated engineering squad sits alongside you. A new integration framework is rolling out. The marketplace is being unified across product lines. You’re picking up a running operation with strong opinions about where it goes.

Half your time is building the platform — the framework, the standards, the shared infrastructure every connector benefits from. The other half is customer-facing enablement: working directly with accounts, regional teams and commercial to get integrations live and keep them healthy. The hard part is that every customer feels bespoke, three regional teams are always pulling in different directions, and real EMR behaviour rarely matches the spec. You’ll need to hold the line between configuring for one account and building for the platform.

You need to understand how a real EMR write-back actually works — encounter IDs, appointment IDs, patient context, addendum vs edit, side-by-side comparison, sectional mapping, the lookup tables that break in v1.0.2 of the desktop app. You need to know when a customer request is a one-account fix and when it’s a framework change that touches every EMR. You need to be the person engineering trusts to call the build-vs-configure trade-off, and the person commercial trusts when they’re scoping integration requirements into a contract.

This role is based in Asia Pacific, ideally located in Singapore.

What you'll do

  • Own product strategy and roadmap for Heidi’s integrations surface — the framework, the marketplace, and the individual EMR and non-EMR connectors — setting clear goals and being held accountable to achieving them

  • Decide which integrations to build, which to deepen, and which to deprecate, balancing customer demand, regional pull and engineering cost

  • Serve as the central integration layer for Heidi’s product lines — when Scribe or Evidence needs to connect to an external system, the path runs through you

  • Own the Integration Marketplace as a single experience across Scribe and Evidence — including discoverability, multi-player setup and the closed loop on integration requests from growth

  • Drive the migration to the new integration framework so every connector benefits from shared infrastructure: sectional notes write-back, error handling, analytics instrumentation, multi-tenancy

  • Translate messy EMR realities — HL7 ADT messages, FHIR resources, Athena shell accounts, Cerner addendum behaviour, MEDITECH Expanse approval pathways, Best Practice workflows — into product specs engineering can build against

  • Set the standard for integration quality and reliability — error handling, write-back confirmations, latency, recovery from upstream failures — and be accountable to it

  • Be the connective tissue between US, UK and APAC regional teams: absorbing their competing priorities and translating them into a coherent platform roadmap rather than a queue of one-offs

  • Work directly with EHR partners, integration engines and platform teams to stay ahead of API changes and certification requirements

  • Connect field signal back to the framework: when the same gap shows up across three accounts or three regions, consolidate it into a platform fix instead of three bespoke ones

  • Expand integrations beyond EMRs — document stores (SharePoint, GDrive, OneDrive), clinical and drug references, scheduling systems, secure messaging — wherever clinicians already work.

If we'd worked together the last 6 weeks, you'd have:

  • Shipped the migration of an existing integration (e.g. Athena) onto the new framework and unblocked sectional notes write-back and mobile parity as a downstream consequence

  • Spent half-days with three customer accounts watching clinicians actually use the EMR alongside Heidi — Cerner clinician mapping, Athena multi-department provider setup, MEDITECH Expanse review-ambient flow — and come back with discrete tickets that changed the next sprint

  • Diagnosed why outbound write-back was failing for a specific Veradigm customer, traced it through the logs to a feature flag mismatch, and shipped the fix without waiting for a release train

  • Written the Integration Marketplace PRD that aligned Scribe, Comms and Evidence integrations into a single surface, with success metrics that commercial actually believes

  • Made a build-vs-configure call on an NHS letter-flow request — proved demographic extraction from a couple of ADT messages before committing to a full integration engine connection — and brought the regional team along for the ride

  • Said “no” to a one-off customer integration request and turned it into a framework capability that unblocked three other deals across two regions

What you'll need

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences or related)

  • 4+ years in product, integrations or technical roles — we care more about what you’ve shipped than years on the clock

  • Real fluency with healthcare interoperability: SMART on FHIR, HL7 v2 (ADT, ORM, ORU), FHIR resources, OAuth flows for clinical apps. This is a requirement, not a nice-to-have

  • Experience shipping platform or framework products where what you build for one customer becomes a configurable module for the next

  • Comfort making build-vs-configure trade-offs daily, and the judgment to know when a shortcut today costs three deployments tomorrow

  • The ability to hold a coherent roadmap under pressure from multiple regional teams with competing priorities

  • Diagnostic data fluency: you can read integration logs and distinguish a model problem from a framework problem from a customer-specific configuration issue

  • A romantic streak about software and a belief that great design transforms someone’s day

  • You build with AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, whatever ships faster) and can show what you’ve made with them

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems (prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation) and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • Strong opinions, weakly held: you’ll shift the room when you’re right

If you answer 'NO' to these questions, this may not be the job for you:

  • Are you an execution powerhouse?

  • Have you shipped something this week?

  • Are you good at games?

  • Did you have a weird teenage hobby?

  • Are you able to execute without a legion of data analysts, product marketers, and research coordinators at your beck and call?

  • Does the prospect of making health systems a lot nicer make you feel fuzzy inside?

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you

We offer a $1,000 annual learning and development budget, a $150/month health and wellness allowance, a $500 home office budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to $10,000, four weeks of work from anywhere per year, and serious equity.

title: Undersköterska
description:
Är du vår nästa undersköterska?

Vill du arbeta på en vårdcentral där patienten står i centrum och där samarbete, utveckling och arbetsglädje är en självklar del av vardagen? Då kan detta var tjänsten för dig!

Om tjänsten

Vi söker en engagerad och serviceinriktad undersköterska som vill bli en del av vårt team. Hos oss får du ett varierande arbete där du möter patienter i alla åldrar och bidrar till en trygg, tillgänglig och kvalitativ vård.

Om oss

Hos oss på Capio vårdcentral i Lund blir du en del av en av Skånes största vårdcentraler. Här arbetar 69 engagerade medarbetare tillsammans för att ge våra ca 19 000 listade patienter en tillgänglig, trygg och högkvalitativ primärvård.

Vi tror på nära samarbete, korta beslutsvägar och ett arbetsklimat där varje medarbetare har möjlighet att påverka verksamheten. Våra team består av läkare, sjuksköterskor och medicinska sekreterare som tillsamman planerar och prioriterar patienternas vård genom dagliga teamronder.

Här hjälps vi åt, stöttar varandra och utvecklas tillsammans.

Din roll

Som undersköterska har du en viktig funktion i det dagliga arbetet på vårdcentralen. Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande och innefattar bland annat:

I tjänsten ingår bland annat:

  • Mottagningsarbete

  • Provtagning och medicinska kontroller

  • Assistera vid undersökningar och behandlingar

  • Samarbete med läkare, sjuksköterskor och övriga yrkesgrupper

  • Administrativa arbetsuppgifter kopplade till patientflödet

Vi erbjuder dig

  • Ett engagerat och närvarande ledarskap

  • Ett inkluderande arbetsklimat med hjälpsamma kollegor

  • Korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet att påverka verksamheten

  • En arbetsplats där kvalitet, utveckling och patientfokus går hand i hand

  • Kollektivavtal och goda pensionslösningar

  • Flexibla arbetsförutsättningar med flextid som ger möjlighet att kombinera arbete och familjeliv

  • Friskvårdsbidrag

Du blir en del av ett starkt team

På vår vårdcentral finns ett brett utbud av kompetenser, bland annat fysioterapeuter, arbetsterapeuter, psykosocialt team, barnmorskemottagning, barnavårdscentral, distriktssköterskor, diabetesmottagning, vaccinationsmottagning, Astma/KOL-mottagning och äldremottagning. Tillsammans skapar vi en arbetsmiljö där samarbete och kunskapsutbyte står i fokus.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är utbildad undersköterska och uppfyller Socialstyrelsens krav om skyddad yrkestitel, oavsett om du läst enligt tidigare eller nuvarande programstruktur. Goda språkkunskaper i det svenska språket i såväl tal som skrift är ett krav. Du får gärna har erfarenhet från primärvård eller mottagningsarbete, där vi lägger stor vikt på dina personliga egenskaper och din vilja att utvecklas samt göra skillnad för dina patienter.

Du är ansvarstagande, serviceinriktad och har ett gott bemötande. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i nära samarbete med dina kollegor. Du är flexibel, lösningsorienterad och vill bidra till att utveckla verksamheten.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vill du arbeta på en vårdcentral där engagemang, kvalitet och arbetsglädje står i fokus? Då ser vi fram emot att lära känna dig.

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Annonsen kan därför tas bort tidigare än planerat, så vänta inte - skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

Publicerat: 2026-08-04

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-09-06

title: Senior Software Engineer | Enterprise | Full-Stack
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Business Acceleration Track (BAT). This is the engine room of DeepL’s global growth. While our Research teams build the models, BAT builds the Revenue Flywheel that allows 200,000+ Enterprises (like the Fortune 500) to actually use and pay for them at scale .

We are moving upmarket. We are transitioning from a consumer-focused app to a mission-critical Enterprise Platform. You will be part of the team architecting the "Financial Nervous System" of DeepL — handling everything from Identity & Access Management (SSO, SCIM) to complex multi-seat Subscription Architectures and Fraud Prevention .

We don't hire engineers to just implement UI tickets. We hire Missionaries who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will own the full vertical: from the user-facing Admin Console in React to the distributed billing logic in C#/.NET.

Your responsibilities

  • Architect Revenue-Critical Flows: You will design and ship complex, high-stakes features like "Enterprise Licensing" or "Automated Seat Provisioning." You ensure that when a customer upgrades, the UX is instant, and the billing ledger is immutable.

  • Own the "Enterprise Experience": You will build the tools that empower CIOs and IT Directors to manage DeepL. You translate complex backend constraints (RBAC, Rate Limits) into simple, elegant UI workflows.

  • Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You work directly with Sales, Product, and Finance to translate "Annual Recurring Revenue" goals into scalable technical architectures .

  • Drive System Reliability: You understand that billing systems cannot fail. You build for idempotency and resilience, ensuring that our financial data is auditable and flawless, while maintaining a high-velocity frontend experience.


Qualities we look for

  • A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about the customer journey. You ask, "How does this feature help us close the next Enterprise deal?" before writing code.

  • Full-Stack Fluency: You are comfortable traversing the stack. You can design a React component for an Admin Dashboard in the morning and debug a distributed transaction in the backend in the afternoon.

  • Enterprise Domain Curiosity: You are interested in the hard problems of B2B SaaS—Identity (SAML/SSO), Monetization, and Compliance. You understand that these aren't "boring details"; they are the pillars of trust for enterprise clients .

  • High Agency: You don't wait for permission. If the billing reconciliation process is slow, you automate it. If the documentation for the API is unclear, you fix it.

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.


A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack .

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JL1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: UX Designer - Infrastructure
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX Designer - Infrastructure based in Ireland.

This role offers the opportunity to design intuitive experiences for complex open-source infrastructure products used by organizations worldwide.
You will work at the intersection of user experience, technology, and engineering to simplify advanced cloud and data center solutions.
The position combines UX strategy, research, design systems, and close collaboration with technical teams.
You will help shape tools that enable organizations to build, manage, and scale modern infrastructure environments.
Working in a globally distributed team, you will contribute to products that influence the future of enterprise technology and open-source innovation.
This opportunity is ideal for a technically curious designer who enjoys solving complex problems and creating impactful user experiences.

Accountabilities

The UX Designer will be responsible for creating user-centered experiences for infrastructure products while collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to improve usability, consistency, and overall product quality.

  • Design intuitive workflows and interfaces for complex infrastructure tools used to build and manage cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define product direction and improve user experiences.
  • Apply UX research methods, usability principles, and design heuristics to solve complex product challenges.
  • Translate technical complexity into clear, efficient, and accessible user experiences.
  • Contribute to the evolution and adoption of design systems that improve consistency across products.
  • Understand broader product ecosystems, technical constraints, and user needs to make informed design decisions.
  • Support cross-functional design initiatives and contribute to shared design practices across teams.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles and help improve design maturity throughout the organization.
  • Conduct user research, gather insights, and incorporate feedback into product improvements.
  • Communicate design concepts clearly to engineers, designers, executives, and other stakeholders.
  • Stay informed about emerging UX trends, research methods, and innovative design approaches.
  • Participate in international team gatherings and collaborative sessions to align on strategy and execution.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a technically minded UX professional with strong communication skills, a passion for technology, and experience designing solutions for complex products.

    • Strong knowledge and passion for user experience, product design, and technology.
    • Experience designing digital products, especially complex platforms, developer tools, enterprise applications, or technical products.
    • Ability to conduct user research and apply insights to improve product decisions.
    • Strong understanding of UX methodologies, design principles, and usability best practices.
    • Experience creating and maintaining design systems or reusable design patterns.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, designers, and leadership teams.
    • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain and defend design decisions clearly.
    • Curiosity, adaptability, and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
    • Interest in working with real technology, infrastructure, and technically complex environments.
    • Ability to think strategically while maintaining attention to detail and execution quality.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in User Experience, Design, STEM, or a related field is preferred, though alternative career paths are considered.
    • Ability and willingness to travel internationally several times per year for company events.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position with the flexibility to work from home.
      • Global and distributed work environment with regular in-person team gatherings.
      • Annual personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000.
      • Annual compensation reviews based on performance and market conditions.
      • Performance-based annual bonus opportunities.
      • Recognition and rewards programs.
      • Paid annual holiday leave.
      • Maternity and paternity leave support.
      • Employee assistance program and wellness platform.
      • Opportunity to travel internationally and collaborate with colleagues around the world.
      • Travel benefits and upgrades for long-distance company events.

title: Chefsygeplejerske søges til Afdeling for Intensiv Behandling, Center for Kræft og Organsygdomme, Rigshospitalet
description:
Er du en visionær leder med lyst og kompetencer til at lede Afdeling for Intensiv Behandling, 4131 sikkert gennem den transformation, der - i en fremtid med færre ressourcer – har som mål at levere høj kvalitet til patienter og pårørende, og samtidigt sikre at medarbejdere og ledere trives med et dybt meningsfuldt arbejde?

Afdeling for Intensiv Behandling, Rigshospitalet søger en chefsygeplejerske, som skal være med til at udleve Rigshospitalets vision om at være til gavn for den enkelte patient og det samlede sundhedsvæsen og ambition for sygeplejen.

Om Afdeling for Intensiv Behandling

Afdelingen varetager højtspecialiseret intensiv behandling og pleje af voksne og børn med et bredt udsnit af kirurgiske og medicinske tilstande. Afdelingen modtager patienter fra andre afdelinger på Rigshospitalet samt fra andre hospitaler i Danmark, Grønland og Færøerne.

Dertil har afdelingen ledelsesansvar for børneintensiv (PICU), der er under udvikling i et nært samarbejde med Mary Elizabeths Hospital under Juliane Marie Centret (JMC) og de øvrige intensive afdelinger på Rigshospitalet. Det er en ny måde at organisere og drive en børneintensiv afdeling på, hvor vi drømmer om et samtidigt fokus på familien og en familiecentreret tilgang, samtidig med høje intensive kompetencer og faglighed, og en robust kapacitet i en virkelighed med meget differentieret behov for børneintensive senge. Der er derfor brug for en stærk strategisk tilgang.

Afdelingen har ligeledes en stor opgave med at understøtte det grønlandske sundhedsvæsen med kompetente medarbejdere gennem den politisk vedtagne stafetordning.

Afdelingen har en høj forskningsprofil og en aktiv forskningsenhed, hvor vi bidrager til udviklingen af fremtidens behandlinger og sygepleje, samt undersøger om det vi gør, også virker, overvejende gennem platformsforsøg. Opbygning af denne kompetence på hospitalet udspringer fra forskningsenheden.

Vi er en afdeling, hvor vi prioriterer at patienter, pårørende og medarbejdere oplever faglighed, respekt, tillid, åbenhed, rummelighed og engagement, og anvender ledelseskraft på dette.

Afdelingen har ca. 170 årsværk fordelt på særligt sygeplejersker og læger og er inddelt i to teams med hver deres teamledelse. Vi råder over 20 senge, dertil kommer den PICU der er under opbygning.

Om Rigshospitalet

Rigshospitalet er som det eneste hospital i Danmark ikke defineret ved et geografisk optageområde, men alene ved sin specialiserede profil. Af samme grund indgår Rigshospitalet ikke i de sundhedsråd, som fra 2027 udgør den politiske grundstruktur i arbejdet omkring det nære sundhedsvæsen. Vi er meget optagede af at bidrage til at styrke et sundhedsvæsen tæt på patienterne, og vi forventer, at Rigshospitalet i fremtiden vil være mindre, smallere og tage et dybere ansvar for den faglige og driftsmæssige robusthed på tværs af geografi og specialiseringsniveauer.

Vores mission er sammen med regionale, nationale og internationale sundhedsaktører at sikre, at alle patienter – uanset hvor sjælden eller kompliceret deres sygdom er – får et behandlingstilbud af højeste faglige kvalitet i det danske sundhedsvæsen.

Vi arbejder sammen med kolleger på tværs af landet for at sikre, at alle patienter har adgang til den bedst mulige udredning og behandling – så tæt på, hvor de bor, som overhovedet muligt. Rigshospitalet er et tertiært og kvartært hospital. Derfor skal vi være et fagligt fyrtårn – også på den internationale scene - så danske patienter altid tilbydes optimal behandling gennem samarbejde med resten af det danske sundhedsvæsen.

Rigshospitalet er organiseret i syv centre og har ca. 12.000 medarbejdere. Over 80 % af vores aktivitet er specialiseret, og vi ser patienter fra alle landets kommuner. Vi udfører 75.000 operationer og har 1,3 mio. ambulante besøg om året, (men vi arbejder på at afvikle 30 % af vores ambulante aktivitet).
Om Center for Kræft og Organsygdomme (CKO)

Afdeling for Kræftbehandling er en del af Center for Kræft og Organsygdomme (CKO) på Rigshospitalet, som består af 7 afdelinger og har ca. 2.200 medarbejdere. CKO’s øvrige afdelinger er: Afdeling for Bedøvelse og Operation, Afdeling for Blodsygdomme, Afdeling for Nyre- og Hormonsygdomme, Afdeling for Kræft, Afdeling for Urinvejskirurgi og Afdeling for Transplantation og Sygdomme i Fordøjelsessystemet.

I CKO har vi særligt fokus på:

  • at være til gavn for patienten og det samlede sundhedsvæsen
  • at alle vores initiativer skaber værdi for vores patienter og at dette sikres gennem systematisk patientinddragelse
  • at vi har en sikker drift, således at vi behandler patienter på et højt fagligt niveau og overholder patientrettigheder
  • at vi samarbejder på tværs af Rigshospitalet, med andre hospitaler og øvrige sektorer i hele landet for at understøtte gode patientforløb
  • at forskning, uddannelse og innovation prioriteres og at det at deltage heri er en del af at være ansat i CKO
  • at vi anvender it og ny teknologi og bidrager aktivt til udvikling heraf således, at god klinisk praksis understøttes
  • at vi sikrer et godt og inspirerende arbejdsmiljø for både medarbejdere og ledere
Om stillingen

Chefsygeplejersken, der refererer til centerledelsen i Center for Kræft og Organsygdomme, skal sammen med cheflægen understøtte et godt samarbejde og fællesskab på tværs af afdelingen som forudsætning for et godt arbejdsmiljø og høj faglig kvalitet. Afdelingsledelsen har sammen ansvar for afdelingens strategi, kliniske aktivitet, budget, personale, uddannelse, forskning og innovation. Chefsygeplejersken vil blive en del af Rigshospitalets ledelsesgruppe og indgår i et tæt samarbejde med de andre afdelingsledelser i Center for Kræft og Organsygdomme.

Vi søger en ambitiøs, involverende og handlekraftig chefsygeplejerske, der gerne har ledelseserfaring på chefsygeplejerskeniveau og gerne med en ledelsesuddannelse.

Den nye chefsygeplejerske skal:

  • sammen med cheflægen udgøre en tværfaglig samlet afdelingsledelse for alle afdelingens personalegrupper
  • varetage opgaven som strategisk leder, med et samtidigt fokus på høj faglighed, faglig kvalitet, patientoplevet tryghed og kvalitet
  • arbejde organisatorisk med at mestre dualiteten mellem at være til gavn for den enkelte patient og det samlede sundhedsvæsen
  • gå forrest i udvikling af organisationen med det mål at levere høj kvalitet til patienter og pårørende i en fremtid med færre ressourcer, og samtidigt sikre at medarbejdere og ledere trives med et dybt meningsfuldt arbejde
  • i en fælles afdelingsledelse varetage de fire kerneledelsesområder driftsledelse, personaleledelse, faglig ledelse og strategisk ledelse. Det indebærer en grundforståelse af Rigshospitalet som en driftsorganisation og dermed fokus på driftssikkerhed i behandling, patientrettigheder og økonomi.
  • omsætte politiske mål og politikker til handling inden for de vedtagne budgetter
  • være stærk faglig og organisatorisk stemme i samarbejdet om fusionen til den nye Region Øst - også på det politiske niveau
Vores nye chefsygeplejerske har en naturlig tilgang til at:

  • arbejde med frisættelse som ledelsesstil indenfor klare rammer, med en god og tillidsvækkende autoritet, når det er behov for det
  • kommunikere tydeligt og anerkende medarbejdere, kollegaers og samarbejdspartneres bidrag og modige beslutninger
  • være en god rollemodel, kulturskabende og en lydhør og stærk formidler på alle niveauer
  • være transparent, eksekverende og vedholdende i ledelsesbeslutninger og derigennem kan motivere, lede og inspirere en tværfagligt sammensat personalegruppe
  • lytte, være oprigtigt nysgerrig og inddragende og dermed medvirke til en positiv arbejdskultur med psykologisk tryghed
  • udvikle og medvirke til medarbejdernes trivsel gennem involvering og engagement
  • arbejde konstruktivt indenfor afdelingens økonomiske rammer og datadrevet ledelse
Af personlige egenskaber vil der blive lagt vægt på evnen til at:

  • være en drivende kraft i transformationen
  • opbygge og fastholde gode faglige og tværfaglige relationer og samarbejde, internt som eksternt
  • se nye muligheder og udnytte det faglige og ledelsesmæssige potentiale i afdelingen
  • styrke kvalitetsudvikling, læring og forskning i afdelingen
  • have et stærkt fagligt såvel som ledelsesfagligt netværk
  • være synlig og eksekverende i den daglige ledelse
Succeskriterier

Chefsygeplejerskens præstation i stillingen vurderes efter følgende kriterier:

  • Afdelingens drives fortsat indenfor den fastsatte økonomiske ramme
  • Der er etableret et konstruktivt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde i afdelingsledelsen
  • Der er etableret gode samarbejdsrelationer og et godt netværk ift. vigtige samarbejdspartnere både internt og eksternt
  • Omstilling til afdelingens nye mål er påbegyndt med fremdrift og udvikling i PICU
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte centervicedirektør Mette Rosendal Darmer på mobil 51 68 45 17 (mette.rosendal.darmer@regionh.dk) eller cheflæge Simon Hyttel Sørensen tlf. 28 12 40 36 (simon.hyttelsoerensen@regionh.dk) for en fortrolig drøftelse.

Yderligere oplysninger

Der henvises i øvrigt til ledelsesregulativ for Region Hovedstaden og Rigshospitalet her.

Information om Center for Kræft og Organsygdomme og dets afdelinger kan findes her.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 16. august.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 20. august. Evt. anden samtale forventes afholdt den 25. august.

Du kan læse mere om afdelingen og centret på Rigshospitalets hjemmeside.

title: Associate Vice President, Integrated Planning, Media Delivery and Operations
description:

With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

In 12 months:

What your day job looks like :

    • Persuasiveness

We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer (Backend) based in Spain.

This role offers the opportunity to build reliable backend systems that power a modern compensation platform used by organizations and employees across Europe.
You will design, develop, and improve scalable services that simplify benefits, payments, and flexible compensation experiences.
The position combines backend engineering excellence, product thinking, and ownership within a fast-moving SaaS environment.
You will collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to solve meaningful customer problems from discovery through delivery.
Working remotely within Europe, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and directly influence product outcomes.
This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building impactful systems, improving reliability, and working in a collaborative product-driven culture.

Accountabilities

The Software Engineer (Backend) will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable backend systems while contributing to product decisions and improving the overall engineering experience.

  • Develop reliable, scalable backend services that support a compensation platform used by businesses and employees.
  • Design and implement APIs, database solutions, and architectural improvements that enhance performance and maintainability.
  • Build production-ready systems with strong testing practices, monitoring, observability, and resilience.
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical discovery and design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to identify the right solutions for customer needs.
  • Contribute technical expertise during product discovery, challenge assumptions, and help shape product direction.
  • Improve system performance through optimization, better error handling, reduced latency, and stronger data consistency.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to engineering standards through reviews, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.
  • Work with modern development practices including small pull requests, CI/CD workflows, and continuous delivery.
  • Build systems capable of supporting multiple markets with different regulatory, compliance, and business requirements.
  • Apply AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity, problem-solving, and engineering workflows.
  • Support team growth by sharing knowledge, pairing with colleagues, and contributing to a strong engineering culture.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a backend engineer with strong software development fundamentals, a product mindset, and experience building reliable systems in a collaborative environment.

    • Strong backend engineering fundamentals with experience building and maintaining production systems.
    • Experience developing scalable applications and services with a focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.
    • Strong understanding of software testing, observability, monitoring, and production operations.
    • Experience working with CI/CD practices and shipping incremental changes through collaborative development workflows.
    • Product-oriented mindset with the ability to understand user outcomes beyond technical implementation.
    • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with engineering, product, and design teams.
    • Experience working with databases, particularly PostgreSQL or similar relational database technologies.
    • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and modern engineering tools such as AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub, GitHub Actions, ConfigCat, or Datadog.
    • Experience with Elixir and Phoenix frameworks is a strong advantage.
    • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, or regulated industries is a plus.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and prompt-based workflows is beneficial.
    • Ability to balance speed, quality, and pragmatic decision-making in a fast-paced environment.
    • Strong ownership mindset, adaptability, and willingness to take responsibility for technical outcomes.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote opportunity within Europe.
      • Competitive base salary ranging from €50K to €80K gross annually, depending on experience.
      • Equity participation through VSOPs.
      • Permanent employment contract.
      • Opportunity to work on a product that directly impacts how companies support and reward their employees.
      • High level of autonomy and ownership over meaningful engineering challenges.
      • Collaborative environment with direct communication and transparent decision-making.
      • Product-driven culture focused on experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
      • Opportunity to work with modern technologies including Elixir, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, AWS, Kubernetes, and AI-assisted development tools.
      • Structured hiring process with clear communication and feedback throughout.

title: Palkka-asiantuntija
description:
Etsimme vakituista palkka-asiantuntijaa palkanlaskennan tiimiimme. Palkka-asiantuntijan työtehtäviin kuuluu operatiivisen palkanlaskennan lisäksi viranomaisraportointi, palvelussuhde- ja palkka-asioihin liittyvä neuvonta ja ohjeistus sekä palkanlaskentaprosessin kehittäminen.

Tehtävän menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää tarkkuutta, suunnitelmallisuutta ja hyvää järjestelmäosaamista. Henkilönä olet palvelualtis, oma-aloitteinen ja pystyt työskentelemään aikataulujen puitteissa. Arvostat ihmisiä ympärilläsi ja omaat hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja viestintätaidot.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena toimeen on soveltuva ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai vastaava opistotason tutkinto. Lisäksi edellytämme aikaisempaa kokemusta palkanlaskennasta ja kehittämistyöstä, työehtosopimusten tuntemusta, hyviä digitaitoja, kykyä toimia itsenäisesti sekä hyvää GDPR tuntemusta.

Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työtehtävän, jossa pääset ottamaan vastuuta palkanlaskennan kokonaisuudesta sekä kehittämään palkanlaskennan prosesseja. Sinulla on tukenasi ammattitaitoinen palkanlaskennantiimi ja mahdollisuus etätyöhön kaksi päivää viikossa.

Toimi täytetään 1.9.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan ja siihen sovelletaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.
Toimen tasopalkka on 3 170 euroa/ kk. Muut palkanosat määräytyvät KVTES:n mukaisesti.
Toimeen valitun on esitettävä hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan ennen toimen vastaanottamista.

Sähköiset hakemukset täytetään osoitteessa www.kuntarekry.fi hakuaikana 4.8.2026 - 18.8.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä. Työhakemukseen tulee liittää ansioluettelo. Työhaastatteluja voidaan järjestää jo hakuaikana.

title: Head of Strategic Growth, APAC
description:
About Moloco:

Moloco builds some of the most powerful AI advertising solutions in the world. Our name—short for "machine learning company"—reflects our core mission: democratizing access to the advanced AI that has historically been reserved for tech giants. Led by machine learning pioneers who built some of the most successful ad systems at Google, including YouTube's monetization engine and key search advertising technologies, we're transforming how businesses grow and compete in the digital economy.

Built with AI from day one, Moloco’s planet-scale machine learning platform powers a suite of solutions for advertising growth and monetization. Moloco Ads is an AI-powered platform that delivers real business outcomes for mobile app marketers through performance-based user acquisition. Moloco Commerce Media enables retailers and marketplaces to build revenue-generating ad businesses that balance user experience and advertiser performance.

Moloco is headquartered in Silicon Valley, with offices in Seattle, New York, San Francisco, Seoul, Beijing, Singapore, Gurgaon, Tokyo, Shanghai, London, Tel Aviv, and Berlin.

Moloco is a truly rewarding place to work and in an exciting period of growth, which you could be a part of. Join us today and apply now!

The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:

Reporting to the VP of Business Development, MCM, the Head of Strategic Growth, APAC will lead Moloco's Strategic Growth team across the region. While supporting retailers and marketplaces throughout APAC, the team is primarily based in Seoul and partners closely with regional Sales, Product, and Engineering leaders

This role is responsible for helping Moloco Commerce Media customers build, launch, and scale successful commerce media businesses. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor to senior customer executives, the team helps define commerce media strategy, operating models, advertiser growth initiatives, and long-term business success.

Beyond customer engagement, this leader will play a key role in shaping Moloco's MCM business in APAC by bringing together customer insights, market trends, and commercial priorities to influence product strategy, regional investments, and go-to-market execution.

The Opportunity:

Lead and develop the APAC Strategic Growth team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Strategic Growth Managers and Directors across APAC.
  • Set clear priorities, operating rhythms, and standards for strategic customer engagement and delivery.
  • Foster a culture of high ownership, intellectual rigor, collaboration, and continuous development.
  • Support the team in navigating complex customer situations, executive relationships, and strategic decisions.

Drive customer growth and business outcomes

  • Enable retailers and marketplaces to build scalable commerce media businesses while accelerating advertising revenue growth.
  • Partner with customer executives to define commerce media strategies, business plans, operating models, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Help customers identify and execute the highest-impact growth levers across both advertiser demand and supply.
  • Lead strategic engagements, executive meetings, and business reviews for Moloco's most important APAC partnerships.

Build trusted, long-term customer partnerships

  • Develop enduring relationships with senior stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
  • Position Moloco and the Strategic Growth team as trusted advisors on commerce media strategy and business growth.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business model, market dynamics, organizational priorities, and growth strategy.
  • Anticipate customer needs, identify partnership risks early, and mobilize the right Moloco resources to address them.

Shape the APAC MCM business

  • Partner closely with cross-functional leaders across Moloco to deliver a cohesive customer experience.
  • Represent the voice of APAC customers, identifying recurring needs and influencing product and go-to-market priorities.
  • Monitor market developments, competitive dynamics, and customer trends to identify strategic opportunities and risks.
  • Establish scalable operating models and best practices that can be applied across APAC and Moloco's global MCM business.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of relevant experience, including experience leading high-performing customer-facing teams and delivering measurable commercial or operational outcomes.
  • Experience spanning strategy consulting, ad tech, retail, commerce media, or enterprise technology businesses.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience developing business strategies, go-to-market plans, and revenue growth initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success advising executive stakeholders and building trusted relationships with large, complex enterprise customers.
  • Deep understanding of digital advertising, performance advertising, retail media, or marketplace monetization.
  • Strong analytical rigor, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear business decisions, executive recommendations, and communications.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Sales, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working with ML- and AI-enabled products and communicating their value to business stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing global environment, creating structure while navigating ambiguity.
  • Based in Seoul, with fluency in both Korean and English.

Moloco Thrive: Benefits and Well-Being:

We take care of you and create the conditions for you to do the best work of your career. Through a lens of inclusion, we offer innovative benefits that empower our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can do the best work of their lives.

Moloco Values:

  • Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. With humility, we become more open and accessible to each other. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.
  • Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
  • Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with rigor and integrity. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.
  • Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one mission and vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.

Additional Resources:

  • Moloco Company Blog
  • Moloco Leadership
  • Moloco Newsroom

AI Use in Interviews

Our interview process is designed to get to know the real you. Unless a round specifically includes AI as part of what's being assessed, we ask that candidates engage without AI assistance. Please review our AI Use in Interviews Policy before your interview to understand what to expect. Failure to comply with this policy may impact your candidacy.

Equal Opportunity:

Creating a diverse workforce and a culture of inclusion and belonging is core to our existence. To reach our goals, diversity of talent and thought is a critical component of how we operate as an organization. Our workforce is our superpower, and we know that fostering a culture of inclusion, authenticity, and belonging gives us the greatest opportunity to achieve our vision to become the scaling engine for the Internet economy.

Moloco is an equal opportunity employer. We highly value diversity in our current and future employees and do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, age, sex and gender, gender expression and identity, sexual orientation, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Candidate Privacy Notice:

title: Employee Relations Specialist
location: St Leonards, New South Wales, au
description:
Ramsay Health Care is seeking an experienced Employee Relations Specialist to provide expert advice and support across workplace relations, employee matters, and people-related risk. Partnering with leaders, People & Culture teams, and employees, you will provide practical and commercially focused advice to support a fair, respectful, and compliant workplace culture. This role will play a key part in managing complex employee relations matters, strengthening leader capability, and supporting positive workplace outcomes across Ramsay. This is an opportunity for an ER professional who enjoys partnering with the business, solving complex people challenges, and making a meaningful impact within a large and purpose-driven organisation. Please note this role can be based in Sydney, Brisbane, or Melbourne.

What You’ll Do

As an Employee Relations Specialist, you will provide trusted advice and support on a broad range of workplace matters, helping leaders navigate complexity while ensuring best-practice employee relations outcomes.

Key accountabilities include:

  • Provide expert advice on employee relations matters including performance, misconduct, grievances, workplace conflict, and disciplinary processes.
  • Manage complex ER cases, including workplace investigations, documentation, recommendations, and resolution strategies.
  • Support leaders with practical guidance on employment legislation, enterprise agreements, policies, and workplace practices.
  • Provide support across industrial relations matters, including union engagement, consultation processes, and workplace change.
  • Identify workplace risks and provide recommendations to strengthen compliance and employee outcomes.
  • Build leader capability through coaching, guidance, and training on effective people management practices.
  • Partner with People & Culture, Legal, Health & Safety, and operational teams to deliver proactive ER solutions.
  • Analyse ER trends and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across policies, processes, and workplace practices.

What You’ll Bring

You are an experienced Employee Relations professional with strong technical knowledge and the ability to build trusted relationships across a complex organisation.

  • Extensive experience in employee relations, workplace relations, industrial relations, or HR advisory roles.
  • Strong understanding of Australian employment legislation, awards, enterprise agreements, and workplace policies.
  • Experience coaching leaders through performance, conduct, and employee relations matters.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to provide practical advice while balancing employee outcomes, risk, and business needs.
  • Strong investigation, report writing, and analytical capability.
  • Relevant qualifications in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Employment Law, Business, or a related discipline.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on workplace culture within Australia’s largest private hospital operator.
  • Access to professional development opportunities and career pathways across Ramsay Health Care.
  • Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options.
  • Comprehensive benefits program including wellbeing support, rewards and recognition programs, and employee discounts.
  • Competitive remuneration package aligned to experience.

About Ramsay Health Care

Founded in 1964, Ramsay Health Care is Australia’s largest private hospital operator and a recognised global leader in healthcare delivery. Across the country, we operate 76 hospitals and 12 surgical centres, caring for more than 1.1 million patients each year with the support of over 30,000 dedicated professionals. Guided by our ethos, “People Caring for People,” we are committed to delivering exceptional patient care, supporting our people, and driving continuous improvement and innovation across our services. Through The Ramsay Way, we foster a culture built on collaboration, accountability, and respect, empowering our teams to achieve outstanding outcomes for patients and communities.

To Apply

All applications should include your CV outlining your experience and skills in line with the above criteria. Applications close Tuesday 1st September 2026.

Please Note:

Ramsay Health Care is committed to Child Safety. Details of our commitment are set out in our Code of Conduct, available at .

Applications made by recruitment agencies will not be considered.

title: [청주] 시스템 엔지니어
description:
About

Responsibilities

title: Vi søger Souschef til Kantine på Panum, Københavns Universitet  – Er det dig, vi leder efter?
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe madoplevelser i særklasse? Er du en skarp kok og en erfaren leder med smag for kvalitet, kreativitet og samarbejde? Så grib muligheden nu – vi ansætter hurtigst muligt og holder løbende samtaler!

Hvem er vi?

På Panum leverer vi, DinnerdeLuxe, madoplevelser, der samler mennesker. Vores kantine er et dynamisk samlingspunkt, hvor smag, variation og høj kvalitet er i centrum. Vi søger nu en souschef, der vil være med til at præge både køkkenet og gæsternes oplevelse.


Hvem søger vi?

Souschef – din næste lederrolle:
Som souschef bliver du højre hånd for vores erfarne og dygtige køkkenchef og en nøgleperson i teamet.
Du er faglært kok, gerne med erfaring fra kantinedrift – og du har mere end bare flair for struktur, kvalitet og systematik.
Vi har brug for dig, der:

  • Har erfaring med ledelse og kan motivere et team.

  • Trives med ansvar for drift, personale og kvalitetsstandarder.

  • Du har høj kvalitetssans og følger opgaverne til dørs

  • Du er ikke udfordret af at skulle kontrollere og følge op på andres arbejde – med et konstruktivt og løsningsorienteret mindset

  • Er kreativ, struktureret, har blik for detaljer OG bevarer overblikket og kan holde hovedet koldt i travle perioder.


Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

  • Et spændende køkken med plads til kreativitet og udvikling.

  • En hverdag fyldt med udfordringer, variation og smil.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer trivsel, samarbejde og bæredygtighed.

  • Attraktive arbejdstider og gode udviklingsmuligheder.


Praktisk:

Vi har travlt, og vi søger med hurtig opstart! Ansøgninger behandles løbende, så send din ansøgning og dit CV til os hurtigst muligt på job.rune@dinnerdeluxe.dk.

Skriv ”Souschef SUND” emnefeltet.
Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte Drifts- og Kundechef Runde Serigstad på mail: job.rune@dinnerdeluxe.dk eller tlf. 22310032

Grib muligheden for at blive en del af Panum-teamet – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Kom med din passion og kreativitet – vi står klar med spændende udfordringer og et stærkt fællesskab!

Grundet GDPR skal du være opmærksom på, at ansøgninger kun kan mailes til ovenstående mailadresse. Oplys kun de nødvendige personoplysninger som dit navn, telefonnummer og mailadresse, så vi kan kontakte dig ved spørgsmål eller tilbud om samtale.

title: Workplace Experience Coordinator
description:
About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

About the Role

We're looking for a Workplace Experience Coordinator to join our Facilities team in Prague - Emplifi's largest global hub. This is not a traditional facilities role. You'll be a business partner who owns the day-to-day experience of 100+ people: anticipating problems before they surface, keeping the office running seamlessly, and making Prague a place people are genuinely proud to work in.

What You'll Do Here

Prague Office Operations (Local Ownership)

  • Daily Excellence: Ensure the Prague office is a functional, safe, and inspiring
    environment for our teams
  • Reception Coordination: Coordinate reception activities when required, including managing deliveries and incoming mail, handling postal services and post office visits as required, welcoming and assisting visitors, and ensuring meeting rooms are prepared with refreshments for guests
  • Building & Facility Coordination: Liaise with building management, main reception, maintenance staff, and other facility service providers to support smooth office operations
  • Vendor Management & Transitions: Manage and coordinate external service
    providers, support the team in switching or auditing vendors to ensure the best value for the company
  • Health & Safety: Maintain local H&S standards, fire safety protocols, and ensure all office equipment is regularly serviced
  • Supply Chain: Oversee procurement for office supplies, kitchen stock, and snacks, maintaining high standards while optimizing costs
  • Internal Logistics: Coordinate physical office needs, including internal moves,
    furniture adjustments, and managing storage spaces

People, Culture & Finance Cooperation

  • Community Building: Organize local office events, wellness workshops, and celebratory moments (e.g., Kids' Day, Holiday events), including coordinating event communications and announcements on Slack and the company Event Calendar
  • Financial Administration: Manage the local office budget, process invoices, and ensure the "4-eyes principle" is followed for all facility-related payments
  • Onboarding: Provide a warm welcome and office orientation for all new hires in the Prague office as well as remote locations virtually

What You'll Bring to Us

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in office management, facilities, or high-level administration
  • You are a professional who doesn't need to be micromanaged; you see a problem and own the solution
  • You enjoy working in a close-knit team where responsibilities are shared, and everyone supports each other
  • Fluency in Czech and English is essential (daily communication with local employees, vendors, and global stakeholders)
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and a natural ability to learn new software for space and subscription management
  • You have a basic understanding of (or a strong curiosity about) how AI tools can help automate routine administrative tasks; you don't need to be an expert, but you should be open-minded about using AI to improve efficiency and streamline workflows

What We Offer

  • International and fast-paced environment
  • Chance to work with the world's biggest brands at the CX tech leader
  • Agile and open-minded culture, with high levels of trust and flexibility
  • Opportunity for professional growth and development
  • Possibility to learn new and cutting-edge technologies, in an environment that encourages new ideas
  • AI-first workplace, with access to leading AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more), empowering you to work smarter, innovate faster, and build AI skills for the future
  • Flexible working environment
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Sick Days & Community Service Days
  • Multisport card
  • Maternity and Parental Benefit
  • Work in an international environment in our modern offices in Karlín, with our big terrace and our own grill
  • There's more as well! Speak with us to find out all the details!

At Emplifi, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone is valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work. We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, races, religions, genders, sexual orientations, gender identities, and LGBTQ+ communities.

Emplifi offers a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment where every employee has the opportunity to thrive and is encouraged to be who they are.

We welcome and encourage applicants with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request at any stage of the recruitment process.

title: Cykelmekaniker till thansen Syd
description:
thansen söker skicklig cykelmekaniker till våra butiker i södra Sverige

Resande cykelmekaniker sökes till thansen – södra Sverige

Vill du arbeta med cyklar i ett företag som växer snabbt och satsar stort på service? Nu söker thansen en skicklig och engagerad resande cykelmekaniker som vill vara med och leverera Sveriges bästa cykelservice.

Som resande cykelmekaniker ansvarar du för service och reparationer i våra butiker i södra Sverige. Du blir en viktig resurs för både våra kunder och våra butiksteam och bidrar till att säkerställa hög kvalitet och professionell service i hela regionen.

Om tjänsten

thansen befinner sig i en stark expansionsfas och öppnar kontinuerligt nya butiker runt om i Sverige. Idag har vi 34 butiker och fler är på väg. Vi erbjuder ett brett sortiment av cyklar, elcyklar, reservdelar och tillbehör, och vårt mål är att alltid finnas nära våra kunder med förstklassig service.

Du blir en del av vårt erfarna team av cykelmekaniker och får en gedigen introduktion och utbildning i våra butiker i Köpenhamn. Vi ser gärna att du är bosatt i södra Sverige, då tjänsten innebär regelbundna resor mellan våra butiker.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som resande cykelmekaniker kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:

● Service och reparation av cyklar och elcyklar

● Montering och leveranskontroll av nya cyklar

● Teknisk support till våra butiker

● Hantering av reklamationer

● Kundservice och rådgivning

● Underhåll av cykelutställningar och butikernas cykelavdelningar

Vi söker dig som

● Är utbildad eller erfaren cykelmekaniker

● Har erfarenhet av service och reparation av elcyklar

● Arbetar självständigt, strukturerat och med hög kvalitet

● Trivs med ett varierande arbete och gillar nya utmaningar

● Har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

● Har B-körkort och möjlighet att resa inom södra Sverige

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en lösningsorienterad person som tycker om att arbeta praktiskt och ge god service. Du arbetar effektivt och noggrant, även när tempot är högt, och har lätt för att samarbeta med kollegor i olika butiker. Du är flexibel, ansvarstagande och ser det som en självklarhet att hjälpa till där behovet finns.

Hos thansen får du en spännande tjänst i ett företag med stark tillväxt och stora framtidsplaner. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med korta beslutsvägar, en positiv arbetsmiljö och goda möjligheter att utvecklas.

Vi erbjuder:

● En varierande och självständig tjänst

● Gedigen introduktion och utbildning

● Stora möjligheter att ta ansvar och utvecklas

● Företagsbil för resor mellan butiker

● Fri mobiltelefon

● Lön enligt överenskommelse och erfarenhet

Arbetstid

● Genomsnittlig arbetstid: 38,25 timmar per vecka.

Anställningen är tidsbegränsad till 1 år. Med möjlighet till förlängning.

Ansökan

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta administrationschef Stefan Roysson på 0760-497625.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Tjänsten tillsätts så snart vi har hittat rätt kandidat.

Skicka din ansökan och ditt CV i PDF- eller Word-format via vårt elektroniska ansökningsformulär.

Märk din ansökan: Cykelmekaniker – Sverige.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Graduate Silicon Engineer
description:
About the job

Start your engineering career helping build the silicon behind tomorrow’s AI systems. Our two-year Graduate Programme is designed to give you the technical experience, support and responsibility to build a successful career in AI computing.

As a Graduate Silicon Engineer, you will gain insight into how sophisticated AI chips are crafted, verified and prepared for manufacture.

You will join one of our silicon teams across logical compose and DFT, verification, or layout implementation. Each path gives you hands-on experience with real chip development and industry-standard EDA tools.

You will work close to expert engineers who explain the detail, challenge your thinking and help you grow. You will build practical skills in RTL, verification methods, timing, implementation or physical design checks.

You do not need to arrive as an authority. We are looking for graduates with strong fundamentals, curiosity and the aim to learn quickly.

The Team & Culture

Graphcore’s Silicon team turns high-reaching AI compute ideas into manufacturable silicon. Logical design, DFT, verification and physical design work closely with architecture, operations and other engineering teams.

You will learn through design reviews, code reviews, technical discussions and practical problem solving. Work is broken into clear tasks, with support available and ownership expected from the start.

Decisions are made through evidence, engineering judgement and open challenge. Graduates are encouraged to ask questions, speak up and build confidence by contributing early.

What we’re looking for

  • On track for, or achieved, a degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science or a related subject
  • Technical skills in C, C++ or Python, shown through study, projects, hobbies, internships or work experience
  • Interest in digital design, ASICs, verification, physical design, computer architecture or AI compute
  • Motivation to learn modern silicon design techniques and industry-standard EDA tools
  • Strong problem-solving skills, collaboration and clear communication
  • Curiosity, ownership and hunger to learn, not instant expertise

Benefits

  • Flexible working:Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave:Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity:Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience:Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection:Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Flexible benefits:Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
  • Optional benefits:Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.

Join the team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies.

Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

Join Graphcore’s Graduate Silicon Software Engineering Programme and start building the skills, confidence, and experience to turn your learning into real impact. Apply now.

title: Senior Recruitment Ops Specialist
description:
Company Introduction :

Booking Holdings is the world’s leading provider of online travel and related services, serving consumers and local partners in over 220 countries and territories. We deliver our services through six primary brands: Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda, and OpenTable. Our mission is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

The Center of Excellence, based in Bangalore, India, is a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. It was established to support the growing business needs of the Booking Holdings brands. The Center provides access to specialized, highly skilled talent, promotes industry best practices, and fosters collaboration across all Booking Holdings brands and business units.

Job Overview :

The Senior Recruiting Ops Specialist serves as a strategic partner to the Talent community, driving scalability and operational excellence by simplifying hiring processes and optimizing recruitment systems. By designing compliant practices, managing complex cross-functional projects, and fostering innovation, this role ensures a seamless candidate experience while maintaining high standards of data integrity and governance, ultimately serving as an essential engine for the Talent team's success

Key Responsibilities

    • Manage end-to-end Offer Management and Pre-Onboarding activities, including offer creation, approvals, pre-employment screening (PES), onboarding readiness, and ensuring a seamless candidate experience.
    • Partner closely with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners, HR Operations, candidates, external vendors, and global teams to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant hiring processes.
    • Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for TA systems and processes, ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of recruitment systems, providing system support, resolving system issues, maintaining data quality, and supporting users with system-related queries.
    • Lead and support recruitment systems and process improvements, including change requests, system enhancements, automation initiatives, testing, and transformation projects in collaboration with global teams.
    • Own vendor relationships and service delivery, ensuring effective partnership management, SLA adherence, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
    • Support executive and complex hiring activities, including coordination for Executive hiring and other business-critical recruitment processes.
    • Develop, maintain, and communicate recruitment processes, policies, playbooks, and system updates, while driving standardization through training, knowledge sharing, and best practices across the TA community.
  • Own operational reporting and dashboarding, delivering accurate recruitment metrics, insights, and data analytics to support business decisions, operational reviews, and leadership reporting.
  • Drive audits, compliance, and governance activities by performing regular quality checks, ensuring adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, data integrity standards, and recruitment controls, while identifying and mitigating operational risks.
  • Drive operational excellence by identifying opportunities for process optimization, innovation, automation, and improved stakeholder and candidate experience.
  • Provide regular operational updates and stakeholder communications, ensuring hiring teams, HR Ops, and other business partners are informed of key activities such as onboarding readiness, system updates, and process changes.

Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of experience in Recruitment Operations
    • Strong knowledge of recruitment processes, policies, guidelines and regulations, with hands-on experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Workday, iCIMS, or similar platforms.
    • Demonstrated expertise in Recruitment Systems and Talent Operations, with the ability to manage system enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and understand the impact of changes across end-to-end recruitment processes.
    • Strong project management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities, lead projects, and deliver results within defined timelines.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams, draft communications, deliver training, and effectively collaborate with business leaders, technical teams, and external vendors.
    • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts, translating business requirements into system solutions and technical information into user-friendly guidance.
    • Experience driving process improvements, automation, and operational excellence, with agility, and continuous improvement methodologies.
    • Ability to coach and mentor team members, sharing knowledge and promoting best practices across the TA function.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), with strong reporting, dashboarding, data analytics, and presentation skills.
  • Experience with reporting and visualization tools e.g Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio is an advantage


Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

title: SSG Facility Services söker lokalvårdare vid behov
