title: Werkvoorbereider
description:
Hou jij van overzicht, tempo en verantwoordelijkheid?
Voor Van Mossel Autoschade in Rotterdam zoeken we een werkvoorbereider.

Wat ga je doen?
Je plant afspraken in, stelt klanten gerust, stemt af met collega’s en zorgt dat de planning klopt zodat de werkplaats efficiënt kan draaien.

Op de dag van de afspraak ontvang je de klant, neem je de schade op en verwerk je deze met behulp van de schade-photobooth.
Je regelt vervangend vervoer en zorgt dat alle dossiers administratief correct worden bijgehouden.
Jij bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt dat alles soepel en gestructureerd verloopt.

Wie ben jij?
Je hebt ervaring in een servicegerichte rol (automotive is een pré, geen must).
Je communiceert makkelijk, past je toon aan per situatie en blijft rustig bij drukte.
Je werkt secuur, houdt overzicht en bent flexibel ingesteld.
Je bent fulltime beschikbaar.

Wat bieden wij jou?
Je komt te werken bij Van Mossel Autoschade in Rotterdam in een hecht team.
Ondanks onze groei blijven we een familiebedrijf met korte lijnen en een informele sfeer.
Je krijgt een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke functie met ruimte om door te groeien.

Daarnaast bieden we je:

  • Een goed salaris passend bij jouw ervaring

  • Opleidingen en trainingen via de Van Mossel Academy

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen de organisatie

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Personeelskorting op auto’s, onderhoud en verzekeringen (ook voor je gezin)

  • Vrijdagmiddagborrel

Interesse?

Ben jij na het lezen van de vacature enthousiast geworden? Solliciteren kan gemakkelijk via de website. Voor vragen kan je ook altijd bellen of appen naar Kyra Horn via 06-16167807

title: Senior Product Designer, Online Deliveries
description:
Get to Know the Team

As a Senior Product Designer on the Food/Mart team, you will be part of a group of accomplished product designers and UX writers who are carving the pathway for the future of online ordering and discovery. The future of online food and mart will leverage Grab's ecosystem, focusing on seamless payments, reliable fulfilment, and the establishment of relationships that build trust between consumers, merchants, and driver-partners who deliver the food.

Get to Know the Role

You will own Product Design outcomes, practice and quality for a cross-functional Problem Space Team, with influence on adjacent teams. You will work in a highly collaborative fashion, exploring the needs of our users and creating impactful solutions for the business.

If you have a user-centric approach, and thrive in collaborative environments, then the Grab Design team is the place for you. We're looking for exceptional designers who are excited by the opportunity to have a major impact on how millions of people across Southeast Asia interact with Grab. You will be reporting to the Manager. The role will be fully onsite.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Lead product design from early insight to final solutions — transforming ideas into clear, intuitive experiences that deliver real value to users and the business.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, researchers, and stakeholders to align on impactful, user-centric solutions that meet business goals.
  • Drive product discovery by planning and conducting user research, synthesizing insights, and translating findings into actionable design opportunities.
  • Support and enhance the design system by creating and documenting new components, refining existing ones, and ensuring consistency across products.
  • Communicate your design work by presenting solutions, rationale, and processes clearly to team members and stakeholders, driving alignment and shared understanding across functions.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 6+ years of direct experience in product design.
  • Portfolio of recent design work (at least 2 completed case studies in English): Showcase your contributions, the impact of your projects, and provide clear context. Highlight your end-to-end workflow, detailing how you move from problem discovery to launch.
  • User research: Experience conducting user research using diverse methods and translating findings into actionable product requirements or improvements.
  • Strong understanding of user experience: Proven expertise in designing responsive interfaces, with a strong understanding of modern standards and front-end development principles.
  • Eye for visual design: Hands-on experience creating intuitive, visually appealing user interfaces. Your work solves problems and aligns with best practices.
  • Collaboration across teams: Demonstrated experience working across team boundaries with diverse stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with modern design tools: Hands-on experience with tools like Figma. Prototype and present design concepts to stakeholders.
  • AI Fluency: Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to enhance product outcomes for end users, as well as integrating AI and automation into daily design workflows to drive measurable improvements in speed, quality, and productivity.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Nokisiivooja, Kuopio
description:

title: Melanders NK
company: Stockholm Restauranger och Wärdshus Holding AB
description:
Ända sedan den första Melanders-butiken öppnade 1961 i Östermalms Saluhall har vår främsta drivkraft varit att erbjuda de absolut finaste råvaror naturen kan uppbringa.

NK:s saluhall är ett kulinariskt mecka för alla sanna mat-entusiaster. På Melanders NK kan du njuta av både fantastisk miljö och gastronomiska upplevelser, oavsett vad du är på för humör. Lunch eller middag i restaurangen, AW med bubbel och ostron i skaldjursbaren eller varför inte slå på stort och ta in en platå med pinfärska skaldjur?

Melanders NK söker nu en extramedarbetare till butiken, i roll som Butiksbiträde. Vi letar efter dig med kunskap och erfarenhet från fisk & skaldjur och som tillsammans med oss vill leverera minnesvärd service till våra kunder, och hjälpa till att packa våra många ordar. Vi ser att du är en servicestjärna med intresse för mat och som brinner för försäljning och kundmötet. Du arbetar aktivt med den dagliga driften vilket innefattar hantering av fisk och skaldjur, beställningar och kundmöten. Samt arbetar med kvalitetssäkring, sortiment och display. Vi söker dig som är driven, engagerad, dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med fisk och skaldjur samt älskar service.

Vi ser att du:

  • Har god kunskap och intresse om mat och dryck, framför allt fisk och skaldjur

  • Har minst 2 års yrkeserfarenhet av att jobba med fisk och skaldjur som främsta råvarorna

  • Brinner för att överträffa gästens/kundens förväntningar

  • Är strukturerad, ordningsam och har god samarbetsförmåga

Vi erbjuder dig:

  • Ett stimulerande och utvecklande jobb i ett fantastiskt team

  • En anställning i en av Sveriges största restaurangkoncerner

  • Utvecklingsmöjligheter inom koncernen

  • Kollektivavtal

Detta är en behovanställning, anställning på enstaka dagar.

Är du intresserad?

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan!

title: Building Engineer
description:
Transwestern is a vertically integrated commercial real estate firm dedicated to serving investors, partners and clients through expertise in investment, development, brokerage and property management. Our experience spans diverse property types, including logistics, multifamily, retail, mixed-use, healthcare, office, data centers, hotel, and life sciences. Across 35 offices nationwide, our team is united by a culture that cultivates agility, mutual trust and high performance.

Transwestern Services turns strategy into reality with consistency and accountability, collaborating to provide dynamic, tailored solutions. Whether representing a tenant, advising an investor or repositioning an asset, we operate with tenacity and own the outcome every time. Our 2,200-strong team works across service lines, ready to activate our full platform to deliver a customized, cohesive experience for clients.

POSITION SUMMARY:

  • Perform all plumbing, electrical or HVAC requirements of the building(s)
  • Maintain heaters, chillers, pumps, fan coil units, etc.
  • Monitor and adjust all mechanical/pneumatic equipment, control gauges, distributor panels, valves, thermostats, diffusers and other equipment necessary to provide a comfortable environment for the buildings.
  • Repair doors, ceilings, hand railings, and floors.
  • Perform preventive maintenance duties, including changing filters, oiling motors, replacing light fixtures, inspecting/adjusting belts, replacing bearings, aligning shafts and annual inspections as directed by manufacturers.
  • Inspect engine room equipment, fan room equipment, cooling tower, all motors, house pumps and sump pumps.
  • Document and report activities.
  • Clean, lubricate and service a wide variety of pumps, valves, pneumatic controls, electrical, mechanical and hydraulic devices.
  • Troubleshoot, evaluate and make recommendations to upgrade maintenance operations and/or implement savings opportunities.
  • Possess competent knowledge of the use and care of tools and equipment used in facility and ground maintenance.
  • Respond immediately to emergency situations and customer concerns.
  • Inspect buildings, ground and equipment for unsafe or malfunctioning conditions.
  • Inspect new installation for compliance with building codes and safety regulations.
  • Maintain and operate life safety/fire systems.
  • Perform welding, carpentry and snow removal when necessary.
  • Comply with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agency and Company directives as related to building operations and practice safe work habits.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years building maintenance experience.
  • Appropriate license/permit for trade as may be required, i.e. Journeyman or Master Electrician License or City Licenses.
  • Must possess basic computer skills, ability to operate Windows based software.
  • Must have a thorough understanding of HVAC, electrical and building automation systems.
  • Ability to interpret mechanical, electrical blueprints and schematics.
  • Manage own time on a daily basis with little supervision.
  • Must be able to handle multiple projects, changing priorities and continually heavy workloads.
  • Maybe required to work extended periods of time without relief when responding to priority/emergency situations (including overtime type assignments.)
  • Stooping, standing, climbing and frequent lifting of a minimum of 50 lbs. of equipment (pump, tools, ladders) and ability to safely install rigging/lifting device.
  • Lift and carry objects of up to 50 pounds for distances of up to 30 feet.
  • Climb ladders and stairs.

WORK SHIFT:

Third Shift (United States of America)

LOCATION:

Tempe, AZ

This is a dynamic, on-site role that places you at the heart of the action. As a result, an essential function of this position is working on-site. Remote or hybrid options are not available. Being on property allows you to build strong relationships with clients and tenants, respond in real time, and make a visible impact every day.



ABOUT US

Our firm is built on a shared purpose: Empowering good people to do extraordinary things together. We hire smart, passionate, hard-working people who value both collaboration and independence. United by our brand promise, we own the outcome for clients, investors and partners. Learn more at transwestern.com.

All candidates selected for an offer of employment are subject to pre-employment background checks, which may include criminal history, education verification, motor vehicle records, credit history, and professional license verification. In addition, your employment with Transwestern is subject to successfully passing a drug screen check prior to you starting with the firm.

title: Senior Software Engineer | API Enterprise | Full-Stack
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

MMeet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the API Enterprise team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem. Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on. We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.

We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How.

Your responsibilities

  • Drive Enterprise API Adoption: You will own the features that turn enterprise interest into deep, durable adoption. Examples include usage insights, cost and consumption controls, and the governance tooling that lets large organizations understand and manage how they use DeepL's APIs.

  • Build for Governance & Compliance: You will design the controls enterprise IT and security admins rely on (roles and permissions, projects, data residency, and audit-ability), making DeepL the compliant default for regulated, global organizations.

  • Guardianship of Quality & Production Reliability: You will own your services end-to-end, including participation in the API on-call rotation, with a shared goal of taking our public API to four nines of reliability. You will implement strong contract testing, monitoring, and SLOs, preventing breaking changes and security vulnerabilities before they reach our enterprise customers.

  • Architect Across the Enterprise Ecosystem: You will work deep within DeepL's existing technical and organizational structures, navigating dependencies across different areas and many stakeholder teams to ship cohesive, reliable enterprise capabilities.

Qualities we look for

  • An "Enterprise-First" Mindset: You treat enterprise IT and security admins as your primary users. You understand that earning their trust means clear governance, predictable cost control, robust compliance, fast response times and data residency. You're a strong communicator who's comfortable owning product decisions and implementing them.

  • Backend Mastery at Scale (C# / .NET): You have deep expertise designing scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and distributed architectures, primarily in C# / .NET, and you've worked with high-scale distributed systems in production. Strong API design fundamentals and system design are core to how you work. Roughly 80-90% of the work is backend; working on the frontend (React/TypeScript) is a welcome plus, not a requirement.

  • Enterprise Platform Fluency: You bring hands-on experience with the building blocks of modern enterprise APIs (MCP, CLIs, and OAuth) and know how to wield them to build secure, extensible integrations.

  • Cross-Team Leadership: You have a track record of leading projects across multiple teams. You can align with different areas and other stakeholders, manage cross-team contracts and dependencies, and keep complex, interconnected systems coherent.

  • Extreme Ownership & Operational Excellence: You own your services end-to-end (production operations, incident response, and on-call) and you're motivated by pushing reliability toward four nines. You write comprehensive tests, learn from incidents, and treat mature SLOs as a core engineering feature.

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery so you can focus your energy on high-value architecture and complex problem-solving.

  • Bonus points if you have: a track record of zero-downtime migrations on live systems; experience with metering, quota, or usage-data systems; worked in a compliance environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, C5, or similar)


A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares: An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: Head of Data Collection (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Mission

You will lead Data Collection — the newest production line within Statista’s Data Production division, alongside Modeled Data, Survey Data, and Researched Data. It is our most scalable and most technical production line: it collects third-party data from publicly available sources and exclusive partnerships, and ingests, structures, and harmonizes it at scale for one of the world’s largest business data platforms.

Your mission: Collect customer-valuable third-party data we can sell at scale — free data that complements and contextualizes our portfolio, and exclusive partner data as a value driver.

Your Role

As Head of Data Collection, you will build and lead a production line structured along the data collection workflow — identify & unlock sources, explore sources, extract & ingest data — with three specialized sub-teams:

  • Source Identification & Unlocking — secures the sources that feed the collection line: unlocking access through partnerships and contractual agreements, and running a structured discovery process to identify and qualify the best source for a given data need. Owns the commercial and contractual side of getting to “unlocked” data.

  • Source Exploration — brings the domain expertise to understand an unlocked source: what data it offers, its structure and quality, and which fields are worth retrieving. Translates this into production-ready extraction specifications — the bridge between a raw source and scaled extraction.

  • Source Extraction & Ingestion — builds and operates the scalable, standardized setup that extracts data via partner dumps, scraping, or APIs, and ingests it into our systems — structuring and harmonizing it in the process, steered by KPIs and focused on efficiency and technical excellence. This team wil disciplinarily report into the Head of Data Engineering, but you steer them operationally.

Strategy & Clarity

  • Drive clarity in your production line with respect to strategy, portfolio role, and operating model — your teams and stakeholders always know where you’re heading and why

  • Own the roadmap for Data Collection as the key volume driver of our data portfolio — delivering breadth of coverage at scale and closing gaps we cannot fill otherwise

  • Shape the future direction towards exclusive partner data via revenue-share models — with the potential to shift the production line’s focus towards high-value exclusive data

  • Join the senior leadership circle of the Data Production division — contributing to vision, OKR-setting, and cross-functional alignment

Leadership & People

  • Lead the three sub-teams of the production line — driving performance, professional development, and a culture of ownership across partnership, research, and engineering profiles

  • Provide clarity, prioritization, and motivation — you lead through direction, not micromanagement

  • Build a production line that delivers reliably against operational KPIs: volume, breadth of coverage, and cost efficiency

Partnerships & Commercial

  • Own the partner dimension of the production line — from outreach and qualification to contractual agreements that unlock data access

  • Develop the exclusive partner data model — revenue-share partnerships that turn third-party data into a differentiating value driver for Statista

Production & Operational Excellence

  • Steer production via KPIs with full transparency over sources, pipelines, and output — optimized for volume and breadth of coverage

  • Drive automation and AI adoption across the collection workflow — from source discovery and intelligent extraction to automated structuring and harmonization

  • Relentlessly improve efficiency: standardized setups, scalable processes, and technical excellence over one-off solutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align with Production Steering and Business Owners, who steer your portfolio priorities — currently focused on strategic themes such as Social Media, eCommerce, and Marketing-persona fit

  • Partner closely with Data Engineering, whose infrastructure, tooling, and architecture power your extraction and ingestion at scale

  • Collaborate with the other production lines and downstream product teams — your data feeds their use cases and reaches customers through our platform and products

Your Profile

Experience & Track Record

  • 5+ years of experience in data operations, data partnerships, data engineering, or a data-centric business — with a proven track record of leading teams

  • Experience with collecting, structuring, or commercializing third-party data at scale — e.g. scraping/API-based data operations, data partnerships, or licensing models

  • Experience with thinking about and producing data as a product — you understand who uses the data, how, and what makes it valuable

  • A track record of steering operations via KPIs — you know how to run a production setup for volume, coverage, and efficiency

Mindset & Working Style

  • Operator mindset — you think in scale, throughput, and unit economics, and you get energy from making a production machine run better every week

  • Commercial acumen — you are comfortable negotiating with partners and structuring agreements that unlock data access

  • You have a talent for clean, simple concepts with practical impact — you simplify without oversimplifying, and your solutions actually work in production

  • You communicate well — with your teams, your supervisors, and your stakeholders across Data, Product, Tech, and Revenue

Technical Understanding

  • Solid technical grounding — you can discuss scraping, APIs, ingestion pipelines, and data structuring credibly with engineers, and challenge setups where needed (hands-on Python/SQL is a plus, not a must)

  • Practical understanding of AI capabilities in data collection — intelligent extraction, LLM-based structuring and harmonization, and automated quality assurance

Communication

  • Excellent English communication skills — able to lead cross-functional teams, coordinate stakeholders, and represent the production line across organizational boundaries

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: Onderhoudsspecialist Elektrotechniek
description:
Ben jij dé specialist die ons materieel elektrotechnisch in topconditie houdt en zorgt dat het veilig en betrouwbaar inzetbaar is? Dan is de functie van Onderhoudsspecialist Elektrotechniek in onze werkplaats in Dordrecht wellicht jouw volgende stap. Kom werken bij VolkerRail!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Onderhoudsspecialist Elektrotechniek ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van elektrische installaties en meetsystemen van ons materieel, zodat deze veilig en betrouwbaar functioneren. Je werkt onder andere aan onze elektrische stopmachines inclusief de meetsystemen die erop zitten. Ook voer je het onderhoud en keuringen uit op twee elektrische locomotieven. Daarnaast kom je af en toe in aanraking met elektronische onderdelen van onze diesellocomotieven en onze elektrische krols (kranen op het spoor). Je taken bestaan onder andere uit:

Beheer van elektrische installaties en gereedschap

  • Zelfstandig uitvoeren van keuringen;

  • Beoordelen van nieuwe installaties, zowel hoogspanning als laagspanning;

  • Tekenen van elektrische schema’s voor bestaande materieelstukken;

  • Het beoordelen van wijzigingen;

  • Voorstellen doen voor aanpassing van installaties bij veranderend gebruik;

  • Bijwerken van tekeningen, documentatie en handleidingen;

  • Aanpassen van keuringsschema’s;

  • Oplossen van storingen indien nodig.

Beheer van meetsystemen (voornamelijk spoorgeometrie)

  • Uitvoeren van reparaties en kalibraties

  • Bijhouden van uitgevoerde kalibraties

  • Oplossen van storingen

  • Toezien op naleving van regelgeving omtrent elektrische installaties, zoals NEN 3140, NEN 3840 en interne bedrijfsvoorschriften

  • Assisteren en coördineren bij onderhoud aan elektrische installaties.

Indien nodig hebben wij een serviceauto beschikbaar, wanneer er een klus buiten Dordrecht is.

Wie ben jij?

Wij zoeken een elektrotechnisch talent dat zelfstandig kan werken, overzicht houdt en samen met anderen veilig en effectief het werk kan uitvoeren. Je kunt goed samenwerken, communiceert duidelijk en kan technische informatie begrijpelijk overbrengen aan collega’s zonder E-kennis. Je werkt nauwkeurig en bent bewust van veiligheid en kwaliteit.

Verder heb je:

  • Een MBO-4 opleiding richting Elektrotechniek, Energietechniek, Mechatronica of Industriële Automatisering;

  • Bij voorkeur minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen de energietechniek;

  • Een rijbewijs B;

Het is een pré als je beschikt over: VCA, Stipel IV/WV HS & LS en kennis voor normeringen NEN 3140, NEN 3840, NEN 1010, IEC 60204;

Wat krijg je hiervoor terug?

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast contract;

  • Een goed salaris van € 3.380 tot en met € 4.798 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van leeftijd en ervaring;

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling van het Pensioenfonds Rail & OV;

  • Maar liefst 48 vrije dagen: 25 vakantiedagen en 23 roostervrije dagen;

  • Gratis toegang tot OpenUp, het platform voor mentaal welzijn voor jou en je gezin;

  • Deelname aan de VolkerWessels Fietsregeling, waarmee je voordelig een fiets kunt leasen of kopen.

title: Care Services Assistant
description:
Bolton Clarke Group one of Australia’s largest independent, not-for-profit providers of home care, retirement living and residential aged care, operating nationally and internationally. Bolton Clarke Residential group now has 88 Aged Care Homes across QLD, NSW, VIC, SA & WA, with the inclusion of the Allity, McKenzie & Acacia Living Group.

The Role

This role plays a pivotal frontline carer role with a particular focus on nutrition and dining, supporting residents to live a life of fulfilment through the delivery of person-centred care and support according to needs and preferences of each resident in everyday practice. Assisting in the preparation, delivery, presentation and serving of resident meals.

Your responsibilities will be to provide care and support aligned with residents’ preferred daily routines with a strong focus on:

  • Meal choices and individual nutrition

  • Consideration of allergies and food intolerances

  • Enhancing the overall dining experience

  • Assist residents with meal selection and meal timing preferences

  • Prepare and set up dining areas to meet individual needs and preferences

  • Actively engage with residents to provide social and emotional support during mealtimes

  • Use empathy and kindness to foster a positive dining experience

  • Promote resident choice and control to uphold dignity and respect

  • Prepare and maintain dining experience areas and provide meal service to meet individual resident choices

  • Maintain accurate nutrition and diet information as required

  • Assist with quality food preparation in accordance with the Food Safety Plan, Bolton Clarke Food Standards and Dining Framework

  • Assist with maintaining kitchen stock supplies as required

To be successful, you will have:

  • Demonstrated customer service skills

  • A compassionate and caring attitude

  • Previous restaurant and/or commercial kitchen experience (highly regarded)

  • Willingness to take direction from others

  • Reliability and shift flexibility

  • Good time management skills and the ability to work well under pressure

  • Valid working rights in Australia (Passport, Birth Certificate etc)

  • Complete a police check and or a NDIS Workers Check (or willingness to obtain) prior to commencement

About this location:

Bolton Clarke’s Fernhill Home provides high-quality aged care in a friendly, secure and comfortable residential environment.

Why Work For Bolton Clarke:


  • Excellent work/life balance with shifts that suit your personal needs
  • A caring team environment with strong clinical and allied health support
  • Career progression and development opportunities
  • Generous salary packaging and not-for-profit tax benefits – claim up to $18,550 tax free
  • Private health insurance and gym discounts
  • An Employee Assistance Program for staff and family

Apply Now: Our application process takes 10 minutes to apply, please follow the below link to start your application.

Our commitment to diversity: At Bolton Clarke we expect our staff to respect and value differences in age, disability, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, intersex status and family or marital status.

Appointment to this position and ongoing employment is subject to your commitment to supporting diversity and inclusion.

If you have any further queries, please contact Goldi Kayastha Giri (workwithus@boltonclarke.com.au)

title: Agribusiness Analyst
description:

The Agribusiness Analyst is responsible for providing the best credit structure and financial solutions for our agribusiness customers. Core responsibilities include credit analysis, building customer and industry insight and helping to secure growth in the portfolio. You will utilise your financial analysis, research and report writing skills to prepare credit submissions whilst supporting your Agribusiness relationship managers with portfolio activity.

You will build a thorough knowledge of Westpac’s products and services as well as industry expertise. Experience in this role provides a solid grounding for future career success whether your interests lie in relationship management, analysis in corporate/institutional or other specialist areas in banking.

  • An understanding of business/commercial and farm management practices

  • Tertiary qualification in Agribusiness or similar is preferred

  • Experience in financial analysis, accounting or credit analysis

  • Ability to recognise areas of opportunity, to adapt and innovate and to drive productivity

  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal)

  • Customer centric, a team-player who exhibits drive, resilience and high levels of personal integrity and professionalism.

Westpac Hei Wāhi Mahi | Working at Westpac

Ko mātou tēnei | Our Organisation
At Westpac, we’re working together to build a fairer and stronger New Zealand for our people, customers, and communities. For over 160 years we’ve been driven by our purpose to Create Better Futures Together.

What makes us unique are the incredible people we’re lucky enough to have walk through our doors every day. The giant ‘W’ on our building doesn’t just stand for Westpac – it says, double you. We’re a place that values, rewards and recognises individuality. Where you can be your whole self, your true self, and your best self. We’re recognised as a place where talent is developed, where passions are fuelled and where ambitions of all shapes and sizes thrive. And it all starts with you!

Tono mai ināianei! | Apply Now!

Apply today with your CV and Cover Letter.

The people of Aotearoa, New Zealand hail from many cultures and backgrounds. At Westpac New Zealand, we draw on this enormous talent pool to cultivate a team rich in ability and empowered to reach its full potential. Our aim is to be brave challengers, celebrating our differences and relentlessly advocating for our customers. It starts with us – we believe that when we care deeply and do our best for our people, they’ll do their best for our customers. We encourage people from all walks of life to apply, including those who are neurodiverse, have chronic health conditions or disabilities – your attitude and passion are as important to us as your experience, qualifications and capabilities.

title: Sr. Solutions Engineer
description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

SUMMARY

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting our Majors customers, reporting to the regional Manager, Solutions Engineering. You will partner directly with regional account executives to help change our customers' view and how they approach cloud security. You will be their trusted advisor for all matters related to cloud security across AWS, Azure, and GCP. We are passionate about technical sales and helping our customers achieve the maximum value from our solution.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Partner with the sales team to provide technical leadership to our customers and prospective customers in conjunction with helping our team meet their quarterly sales targets.
  • Provide presentations to our customers and prospective customers such as whiteboards, product demonstrations, slides, and proof of value outcomes.
  • Help our customers and prospective customers plan in-depth test plans for showing the value of the Wiz platform in their environment (proof of value).
  • Invest time in learning new product features, industry related developments, and broadening your overall technical skillset.
  • Represent Wiz in technical forums such as trade shows, technical meet-ups, and industry events.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Ability to deliver world class demonstrations and training experience to our channel customers
  • Mastered the technical sales process
  • Thrive in a creative technical role assisting partners to build a technical business delivery model
  • Experience in a sales engineering role delivering solutions to C-level executives at strategic customers
  • Cloud security experience
  • AWS/Azure/GCP hands on experience
  • Network engineering experience
  • Strong operating system, virtual machine, and container knowledge
  • Knowledge of risk-based security assessments and frameworks
  • Understanding of cloud identity, access, certificates, and keys

BONUS POINTS:

  • Experience with traditional CSPM tools
  • SaaS experience
  • Awareness of the CI/CD process
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code

title: Thermal and Performance Engineer, Commercial PCs
description:
Thermal and Performance Engineer, Commercial PCs

Description -

Job Summary
• This role is responsible for designing portions of engineering solutions, developing and implementing parameters and test plans, and conducting feasibility studies. The role applies intermediate level of subject matter knowledge to design, analyze, build, and test mechanical components. The role participates in project teams with internal and outsourced partners to develop reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions. The role manages relationships with partners and suppliers, oversees design engineering change processes, and drives value engineering projects.

Responsibilities
• Designs portions of engineering solutions for mechanical and thermal hardware, electronics enclosures, and production tooling based on established engineering principles and in accordance with development technology practices and guidelines.
• Develops and implements parameters and test plans for existing designs, including validation of tolerances, form/fit/function, shock and vibration, electromagnetic interference, safety, reliability, developing fan curves, system power measurements & acoustics.
• Conducts feasibility studies, design margin and validation analyses and empirical testing on new and modified designs.• Performs root cause analysis of defects, propose, evaluate and implement solutions.
• Works in a collaborative environment to design, analyze, build and test mechanical components, devices, structures and assemblies, including mechanical ground support equipment.
• Participates as a member of project team of other mechanical hardware engineers and internal and outsourced development partners to develop reliable, cost effective and high quality solutions for low to moderate to complex products.
• Manages relationships with outsourced partners and suppliers, on mechanical and thermal design and development, including setting expectations regarding deliverables, product quality, schedules, and costs.
• Manages design engineering change notifications/engineering change approval request processes, qualification tests, and schedule.
• Manages value engineering project proposals, schedule, tests, and communication.

Education & Experience Recommended
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.

title: Vær med til at forme fremtidens endokrinologiske sygepleje på Regionshospitalet Viborg
description:
Selvstændige konsultationer, stærkt fællesskab og høj faglighed. Vi søger en sygeplejerske med ambitioner til en fast stilling.

Vi søger en engageret sygeplejerske til vores Klinik for Diabetes og Hormonsygdomme, Regionshospitalet Viborg med tiltrædelse pr. 1. oktober 2026.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer/uge med weekendvagt hver 6. weekend og én helligdag pr. halve år i vores medicinske sengeafsnit. Derudover har vi ambulatoriefunktion på Regionshospitalet Sive, hvor du – efter endt oplæring – vil have 2-3 arbejdsdage om året.

Om klinikken
I klinikken møder vi patienter med forskellige diabetestyper, en bred vifte af hormonsygdomme samt osteoporose.

Som sygeplejerske hos os får du selvstændige konsultationer, hvor du blandt andet:

  • Varetager ambulante diabeteskontroller
  • Underviser og oplærer patienter med nyopdaget diabetes
  • Introducerer, justerer og vurderer insulinbehandling for såvel penbrugere som pumpebrugere
  • Oplærer patienter i brug af anden diabetesteknologi
  • Arbejder med kontaktpersonsordning og skaber kontinuitet i patientforløb

Inden for osteoporoseområdet:

  • Afholder oplæring og opfølgende samtaler
  • Udfører ambulante behandlinger
  • Giver behandling

Derudover varetager sygeplejerskerne diagnostiske undersøgelser såsom:

  • Fundusfoto
  • Døgnblodtryksmåling
  • Synachtentest

Hvad vægter vi?

  • Vi prioriterer sygeplejefaglig udvikling højt og har et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Vi ser tværfaglighed som en styrke og tror på, at vi i fællesskab skaber de bedste patientforløb.
  • Som uddannelsessted med en stærk faglig kultur og en vigtig uddannelsesforpligtelse er studerende en naturlig del af vores hverdag.

Hos os vil du trives, hvis du:

  • Tænker innovativt og ser muligheder
  • Inddrager og samarbejder med patienten
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med teknologi
  • Har faglige ambitioner
  • Er stærk i både mono- og tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Har mod på udfordringer
  • Sætter pris på et arbejdsmiljø med plads til grin – kombineret med høj faglig seriøsitet

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Grundig introduktion til klinikken og specialet
  • Et positivt og engageret personale med fælles værdigrundlag
  • Indflydelse på arbejdsplanen
  • Selvstændige funktioner i ambulatoriet
  • Mulighed for både klinik- og sengeafsnitsfunktion
  • Mulighed for at blive klinisk vejleder for sygeplejestuderende

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring inden for endokrinologi
  • Gerne har kendskab til diabetesteknologi (en fordel, ikke et krav)
  • Har lyst til at arbejde både i klinikken og i sengeafsnittet
  • Samarbejder loyalt og respektfuldt i et tværfagligt miljø
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt såvel som i team
  • Er engageret, ansvarlig og ærlig
  • Arbejder reflekterende
  • Er åben for ny læring
  • Er rummelig og robust
  • Har et godt humør

Vil du være en del af et speciale i rivende udvikling, hvor patientinddragelse, teknologi og høj faglighed går hånd i hånd?

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Om Medicinsk Diagnostisk Center
Klinik for Diabetes og Hormonsygdomme er en del af Medicinsk Diagnostisk Center.

Bredde og sammenhæng er centrale ord, når vi skal beskrive Medicinsk Diagnostisk Center som både behandlingssted og arbejdsplads.

Med 500 medarbejdere, syv medicinske specialer og afsnit og klinikker i både Viborg, Silkeborg og Skive spænder Medicinsk Diagnostisk Center bredt. Vores patientgruppe er mangfoldig, både hvad angår sygdom, alder og sociale forhold, og mange har flere sygdomme og forløb, der går på tværs af afdelinger, hospitaler og sektorer.

Vi er derfor vant til at samarbejde på tværs og tænke i helhed – samtidig med at vi har øje for nærhed og sammenhæng for den enkelte patient, pårørende og medarbejder.

På samme måde ser vi vores kolleger som hele mennesker, der har brug for balance mellem arbejde og fritid. Vi fleksible med vagtplaner og tager så vidt muligt hensyn til individuelle behov.

Trods vores størrelse er der aldrig langt til en hjælpsom kollega. Vi prioriterer vidensdeling og dialog, fordi det giver de bedste patientforløb og meningsfulde arbejdsdage. Som ny medarbejder vil du opleve at blive taget imod af engagerede kolleger, der står klar med formaliseret onboarding-program og vilje til sparring, uanset om du er nyuddannet eller erfaren.

Samtidig tager vi også gerne selv imod nye tanker og ideer. Vi er altid på jagt efter måder at forbedre vores patientforløb og vægter udvikling og forskning højt; blandt andet i kraft af vores Universitetsklinik for Innovative Patientforløb. På den måde står vi godt rustet til de kommende års øgede fokus på det medicinske område, og vi har en ambition om at være en toneangivende spiller i fremtidens sundhedsvæsen.

Ansættelsen sker ved Hospitalsenhed Midt, læs mere om den samlede hospitalsenhed her www.hospitalsenhedmidt.dk
Interesserede ansøgere, uanset personlig baggrund, opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst på området.
Med henvisning til lov om børneattest i forbindelse med ansættelse af personale m.v., vil der blive indhentet børneattest i forbindelse med eventuel ansættelse.
Ansættelse sker ved Region Midtjylland med tjeneste indtil videre ved Hospitalsenhed Midt, Medicinsk Diagnostisk Center.

Vil du vide mere?
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til oversygeplejerske Birgitte Dyreborg på telefonnummer: 78417306

Din ansøgning
Din ansøgning indeholdende autorisations ID, oplysninger om uddannelse og hidtidig erfaring skal være os i hænde elektronisk senest onsdag den 19. august 2026.
Samtaler forventes afholdt den 24. august 2026 fra kl. 12.30


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.
Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse. Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Student med driv? Vi söker konsultchefsassistent på deltid
description:
Professionals Nord grundades med ambitionen att skapa en plats för människor att växa, på riktigt. En plats för människor att utvecklas, utmanas och nå sin fulla potential. Det är fortsatt drivkraften bakom allt vi gör – kompetensförsörjning inom rekrytering, personaluthyrning och Accelerated Learning. Vi utvecklar företag, individer och bidrar till att förändra branschen.

Är du en student som söker ett givande extraarbete vid sidan av dina studier? ? Då ska du läsa vidare! Just nu söker vi en intern konsultchefsassistent till vårt kontor i Luleå – i rollen erbjuds du utbildningar, utmaningar och en fartfylld vardag!

Som assistent avlastar du våra konsultchefer och hjälper till med alla delar av rekryteringsprocessen för att säkerställa att våra företagskunder får de vassaste kandidaterna. När du är klar med dina studier finns det goda möjligheter att fortsätta avancera in i en heltidstjänst på bolaget precis som många av våra tidigare assistentstjärnor. Har du rätt inställning och egenskaper kan vi lära dig resten! Låter det intressant? Ansök redan idag då urval kommer ske löpande.

Information om tjänsten

Professionals Nord arbetar med kompetensförsörjning i världsklass – vår strategi innebär skräddarsydda lösningar med avstamp i kundens behov och den lokala marknaden. Vi som arbetar internt tror att de bästa skorna alltid är några storlekar för stora, det ska alltid finnas utrymme att växa både i sin roll och som person. Hos Professionals Nord är beslutsvägarna korta och möjligheten till att påverka, bidra och förändra är stor. Bolaget i sig har gjort en raketresa med mycket stor tillväxt och förväntas fortsätta växa än mer kommande år. Det innebär att det finns möjlighet för dig att växa tillsammans med företaget. När du är klar med dina studier finns det goda möjligheter att fortsätta avancera in i en heltidstjänst på bolaget precis som många av våra tidigare assistentstjärnor.

Som konsultchefsassistent hos oss sitter du på vårt nyrenoverade kontor i centrala Luleå tillsammans med glada och drivna kollegor. Vi som arbetar här har en förkärlek för hundar, roliga upptåg och såklart – våra karriärer! De senaste åren har vi tagit stora marknadsandelar i regionen och våra framgångar har vi bland annat firat genom resor till Budapest, Riga och Åre. Vi gillar alltså att jobba lika mycket som vi gillar att ha kul tillsammans!

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som konsultchefsassistent arbetar du ungefär två dagar i veckan utöver dina studier. Schema läggs veckovis och baseras på arbetsbelastning nästkommande vecka, samt de möjligheter som finns utifrån ditt studieschema. Notera att vi ser mycket positivt på att du är flexibel och i perioder av arbetstoppar även kan avlasta under kvällar samt helger.

Som konsultchefsassistent på vårt kontor i Luleå avlastar du våra konsultchefer och hjälper till med alla delar av rekryteringsprocessen. Det innebär att du bland annat hjälper till med att skriva annonser, kandidaturval via CV-granskning, telefonavstämningar och referenstagningar. På sikt kan du även få ta egna intervjuer och ta det yttersta ansvaret över enklare processer. I rollen ingår även att avlasta med administration kopplat till själva anställningen så som att rulla ut scheman, administrera anställningsavtal samt löneunderlag. I rollen som konsultchefsassistent har du en varierad vardag där ingen dag är den andra lik och kontaktytorna är många – alltifrån kandidater och konsulter till interna medarbetare.

Hos oss på PN kommer du få alla verktyg för att utvecklas och skapa dig en karriär inom rekrytering. Under dina lov förväntas du arbeta heltid och vikariera som konsultchef. Du kommer då att arbeta tillsammans med övriga assistent-team runt om i Sverige för att sköta den dagliga verksamheten.

Vi söker dig som

Det allra viktigaste för den här rollen är att du har rätt driv och ambition – besitter du det kan vi lära dig resten! Vi tror att du är en person som beskrivs som ansvarstagande, ambitiös och engagerad. För att vara framgångsrik och trivas i rollen hos oss, tror vi att du gillar affärsmässighet och ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt. För dig är det en självklarhet att leverera inom utsatta tidsramar. Du tycker om att skapa relationer och drivs av att jobba mot högt uppsatta mål.

Vi ser att du studerar på högskolenivå inom exempelvis HR, juridik eller ekonomi. Krav för tjänsten är även flytande svenska i tal samt skrift.

Självfallet identifierar du dig i våra värdeord; FRAMGÅNG, SNÄLL, LYCKA.

START: Enligt överenskommelse

OMFATTNING: Deltid

STAD: Luleå

URVAL: Sker löpande

KONTAKT: Matilda Lindfors

Sök tjänsten nedan genom att fylla i din information samt bifoga dokument. Logga gärna vidare in på "Mina sidor" efter att du bekräftat ditt konto, här kan du skapa din kandidatprofil vilket utökar din chans till drömjobbet! Vi går igenom urvalet löpande och kan därför ha gått vidare med kandidater innan annonsen stängs ner. Vi tar tyvärr inte emot ansökningar via mail men har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta matilda.lindfors@pn.se

title: Software Engineer
description:

Live events are fun.

Concerts, sporting events, and festivals create memorable lifelong experiences with clients, prospects, partners, friends, and family—and they drive real business impact.
Companies spend more than $600 billion each year on client entertainment. TicketManager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization.

Built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, TicketManager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. Our industry-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove ROI and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences.

TicketManager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including Anheuser-Busch, Verizon, American Express, Nike, and Visa, as well as Fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the NBA, NFL, NCAA, and NASCAR.

We’re also proud to partner with some of the most iconic teams and venues in sports and entertainment, including the New York Jets, Philadelphia Eagles and Phillies, Capital One Arena, Texas Rangers, LAFC, and Seattle Seahawks, along with more than 50 professional and collegiate teams, franchises, universities, and technology providers.

Why Work at TicketManager

At TicketManager, you’ll help build technology that brings people together through live experiences—while solving complex, real-world problems for the world’s best companies. We’re a fast-growing, profitable company that values ownership, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re building a team that’s passionate about making work impactful and fun.

If you’re excited about live events, cutting-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role

We are looking for a motivated full-stack developer to join our team as a Software Engineer. The position offers a lot of opportunity to learn and grow as a developer. As a Software Engineer, you’ll be a key member of our Technology team, contributing cross-departmentally to create web pages that fuse compelling design and current technologies. The ideal candidate will be able to hit the ground running, possess a strong curiosity and desire to ideate and explore new features to improve experiences. You’ll participate in discussions about product ideation, proof-of-concepts, and give feedback on ideas.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain web-based application on AWS, using Node.js, PHP, and Java
  • REST API development on our External and Internal APIs
  • Respond to requests and questions about how our application works, including verification and debugging for features and functionality.
  • Work through the entire web application development life cycle right from requirements to delivery and post launch support
  • Tackle a wide variety of coding problems throughout the stack, including learning new languages and design patterns
  • Keep abreast of new trends and best practices in web development
  • Need to work in office; be available during regular hours as well as off-hours availability depending on project needs

Desired Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree Required, MS in Computer Science Engineering, MIS or relevant field is preferred
  • 3+ years of frontend and backend application development experience
  • In depth knowledge of Node.js
  • Advanced experience with MySQL or similar relational databases

title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer (Backend) based in Germany.

This role offers the opportunity to build reliable backend systems that power a modern compensation platform used by organizations and employees across Europe.
You will design, develop, and improve scalable services that simplify benefits, payments, and flexible compensation experiences.
The position combines backend engineering excellence, product thinking, and ownership within a fast-moving SaaS environment.
You will collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to solve meaningful customer problems from discovery through delivery.
Working remotely within Europe, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and directly influence product outcomes.
This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building impactful systems, improving reliability, and working in a collaborative product-driven culture.

Accountabilities

The Software Engineer (Backend) will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable backend systems while contributing to product decisions and improving the overall engineering experience.

  • Develop reliable, scalable backend services that support a compensation platform used by businesses and employees.
  • Design and implement APIs, database solutions, and architectural improvements that enhance performance and maintainability.
  • Build production-ready systems with strong testing practices, monitoring, observability, and resilience.
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical discovery and design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to identify the right solutions for customer needs.
  • Contribute technical expertise during product discovery, challenge assumptions, and help shape product direction.
  • Improve system performance through optimization, better error handling, reduced latency, and stronger data consistency.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to engineering standards through reviews, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.
  • Work with modern development practices including small pull requests, CI/CD workflows, and continuous delivery.
  • Build systems capable of supporting multiple markets with different regulatory, compliance, and business requirements.
  • Apply AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity, problem-solving, and engineering workflows.
  • Support team growth by sharing knowledge, pairing with colleagues, and contributing to a strong engineering culture.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a backend engineer with strong software development fundamentals, a product mindset, and experience building reliable systems in a collaborative environment.

    • Strong backend engineering fundamentals with experience building and maintaining production systems.
    • Experience developing scalable applications and services with a focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.
    • Strong understanding of software testing, observability, monitoring, and production operations.
    • Experience working with CI/CD practices and shipping incremental changes through collaborative development workflows.
    • Product-oriented mindset with the ability to understand user outcomes beyond technical implementation.
    • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with engineering, product, and design teams.
    • Experience working with databases, particularly PostgreSQL or similar relational database technologies.
    • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and modern engineering tools such as AWS, Kubernetes, GitHub, GitHub Actions, ConfigCat, or Datadog.
    • Experience with Elixir and Phoenix frameworks is a strong advantage.
    • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, or regulated industries is a plus.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and prompt-based workflows is beneficial.
    • Ability to balance speed, quality, and pragmatic decision-making in a fast-paced environment.
    • Strong ownership mindset, adaptability, and willingness to take responsibility for technical outcomes.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote opportunity within Europe.
      • Competitive base salary ranging from €50K to €80K gross annually, depending on experience.
      • Equity participation through VSOPs.

      • High level of autonomy and ownership over meaningful engineering challenges.

title: Myyjä (25-30h/vko) K-Market Lahela ja K-Market Sahankulma, Tuusula
description:
Otatko vastuuta, toimit oma-aloitteisesti ja sopeudut nopeasti vaihtuviin tilanteisiin?

K-Market Lahela ja K-Market Sahankulma Tuusulassa etsivät vakituiseen työsuhteeseen myyjää, joka tarttuu toimeen ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta, oppii nopeasti uusia toimintatapoja ja huolehtii siitä, että asiat tulevat tehdyiksi laadukkaasti loppuun asti.

Työskentelet kahdessa eri myymälässä, joten menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinun tulee omaksua nopeasti erilaisia toimintatapoja, tunnistaa työtehtävien prioriteetit ja pystyä toimimaan sujuvasti kummassakin myymälässä. Lisäksi toimit molempien myymälöiden osastovastaavien tukena ja tarvittaessa heidän sijaisenaan loma- ja poissaolotilanteissa.

Mitä teet – ja mistä kannat vastuun

Asiakaspalvelu ja myynti

  • Kohtaat asiakkaat aidosti palveluhenkisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti.
  • Huolehdit omalta osaltasi siitä, että asiakkaan asiointi on sujuvaa ja myönteistä jokaisessa tilanteessa.

Kassa, pakettipalvelut ja Wolt-keräily

  • Työskentelet huolellisesti, tehokkaasti ja vastuullisesti.
  • Omaksut eri työtehtävät nopeasti ja varmistat, että palvelu toimii myös kiireisimpinä hetkinä.

Myymälän toimivuus

  • Otat vastuuta hyllysaatavuudesta, esillepanoista, kuormien purusta ja myymälän yleisestä siisteydestä.
  • Havaitset itse, mitä tulee tehdä, ja toimit aktiivisesti ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta.
  • Huolehdit siitä, että sovitut tehtävät tulevat valmiiksi ja myymälä pysyy hyvässä kunnossa koko työvuoron ajan.

Osastovastaavien tukena toimiminen

  • Toimit molempien myymälöiden osastovastaavien tukena päivittäisessä tekemisessä.
  • Toimit jatkossa osastovastaavien sijaisena heidän poissaolojensa aikana sekä huolehdit siitä, että vastuualueet toimivat suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

Työvuorot sijoittuvat myymälöiden aukioloaikojen mukaan painottuen ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroihin. Yhden osastovastaavan opintovapaan vuoksi tehtävään sisältyy määräaikasesti myös aamuvuoroja tarpeen mukaan. Työtä tehdään sekä K-Market Lahelassa että K-Market Sahankulmassa.

Millä asenteella onnistut

  • Omaksut uusia työtehtäviä ja toimintatapoja nopeasti.
  • Sopeudut joustavasti erilaisiin tilanteisiin ja työympäristöihin.
  • Sinulla on kyky hahmottaa myymälän kokonaisuutta ja tehdä itsenäisiä ratkaisuja vastuuvuoroissa.
  • Pidät yllä hyvää palveluasennetta myös kiireessä.
  • Toimit luotettavasti, täsmällisesti ja yhteistyökykyisesti.
  • Sinulla on hyvä peruskunto ja kyky toimia vauhdikkaassa työympäristössä.
  • Puhut suomea, olet täyttänyt 18 vuotta ja pystyt työskentelemään myymälöiden kaikissa vuoroissa.
  • Aiempi kokemus päivittäistavarakaupasta ja vastaavista tehtävistä välttämätöntä.

Me tarjoamme

  • Monipuolisen työn kahdessa erilaisessa myymälässä.
  • Mahdollisuuden ottaa vastuuta ja kehittyä osastovastaavien tukena sekä heidän sijaisenaan.
  • Kannustavan työyhteisön ja esihenkilöiden tuen.
  • K-ryhmän koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet.
  • Kaupan alan TES mukaisen palkan sekä K-ryhmän henkilöstöedut.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Imports Platform
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Staff Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Imports Platform

Company Description

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

Position Description

We are looking for an experienced Staff Software Engineer (Full Stack) to join our next-generation Imports Platform team. The Imports Platform team is leading a strategic initiative to modernize Okta's identity lifecycle management capabilities by architecting and migrating from a legacy monolithic system to a highly scalable, distributed microservices platform. This critical service orchestrates the importing, syncing, mapping, and provisioning of identities and access policies—users, groups, roles, entitlements—from external directory services including Active Directory, Office 365, and LDAP-based systems.

As a Full Stack Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader who independently owns end-to-end features and platform capabilities—spanning intuitive user interfaces, REST/GraphQL APIs, high-throughput asynchronous job engines, and microservice backends. You will drive technical strategy, make critical architectural decisions across the entire stack, and influence both your immediate team and cross-functional initiatives. You'll solve complex challenges ranging from building rich, responsive admin workflows to managing massive-scale batch processing, real-time synchronization, and identity resolution algorithms.

This role requires strong technical leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to balance short-term delivery with long-term platform health. You will mentor engineers across the full stack, partner closely with Product Management and UX on feature strategy, and help shape the future of Okta's Imports platform.

This is a hybrid position requiring a blend of remote and in-office collaboration.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Full-Stack Technical Leadership: Lead the architectural design and execution strategy across the full stack (Frontend, APIs, Microservices, Data Layers) for major platform initiatives.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Independently own and deliver complex products end-to-end—from front-end admin configuration flows and wizard UIs to back-end event streams and database persistence.
  • Monolith to Microservices Migration: Drive the migration strategy for full-stack features from legacy systems into modern, modular frontend applications and distributed microservices.
  • API & System Design: Architect robust RESTful/GraphQL APIs and server-side components optimized for performance, security, and low-latency frontend interaction.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Architects, QA, and SRE to translate complex enterprise identity requirements into seamless user experiences and scalable technical designs.
  • Code Quality & Standards: Conduct comprehensive code reviews across both frontend and backend codebases, enforcing high standards for performance, accessibility, security, testability, and maintainability.
  • Operational Excellence: Troubleshoot complex production incidents spanning client-side applications, API gateways, and distributed backends; perform root cause analyses (RCAs) and drive systemic improvements.
  • Mentorship & Growth: Mentor and guide senior and junior engineers across full-stack technologies, promoting software design best practices and fostering engineering velocity.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience: 7+ years of software development experience building highly reliable, mission-critical, enterprise-grade software at scale across both frontend and backend stacks.
  • Backend Expertise: Deep expertise with Java and the Spring Boot framework for building distributed microservices, RESTful APIs, and scalable backend workflows.
  • Frontend Expertise: Strong, hands-on experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React, Redux, or modern Web Components) and building complex, accessible enterprise web applications.
  • Distributed Systems & Data: Experience with distributed job processing, event-driven architectures, relational databases (MySQL), caching layers (Redis), and message queues (e.g., Kafka, SQS).
  • API Design: Proven track record designing, versioning, and maintaining clean RESTful or GraphQL APIs that power rich UI applications and enterprise integrations.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), microservice architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and modern web deployment tools.
  • Directory & Identity Services: Exposure to or understanding of Identity & Access Management concepts, directory services (Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD), or SCIM/SAML/OAuth standards.
  • Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end architecture, break down complex initiatives into execution roadmaps, and mentor cross-functional team members.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with frontend state management, micro-frontends, and design system integration (e.g., Okta Odyssey or similar UI libraries).
  • Experience with server-side rendering, WebSockets, or real-time progress tracking for long-running batch operations.
  • Experience with feature flag frameworks, A/B testing, and gradual rollout strategies for large-scale application migrations.
  • Familiarity with UI automation testing tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Jest) alongside backend TDD (JUnit/Mockito).
  • Knowledge of user matching, correlation algorithms, and identity resolution at scale.

Education and Training

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
