title: To årsvikariater til Centerklasserne Højvangskolen
description:
Centerklasserne v. Højvangskolen i Horsens søger to engagerede pædagoger, der brænder for at styrke og videreudvikle den fritidspædagogiske profil samt det pædagogiske arbejde i Centerklasserne.

Vi tilbyder to spændende årsvikariater. Begge stillinger er på 37 timer med ansættelse hurtigst muligt eller pr. 1. oktober 2026 og frem til d. 30. juni 2027. Den ene stilling er tilknyttet vores indskoling og den anden stilling er tilknyttet vores udskoling.
Som pædagog på Højvangskolen er trivsel og deltagelse grundlæggende værdier og samtidig en vigtig forudsætning for børns læring og udvikling i hverdagen. Vi arbejder med fokus på det hele barn og har særlig opmærksomhed på at skabe meningsfulde deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn. Vi ønsker, at alle elever oplever sig som en værdifuld del af fællesskaber, hvor de kan deltage aktivt, bidrage og have indflydelse – både i de små og store fællesskaber.
På alle klassetrin i Centerklasserne arbejdes der ud fra en tilgang der fokuserer på det visuelle, det strukturerede, det kommunikative – og ud fra en anerkendende tilgang. Der arbejdes ligeledes med elementer fra low arousal.
Vi har et stærkt fokus på at inddrage børnene aktivt i deres egen læring og udvikling. Gennem en målrettet pædagogisk praksis arbejder vi med elevernes faglige udvikling, trivsel og personlige mestring.
I SFO’en vægter vi legens betydning højt. Vi arbejder bevidst med at understøtte børns leg og skabe gode rammer for legefællesskaber, hvor børnene kan udvikle sociale kompetencer, fantasi og relationer.
Som pædagog i Centerklasserne vil du have en central rolle både i undervisningen og i SFO’en. Du bliver en del af et hus-team og indgår i et tæt og forpligtende samarbejde med lærere og pædagoger om at skabe sammenhængende og udviklende læringsmiljøer for børnene.

Vi forventer:
  • At du er uddannet pædagog.
  • At du har lyst til, interesse i og evt. erfaring med arbejdet i både undervisningen og i fritidsdelen i SFO’en.
  • At du brænder for læringsfællesskaber og har et nysgerrigt og fleksibelt mindset.
  • At du kan reflektere over egen praksis og sætte dine refleksioner i spil.
  • At du kan arbejde ud fra pædagogiske mål og omsætte disse til pædagogiske handlinger.
  • At du kan bidrage til en fælles kollegial trivsel ved at indgå i et tæt samarbejde med kollegaer.
  • At du er fleksibel, og har gode samarbejdsevner.

Du skal være tydelig i din kommunikation, og stærk på eller disponeret/motiveret for udvikling inden for følgende områder:
  • Faglige kompetencer – med kvalitet, ambitioner og engagement
  • Relations dannelse
  • Udvikling og fokus på elevernes læring, trivsel og personlig mestring

Derudover skal du være parat til løbende at udvikle dig i samspil med kollegaer og ledelse.
Højvangskolen er en skole med fokus på faglighed og fællesskab. Derfor kan Centerklasserne tilbyde et spændende og udfordrende job.

Ansættelse:
- Du ansættes på Højvangskolen som pædagog d. 1. oktober 2026.
- Du aflønnes efter gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: mandag d. 24. august 2026. Ansøgning med bilag lægges ind digitalt via link. Vi vil afholde løbende samtaler. Den sidste samtaler forventes afholdt: torsdag d. 27. august 2026 fra kl. 14.00.

Kontakt:
For yderligere oplysninger, kontakt ledende pædagog Mette Vester på telefon 76 29 40 60
(Mobil 30 29 53 16), email: mfe@horsens.dk. Besøg på skolen kan aftales og vil være en fordel for rette ansøger.

Om skolen
Om skolen
Højvangskolen er en velfungerende og attraktiv folkeskole beliggende i den sydøstlige del af Horsens med både by, land og fjord som nærmeste nabo. Her er 800 fantastiske elever, hvoraf de 107 går i centerklasserne og 120 engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere, giver skolen en volumen, hvor alle kompetencer kommer i spil.
Højvangskolen er en ambitiøs skole, hvor personalet har et højt fagligt niveau og elever og forældre har et positivt syn på skolen.
Centerklasserne er et kommunalt specialtilbud for elever fra hele Horsens Kommune med udfordringer inden for ADHD og/eller autismespektret, samt en række mindre udbredte udviklingsforstyrrelser. Centerklasserne dækker hele skoleforløbet fra 0. til 10. klasse.
Centerklasserne er placeret i umiddelbar nærhed af hovedskolen og indgår i lokalemæssigt og delvis pædagogisk samarbejde med denne. Der undervises i henhold til folkeskoleloven – og der er mulighed for at aflægge prøver i alle fag.
Fællesskabet prioriteres særdeles højt på Højvangskolen både blandt elever, forældre og personale.

Alle medarbejdere på hovedskolen har individuel arbejdsplads – placeret fysisk i nærheden af deres hus-team, og flekstidsaftale med muligheder for en dynamisk og individuelt tilpasset placering af arbejdstiden.
Vi er en skole med et meget stærkt kollegialt sammenhold og gode individuelle udviklingsmuligheder.

I Horsens Kommune ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke, og vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion, etnisk tilhørsforhold og handicap.

title: Designer Produit Senior / Senior Product Designer
description:
Akur8 est une scale-up InsurTech en forte croissance, dont la mission est de moderniser la façon dont les assureurs évaluent, tarifient et gèrent les risques.

Notre plateforme SaaS de nouvelle génération associe machine learning transparent, analyse prédictive et conception intelligente de produits pour transformer des processus complexes d’assurance en systèmes évolutifs et fondés sur les données.

Grâce à ses équipes d’engineering, de data, de product et d’actuariat, Akur8 permet aux assureurs de modéliser les risques jusqu’à 10 fois plus rapidement, tout en préservant la transparence, l’explicabilité et la confiance des organismes de réglementation.

À mesure que notre suite de produits s’enrichit, nous développons une plateforme de bout en bout couvrant la tarification en assurance non-vie et vie, le provisionnement, l’intelligence de marché et les décisions de gestion des risques fondées sur des projections. Nous aidons ainsi les assureurs à gagner en efficacité dans un environnement complexe.

Reconnue à l’échelle mondiale, Akur8 a été citée dans :

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC’s InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index, avec un score de 97/100 (2025)

Avec plus de 40 nationalités réparties dans 8 bureaux à travers le monde, nous accompagnons plus de 320 clients sur 4 continents, tout en cultivant une forte culture d’engineering et de product.

Nous sommes fiers d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances et de favoriser un environnement inclusif, où la diversité des points de vue contribue à concevoir de meilleurs produits et à prendre de meilleures décisions.

__________________________________________________________________________________

Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our next-generation SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and smart product design to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems.

Powered by expert engineering, data, product, and actuarial teams, Akur8 enables insurers to model risk up to 10x faster while maintaining transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As our product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform supporting non-life and life pricing, reserving, market intelligence and forward-looking risk decisions — helping insurers operate efficiently in a complex environment.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC’s InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)

With 40+ nationalities across 8 global offices, we serve 320+ clients across 4 continents while maintaining a strong engineering and product culture.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives help shape better products and decisions.

Nous recherchons un·e Senior UX Designer talentueux·se pour rejoindre notre équipe à Montréal. Vous aurez pour mission de concevoir, développer et donner vie à l’ensemble des éléments des produits Akur8 destinés aux utilisateurs.

Rattaché·e directement au Head of Product, vous serez un partenaire stratégique des équipes Product Management et Engineering, en vous concentrant sur un périmètre produit dédié.

Vous collaborerez étroitement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires afin de garantir que nos solutions de design respectent les standards du secteur et les meilleures pratiques.

Votre niveau de séniorité vous amènera à jouer un rôle déterminant dans la production de résultats de grande qualité en matière de design, en répondant aux besoins de l’équipe tout en défendant l’excellence du design à l’échelle de l’organisation.

Responsabilités :

  • Démontrer une expertise exceptionnelle en matière de design, couvrant l’UX/UI et le design ops.

  • Résoudre des problématiques de design complexes en collaborant avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires afin de concevoir des solutions pertinentes.

  • Éclairer vos choix de design grâce à des insights qualitatifs et fondés sur les données concernant les besoins et les difficultés des utilisateurs.

  • Maintenir un niveau d’exigence élevé pour les livrables de design, en veillant à ce qu’ils répondent aux besoins des utilisateurs et soient alignés sur les objectifs de l’entreprise, en collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées.

  • Produire des solutions de design de grande qualité grâce aux revues de design et à une collaboration étroite avec l’équipe.

  • Définir et maintenir les directives de design UX à l’échelle de la plateforme afin de garantir la cohérence de l’expérience à mesure que le produit évolue.

  • Prendre en charge le design system de bout en bout : architecture des composants dans Figma, design tokens et implémentation dans la base de code frontend.

  • Collaborer avec les frontend engineers afin de garantir que l’intention de design soit préservée jusqu’à la mise en production.

  • Utiliser, maintenir et améliorer des workflows assistés par l’IA (Claude, Cursor ou équivalent) afin de fluidifier le processus de design et de contribuer directement aux évolutions du produit.

  • Gérer efficacement les parties prenantes, communiquer les décisions de design et promouvoir la valeur du design au sein de toute l’organisation.

  • Faire preuve d’autonomie et être responsable de la gestion de votre temps et de vos livrables.

___________________________________________________________________________________

We're seeking a talented Senior UX Designer to join our team in Montreal. Your role will involve shaping, developing, and bringing to life all user-facing elements of Akur8 products.

Reporting directly to the Head of Product, you'll serve as a strategic partner to both Product Management and Engineering, focusing on a dedicated product domain.

You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that our design solutions align with industry standards and best practices.

Your seniority will mean that you’re instrumental in driving high-quality design outcomes, both in terms of supporting the design needs, as well as advocating for design excellence across the organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrating exceptional skills in design craft, encompassing UX/UI design and design ops.

  • Tackling complex design problems by collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions.

  • Informing your designs with both qualitative and data-driven insights on user needs and pain points.

  • Upholding a high-quality bar for design deliverables, ensuring they meet user needs and align with business objectives with oversight from relevant stakeholders.

  • Delivering high-quality design solutions, through design critiques and close team collaboration.

  • Defining and maintaining UX design guidelines across the platform to keep the experience coherent as the product scales

  • Owning the design system end-to-end: component architecture in Figma, design tokens, and their implementation in the frontend codebase

  • Aligning with frontend engineers to make sure design intent survives into production

  • Using, maintaining and enhancing AI-assisted workflows (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) to streamline the design process and contribute directly to product enhancements

  • Managing stakeholders effectively, communicating design decisions, and evangelizing the value of design throughout the organization.

  • Being autonomous and responsible for your time and deliverables.

  • 5 ans ou plus d’expérience.

  • Expérience confirmée en design UX B2B et SaaS.

  • Maîtrise des principes de design UX/UI, avec un portfolio solide présentant vos réalisations.

  • Expérience dans la création, l’utilisation et la maintenance de design systems, ainsi que dans le développement de composants.

  • À l’aise avec la lecture et la modification de code frontend.

  • Expérience avérée dans l’utilisation d’agents IA de programmation pour effectuer des corrections ciblées de l’interface.

  • Connaissance des méthodologies Agile et expérience des cycles de design itératifs.

  • Aptitude à comprendre des domaines quantitatifs tels que la data science, la modélisation actuarielle et le secteur financier.

  • Vous adoptez une vision stratégique dans tout ce que vous entreprenez, et vos réalisations s’inscrivent dans la durée.

  • Vous disposez d’excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes et savez traiter des problématiques de design complexes afin d’orienter le développement de solutions adaptées.

  • Vous possédez d’excellentes compétences en communication, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, ainsi qu’une capacité démontrée à gérer efficacement les parties prenantes et à influencer les processus de décision.

  • Vous êtes passionné·e par la qualité d’exécution et l’impact du design.

  • Vous êtes basé·e à Montréal ou disposé·e à vous y installer.

  • Vous maîtrisez couramment l’anglais à l’oral.

Merci d’inclure un lien vers votre portfolio, ainsi que le mot de passe s’il est protégé.

___________________________________________________________________________________

  • 5+ years experience.

  • Proven B2B / SaaS UX Design experience.

  • Expertise in UX/UI design principles, with a strong portfolio showcasing your design work.

  • Experience creating, using, and maintaining design systems, as well as coding components

  • Comfortable reading and editing frontend code

  • Proven usage of AI coding agents to make targeted UI fixes

  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies and experience working in iterative design cycles.

title: Senior System Engineer (CloudGate)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior System Engineer (CloudGate) based in United Kingdom.

This role offers the opportunity to work on advanced cloud networking solutions powering the next generation of AI infrastructure. As a Senior System Engineer, you will contribute to the development and optimization of high-performance network services within a large-scale cloud environment. You will design reliable systems, improve service scalability, and solve complex infrastructure challenges involving connectivity, traffic management, and distributed architectures. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will help build technologies that support demanding AI workloads and enterprise applications. The position combines deep systems engineering, networking expertise, and software development in a fast-paced international environment. You will have significant ownership and the opportunity to shape critical components of modern cloud platforms.

Accountabilities:

As a Senior System Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and improving core networking services that support large-scale cloud infrastructure. You will work on high-performance systems, ensuring reliability, scalability, and efficiency while collaborating with engineers across different technical domains.

  • Develop and maintain data plane components for advanced cloud network services.
  • Design and implement reliable, high-performance software solutions for large-scale infrastructure.
  • Improve service scalability, performance, and reliability through architectural enhancements and optimization.
  • Develop new service functionality, including support for additional endpoints and improved health-check mechanisms.
  • Optimize interactions between distributed services within a microservice-based control plane architecture.
  • Automate complex cross-service workflows to improve operational efficiency.
  • Perform load testing and analyze system behavior under high-traffic conditions.
  • Contribute to the evolution of cloud networking technologies, including connectivity, traffic delivery, and network management solutions.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced systems engineer with strong software development skills and a passion for building reliable, high-performance infrastructure. You should have a solid understanding of networking concepts and be comfortable working with complex distributed systems.

    • Proven experience writing reliable, high-performance production code.
    • Strong programming skills in C, with willingness and ability to learn Go and C++.
    • Experience with network traffic routing and network infrastructure concepts.
    • Understanding of distributed systems, cloud environments, and service-oriented architectures.
    • Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop scalable solutions.
    • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to performance, reliability, and maintainability.
    • Experience with VPP, DPDK, or the Linux kernel networking subsystem is a plus.
    • Knowledge of virtual networks, overlays, SDN, NFV, DPI, network protocols, routing, tunneling, BGP, or MPLS is considered an advantage.
    • Ability to successfully complete technical coding assessments as part of the recruitment process.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation package.
      • Career development opportunities with access to continuous learning.
      • High level of ownership and flexibility in your work.
      • Opportunity to work on impactful cloud infrastructure projects supporting AI innovation.
      • Collaborative environment with talented international engineering teams.
      • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies across cloud computing, networking, and artificial intelligence.
      • Opportunity to contribute to solutions shaping the future of AI infrastructure.
      • Inclusive and diverse workplace culture focused on trust, growth, and meaningful impact.

title: Global Growth Business Director
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Global Growth Business Director do at WPP Production?

The Business Director - Growth & Clients plays a pivotal role in shaping and driving growth for WPP Production: defining how we win high-value, complex opportunities, deepening our most important client relationships, and shaping the strategic direction of our growth function.

Reporting into the Global Chief Growth Officer and working closely with the Global Chief Client Officer, this is a highly strategic role, responsible for designing integrated solutions, evolving go-to-market propositions and building a repeatable growth engine that enables the business to win and grow consistently across markets, clients and opportunity types. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, you will help set the direction of the business and represent growth and clients at a senior level.

You will lead the strategic direction and narrative for priority opportunities, ensuring that responses are clearly positioned, commercially compelling and aligned to client needs. You will be accountable for the quality and consistency of our narrative and strategic output across pitches you are leading, setting the standard for how we articulate our value. Equally, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, using a deep understanding of their business and objectives to grow relationships and unlock new opportunities.

You will partner with Global Managing Partners on organic and new opportunities and the Global MD of Hex. Hex is the WPP Production Creative Technology and AI Studio specialising in generative AI, agentic AI, gaming, immersive experiences, and robotics. As part of this collaboration, you will come to understand our significant tech and tools partnerships.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across WPP Production and the wider WPP network, you will play a key role in driving integration across Media, Creative and Production, shaping how we bring together capabilities to deliver differentiated client solutions.

Beyond individual opportunities, you will take a broader view of growth, defining where we should focus, how we prioritise opportunities, and how we scale success globally. This includes evolving our approach to pitches, refining commercial models and embedding best practice ways of working across the team.

This is a high-impact, high-profile role with visibility across the business, suited to someone who thrives in complexity, operates with a high level of autonomy, and is motivated by driving measurable growth, client satisfaction and business impact at scale.

Key areas of responsibility

  • Define and lead the strategic direction for priority, high-value opportunities, ensuring a clear and differentiated approach to winning
  • Accountable for the narrative quality and strategic standard across assigned pitches, setting the benchmark for how we articulate our value
  • Design end-to-end client solutions, including operating models, pricing approach and value proposition
  • Lead on innovation in growth, including exploring the use of AI and new technologies to enhance team capability and efficiency
  • Work with the Global Chief Growth Officer to define and drive the global growth strategy for WPP Production, identifying priority markets, opportunity types and areas of focus
  • Partner with the Global Chief Client Officer to grow existing relationships, driving organic growth and cross-selling WPP Production's full breadth of capabilities and services
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, providing strategic insights and guidance that help them achieve their business objectives through the right production strategy
  • Drive improved conversion, efficiency and revenue impact across the new business pipeline through stronger strategic positioning and approach
  • Support financial performance, partnering with Commercial and Finance teams on P&Ls, budgets, forecasting, contribution margins and profit levers across clients and new opportunities
  • Build and scale a repeatable growth engine, embedding frameworks, playbooks, tools and best practice that enable teams globally to win consistently without central dependency
  • Act as a "pitch doctor", stepping into critical opportunities to strengthen narrative, structure and overall response quality
  • Present and represent WPP Production in senior client meetings and pitch meetings
  • Drive cross-WPP integration, ensuring collaboration across Media, Creative and Production
  • Develop and scale team capability through coaching, mentoring and training, creating a culture of collaboration, inclusion and continuous learning

What good looks like (key requirements)

  • Significant experience (typically 10+ years) in new business, growth, client leadership or strategy roles within a creative, production or agency environment
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, with a proven ability to define how complex opportunities are approached and won
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling ability, with experience leading narrative development for high-value, multi-disciplinary pitches
  • Proven experience leading large, complex and high-value pitch processes, often involving multiple stakeholders and disciplines
  • Expert client relationship skills in a multi-stakeholder, matrix environment, with a track record of driving up (or turning around) client satisfaction
  • Confident and credible communicator, with experience presenting to senior clients and influencing at leadership level
  • Comfortable operating at pace and under pressure, managing multiple high-stakes opportunities simultaneously
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing ecosystems, including the intersection of media, creative, technology and production
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, bringing structure and clarity to complex challenges
  • A proactive and solutions-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Experience developing and mentoring team members, with a focus on building capability and scaling impact
  • Curious and forward-thinking, with an interest in innovation, AI and the future of content and production

#LI-HYBRID

#LI-RH1

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. title: Kreditspecialist till Ellevio
description:
Vi söker dig med god administrativ förmåga, en framåtlutad inställning och en stark känsla för service för ett långsiktigt uppdrag som kreditspecialist till Ellevio! Trivs du i en roll där du får kombinationen av struktur och systemarbete med löpande kundkontakt? Då kan detta vara helt rätt möjlighet för dig. Skicka in din ansökan redan idag - urval sker löpande.

Om tjänsten

Ellevio är ett av Sveriges största elnätsföretag och arbetar med att leverera trygg och hållbar el till över en miljon kunder. Med fokus på att modernisera och framtidssäkra elnäten bidrar de till omställningen mot ett klimatsmart samhälle. För Ellevios räkning söker vi nu en konsult för ett långsiktigt uppdrag med målet att på sikt gå över till en anställning hos Ellevio.

Som kreditspecialist hos Ellevio spelar du en central roll i att hantera och effektivisera Ellevios inkassoprocesser. Du kommer att arbeta med allt från analys av utestående fordringar till att säkerställa korrekt från- och återinkoppling av kunder. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, både internt och externt, samt ett proaktivt förhållningssätt till kunddialog för att förebygga kreditförluster. Du kommer att ingå i ett sammansvetsat team på 14 personer där samarbete och nytänkande värdesätts högt.

Ellevio sitter i moderna lokaler beläget på Valhallavägen nära Gärdet och de tillämpar en hybridpolicy som innebär viss möjlighet till distansarbete vid behov. Vi söker dig som kan börja i augusti/september och som ser långsiktigt på uppdraget.

Du erbjuds

  • Möjligheten till en fast anställning och fortsätt utveckling hos ett av Sveriges största elnätsbolag.
  • Hybridlösning där du kombinerar arbete från kontoret med flexibilitet för distansarbete.
  • Ett kompetent team med engagerade chefer där företagskulturen genomsyras av framåtanda och lagarbete.
  • En dedikerad konsultchef från Academic Work som kommer att stötta och coacha dig under din tid på uppdraget.

Arbetsuppgifter

Rollen som kreditspecialist innebär många kontaktytor, både internt och externt. Du kommer att arbeta med delar av reskontraprocessen, men ditt huvudsakliga ansvarsområde är inkasso där aktiv kundkontakt och dialog per telefon är en central del i din vardag. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter är:

  • Analysera utestående fordringar och bidra till utveckling och effektivisering av våra metoder för betalningsindrivning.
  • Ha löpande kundkontakt inför frånkoppling samt fungera som stöd till kundsupporten.
  • Genomföra från- och återinkopplingar för Ellevios egna kunder.
  • Utföra från- och återinkopplingar på uppdrag av elhandelsföretag.
  • Hantera inkassoärenden i nära samarbete med Ellevios inkassopartner.
  • Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt och kravställa förändringar i Ellevios system, inklusive deltagande i tester tillsammans med kollegor.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har en avslutad gymnasieexamen.
  • Har tidigare erfarenhet av administration och kundservice.
  • Känner dig bekväm med telefonen som verktyg och trivs med att föra en god dialog med kunder.
  • Har en mycket god kommunikationsförmåga i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Erfarenhet från energibranschen.
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med inkassoprocesser.

Personliga egenskaper

För detta uppdrag lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Som person tror vi att du har en god arbetsmoral och en prestigelös inställning. Du tycker om att arbeta i team och trivs med att hjälpa dina kollegor när det behövs. Att anpassa dig snabbt till förändringar och nya förutsättningar gör du med lätthet och du lär dig även gärna nya rutiner och uppgifter. Vidare har du en naturlig känsla för service, känner dig trygg i telefonen och trivs i en roll med mycket kundkontakt och många kontaktytor, både internt och externt.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Product Training Specialist
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role

We're looking for someone to take ownership of how partners and internal teams learn our product, and to keep raising the bar on clarity and quality as they do it. You'll be the driving force behind how we teach, document, and train, from the Help Center partners turn to first, to the videos and live sessions that get new hires up to speed. You'll turn briefs from our Product and Product Marketing teams into content and training that's clear, engaging, and genuinely self serve, and you'll use AI tools every day to produce scripts, articles, and training decks quickly and to a high standard.

Day to day, this means you'll:

  • Own and grow the Fever Help Center, and build and maintain our tutorial video library, scripting and producing a clear walkthrough for every feature.
  • Run on demand product trainings for new hires in Partner Management and Business Development, train a go to trainer within each team, and design simple, repeatable training programs around recurring partner inquiries.
  • Coordinate localization by preparing clean source content and managing the workflow with our Translation team and AI tools, keeping everything consistent across languages.

About you

Basic skills and qualifications

  • Excellent English, written and spoken.
  • AI fluency: you already use AI tools to produce high-quality content fast, and you are eager to push that further.
  • Experience in or exposure to B2B SaaS (an internship counts). It gives you an instinct for what good product education looks like.
  • Relevant experience in technical content creation, documentation, customer education, or training. This role is open to early-career and mid-level candidates.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; you can manage many small content pieces and keep them consistent.
  • Strong presentation and public-speaking skills, with genuine comfort leading live trainings and train-the-trainer sessions.
  • A high sense of ownership and a hands-on, bar-raising mindset.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred skills and qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk's content management system, or another knowledge-base / CMS platform.
  • Prior experience producing customer-facing educational content or tutorial videos.
  • Video creation and editing (Camtasia or similar).
  • Spanish or other languages.
  • Exposure to marketplaces or the live-events / ticketing space.
  • A strong willingness to thrive in a leading, very fast-paced tech environment.

Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Home office friendly
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee.
  • English Lessons
  • Gympass Membership
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

title: Senior People Business Partner
description:
Get to Know the Team

The HR team, known as the People Operations (Pops) team, drives Grab's mission to revolutionise transportation and financial inclusion in Southeast Asia. We are dedicated to finding, nurturing, and retaining the remarkable talent that drives our success and innovation.

Get to Know the Role

As a People Operations Business Partner (Pops BP), you will play a strategic role in aligning business objectives with partners and employees across designated departments. You will act as a strategic advisor in decision-making processes. You will provide end-to-end HR expertise across talent acquisition, compensation, employee relations, and leadership development. This expertise will ensure our people strategy creates a measurable impact on our organisation.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • You will shape the organisation's future by understanding its evolving needs, partnering with business leaders in organisational design decisions.
  • You will diagnose complex problems by connecting insights across teams, solving for downstream and second-order effects before they surface.
  • You will lead the implementation of HR programmes and targeted learning initiatives to upskill the workforce
  • You will provide expert guidance to managers on employee relations, performance management, and talent development, ensuring equitable practices.
  • You will partner with business leaders on workforce planning, forecasting budgets for hiring, engagement, and learning and development while assessing and anticipating team needs.
  • You will drive large-scale organisational changes, securing buy-in from stakeholders at all levels and executing internal communication plans for major launches.
  • You will use People metrics to guide necessary data-based decisions and changes.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 10+ years of HR experience with at least 5 years of relevant experience in a human resource business partnering in technology, fintech, or high-growth organisations.
  • Track record of solving complex problems and managing organisational change, including experience guiding senior HR professionals through ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with employees and leaders at all levels, demonstrated through your history of influencing decisions and navigating sensitive conversations.
  • Experience with HRIS systems and People analytics tools such as Power BI, to extract workforce insights and present data to leadership.
  • Structured analytical skills with demonstrated judgement, shown through your experience diagnosing causes of organisational challenges and recommending specific solutions.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, demonstrated through your history of delivering workforce initiatives within timeline and budget.
  • Knowledge of employment laws and regulations across the markets where we operate

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For at Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in United States.

This role offers the opportunity to design and build the foundation of an AI-native operating environment used across a global organization.
You will create scalable infrastructure that enables intelligent agents to operate reliably, securely, and transparently.
The position combines advanced AI engineering, platform development, governance, and automation to solve complex operational challenges.
You will own the architecture, execution layer, evaluation systems, and tooling required to make AI workflows trustworthy.
Working in a fully remote and highly autonomous environment, you will influence how teams adopt and benefit from AI at scale.
This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building foundational systems, solving open-ended problems, and shaping the future of AI-powered work.

Accountabilities

The AI Platform Engineer will be responsible for building and operating the infrastructure that enables reliable, measurable, and governed AI systems across the organization.

  • Design, build, and maintain the AI execution platform, including event-triggered workflows, model-agnostic runtimes, durable state management, human review processes, rollback mechanisms, and comprehensive run logging.
  • Own the architecture decisions required to bring AI agent systems into production and ensure the platform operates reliably at scale.
  • Develop the evaluation layer that determines whether AI systems are safe, accurate, and ready for production use.
  • Create golden test suites, behavioral evaluations, safety checks, and CI gates that prevent unreliable AI capabilities from being deployed.
  • Build and manage a portfolio of AI agents supporting business workflows such as reporting, drafting, analysis, triage, and knowledge management.
  • Develop meta-level systems that monitor agent performance, identify improvements, and continuously enhance the platform.
  • Implement governance mechanisms directly into the platform, including risk tiers, least-privilege permissions, tool access controls, audit logging, and human approval workflows.
  • Ensure high-risk AI actions are technically restricted through system design rather than relying only on policies or prompts.
  • Design responsible communication systems that optimize notifications, minimize interruptions, and increase user trust and adoption.
  • Build platform tooling, including validators, compilers, context distribution systems, and integrations across repositories and collaboration environments.
  • Create data pipelines and reporting systems that measure AI adoption, operational impact, maturity levels, and return on investment.
  • Instrument AI workflows to track usage, efficiency gains, costs, and measurable business value.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an experienced AI platform engineer with a strong background in production-grade AI systems, infrastructure ownership, and reliable software engineering practices.

    • Proven experience building and deploying production LLM agent systems used by real users, beyond prototypes or demonstrations.
    • Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including golden datasets, behavioral assertions, judge criteria, safety testing, and automated quality gates.
    • Experience designing and implementing reliable AI workflows where correctness, traceability, and governance are critical.
    • Deep API integration experience with business systems and experience creating MCP servers.
    • Strong infrastructure engineering skills using Python, cloud platforms such as GCP, cloud data warehouses, and infrastructure-as-code tools.
    • Ability to independently design, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production systems end to end.
    • Experience with LLM observability, tracing, cost tracking, and transforming AI execution data into actionable insights.
    • Strong understanding of security principles, access controls, permissions management, and system-level risk prevention.
    • Experience building internal platforms, developer tools, or automation systems that achieved strong adoption among non-engineering teams.
    • Strong product mindset and ability to design AI experiences that respect user attention and build trust.
    • Experience working with agentic development tools and the ability to explain workflows, permissions, approval points, logging strategies, and lessons learned from failures.
    • Public contributions such as open-source AI frameworks, MCP servers, evaluation tools, or technical writing in AI reliability are considered a strong advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.
      • Remote-first culture with coworking support through a WeWork membership or coworking allowance.
      • Employee equity ownership program.
      • Technology allowance to create an ideal home office setup with equipment of your choice.
      • Comprehensive health benefits, including full employee health insurance coverage and dependent coverage support.
      • Annual company off-site gatherings focused on collaboration, connection, and team building.
      • Flexible and asynchronous work environment built on trust and autonomy.
      • Annual professional development budget for courses, books, conferences, and learning opportunities.
      • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team across multiple countries and cultures.
      • Chance to contribute to open-source-driven products used by a large developer community.
      • High-impact role with significant ownership over AI infrastructure strategy and execution.

title: Locatie secretaresse
description:

Wat ga je doen?

Als locatiesecretaresse denk je actief mee met de locatiemanager en teammanagers en ondersteun je door taken zelfstandig uit te voeren. Jouw werk bestaat uit algemene secretariaatswerkzaamheden zoals: agendabeheer, notuleren en het uitwerken van verslagen. Je draait je hand niet om voor het opstellen van brieven en nieuwsbrieven en je weet daarbij de juiste toon te vinden. Je kennis van de Nederlandse taal is dan ook uitstekend en je bent punctueel en secuur in je werk. Samen met je collega zorg je ervoor dat niet alleen medewerkers, maar ook bewoners en contactpersonen zich welkom voelen om de vragen te stellen die voor hen van belang zijn. Geen vraag is te gek en weet je het antwoord niet direct, dan kijk je bij wie de vraag wel thuis hoort. Jij bent een toegevoegde waarde voor de locatie. Kortom, krijg jij energie van het geven van maximale administratieve ondersteuning? Dan zien we jou graag!

Wat moet je weten over deze locatie?

Verpleeghuis Stefanna is gelegen in een prettige wijk in Delft. De locatie is sfeervol ingericht en beschikt onder andere over een mooie tuin, een kapsalon, een kapel en een restaurant waar verschillende activiteiten plaatsvinden. Stefanna biedt zorg aan 92 bewoners met een psychogeriatrische achtergrond.

Wat krijg je?

  • Salaris (FWG 35), vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering (CAO VVT);
  • Jaarcontract voor 24 uur per week, onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 4x6 uur en werkdagen in overleg;
  • Aansluitend een vast dienstverband als de samenwerking wederzijds goed bevalt;
  • Fijne en professionele werkomgeving met collega’s die voor elkaar klaar staan;
  • Fietsregeling voor onder andere een e-bike en korting op je zorgverzekering;
  • Bekijk onze aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden via deze link

Bovenop deze al mooie arbeidsvoorwaarden bieden wij je ook een zeer aantrekkelijk Meerkeuze Systeem Arbeidsvoorwaarden. In ons Meerkeuze Systeem Arbeidsvoorwaarden vind jij vast een mooi voordeel waar wij jou blij mee kunnen maken.

title: Senior Research Scientist | Multimodal Systems
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey: Language AI

Our Language AI teams form the foundation of DeepL's success. We are a dedicated group of researchers who collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers. Our mission is to build the world's leading language AI system to deliver perfect translations for the most demanding use cases. To that end, we take responsibility for the entire life cycle of the machine learning models that power our language AI products. This includes data, training, quality assurance, and operational aspects. In our highly collaborative teams, each person has the scope to drive impact across the company.

Your responsibilities

We are looking for a Senior Research Scientist to lead fine-tuning, post-training, and reinforcement learning for the next generation of DeepL's document translation multimodal and vision models. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for a researcher who can own a major research direction, prototype rapidly, run large-scale experiments, and drive breakthroughs all the way into production.

You will develop models that reason about document layout by fusing expert, real world and synthetic data, while leading efforts to make our translation highly steerable and adaptable.

You will:

  • Drive the development of vision and multimodal models for document, image and media translation, ranging from media ingestion and generation to end-to-end models.

  • Drive hands-on research and development on post-training for our vision and/or multimodal models: supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning tuned to translation quality.

  • Build evaluator models for document and design quality, including rubric- and reference-based grading, and investigate and mitigate reward hacking and quality-estimation failure modes.

  • Own the full lifecycle of model delivery: prototyping, ablations, training, evaluation, optimization, and production deployment, working closely with engineering to ship into real-time systems at scale.

  • Establish strong practices for evaluation, reproducibility, monitoring, and continuous model improvement in production.

Qualities we look for

  • Proven experience with developing multimodal models, VLM, and/or vision models.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in model post-training, knowledge distillation (teacher-student training), and/or reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLAIF, PPO/GSPO, and reward modeling).

  • Strong data-centric instincts for building synthetic-data and preference-data pipelines, Model-as-judge generation, data curation and filtering, data augmentations, and/or reasoning about data mixtures and ablations.

  • A hands-on builder who enjoys training models, running experiments, debugging pipelines, and integrating ML systems into production while staying grounded in product impact and real-world quality.

  • Strong coding and experimentation skills (Python, PyTorch/JAX/Tensorflow), and the ability to communicate clearly and align research with product and engineering priorities.

  • Ability to lead complex research efforts, to communicate clearly and collaborate across teams, while staying grounded in product impact, user experience, and real-world performance.

Nice to have

  • Experience with machine translation, multilingual NLP, efficient long-context modeling, language quality estimation, or multimodal machine translation.

  • Experience designing evaluation and reward signals using automatic metrics, Model-as-judge evaluation, non-verifiable rewards, and human-in-the-loop evaluation.

  • Experience with multi-objective optimization, consistency models, unified multimodal generation.

  • Experience with diffusion models.

  • Publications at top-tier venues.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
description:
Pitkäaikaisen työntekijämme siirtyessä eläkkeelle haemme Turun tehtaallemme uutta

KUNNOSSAPITOASENTAJAA

Valmistamme Turussa pesu- ja puhdistusaineita teollisuuteen, ammattikäyttöön ja kuluttajille. Oma 11 hengen kunnossapitotiimimme työskentelee tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotannon kanssa ja omalta osaltaan varmistaa tuotannon laadukkaan ja tehokkaan toiminnan. Työtä tehdään arkisin kahdessa vuorossa ja työaika on 40 tuntia viikossa.

Mitä kunnossapitoasentajan tehtäviin tuotannossa kuuluu?

Tehtävässä vastaat pakkauslinjojen tuotantolaitteiden ylläpidosta ja huollosta edistäen joustavaa ja mahdollisimman tehokasta ja häiriötöntä tuotantoa. Tehtävänäsi on huolehtia itsenäisesti tuotanto-ohjelman mukaisista tuotevaihdoista. Huolehdit aktiivisella otteella myös ajon aikaisista linjojen ja koneiden asennuksista sekä hienosäädöistä. Lisäksi työtehtäviisi kuuluu tuotantolaitteiden tuotannonaikaisten häiriöiden selvitys ja korjaukset sekä koneiden ja laitteiden ennakkohuoltotyöt kunnossapitosuunnitelman mukaisesti. Toivomme, että tuot myös esille kehitysehdotuksia tuotantolaitteiden ja menetelmien sekä toiminnan ja laiteturvallisuuden parantamiseksi.

Jos tunnistat itsesi seuraavasta, voisit viihtyä meillä kunnossapitoasentajana:

  • Tehtävään sopiva koulutus tai alalta hankittu kokemus – Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta valmistavasta teollisuudesta ja automaattisten pakkauskoneiden kanssa työskentelystä. Tehtävässä menestymistä edesauttaa alalle soveltuva tekninen koulutus tai työssä hankittu osaaminen. Voit olla myös sähkö- tai automaatioasentaja, jos sinulla on kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta. Käyttökokemus kunnossapitojärjestelmistä katsotaan eduksi.
  • Oma-aloitteinen työote ja ryhmätyöskentelytaidot – Työtä tehdään sekä itsenäisesti että ryhmässä. Olet päivittäin tekemisissä sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa.
  • Into oppia uutta – Kannustamme uuden oppimiseen ja pääsetkin oman kiinnostuksesi sekä aiemman kokemuksesi mukaan kehittymään kunnossapidon moniosaajaksi.
  • Kielitaito – Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Lisäksi englannin kielen taidosta on hyötyä.

Me otamme työhyvinvoinnin tosissamme

Kiillossa pääset työskentelemään ympäristössä, joka on kiehtova yhdistelmä kasvavaa kansainvälistä ja maanläheistä perheyritystä. Työntekijämme arvostavat pitkän tähtäimen toimintatapaamme, avointa ja läpinäkyvää yrityskulttuuria, kiiltolaista yhteishenkeä sekä monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia oppia uutta ja kasvaa yhdessä yrityksen kanssa. Me rohkaisemme työntekijöitämme tuomaan ideoitaan esille ja kehittymään omissa innovaatio- ja koulutusohjelmissamme. Olemme erityisen ylpeitä tunnustuksista, joita olemme saaneet panostuksistamme työhyvinvointiin: meidät on valittu kahdesti Suomen aktiivisimmaksi työpaikaksi. Olemme savuton työpaikka.

Muutama sana hakuprosessiin liittyen

Odotamme hakemustasi 23.8.2026 mennessä. Kerro viestikentässä tarkemmin, miksi haet ja mikä tehtävässä erityisesti kiinnostaa. Liitäthän mukaan myös CV:si ja palkkatoiveesi sekä vastaat lyhyesti hakulomakkeen lopussa olevaan videokysymykseen.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa 19.8.2026 klo 13-13.30 kunnossapitoinsinööri Antero Kotiranta, +358 40 358 3073.

Toimimme Kiillon rekrytointiprosessin mukaisesti ja käsittelemme kaikki tehtävää koskevat yhteydenotot ehdottoman luottamuksellisesti. Pyydämme hakijoita varaamaan 28.8.2026 mahdollista Turun tehtaalla pidettävää työhaastattelua varten. Tehtävään valitulta edellytetään hyväksyttyä terveystarkastusta, joka sisältää huumausainetestauksen.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How.

As a Software Engineer at DeepL, you will join a high-performance culture where "good enough" isn't enough. You won't be treated as a "junior" who only fixes bugs; you will be a core contributor shipping user-facing features, collaborating with Senior Engineers, and growing your skills at the speed of our scale. We are looking for engineers with a "high slope"—builders who learn fast, ship often, and care deeply about the product they build.

Your responsibilities

  • Ship Features, Not Just Code: You will own the implementation of end-to-end features. You won't just write functions in isolation; you will ensure your code solves the actual user problem, works in production, and is covered by robust tests.

  • Collaborate to Raise the Bar: You will actively participate in pair programming, code reviews, and technical discussions. You aren't afraid to ask for help, but you also aren't afraid to challenge a design if you think there is a better way.

  • Leverage Modern Tooling: You will use AI-assisted tools (like Copilot and Claude) to handle boilerplate and refactoring, allowing you to focus on logic and product value. We value engineers who use the best tools to ship faster.

  • Build for Quality: You will write clean, maintainable code that your future self (and your team) will thank you for. You understand that "speed" doesn't mean "sloppy"—it means building reliable software that doesn't break at 2am.

Qualities we look for

  • A "Product-First" Mindset: You care about who uses your software. You ask questions about the feature requirements and suggest improvements, rather than blindly following a spec.

  • High Learning Trajectory (High Slope): You might not know everything yet, but you learn incredibly fast. You are curious about the full stack—from the database query to the React component—and you actively seek out hard problems to grow.

  • Strong Engineering Fundamentals: You have a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and clean coding principles. You can take a complex logic problem and break it down into small, solvable pieces.

  • Adaptability: We use C#/.NET Core, Python, React, and Kubernetes. We don't expect you to be an expert in all of them today, but we expect you to be willing to jump in and learn whatever tool gets the job done.

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.

A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

title: Key Account Director
description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

Key Account Director

We're seeking a driven, dynamic, and strategic commercial leader to drive growth across our key accounts in Europe. This is a hands-on, high-impact player-coach role focused predominantly on personal account execution paired with informal team leadership and commercial mentoring.

To succeed in this role, you will need a consultative mindset, excellent communication skills, and knowledge of the utilities industry. You will also need a proven track record of commercial execution across large, multi-year, multi-faceted contracts, and experience leading or mentoring a customer-facing team.

What You'll Do

  • Personally own and grow relationships with a portfolio of our most strategic accounts, serving as the senior commercial relationship owner and executive point of contact.

  • Develop and deliver expansion plans across assigned key accounts to execute against business metrics and revenue goals.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success Operations, Customer Value Architects, and Product on overall account strategy and execution.

  • Co-present with utilities at key conferences and events across Europe, helping elevate Neara’s market presence.

  • Report on account performance, pipeline, and expansion opportunities to senior leadership.

Who You Are

  • Demonstrated history of personally managing and expanding enterprise-level accounts within complex technical or SaaS environments, ideally operating as a Key Account Director, Key Account Manager, Client Partner, or in a similar enterprise role.

  • Experience leading, managing, or mentoring Account Managers or Customer Success Managers, ideally in a player-coach capacity.

  • Experience in strategic sales, management consulting, or tech-enabled enterprise environments.

  • Domain exposure to the utilities sector or a similarly complex, technical, infrastructure-heavy industry is highly desirable.

  • Based in or willing to work from London, with the ability to travel across Europe as needed.

What We Are Offering You

  • Significant development opportunities with scope for lateral and upward movement in a high-growth company.

title: Building Engineer
description:
Transwestern is a vertically integrated commercial real estate firm dedicated to serving investors, partners and clients through expertise in investment, development, brokerage and property management. Our experience spans diverse property types, including logistics, multifamily, retail, mixed-use, healthcare, office, data centers, hotel, and life sciences. Across 35 offices nationwide, our team is united by a culture that cultivates agility, mutual trust and high performance.

Transwestern Services turns strategy into reality with consistency and accountability, collaborating to provide dynamic, tailored solutions. Whether representing a tenant, advising an investor or repositioning an asset, we operate with tenacity and own the outcome every time. Our 2,200-strong team works across service lines, ready to activate our full platform to deliver a customized, cohesive experience for clients.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Building Engineer is responsible for completing work orders, grounds maintenance, painting, caulking, HVAC, plumbing, drywall, electrical and completing maintenance on buildings as needed. The Building Engineer will perform general preventive maintenance and corrective repair of buildings, industrial systems, equipment and grounds. The Building Engineer will also monitor the building operations and performance.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Perform preventive maintenance and corrective repair of buildings, industrial systems, equipment, and grounds.

  • Inspect building systems including fire alarms, HVAC, and plumbing to ensure operation of equipment is within design capabilities and achieves environmental conditions prescribed by client.

  • Perform assigned repairs, emergency, and preventive maintenance. Complete maintenance and repair records as required.

  • Take the lead to troubleshoot and repair of buildings and installed systems to include, but not limited to: plumbing systems, kitchen equipment, roofs, drains, and HVAC.

  • May be required to direct mechanics, technicians, and outside contractors on assigned projects.

  • Respond quickly to emergency situations, summoning additional assistance as needed.

  • Maintain an energy management program to ensure measures are taken to operate all systems in the most efficient manner to keep operating costs at a minimum.

  • Maintain the building lighting system, including element and ballast repairs or replacements.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED) and a minimum of two years of related experience and/or trade school training or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • A minimum of 5 years building maintenance experience.

  • Thorough knowledge in all building systems operations, maintenance and repair.

  • Appropriate license/permit for trade as may be required, i.e. Journeyman or Master Electrician License or City Licenses, such as Refrigeration Certificate of Fitness, High Pressure Boiler License, High Pressure Steam Operator, etc.)

  • Knowledgeable in energy management systems, techniques, and operations.

  • Basic skills with Microsoft Office Outlook, Word, and Excel.

  • Must have a thorough understanding of HVAC, electrical and building automation systems.

  • Ability to understand and give general instructions in standard situations.

  • Operate and use necessary manual and power-driven tools.

  • Strong organizational and analytical skills.

  • Strong customer service orientation.

  • May require shift work, overtime and/or on call duties.

  • Stooping, standing, climbing and frequent lifting of a minimum of 50 lbs. of equipment (pump, tools, ladders) and ability to safely install rigging/lifting device.

  • May be required to work extended periods of time without relief when responding to priority/emergency situations (including overtime type assignments).

  • Climb ladders and stairs.

  • Strong Commercial Electrician / Maintenance Electrician

WORK SHIFT:

First Shift (United States of America)

LOCATION:

Tempe, AZ

This is a dynamic, on-site role that places you at the heart of the action. As a result, an essential function of this position is working on-site. Remote or hybrid options are not available. Being on property allows you to build strong relationships with clients and tenants, respond in real time, and make a visible impact every day.



ABOUT US

Our firm is built on a shared purpose: Empowering good people to do extraordinary things together. We hire smart, passionate, hard-working people who value both collaboration and independence. United by our brand promise, we own the outcome for clients, investors and partners. Learn more at transwestern.com.

All candidates selected for an offer of employment are subject to pre-employment background checks, which may include criminal history, education verification, motor vehicle records, credit history, and professional license verification. In addition, your employment with Transwestern is subject to successfully passing a drug screen check prior to you starting with the firm.

title: Market Development Representative
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



The Market Development Representative (MDR) will generate new business through outbound calls and targeted emails to potential clients. The MDR qualifies prospective customers through targeted questions about their business strategy and then leverages this information to align and sell Docusign’s product offerings.

This position spends roughly 80% of the time on the phone prospecting new clients. Market Development Reps will receive hands-on training with an emphasis on strategic selling and a focus on researching targeted accounts. This position is a great way for individuals to gain in-depth experience in a rapidly growing SaaS company.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, MDR.

Responsibility

  • Make outbound calls to prospects who reside in one of Docusign’s core vertical markets, offering tailored solutions to solve and improve business process problems
  • Schedule appointments between prospects and our Account Executives across SMB, Mid-Market or Enterprise verticals
  • Use CRM strategically to record information and identify further opportunities in your assigned territory
  • Work closely with marketing to create email and LinkedIn campaigns to increase company and personal brand awareness

Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring

Preferred

  • Prior experience in the SaaS industry
  • Driven, enthusiastic and hard-working nature
  • Ability to form strong business relationships
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:

Illinois: $24.00/hour - $31.28/hour

This role is also eligible for the following:

Global benefits provide options for the following:

  • Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region
  • Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement
  • Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment
  • Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions
  • Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements

Work Authorization Notice: Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. title: Harjoittelija strategiaosastolle
description:
Strategiaosaston tehtävänä on pitkän aikavälin yhteiskuntapolitiikan suunnittelu, kestävän kehityksen kansallisen toimeenpanon ja kansallisen tutkimus-, kehittämis- ja innovaatiotoiminnan (TKI) politiikan yhteensovittaminen, hallituksen strategiatyö ja toimintasuunnitelman valmistelu sekä toimiminen hallituksen tukena poikkihallinnollisissa ja kokonaiskuvaa vaativissa tehtävissä. Strategiaosastolla toimivat mm. tutkimus- ja innovaationeuvoston ja kestävän kehityksen toimikunnan sihteeristöt, joille haetaan nyt yhteistä harjoittelijaa.

Tutkimus- ja innovaationeuvoston tehtävänä on tukea valtioneuvostoa tutkimus- ja innovaatiopolitiikan kehittämisessä, tehdä TKI-politiikkaa koskevia aloitteita, seurata toimintaympäristön muutoksia sekä edistää tutkimus- ja innovaatiopolitiikan maakuvaa. Pääministeri Orpon hallitus on tehnyt merkittävät lisäinvestoinnit tutkimus- ja kehittämistoiminnan rahoitukseen hallituskauden aikana. Neuvoston tehtäviin kuuluu tämän rahoituksen seuranta ja vaikutusten arviointi. Neuvoston sihteeristö toimii myös parlamentaarisen TKI-seurantaryhmän sihteeristönä ja vetää useita poikkihallinnollisia työryhmiä.

Kestävän kehityksen toimikunta on pääministerin johtama, osallistava foorumi kestävän kehityksen toimeenpanolle. Toimikunnan sihteeristö vastaa toimikunnan työn tuen lisäksi Agenda2030:n ja kestävän kehityksen tavoitteiden kansallisen toimeenpanon koordinaatiosta valtioneuvostossa.

Tutkimus- ja innovaationeuvoston sihteeristössä harjoittelija osallistuu neuvoston työn edistämiseen ja järjestyksessä toisen valtion tutkimus- ja kehittämistoiminnan rahoituksen seurantaraportin valmisteluun. Ensimmäinen raportti on julkaistu neuvoston sivuilla keväällä 2026: https://valtioneuvosto.fi/tutkimus-ja-innovaationeuvosto.

Kestävän kehityksen toimikunnan sihteeristössä harjoittelija osallistuu muun muassa toimikunnan ja valtionhallinnon kestävän kehityksen koordinaatioverkoston kokousten ja muiden tilaisuuksien suunnitteluun, toteutukseen ja raportointiin. Harjoittelija tukee toimikunnan 2025-2027 toimenpidesuunnitelman toteutusta sekä osallistuu aktiivisesti toimikunnan viestinnän suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
