title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in United Arab Emirates.

This role offers the opportunity to design and build the foundation of an AI-native operating environment used across a global organization.
You will create scalable infrastructure that enables intelligent agents to operate reliably, securely, and transparently.
The position combines advanced AI engineering, platform development, governance, and automation to solve complex operational challenges.
You will own the architecture, execution layer, evaluation systems, and tooling required to make AI workflows trustworthy.
Working in a fully remote and highly autonomous environment, you will influence how teams adopt and benefit from AI at scale.
This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building foundational systems, solving open-ended problems, and shaping the future of AI-powered work.

Accountabilities

The AI Platform Engineer will be responsible for building and operating the infrastructure that enables reliable, measurable, and governed AI systems across the organization.

  • Design, build, and maintain the AI execution platform, including event-triggered workflows, model-agnostic runtimes, durable state management, human review processes, rollback mechanisms, and comprehensive run logging.
  • Own the architecture decisions required to bring AI agent systems into production and ensure the platform operates reliably at scale.
  • Develop the evaluation layer that determines whether AI systems are safe, accurate, and ready for production use.
  • Create golden test suites, behavioral evaluations, safety checks, and CI gates that prevent unreliable AI capabilities from being deployed.
  • Build and manage a portfolio of AI agents supporting business workflows such as reporting, drafting, analysis, triage, and knowledge management.
  • Develop meta-level systems that monitor agent performance, identify improvements, and continuously enhance the platform.
  • Implement governance mechanisms directly into the platform, including risk tiers, least-privilege permissions, tool access controls, audit logging, and human approval workflows.
  • Ensure high-risk AI actions are technically restricted through system design rather than relying only on policies or prompts.
  • Design responsible communication systems that optimize notifications, minimize interruptions, and increase user trust and adoption.
  • Build platform tooling, including validators, compilers, context distribution systems, and integrations across repositories and collaboration environments.
  • Create data pipelines and reporting systems that measure AI adoption, operational impact, maturity levels, and return on investment.
  • Instrument AI workflows to track usage, efficiency gains, costs, and measurable business value.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an experienced AI platform engineer with a strong background in production-grade AI systems, infrastructure ownership, and reliable software engineering practices.

    • Proven experience building and deploying production LLM agent systems used by real users, beyond prototypes or demonstrations.
    • Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including golden datasets, behavioral assertions, judge criteria, safety testing, and automated quality gates.
    • Experience designing and implementing reliable AI workflows where correctness, traceability, and governance are critical.
    • Deep API integration experience with business systems and experience creating MCP servers.

description:

Empower global teachers. Inspire global learners.

The Instructional Designer drives the creation of high-volume content for goFLUENT’s middle and high school language teaching solutions. This role combines instructional design, digital pedagogy, AI-assisted production, and project management for the development of effective, engaging, and practical teaching content

In this role, you will:

  • design and develop activities that build language, critical thinking, and real-world communication skills while ensuring measurable proficiency (level progression);

  • curate and organize courses that meet curriculum goals and business requirements;

  • conduct research on curriculum standards and edtech trends to identify market opportunities, integrate best practices, and shape impactful content strategies;

  • lead discussions with stakeholders to establish project scopes and objectives, assess project viability, and ensure effective deployment;

  • schedule, monitor, and adjust project timelines, resources, and deliverables to achieve strategic business goals;

  • brainstorm and collaborate closely with stakeholders to continually update and optimize content on goFLUENT’s platform;

  • perform other duties aligned with the team's evolving needs and priorities.


What You’ll Need

To thrive in this role, you must have:

  • native-level, expert, or bilingual English proficiency;

  • a college degree (those with a degree in education, English, linguistics, or a related field will be prioritized);

  • instructional design expertise and the ability to develop innovative content strategies for digital and blended/hybrid contexts;

  • experience in at least one of the following:

    • teaching young learners (any subject);

    • teaching English or other languages (any age group);

    • working in middle or high school educational settings; or

    • writing or editing for young readers (fiction or nonfiction);

  • excellent problem-solving, research, and critical-thinking skills to evaluate curriculum standards, track edtech trends, and quickly learn language acquisition principles and proficiency frameworks like the CEFR;

  • keen attention to detail, with the ability to follow complex instructions and apply feedback effectively;

  • strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to work independently and collaboratively to drive projects to completion;

  • engaging presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences;

  • a positive, can-do attitude to tackle routine tasks, adapt when priorities shift, and remain composed and efficient in a fast-paced environment;

  • a growth mindset and a commitment to continuous professional improvement;

  • proficiency in office software suites and a willingness to learn new instructional technologies and project management tools.

Experience with the following is not required but is a PLUS:

  • generative AI;

  • project management;

  • workflow automation tools.

Other Requirements

Willing to work in Eastwood, Quezon City.

What we offer:

  • HMO and Benefits from Day One: Your health and well-being are a priority. Comprehensive medical coverage and benefits start as soon as you do.

  • Hybrid Work Setup: Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and onsite, designed to support work-life balance and productivity.

title: Senior/Strategic Digital Analytics Consultant - Spain
description:
😎 Our Culture
Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

🚀 About the Role
As a Strategic Customer Success Business Consultant, you will serve as a premier strategic advisor and domain leader for Quantum Metric’s most complex, high-impact enterprise accounts. Beyond driving customer activation and operationalization, you will shape how our largest clients leverage technology by developing productized service offerings, pioneering domain-specific AI automations, and serving as a subject matter expert both for clients and internally across our entire consulting organization.

In this role, you will advise and align with senior stakeholders, navigating complex organizational landscapes from day-to-day power users to executive sponsors. You will act as the go-to subject matter expert in your specialized domain, stepping in ad hoc to advise on high-stakes client engagements, while also serving as the primary point of contact for leveraging AI to automate analytical workflows tailored to key use cases. You won't just deliver value; you will define, scale, and automate it—translating deep quantitative insights into strategic business outcomes that directly influence account retention, executive alignment, and long-term partnership growth.

🔧 Responsibilities

  • Drive Strategic Customer Outcomes: Serve as the premier strategic advisor for Quantum Metric’s most complex, high-impact enterprise accounts, aligning macro digital strategies with customer business outcomes. Navigate complex organizational landscapes to build executive alignment, establishing mission-critical status that directly drives account retention, renewal, and long-term partnership growth.
  • Pioneer AI & Scalable Value: Serve as the primary subject matter expert for leveraging AI to automate analytical workflows tailored to key enterprise use cases. Define, scale, and automate value delivery by translating deep quantitative insights into productized service offerings and repeatable frameworks that benefit the broader consulting organization.
  • Orchestrate Enterprise Domain Activation: Deploy as a targeted domain leader into strategic accounts—such as aligning with IT and Engineering teams on Site Observability—to design engagements, align senior stakeholders, and drive domain-specific activation. Embed Quantum Metric into critical operational workflows and digital decision-making processes.
  • Surface Transformational Insights: Synthesize deep quantitative data into macro-level digital and omnichannel optimization strategies, moving beyond defect detection to actively shape customer strategic roadmaps. Establish clear benchmarks for value realization and scale successful consulting methodologies across the entire practice.
  • Serve as Enterprise Subject Matter Expert: Act as a premier domain leader within assigned verticals or specialized use cases, stepping in ad hoc to advise on high-stakes, complex client engagements across the global organization. Drive the evolution of Quantum Metric’s consulting methodology by translating deep vertical or use-case expertise into reusable applications, pioneering AI-driven workflows, and establishing best practices that elevate the entire team's consulting rigor.
  • Mentor and Elevate the Practice: Act as a force multiplier across the organization by mentoring Consultants, modeling best-in-class advisory practices, and leading team enablement. Drive vertical playbooks and share specialized domain expertise in global forums to continuously upskill the broader business consulting practice.
  • Proactively Safeguard Strategic Engagements: Partner closely with primary Business Consultant to systematically identify, diagnose, and remediate high-stakes account risks across key functional domains. Step in globally on targeted engagements to design high-level recovery strategies, re-establish executive alignment, and reposition value to secure renewals and protect long-term account health.

    • 💡 Requirements

  • Domain Expertise: Deep specialized domain expertise in at least one key enterprise area:
  • Site Observability & Technical Performance: Experience partnering with SRE, IT, and Engineering teams to monitor digital experience performance, client-side/API errors, and application stability.
  • Contact & Call Center Optimization: Experience leveraging experience data to drive call deflection, reduce Average Handle Time (AHT), and optimize omnichannel agent workflows (e.g., Salesforce integrations).
  • Internal Applications & Employee Experience: Proven ability to apply digital analytics to internal enterprise tools to streamline operational workflows and boost employee productivity.
  • AI Proficiency & Autonomous Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to leverage AI technologies (e.g., Claude Code, AI CLI tools, LLM prompts) to streamline processes and automate analytical workflows. Strong natural resourcefulness with a track record of navigating technical ambiguity, troubleshooting complex challenges, and figuring things out independently without rigid guidance.
  • SQL & Data Engineering Proficiency: Proficient in reading, writing, interpreting, and auditing complex SQL queries and data engineering pipelines to validate backend system logic, ensure data integrity, and support deep-dive quantitative analyses.
  • Experience & Background: 8+ years of professional experience in digital analytics, digital product management, management/technology consulting, or a related field, with a proven track record of transforming complex data into executive-level business outcomes.
  • Analytical Expertise: Advanced ability to work with large, un-aggregated quantitative datasets to uncover macro-level trends, quantify business impact, and solve ambiguous, high-stakes business challenges.
  • Client-Facing Leadership & Executive Advisory: Proven experience acting as a trusted domain advisor, comfortable navigating enterprise client matrixes, interfacing with C-suite stakeholders, and deploying ad-hoc to high-stakes strategic engagements.
  • Communication Excellence: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with polished executive presentation abilities and the confidence to facilitate strategic workshops, executive briefings, and large-group enablement sessions (50+ participants).
  • Self-Starter & Collaborative Mindset: Highly proactive with a track record of driving impact independently across global accounts while seamlessly collaborating with primary Account Owners and internal practice leaders.
  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 10% to visit enterprise customers for high-impact, onsite enablement, executive sessions, and strategic workshops.
    • 💻 Recruitment Process
    Note: This interview process is subject to change. End stage candidates are also given the optional opportunity to meet with an Employee Resource Group Member if that is of interest.
    - Recruiter Screen (30 minutes)
    - Independent Assessment (1 hour)
    - Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes)
    - Director Interview (30 minutes)
    - VP, Consulting Services Interview (45 minutes)
    - Chief Customer Officer Interview (30 minutes)
    - CEO Interview (30 minutes)

    🏆 Perks & Benefits
    One time Home-Office Stipend - upon hire
    Monthly Business Expense Stipend
    Stock Options
    Employee Lead Referral Program
    Internal Lead Referral Program
    Company-Wide Unlimited Paid Time Off policy (In addition to company vacation entitlement)
    Flexible Schedules
    Work From Home
    MacBook and awesome swag delivered to your door
    RECHARGE PROGRAM (after 3 years, disconnect for 3 weeks, no email/slack)
    QM-funded Restaurant Vouchers
    Private Medical Insurance - 100% Employer Paid, Cover for employees and family, Includes routine dental care
    Encouraging and collaborative culture
    🐉 About Quantum Metric
    As a leader in digital analytics, Quantum Metric helps organizations put customers at the heart of everything they do. Providing a simplified approach to monitor, diagnose and optimize the digital journeys that matter most, the Quantum Metric platform offers in-depth customer understanding, quantified and tied to core business objectives.

    Today, Quantum Metric captures insights from 50 percent of the world’s internet users, supporting nationally recognized brands in ecommerce and retail, travel, financial services and telecommunications.

    Quantum Metric has been named to the Inc 5000 and the Deloitte 500 for the last six-consecutive years, and has made the Best Places to Work lists by Glassdoor, BuiltIn, Fast Company and Forbes.

    If the above role seems like a match and you’re interested in joining a team of people with exceptional potential from diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences, we want to hear from you!

Quantum Metric reserves the right to change, edit, and add duties and responsibilities of all job descriptions at any time, at its sole discretion, and to notify the respective employee accordingly.

title: Senior Research Scientist | Model Steering
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

Our Language AI teams form the foundation of DeepL's success. We are a dedicated group of researchers who collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers. Our mission is to build the world's leading language AI system to deliver perfect translations for the most demanding use cases. To that end, we take responsibility for the entire life cycle of the machine learning models that power our language AI products. This includes data, training, quality assurance, and operational aspects. In our highly collaborative teams, each person has the scope to drive impact across the company.

Your responsibilities

We are looking for a Senior Research Scientist to lead fine-tuning, post-training, model-steerability, and reinforcement learning for the next generation of DeepL's LLM-based translation models. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for a researcher who can own a major research direction, prototype rapidly, run large-scale experiments, and drive breakthroughs all the way into production.

Your central focus is how we blend data and shape model behaviour after pre-training. You will fuse high-value human expert data with synthetic data, and you will lead the effort to make our translation models steerable, following custom user instructions, rules, and context. You will work with model architectures at the scale of hundreds of billions of parameters.

You will:

  • Drive the development of translation models that are steerable conditioned on user preferences, rules and context.

  • Drive hands-on research and development on post-training for our core translation models: supervised fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning tuned to translation quality.

  • Build reward models and evaluator models for translation, including rubric- and reference-based grading, and investigate and mitigate reward hacking and quality-estimation failure modes.

  • Drive an agenda toward models that ingest multimodal content and context to increase translation quality.

  • Own the full lifecycle of model delivery: prototyping, ablations, training, evaluation, optimization, and production deployment, working closely with engineering to ship into real-time systems at scale.

  • Establish strong practices for evaluation, reproducibility, monitoring, and continuous model improvement in production.

  • Mentor researchers and engineers, promote hands-on collaboration, and raise the bar for model quality.

Qualities we look for

  • Proven experience making large models steerable and instruction-following by identifying the most effective method to instill a given behavior, drawing from instruction tuning, latent space methods, steering vectors, and/or constrained encoding and decoding methods.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in LLM post-training (SFT, DPO), knowledge distillation (teacher-student training), and/or reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLAIF, PPO/GSPO, and reward modeling).

  • Strong data-centric instincts for building synthetic-data and preference-data pipelines, LLM-as-judge generation, data curation and filtering, and reasoning about data mixtures and ablations.

  • Experience designing evaluation and reward signals using automatic metrics, LLM-as-judge evaluation, non-verifiable rewards, and human-in-the-loop evaluation.

  • A hands-on builder who enjoys training models, running experiments, debugging pipelines, and integrating ML systems into production while staying grounded in product impact and real-world quality.

  • Ownership of a substantial research direction with strong execution, and experience mentoring others on a fast-moving, applied research team.

  • Strong coding and experimentation skills (Python, PyTorch/JAX/Tensorflow), and the ability to communicate clearly and align research with product and engineering priorities.

Nice to have

  • Demonstrated experience fine-tuning and training large models at scale, including distributed/multi-node training (e.g. FSDP, DeepSpeed, or Megatron-style frameworks) and efficient training techniques.

  • Experience fine-tuning existing reasoning models for specific tasks and behaviors without degrading their reasoning capabilities.

  • Experience with machine translation, multilingual NLP, or language quality estimation.

  • Familiarity with inference and serving at scale (e.g. via vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, etc) and long-context modelling.

  • Publications at top-tier venues.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

title: Head of asset risk
description:
At Ayvens, progress starts with you.

Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.

  • At Ayvens, we have an opening for an experienced Head of Asset Risk

    What are you going to do?

    As our new Head of Asset Risk, you will lead Ayvens' second line of defence (LOD2) for vehicle asset risks, ensuring robust oversight of residual value and repair, maintenance and tyres (RMT) risk management across the Group. Residual value risk represents Ayvens' largest risk exposure, making this position critical in maintaining a strong risk governance framework and ensuring risks remain within the Group's risk appetite.

    You will lead a team of 14 professionals and work closely with local and central stakeholders, senior management, Board committees, and regulators. In this highly visible role, you will shape asset risk policies and standards, challenge business assumptions, oversee key risk models and processes, and provide strategic guidance on evolving market trends affecting vehicle values and fleet performance.

    Your responsibilities will include:

    • Establishing and maintaining an appropriate governance, monitoring, and reporting framework to ensure effective oversight of asset risk across Ayvens.
    • Defining Group-wide policies, norms, and standards for asset risk management.
    • Ensuring local entities perform residual value and RMT setting in line with Group Regulations and established standards.
    • Reviewing, challenging, and validating residual value proposals submitted by local pricing committees before implementation.
    • Reviewing, challenging, and controlling RMT technical cost setting across the organization.
    • Leading and contributing to the fleet revaluation process, including ownership of the fleet revaluation model.
    • Analysing residual value trends and market developments to monitor risk and challenge central and local assumptions on new and used vehicle prices.
    • Acting as Vehicle Asset Risk model family owner and owner of the Ayvens central Asset Risk database.
    • Leading Asset Risk contributions to ICAAP and Risk Identification processes.
    • Collaborating closely with local and central first line of defence teams.
    • Contributing to the Risk Appetite Statement (RAS) process for both Ayvens and Société Générale.
    • Producing and presenting asset risk reporting and insights to Ayvens Executive Management, Société Générale CORISQ, the Ayvens Board Risk Committee, and regulatory authorities, including the European Central Bank.

    Who are we looking for?

    The ideal candidate is an experienced risk leader with deep expertise in asset risk management, residual value risk, and governance frameworks within the automotive leasing, financial services, or banking sectors. You possess strong analytical capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across an international environment.

    You will have relevant experience in a similar role and preferably hold a Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

    Additionally, you bring:

    • Extensive experience in asset risk, residual value risk, automotive finance, leasing, or financial services.
    • Proven people leadership experience, including managing and developing high-performing international teams.
    • Strong knowledge of risk governance frameworks, ICAAP processes, and regulatory expectations.
    • Excellent analytical and quantitative skills, with experience working with risk models and large datasets.
    • The ability to challenge business decisions constructively and provide independent risk oversight.
    • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience engaging senior executives, board-level committees, and regulators.
    • A solid understanding of automotive market dynamics, vehicle valuation methodologies, and residual value trends.
    • Fluent English is required.

    What do we offer?

    We're on this journey together. By investing in professional growth, rewards and incentives, plus plenty of training and experience on the job, we create an inspiring environment for our colleagues that fosters high performance with positive impact.

    Enjoy comprehensive rewards and recognition.

    We believe in rewarding you holistically, through compensation, competitive benefits and rich development opportunities.

    Discover your talent.

    We enable you to reach your full potential by offering you the opportunities and support to reach the next level in your career.

    Benefit from a healthy, positive work atmosphere.

    We offer a wide variety of benefits to help keep you mentally and physically strong and to find the perfect work–life balance.

    Find a shared sense of belonging.

    We create an engaging environment where you can be your authentic self and harness your commitment, curiosity and collaboration.

    Build a sustainable future.

    We’re conscious of our environment and the societies we’re part of and we work together to drive electrification and lead the way to decarbonisation.

    Make your Move at Ayvens

    Ayvens provides a unique opportunity: the chance to accelerate the transition to electric, lead the way to decarbonisation and shape the industry’s digital transformation. Behind the wheel, our people make the difference, driving us towards our ambitions. Ayvens is home to the best talent in the industry – so if you’re looking for a fulfilling career with positive impact, we’d love to discuss your opportunities with us!

    Ready to make your move at Ayvens? Join a global leader in sustainable mobility and follow @ayvens, @lifeatayvens, and Ayvens on LinkedIn to check out what’s happening at Ayvens!

    Our commitment

    We’re committed to building a culture where everyone can be themselves and where everyone gets an equal chance to make their journey count. If you’d like to learn more about our DE&I journey – and how you can contribute – please find out more on Career pages of our website.


Why Ayvens?


With over 3.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive.


At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are.


Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

title: Ulkoaluetyöntekijöitä | Helsinki
description:
Haemme Alltimelle osaavia ulkoaluetyöntekijöitä vakituisiin, kokoaikaisiin (37,5 h/viikko) työsuhteisiin Helsinkiin. Työsuhteiden suunniteltu aloituspäivä on 14.9.2026.

Alltimen ulkoaluetyöntekijänä päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluu vuodenkierron mukaista kiinteistöjen ulkoalueiden hoitoa ja huoltoa sekä tietysti alueen asiakkaiden sujuvaa palvelua. Kesäisin työpäivät koostuvat kiinteistöjen piha-alueiden kunnossapidosta ja hoidosta, kuten nurmikon leikkuusta, rikkakasvien torjunnasta, istutusalueiden, pensasaitojen ja kasvillisuuden hoidosta ja ylläpidosta sekä piha-alueiden yleisestä siisteydestä huolehtimisesta. Talvisin työpäivät täyttyvät käsilumitöistä ja liukkaudentorjunnasta sekä tarvittaessa myös koneellisista lumitöistä. Työkohteesi ovat Helsingin alueella sijaitsevia asuinkiinteistöjä, ja niiden välillä liikutaan Alltimen työautoilla. Tämän vuoksi B-ajokortti on työssä suoriutumisen kannalta välttämätön.

Palkkaus tehtävässä on Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukainen PR2 12,59 €/h, ja lisäksi maksetaan koulutuslisä mahdollisen koulutuksen mukaisesti.

Toivomme sinulta:

- aiempaa kokemusta ulkoaluetöistä ja työkoneiden käytöstä

- työtä ja säätä pelkäämätöntä ja rohkeaa asennetta, sekä kykyä hoitaa itsenäisesti ja vastuullisesti omia päivittäisiä työtehtäviä

- B-ajokorttia

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

- eduksi katsomme koneenajotaidot

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä mukavassa työyhteisössä itsenäisessä työnkuvassa. Saat käyttöösi laadukkaat ja ajantasaiset työvälineet ja varusteet. Lisäksi tarjoamme Pihlajalinnan työterveyspalvelut kaikissa Suomen toimipisteissä, ja koeajan jälkeen pääset hyödyntämään monipuolisia Edenredin työsuhde-etuja. Alltimella tuemme vahvasti osaamisen kehittämistä, ja voit opiskella työn ohessa oppisopimuksella tutkintoja, jotka tukevat ammattitaitoasi.

Odotamme innolla kuulevamme sinusta lisää! Haethan meille mahdollisimman pian, täytämme paikkoja heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja työtehtävästä antaa sähköpostitse työnjohtaja Jere Salo, jere.salo@alltime.fi


Alltime Suomi Oy

Alltimella meillä on noin 1000 työkaveria ympäri Suomea ja Ruotsia maanläheisessä, matalassa organisaatiossa, jossa ilmentyvät arvomme: ketteryys, luotettavuus, yhteistyö ja ammattitaito. Meillä on tekemisen meininki ja hyvä henki: esimerkiksi työtyytyväisyyskyselyssämme "työkaverit kohtelevat minua hyvin" ;kysymyksen keskiarvo oli 4.3/5. Alltimen visiona on kehittyä Pohjoismaiden johtavaksi rakennetun elinympäristön kunnossapitäjäksi. Me hoidamme ennakoivana ja välittävänä kumppanina kiinteistöpalvelut, puhtauspalvelut sekä infrastruktuurin kunnossapidon maalla ja vesillä. Työntekijämme Suomessa ja Ruotsissa helpottavat asiakkaidemme elämää ylläpitämällä sujuvia ja turvallisia elinympäristöjä. Alltime Groupin omistaa kotimainen pääomasijoitusyhtiö MB Rahastot yhdessä toimivan johdon kanssa.[www.alltime.fi](http://www.alltime.fi/)

Sähköposti: jere.salo@alltime.fi Sijainti: Espoo

title: UX Designer - Infrastructure
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX Designer - Infrastructure based in United Kingdom.

This role offers the opportunity to design intuitive experiences for complex open-source infrastructure products used by organizations worldwide.
You will work at the intersection of user experience, technology, and engineering to simplify advanced cloud and data center solutions.
The position combines UX strategy, research, design systems, and close collaboration with technical teams.
You will help shape tools that enable organizations to build, manage, and scale modern infrastructure environments.
Working in a globally distributed team, you will contribute to products that influence the future of enterprise technology and open-source innovation.
This opportunity is ideal for a technically curious designer who enjoys solving complex problems and creating impactful user experiences.

Accountabilities

The UX Designer will be responsible for creating user-centered experiences for infrastructure products while collaborating closely with engineering and product teams to improve usability, consistency, and overall product quality.

  • Design intuitive workflows and interfaces for complex infrastructure tools used to build and manage cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define product direction and improve user experiences.
  • Apply UX research methods, usability principles, and design heuristics to solve complex product challenges.
  • Translate technical complexity into clear, efficient, and accessible user experiences.
  • Contribute to the evolution and adoption of design systems that improve consistency across products.
  • Understand broader product ecosystems, technical constraints, and user needs to make informed design decisions.
  • Support cross-functional design initiatives and contribute to shared design practices across teams.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles and help improve design maturity throughout the organization.
  • Conduct user research, gather insights, and incorporate feedback into product improvements.
  • Communicate design concepts clearly to engineers, designers, executives, and other stakeholders.
  • Stay informed about emerging UX trends, research methods, and innovative design approaches.
  • Participate in international team gatherings and collaborative sessions to align on strategy and execution.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a technically minded UX professional with strong communication skills, a passion for technology, and experience designing solutions for complex products.

    • Strong knowledge and passion for user experience, product design, and technology.
    • Experience designing digital products, especially complex platforms, developer tools, enterprise applications, or technical products.
    • Ability to conduct user research and apply insights to improve product decisions.
    • Strong understanding of UX methodologies, design principles, and usability best practices.
    • Experience creating and maintaining design systems or reusable design patterns.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers, product managers, designers, and leadership teams.
    • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain and defend design decisions clearly.
    • Curiosity, adaptability, and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
    • Interest in working with real technology, infrastructure, and technically complex environments.
    • Ability to think strategically while maintaining attention to detail and execution quality.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in User Experience, Design, STEM, or a related field is preferred, though alternative career paths are considered.
    • Ability and willingness to travel internationally several times per year for company events.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote position with the flexibility to work from home.
      • Global and distributed work environment with regular in-person team gatherings.
      • Annual personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000.
      • Annual compensation reviews based on performance and market conditions.
      • Performance-based annual bonus opportunities.
      • Recognition and rewards programs.
      • Paid annual holiday leave.
      • Maternity and paternity leave support.
      • Employee assistance program and wellness platform.
      • Opportunity to travel internationally and collaborate with colleagues around the world.
      • Travel benefits and upgrades for long-distance company events.

title: Miljømedarbejder til Landbrugsområdet
description:
Vil du arbejde med miljøfaglige vurderinger, tilsyn og myndighedsopgaver – og samtidig bidrage til en åben og konstruktiv dialog med landbrugere og rådgivere?

Vi søger en miljømedarbejder til landbrugsområdet i Team Natur og Miljø. Du får en varieret stilling, hvor du kombinerer miljøfaglighed, lovgivning, tilsyn og dialog med virksomheder og rådgivere.

Vi lægger vægt på, at borgere og virksomheder oplever en tilgængelig, professionel og løsningsorienteret kommune. Derfor arbejder vi med tidlig dialog, tydelig vejledning og klare forventninger til sagsforløbet. Målet er, at landbrugeren ved, hvad der skal ske, hvilke oplysninger der er behov for, og hvad der er afgørende for kommunens vurdering.

Dine opgaver
Du kommer primært til at arbejde med myndighedsopgaver på landbrugsområdet. Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet miljøtilsyn på husdyrbrug, behandling af ansøgninger om miljøgodkendelser og tilladelser, revurderinger, anmeldelser, klagesager og opfølgning på tilsyn.

En vigtig del af arbejdet er dialogen med landbrugere og rådgivere. Du skal kunne vejlede om regler, processer og dokumentationskrav og tage initiativ til dialog, når det kan forebygge misforståelser eller skabe et bedre og mere effektivt sagsforløb.

Du skal samtidig kunne træffe fagligt og juridisk holdbare afgørelser og navigere i myndighedsrollen. For os betyder god service ikke, at lovgivning eller miljøhensyn er noget man skal se stort på. Det betyder i stedet, at vi gør os umage med at vurdere de reelle risici og konsekvenser for at forvalte kravene, sikre gode processer og hjælpe ansøgeren videre inden for de muligheder, som reglerne giver.

Du får ansvar for dine egne sager og skal kunne planlægge og prioritere dine opgaver. Samtidig vil du have adgang til faglig sparring med kollegerne og hjælp til prioritering, når opgavemængden kræver det.

Landbrugsområdet arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger på mange områder, så du får adgang til et bredt fagligt miljø og mulighed for samarbejde på tværs, hvor opgaverne kræver det.

Hvem er du?
Du har en relevant natur-, miljø- eller landbrugsfaglig uddannelse. Det kan f.eks. være som miljøingeniør, agronom, biolog, jordbrugsteknolog, miljøteknolog eller en anden relevant uddannelse.

Erfaring med kommunal myndighedsbehandling, miljøtilsyn eller husdyrbrugloven er en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har en solid faglig grundforståelse, interesse for området og evne til at sætte dig ind i relevant lovgivning.

Du arbejder systematisk og evner at have overblik over dine opgaver og prioritere din tid. Du kan foretage og formidle faglige og juridiske vurderinger og kommunikerer klart, respektfuldt og forståeligt.

Du er nysgerrig på landbrugernes og rådgivernes perspektiver og har blik for muligheder inden for lovgivningens rammer. Samtidig kan du fastholde den faglige retning og myndighedsrollen, også når kommunens vurdering ikke svarer til ansøgerens forventninger.

Vi lægger også vægt på, at du kan balancere kvalitet, fremdrift og effektivitet, og at du trives med både selvstændigt ansvar og tæt fagligt samarbejde. Du skal være fortrolig med digitale redskaber og have interesse for at udvikle mere effektive digitale arbejdsgange.

Det tilbyder vi
Du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor faglighed, dialog og service går hånd i hånd.

Vi arbejder med stor grad af ansvar og indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af opgaverne. Du får mulighed for at følge dine sager fra start til afslutning og for at bidrage til udviklingen af vores faglige og digitale arbejdsgange.

Du får kompetente og erfarne kolleger, løbende faglig sparring og tydelige rammer for opgaveløsningen. Vi lægger vægt på en ordentlig introduktion til arbejdsopgaverne og vores arbejdsgange og introduktionen tilpasses din erfaring og faglige baggrund.

Om Team Natur og Miljø
Team Natur og Miljø består af 17 medarbejdere inklusive teamlederen. Vi løser myndighedsopgaver og arbejder med naturforbedrende, klimarelaterede og formidlende opgaver inden for natur- og miljøområdet.

Vi prioriterer faglig sparring, tværfagligt samarbejde og en høj grad af uddelegering af ansvar. Medarbejdere og ledelse stiller viden og ressourcer til rådighed for den fælles opgaveløsning.

Teknik og Miljø har stor betydning for borgernes og virksomhedernes hverdag. Vores kerneopgave er i samspil med borgere og virksomheder at skabe rammer for velfungerende og bæredygtige bymiljøer og landskaber.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Vi tilbyder en fast stilling på 37 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Afhængigt af din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund sker ansættelsen efter Kommunernes Landsforenings overenskomst med den relevante faglige organisation.

Arbejdsstedet er Holstebro Rådhus, Kirkestræde 11, 7500 Holstebro.

Det er nødvendigt, at du har kørekort til almindelig bil, så du kan komme omkring på tilsyn.

Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:
Torben Mølgaard
Chef for Natur, Miljø og Byggesag

Ole Lousdal
Teamleder for Team Natur og Miljø

title: Senior Project Manager - PMO Lead
description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

Senior Project Manager - PMO Lead

As Neara scales globally, we are investing in the operational rigor required to maintain excellence across an increasingly complex portfolio of customer engagements. To that end, we are hiring a Senior Project Manager for our European business: a position dedicated to software delivery and project management excellence, internal and customer training, and maintaining the connective tissue between our customer value, solutions and engineering teams.

PMO is a new team that you will shape and operationalize, owning several critical functions which have to date, either operated in a more disaggregated manner or not existed at all. This is an exciting opportunity to build an important part of the Neara engine, with scope to influence global operations strategy as a senior member of the team in one of our fastest growing markets.

What You Will Do:

  • Own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of complex, high-value enterprise software implementations, from kickoff through go-live and handover.

  • Apply and reinforce project management best practices and standards across your projects, setting the bar for how implementations should run.

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date project tracking and reporting - status, risks, milestones, and value delivery - and roll it up into team-level rituals and leadership dashboards.

  • Identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution by coordinating across Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with the VP of CS and the wider CS team to refine PMO tooling, templates, and reporting infrastructure as the function matures.

  • Support contract and scope reviews with Product and Engineering to ensure projects are resourced and configured for success from the start.

  • Design and maintain Customer Success team onboarding and continuous learning systems.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of project management experience, ideally as a Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Implementation Manager, or Professional Services Manager, within a formal PMO, high-growth software, consulting, or enterprise technology environment.

  • Direct experience running enterprise software deployments or large-scale transformation programs, with a clear understanding of what makes complex implementations succeed or fail.

  • Track record of applying, and improving, project management standards and processes rather than just operating within an existing framework.

  • Comfortable working at multiple altitudes: following a defined methodology one day, unblocking execution on the ground the next.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex project status, risks, and trade-offs into clear narratives for senior leadership and customers.

  • Comfortable with data and tooling - able to build and maintain (automated) reporting, dashboards, and tracking systems, and confident working with project management tools (e.g., Fibery, Jira, Asana, or similar).

  • Experience within infrastructure, and specifically the energy sector, is a plus but not essential.

  • Fluent in English (must) and other European languages (preferred).

What We Offer:

  • This is a rare opportunity to help stand up a brand-new PMO function for Neara. You will run some of our most important customer implementations while directly shaping the standards and tooling that scale our customer success operations in our largest market.

  • Based in Europe, you will be a key part of our strategic growth in this market and drive the development of a self sustained business.

  • Work on technology that matters. Our physics-enabled digital twins are actively protecting global energy grids from increasingly common weather events and structural failure, meaning your operational excellence directly translates to a more resilient world.

  • You will have the strategic autonomy to influence global operations, paired with a collaborative culture where everyone, from engineering to leadership, is accessible and aligned on the same mission.

title: Lifecycle Communications Coordinator
description:

Join our Lifecycle Communications team on a 12 month max term contract and help create meaningful digital experiences that keep our members informed, engaged and connected.

As the Lifecycle Communications Coordinator, you'll transform campaign briefs into compelling email and SMS communications, bringing member journeys to life through engaging content and well-executed campaigns.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking to build their career in digital marketing, lifecycle communications and marketing automation while working alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where you'll continue to learn, grow and make a genuine impact.


What will you be doing?

  • Support the delivery of engaging member email and SMS campaigns, including campaign copy, subject lines and calls-to-action aligned to audience needs and lifecycle journeys.
  • Adapt content, imagery and digital assets for different audiences, products, channels and communication stages.
  • Ensure content quality, consistency and accuracy across all member communications.
  • Maintain campaign schedules, templates, documentation and content libraries for efficient delivery.
  • Support quality assurance processes, including dynamic content reviews, personalisation and accessibility checks and cross-device/channel rendering validation.
  • Assist in applying audience insights, segmentation and personalisation to improve communication relevance and effectiveness.
  • Support campaign testing, reporting, optimisation and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to collate and apply feedback, manage approvals and deliver effective lifecycle communications.
  • Follow processes to ensure communications comply with brand, privacy, consent, accessibility and governance requirements.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and recommend improvements to communication performance.
  • Support reporting and insights to improve member engagement and campaign outcomes.

What are we looking for in you?

  • Relevant study or equivalent experience in Digital Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Digital Media or a related field.
  • Experience creating content, communications or customer-facing materials in a professional environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the ability to combine copy and imagery to create engaging member communications.
  • Experience working with digital marketing platforms, templates or content production processes considered an advantage but not a requirement.
  • Ability to learn and navigate digital platforms and tools.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Cloud templates, particularly InDesign, Photoshop and Dreamweaver, with a basic understanding of HTML or a willingness to learn. Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and collaborate effectively. Transferable experience and demonstrated capability will be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
  • Confidence in managing and coordinating multiple business stakeholders with varying needs, priorities and requirements.

What can we offer you?

  • A workplace culture where our people feel valued, respected and empowered
  • Work in flexible ways that meet work/life commitments and support wellbeing
  • Professional career development and training
  • Free Roadside Assistance and discounts on RAC products and services including Insurance, Holiday Parks and Resorts, Security, Finance and Auto Services
  • Be part of a purpose led organisation that gives back to the WA community
  • Opportunities for community engagement and corporate volunteering
  • A very active Social Club - join one of the most active social clubs in Perth with over 900 members

To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit a 1-page cover letter outlining your suitability and interest in the position along with your resume.

Applications Close: Sunday 16th August 2026

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as RAC reserves the right to close this vacancy without notice.

RAC is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where we respect and celebrate differences. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people of all ages and abilities, LGBTQI+ communities, and those from diverse cultures, languages and experiences.

IMG is a subsidiary of TKO, a premium sports and entertainment company.

We're looking for an exceptional creative leader who thrives where strategy, storytelling and design meet. This is a rare opportunity to influence one of the world's biggest names in sport and entertainment while helping define how IMG shows up to clients, partners and fans around the world.

This role oversees and influences creative across graphic design, presentation design, campaign creative, brand identity, digital, social, motion and experiential activation. Bringing together strategy, storytelling, design and innovation to create work that wins clients, builds brands and inspires audiences. Perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, champions bold, original thinking grounded in strategic insight with a passion for sport. You’ll collaborate closely with senior leaders, business development teams and marketers to ensure visually striking, strategically effective designs are delivered to the highest standards.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Lead creative for IMG's most strategically important pitches and RFPs from initial brief through to presentation.

  • Manage, mentor, and inspire a team of designers and set standards for quality, consistency, and creative excellence.
  • Collaborate directly with senior stakeholders, industry-leading strategists and marketers to interpret briefs and shape visual direction.
  • Build and maintain template systems and asset libraries to streamline workflow and raise quality across the organisation.
  • Evolve design capabilities and identify opportunities to push our creative through new tools, processes, or formats.
  • Balance hands-on design leadership with strategic oversight.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver under tight deadlines in a high-pressure environment without compromising quality.
  • Maintain and evolve IMG’s brand identity.

Knowledge and Experience

  • 10+ years in design with at least 3 years leading teams in an agency, studio, or in-house creative environment.
  • A strong portfolio - we'd love to see examples of:
    • Winning pitch presentations
  • Integrated marketing campaigns
  • Brand systems
  • Large-scale activations
  • Exceptional typography, layout and visual storytelling skills.
  • Knowledge in AI-driven design tools (E.g. Flora, Runway, Nano Banana, generative design) to improve creative, storytelling and time efficiencies.
  • Experience presenting and selling creative concepts to senior leadership.
  • Fluency in Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and comfort with motion and digital design.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities without sacrificing quality.
  • Experience in sports, entertainment, or culturally driven brands preferred.

Skills and Abilities

  • A creative leader who raises the bar for everyone around you.
  • A natural storyteller who knows how to turn ideas, strategy and raw content into beautifully crafted narratives.
  • You give direct, constructive feedback and create space for your team to do their best work.
  • You believe great design can change how people feel about a brand, an event, or a moment and you want to prove it at the highest level.

title: Associate professor / professor, pathology
description:
The Faculty of Medicine at the University of Helsinki invites applications for the position of

ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR / PROFESSOR

as of 1.1.2027. The field of the position is pathology with Swedish as the language of instruction.

The positions may be filled as associate professor or professor, depending on the candidates’ merits and career stage.

Associate professor
An appointee to the position of associate professor in the tenure track system shall hold a doctoral degree, have the ability to conduct independent scholarly work and have the teaching skills necessary for the position. In addition, applicants for associate professorships shall demonstrate their ability and motivation for an academic career through publications and other means. The degree requirement must be met by the end of the application deadline.

When considering applicants’ qualifications, account shall be taken not only of their research work and teaching qualifications, but also of their success in obtaining external research funding, international research experience and other international experience.

Professor

An appointee to a professorship shall hold a doctoral degree and have top-level scholarly qualifications, experience in the supervision of scientific research, as well as the ability to provide top-level research-based teaching and to supervise theses and dissertations. In addition, the appointee shall present documentation of international cooperation in the field of research that this person represents. Holders of professorships shall also have the skills necessary for serving as an academic leader. The degree requirement must be met by the end of the application deadline.

When considering the applicant’s qualifications, attention shall be given to scientific publications and other research results of scientific value, teaching experience and pedagogical training, the ability to produce teaching material, other teaching merits , if necessary, a demonstration of teaching skills as well as the applicant’s participation in doctoral education. Account shall also be taken of the applicant’s activity in the scientific community, success in obtaining external research funding, international research experience and international elected positions as well as leadership and interaction skills. To ensure that the applicant’s ability to supervise theses and dissertations meets the requirements of the Faculty of Medicine, he or she must have completed the supervision of at least one doctoral dissertation. The requirement for a supervised dissertation must be met by the end of the application deadline.

Duties

The University of Helsinki has national responsibility for Swedish-language education in medicine. The associate/ professor is responsible for undergraduate, postgraduate and continuing education in pathology as well as participating in other basic education and specialist training in the field. The associate/ professor will provide teaching in the Degree Programme in Medicine, including practical small group and lecture-based teaching. The duties of the position include carrying out and supervising scientific research and, consequently, following scientific developments as well as participating in public engagement and Finnish and international cooperation in the field. In addition, the appointee has other duties related to the responsibilities of the Faculty.

The practical experience required for the position can be demonstrated with an applicable specialist’s degree or license in the field (pathology).

The appointee and HUS Helsinki University Hospital may negotiate a suitable secondary position.

Trial period of six months will be applied.

Requirements for language skills

According to the Government Decree on Universities, holders of teaching and research positions must be proficient in the language of instruction. The language of instruction is Swedish. In addition, the appointee must have at least satisfactory oral and written skills in Finnish. To successfully attend to the duties of the position, the appointee must also have good English skills.

When the language of instruction is Swedish the language proficiency recommended for successfully attending to the duties of the position corresponds with level C2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. During the recruitment process, language proficiency is demonstrated with documents, an interview and a teaching demonstration. If needed, applicants may be requested to provide further clarification of their language proficiency. Instructions, requirements for language skills and models are available on the Faculty’s website at

Salary

The salary will be based on level 7 (associate professor) and levels 8-10 (professor) of the demands level chart for teaching and research personnel in the salary system of Finnish universities. In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal work performance.

Application documents

Applications must have the following enclosures as a one single pdf file (in English):

  • CV;
  • Scientific activities: free-form, one-page report of the applicant’s scientific activities;
  • Statement of intent: a statement of no more than one page on how the applicant intends to carry out the duties of the position and develop the teaching and research in the field;
  • List of received funding sources (€)
  • List of publications
  • List of selected 20 publications


Applicants are also requested to submit the "Documentation of Teaching Qualifications" form in Swedish. In addition, the applicant must submit a certificate of their Swedish language proficiency by the application deadline. The Documentation of teaching qualifications- form, the instructions and requirements for language skills are available on the Faculty’s website at https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-medicine/about us/work-us

Applications should be submitted through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System via the "Apply now" button. Internal applicants (i.e., current employees of the University of Helsinki) submit their applications by using the Employee Login button. The closing date for applications is 1.9.2026.

Further information
Further information about the position may be obtained from Director of Medicum, Professor Eero Mervaala, eero.mervaala(at)helsinki.fi, tel. 029 412 5355 and Head of the Department of Pathology, Professor Ari Ristimäki, ari.ristimaki(at)helsinki.fi, tel. 040-5819311.


For enquiries about the recruitment process and for technical support for using the University’s electronic recruitment system, please contact HR Specialist Taru Vitikka (recruitment(at)helsinki.fi).

The Faculty of Medicine promotes scientific research of a high standard and is responsible for providing research-based undergraduate and postgraduate education in medicine, dentistry, psychology and logopedics, as well as for the English-language Master’s Programme in Translational Medicine, Master’s Programme in Development of Health Care Services and provides also psychotherapist education. In addition to its teaching and research activities, the Faculty serves as a significant expert organisation in the healthcare sector and contributes to the discourse on ethics in the field. In terms of research, the Faculty aims for a place among the best medical faculties in the world, while consolidating and strengthening its status as a top-level institution of medical education.

Together with HUS Helsinki University Hospital and the Helsinki Institute of Life Science (HiLIFE), the Faculty of Medicine, University of Helsinki, constitutes the Academic Medical Center. This medical center has been very successful in international comparisons, ranking among the top 10 medical campuses in Europe and among the top 50 globally.

title: Senior Creative Technologist
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Senior Creative Technologist do at WPP Production?

Overview

A Senior Creative Technologist is a confident technical and creative leader who delivers exceptional work and elevates the team around them with +10 years of experience. The candidate should have strong understanding of the creative and production industry, ultimately worked within a creative agency (or in-house agency) or a production company for a vast majority of their career.

They can shape ideas, briefs and expand on concepts, not only execute them.

They don’t just build prototypes; they think about how things can scale.

They don’t just solve problems; they spot them early and think about mitigating risk.

They are comfortable working with clients and have strong presentation skills.

The Senior CT plays a supporting leadership role across strategic and creative delivery, mentoring and standards. Senior CTs own workstreams, line manage junior team members and help ensure that what we ship is technically robust, creatively ambitious and compliant with corporate and client expectations. The Senior CT has strong technical capabilities to guide teams about the suitable models they should work with for each project and provide technical support for the different models, programs and tools.

Responsibilities

• Line manages Creative Technologists

• Set clear expectations and support personal development plans

• Run regular, 1:1 with honest feedback loops

• Actively mentor less confident team members, creating space for them to grow

• Confidently propose and justify technical approaches in response to briefs

• Take responsibility for ensuring creative and technical output meets corporate and client standards

• Work closely with Producers/PMs to scope realistically and protect quality

• Turn ideas into meaningful prototypes that support internal new business

• Balance experimentation with integrated production discipline

• Anticipate technical risks and resolve issues early

• Develop scalable workflows across AI, real-time and other emerging tech

• Encourage ownership and pride in output

• Share knowledge openly and raise the overall capability of the team

• Escalate when something doesn’t match the brief or standards

• Be the bridge between Creative, Strategy, Production and Tech

• Clearly explain complex technical approaches to non-technical audiences

• Represent the Creative Technology team confidently in client settings

• Provide transparent updates on progress, blockers and risks

• Give constructive, solution-focused feedback

• Proactively identify opportunities to prototype new ideas or tools

• Contribute to group R&D initiatives

• Stay curious about emerging tech and share insights with the team

Requirements

• Strong capability across multiple areas such as: Unreal (Blueprints, UEFN, Verse), creative coding, generative AI workflows, AR/VR, 3D, interaction design, world building, automation pipelines etc.

• Proven ability to deliver high-quality technical work with minimal oversight

• Experience mentoring or line managing junior team members

• Strong troubleshooting skills across technical/creative pipelines

• Confident communicator both internally and with clients.

• Comfortable working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments

• High standards and a strong sense of accountability

• Great collaborator and team player that is used to working with multiple stakeholders co-owning a project

• Commercial awareness and understanding of production realities

#LI-RH1

#LI-HYBRID

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

About DHL Blue Dart Express India:

Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.

If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

Position Overview:

The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.

Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

Job Purpose:

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

Pickup & Delivery Operations

• Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.

• Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.

• Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.

• Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.

• Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

Customer Service Excellence

• Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.

• Maintain courteous, professional and customer-centric behaviour at all times.

• Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.

• Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.

• Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

COD & Documentation Management

• Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.

• Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.

• Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.

• Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.

• Report discrepancies immediately.

Operational Compliance

• Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.

• Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.

• Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.

• Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.

• Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

Safety & Security

• Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.

• Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.

• Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.

• Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.

• Protect company assets and customer property.

Vehicle & Asset Responsibility

• Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two-wheeler in roadworthy condition.

• Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.

• Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.

• Report maintenance requirements promptly.

Workplace Discipline & Brand Representation

• Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.

• Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.

• Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.

• Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.

• Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

Team Collaboration

• Work closely with Shift In-charges and branch operations teams.

• Support colleagues during operational contingencies.

• Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.

• Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

Qualifications & Experience:

Education:

• Minimum 10th Standard Pass.

• Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

Experience:

• Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.

• Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

Eligibility Requirements:

• Minimum age 18 years.

• Valid Two-Wheeler or Four-Wheeler Driving Licence.

• Must own a two-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.

• Physically fit to perform field operations.

• Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

Skills & Capabilities:

Technical Skills:

• Pickup & Delivery Operations

• Shipment Handling

• Cash Collection (COD)

• Proof of Delivery (POD)

• Mobile Device / Scanner Usage

• Route Familiarity

• Basic Computer & Mobile Application Skills

• Basic English Reading & Understanding

Key Competencies:

• Customer Focus

• Integrity

• Reliability

• Safety Consciousness

• Teamwork

• Discipline

• Time Management

• Accountability

• Positive Attitude

• Professional Appearance

Key Performance Indicators:

KRAs

KPIs
