On-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

Service Quality

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

COD & Documentation

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

Safety & Compliance

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform & Grooming Compliance

Operational Productivity

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

Why join DHL Blue Dart?

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

Here’s what makes us stand out:

  • Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.
  • Competitive pay and performance-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
  • Structured learning, global exposure, and on-the-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
  • Best-in-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
  • A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
  • Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.
  • The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

title: Enterprise Market Development Representative
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



The Enterprise Market Development Representative (Enterprise MDR) will generate new business through outbound calls and targeted emails to potential clients. The Enterprise MDR qualifies prospective customers through targeted questions about their business strategy and then leverages this information to align and sell Docusign’s product offerings.

This position spends roughly 80% of the time on the phone prospecting new clients. Enterprise MDRs will receive hands-on training with an emphasis on strategic selling and a focus on researching targeted accounts. This position is a great way for individuals to gain in-depth experience in a rapidly growing SaaS company.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Enterprise MDR.


Responsibility

  • Make outbound calls to prospects who reside in one of Docusign’s core vertical markets, offering tailored solutions to solve and improve business process problems
  • Schedule appointments between prospects and our Account Executives across SMB, Mid-Market or Enterprise verticals
  • Use CRM strategically to record information and identify further opportunities in your assigned territory
  • Work closely with marketing to create email and LinkedIn campaigns to increase company and personal brand awareness

Job Designation



Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent sales related experience
  • 1+ year of experience in a client or customer facing role

Preferred

  • Prior experience in the SaaS industry
  • Driven, enthusiastic and hard-working nature
  • Ability to form strong business relationships
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Wage Transparency



Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:

California: $25.60/hour - $35.48/hour

This role is also eligible for the following:

  • Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre-established sales goals. Non-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance.

Global benefits provide options for the following:

  • Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region
  • Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement
  • Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment
  • Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions
  • Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements
  • Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life-changing events

Work Authorization Notice: Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice


States Not Eligible for Employment

Equal Opportunity Employer

This role offers the opportunity to build reliable backend systems that power a modern compensation platform used by organizations and employees across Europe.
You will design, develop, and improve scalable services that simplify benefits, payments, and flexible compensation experiences.
The position combines backend engineering excellence, product thinking, and ownership within a fast-moving SaaS environment.
You will collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to solve meaningful customer problems from discovery through delivery.

This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building impactful systems, improving reliability, and working in a collaborative product-driven culture.

Accountabilities

Strategic Product Leadership

Customer & Market Engagement

Position product solutions for AI inference, KV‑cache, and memory‑centric architectures informed by industry trends, inference context memory, KV‑tiering.

Business & Financial Ownership

Partner closely with ASIC, firmware, NAND, system, and quality teams to drive technical readiness and performance targets. Manage supplier relationships and work with supply chain to ensure cost, yield, and delivery success. Coordinate internal alignment with engineering, reliability, operations, and exec staff.

Competitive Intelligence
Maintain a robust understanding of the semiconductor memory landscape—AI Storage Solutions competition, NAND‑AI Storage Solutions, emerging AI architectures, and customer platform roadmaps.

Technical Expertise
Strong understanding of:
3D stacking / TSV
Memory–accelerator integration (AI/ML GPU pipelines)
Memory subsystem architecture and performance analysis
AI Storage Solutions, NAND‑based high‑bandwidth architectures

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. MBA preferred.

title: [쿠팡] 로켓배송 직수입 MD (Global Sourcing MD) (경력)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개
우리는 주어진 역할을 넘어 과감한 실행력을 지향합니다. 쿠팡 리테일은 로켓배송의 압도적인 성장을 실질적인 비즈니스 성과로 창출해 나가고 있는 핵심 조직입니다. 쿠팡 리테일에서는 카테고리 전략과 수익구조를 직접 설계하며 유통 산업의 새로운 표준을 정립합니다. 데이터와 고객 중심 사고로 성장을 견인할 시니어/리드급 인재에게 쿠팡은 커리어 확장의 최고 무대가 될 것입니다. 정해진 답을 따르기 보다 과감한 시도로 성과를 증명해 온 분이라면, 로켓배송과 함께 그 가치를 더 크게 키워 보시기 바랍니다.
로켓배송은? 로켓배송은 세계적 수준의 압도적인 기술과 물류 인프라를 바탕으로 오늘 주문하면 내일 도착하는 쿠팡의 핵심 서비스입니다. 상품의 직접 매입부터 보관, 배송, 반품까지 전 과정을 쿠팡이 책임지는 End-to-End 방식입니다.
주요 업무

• 글로벌 브랜드, 총판 및 병행수입 업체를 발굴하고 신규 상품 소싱 전략을 수립하여 카테고리 성장을 주도
• Grocery, Home & Kitchen, Leisure, Consumer Electronics 등 주요 카테고리에 대한 시장 및 트렌드 분석을 통해 경쟁력 있는 상품과 공급사 발굴
• 공급사와 가격, 물량, 상품 구성, 마케팅 지원 등 주요 비즈니스 조건 협상을 리드
• 글로벌 상품 셀렉션을 확대하여 고객에게 더 다양한 해외 상품 구매 경험 제공
• 수입 일정 관리, 통관 및 규제 준수, 상품 등록, 프로모션 운영 등 End-to-End Import Process 관리
• 신규 및 기존 브랜드와 협업하여 프로모션, 신상품 런칭 및 매출 성장을 위한 전략 수립
• P&L 관점에서 수익성을 관리하고 리스크를 최소화할 수 있는 비즈니스 의사결정 수행
• Finance, Legal, Marketing 등 다양한 유관 부서와 협업하여 사업 목표 달성
자격 요건
• 관련 분야 경력 12년 이상이신 분
• 글로벌 브랜드사, 유통사, 병행수입사 또는 리테일/이커머스 업계 경험을 보유하신 분
• 해외 소싱, 수입 및 병행수입 비즈니스에 대한 이해와 실무 경험이 있으신 분
• 영어 및 한국어 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분 (비즈니스 수준)
• 공급사 개발 및 비즈니스 협상 역량을 보유하신 분
우대 요건
• 식품, 생활용품, 주방용품, 레저, 스포츠, 가전, 뷰티 등 관련 카테고리 경험을 보유하신 분
• 데이터 기반 분석 및 문제 해결 능력, 다양한 이해관계자 설득 경험이 있으신 분
• 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 우선순위를 설정하고 실행할 수 있는 역량이 있으신 분
• 비즈니스 성장과 고객 경험 향상에 대한 강한 Ownership이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Head Theatre Technician
description:
Join our wonderful Theatre team as a Full-Time Head Theatre Technician.

As our Head Theatre Technician, you’ll be the driving force behind the smooth operation of our operating theatres. You’ll lead a skilled team of technicians, ensuring every piece of equipment is ready, every theatre is prepared to the highest standard, and every procedure is supported with technical excellence. Your leadership will directly contribute to patient safety, surgical efficiency, and the confidence of our clinical teams.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of theatre technicians to deliver outstanding technical support across all surgical specialties
  • Oversee the preparation, setup, and maintenance of surgical equipment and instruments, ensuring compliance with hospital protocols and safety standards
  • Coordinate with surgeons, anaesthetists, and nursing staff to anticipate and meet technical needs during procedures
  • Manage equipment inventory, maintenance schedules, and troubleshooting to minimise downtime
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, safety, and patient outcomes
  • Support training and onboarding for new technicians, fostering a culture of learning and excellence

Your Skills and Experiences

To succeed in this role, you will be an enthusiastic individual with a passion for customer service who enjoys being part of a busy team.

You will also bring:

  • Certificate IV in Operating Theatre Technician Practice or other relevant accredited Theatre training program
  • Recent relevant experience and understanding of issues associated with acute care/perioperative settings
  • Previous experience in a similar role
  • Effective interpersonal and communication skills
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently when required
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Sound written & verbal communication
  • Basic understanding of Infection Control principles
  • Sound computer skills
  • Previous experience in a management position (desirable)

What’s in it for You:

At Ramsay, we care for our people by offering benefits that truly support your career, wellbeing and lifestyle, including:

  • Grow your career with recognition programs, employee referral bonuses, scholarships, free access to LinkedIn Learning and the Ramsay Leadership Academy

  • Save more every day with Ramsay Rewards, giving you exclusive deals at 100+ retailers, restaurants, travel providers and more

  • Enjoy peace of mind with lower hospital cover costs and higher extras limits on services like General and Major Dental, plus pharmacy and allied health discounts

  • Find balance through flexible rostering options, flexible leave and access to free, confidential counselling and wellbeing support 24/7

  • Increase your take-home pay through salary packaging and novated leasing, plus discounts on leisure travel, gyms and lifestyle services.

Why Join Ramsay:

At Ramsay Health Care, “people caring for people” is at the heart of everything we do. We are:

  • Australia’s largest private hospital operator, with over 74 sites and 35,000 staff

  • A values-led workplace where you’ll be supported personally and professionally

  • A place with flexible, permanent and career-growth opportunities nationwide.

  • Must provide or complete a National Police Check conducted within the previous 12 months.

  • According to the role, Ramsay may require a Working-With-Children Check and proof of immunisation against infectious diseases.

Apply:

Ready to feel cared for while you care for others? Apply today and join us at Beleura Private Hospital. All applications must be lodged online.

Applications close: 1st September 2026

Reference number: JR114984

Please Note:

Ramsay Health Care is committed to Child Safety. Details of our commitment are set out in our Code of Conduct, available at .

Applications made by recruitment agencies will not be considered.

title: specjalista(-ka) relacji z klientem
description:
To masz na bank:

  • ​​​umowa na zastępstwo,

  • pracę stacjonarną w 3 Oddziale w Koszalinie, ul. Józefa Piłsudskiego 85,

  • zespół/lider: Monika Puzio,

  • udział w atrakcyjnym systemie premiowym (z gwarantowaną premią w okresie wdrożeniowym) i w szerokiej ofercie benefitowej.

Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Do oddziałów szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić naszym klientom najlepsze doświadczenie w sektorze finansowym - jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Dbamy o portfele klientów w ponad 300 oddziałach w całej Polsce. Zarządzamy wieloma produktami bankowymi dla osób prywatnych oraz przedsiębiorstw.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz minimum średnie wykształcenie,

  • posiadasz minimum roczne doświadczenie w bankowości i chcesz się rozwijać w tym sektorze,

  • cenisz sobie kontakt z ludźmi i długotrwałe relacje oparte na zaufaniu,

  • stawiasz sobie ambitne cele i dobrze się czujesz wiedząc do czego dążysz,

  • lubisz działać nie tylko indywidualnie, ale też zespołowo i osiągać wspólnie ustalone cele.

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • umiejętność porozumiewania się w języku angielskim na poziomie komunikatywnym, umożliwiającym kontakt z klientem zagranicznym i pomoc w wyborze odpowiednich produktów bankowych,

  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • wspieranie klientów w wyborze najlepszych produktów i usług bankowych,

  • zapewnienie profesjonalnej obsługi oraz najlepszych doświadczeń związanych z wizytą w oddziale,

  • oferowanie i promowanie produktów bankowych,

  • realizacja indywidualnych i zespołowych zadań sprzedażowych, za które przyznajemy miesięczne premie na atrakcyjnym poziomie,

  • telefoniczny i bezpośredni kontakt z klientami,

  • budowanie długotrwałych relacji z klientami banku oraz pozyskiwanie nowych,

  • codzienną obsługę transakcji gotówkowych (w oddziałach gotówkowych) i bezgotówkowych,

  • praca w zgodzie z obowiązującymi procedurami oraz standardami jakości

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę na zastępstwo,

  • pracę stacjonarną w Oddziale (lokalizacja na początku oferty),

  • ubezpieczenie na życie,

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),

  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,

  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,

  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,

  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,

  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci),

  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, praca hybrydowa, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,

  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy.

  • Po 2 miesiącach zaczniesz realizować część planu sprzedażowego i wejdziesz do systemu premiowego.

  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.

  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

1. wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,

2. spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,

3. pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer (Backend) based in Ireland.

This role offers the opportunity to build reliable backend systems that power a modern compensation platform used by organizations and employees across Europe.
You will design, develop, and improve scalable services that simplify benefits, payments, and flexible compensation experiences.
The position combines backend engineering excellence, product thinking, and ownership within a fast-moving SaaS environment.
You will collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to solve meaningful customer problems from discovery through delivery.
Working remotely within Europe, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and directly influence product outcomes.
This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building impactful systems, improving reliability, and working in a collaborative product-driven culture.

Accountabilities

The Software Engineer (Backend) will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable backend systems while contributing to product decisions and improving the overall engineering experience.

  • Develop reliable, scalable backend services that support a compensation platform used by businesses and employees.
  • Design and implement APIs, database solutions, and architectural improvements that enhance performance and maintainability.
  • Build production-ready systems with strong testing practices, monitoring, observability, and resilience.
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical discovery and design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to identify the right solutions for customer needs.
  • Contribute technical expertise during product discovery, challenge assumptions, and help shape product direction.
  • Improve system performance through optimization, better error handling, reduced latency, and stronger data consistency.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to engineering standards through reviews, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.
  • Work with modern development practices including small pull requests, CI/CD workflows, and continuous delivery.
  • Build systems capable of supporting multiple markets with different regulatory, compliance, and business requirements.
  • Apply AI-assisted development practices to improve productivity, problem-solving, and engineering workflows.
  • Support team growth by sharing knowledge, pairing with colleagues, and contributing to a strong engineering culture.

  • Climb ladders and stairs.

Second Shift (United States of America)

LOCATION:

Tempe, AZ

This is a dynamic, on-site role that places you at the heart of the action. As a result, an essential function of this position is working on-site. Remote or hybrid options are not available. Being on property allows you to build strong relationships with clients and tenants, respond in real time, and make a visible impact every day.

Our firm is built on a shared purpose: Empowering good people to do extraordinary things together. We hire smart, passionate, hard-working people who value both collaboration and independence. United by our brand promise, we own the outcome for clients, investors and partners. Learn more at transwestern.com.

title: People Technology and Data Lead
description:
Job Title

People Technology and Data Lead

Department

Human Resources-BG-UK

Overview of Department

The people team develops the capabilities, culture and experiences that create a human and commercial edge for Baillie Gifford. We exist to make the firm the world’s most distinctive place to grow a career, investing in our people with the same long-term conviction as our portfolios and continually reimagining how work is done to outpace the industry.

The team supports the full people lifecycle, including people operations, people partnering, leadership, learning and capability development, attraction and resourcing, organisational culture, reward, wellbeing and the end-to-end people experience.

Through this work, we ensure that people and performance are deeply connected and that our colleagues are equipped to deliver long-term value for clients.

Purpose of Role

People Technology and Data designs, delivers and stewards the systems, data and insights that support our people across the employee lifecycle. The team ensures our people technology is secure, resilient and intuitive, and that our data is accurate, trusted and translated into meaningful insight.

As People Technology and Data Lead, you’ll bring together technology leadership, data stewardship, operational expertise and strategic thinking. This role exists to create an integrated, scalable people technology and data ecosystem that simplifies services, strengthens controls and enables better use of automation, AI and workforce insight.

Combining strategic leadership with hands-on delivery, you’ll set the direction and roadmap for our people technology ecosystem, data services and reporting capability. You’ll balance reliable day-to-day stewardship with longer-term improvement, make clear priority and risk decisions, and lead a capable team to solve complex problems and deliver practical solutions.

Working closely with the People team and partners across firm-wide Technology, Data, Innovation and Risk, you’ll ensure our people technology and data capabilities evolve in line with established architecture, data, security and governance frameworks. Through these partnerships, you’ll create the capacity, confidence and clarity needed for a modern, scalable and insight-led People function.

Responsibilities

Strategy and priorities

  • Own, shape and deliver the People technology and data strategy and roadmap, translating organisational priorities into clear, practical plans aligned with firm-wide technology and data strategies.
  • Shape the future People technology architecture, identifying opportunities to simplify, consolidate and improve systems, integrations, data and reporting capabilities.
  • Ensure technology and data decisions align with established enterprise architecture, data-management, security and governance standards, making appropriate use of existing firm-wide platforms and capabilities.
  • Assess complex technology, data and reporting requirements, shaping practical solutions and developing workforce insight that supports informed decision-making.

Technology and data stewardship

  • Own the performance, reliability and continuous improvement of core People systems, data services and supporting third-party platforms.
  • Lead and directly contribute to significant technology and data changes, from solution design and governance through to implementation, partnering with the People Product Lead to deliver technology, automation and AI-enabled improvements.
  • Balance strategic leadership with day-today stewardship, stepping into delivery where priorities, complexity or capacity require it to keep critical services or improvements moving.

Reporting and workforce insight

  • Own the People data governance framework, ensuring high-quality data, trusted reporting, clear ownership and effective access controls.
  • Lead the development of operational reporting and workforce insight, prioritising analytical demand and translating insight into meaningful action.
  • Champion the responsible use of advanced analytics, ensuring appropriate governance, data quality and business value.

Risk, controls and responsible use

  • Ensure robust governance of People technology and data, including system access, sensitive employee data, change control and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead the assessment and resolution of significant technology, data and service risks, driving effective investigation, remediation and continuous improvement.
  • Work closely with Technology, Data, Risk, Security, Legal and Compliance teams to ensure People technology, data and AI capabilities are secure, compliant and used responsibly.

Team, delivery and stakeholder leadership

  • Lead and develop the People Technology and Data team, building capability, resilience and strong professional standards. Take ownership of high-priority work while supporting the team to deliver successfully.
  • Build trusted partnerships across People and firm-wide teams, bringing clarity to complex technology and data decisions and using service, system and data insights to improve reliability, confidence and the colleague experience.

What success looks like

  • Trusted technology foundations: People systems, data services and reporting are reliable, secure and well governed, providing confidence across the People function.
  • Clear strategic direction: A coherent technology and data roadmap is in place, balancing operational priorities with longer-term improvement and innovation.
  • Actionable workforce insight: High-quality People data and reporting enable better decision making, supporting operational excellence and strategic priorities.
  • Responsible innovation: Technology, automation and AI are adopted thoughtfully, improving services while maintaining strong governance, security and compliance.
  • High-performing team: The People Technology and Data team is capable, resilient and continually developing, with knowledge shared and critical expertise embedded across the team.
  • Strong partnerships: Trusted relationships across People, Technology, Data, Risk and other firm-wide teams enable effective delivery and well-informed decision making.

Your knowledge and experience

  • Significant experience leading technology, data or reporting functions within a complex organisation. Experience of HR technology is helpful but not essential.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, reporting and workforce analytics, ideally including the management of sensitive or restricted data.
  • Proven ability to balance operational delivery with strategic development, with experience developing technology roadmaps, leading system improvements and delivering technology-enabled change.
  • Experience translating business needs into practical technology and data solutions, working effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills, using data and insight to inform decisions, prioritise investment and improve services.
  • Experience leading and developing teams, building capability and creating resilient ways of working.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted partnerships across People, Technology, Data, Risk and other business functions.
  • Good understanding of governance, security, privacy and risk management within technology and data environments.

The type of candidate we're looking for

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with practical delivery. You'll enjoy solving complex technology and data challenges, setting clear direction while remaining close enough to the detail to guide delivery, remove obstacles and ensure important work moves forward. You'll be curious about how technology, data, automation and AI can improve services, while recognising that trusted data, strong governance and well-designed systems are the foundations of sustainable, scalable change. You’ll understand that People technology and data form part of a wider firm-wide ecosystem and you’ll adopt established standards while also helping other teams understand the People function’s needs. You’ll balance innovation with operational reality, making informed decisions that strengthen colleague experience, operational resilience and business performance. You'll build trusted relationships across People, Technology, Data, Risk and the wider business, translating complex technical concepts into practical recommendations and bringing people together around shared outcomes. As a leader, you'll develop capability, create clarity and foster an environment where your team can thrive, collaborate and continuously improve.

Critical skills

  • Systems thinking
  • Data literacy
  • Digital effectiveness (including AI)
  • Improvement mindset
  • Storytelling

Additional information:

Instead of a cover letter, candidates are asked to submit a CV and short written responses (maximum 300 words each) to the following questions:

  • Question 1 – Describe a time when you improved a technology, data or reporting capability that enabled better decision making, strengthened governance or improved a service.
  • Question 2 – Tell us about a difficult prioritisation decision you made when balancing operational demands with longer-term technology or data improvements.
  • Question 3 – Describe a time when you brought together people with different priorities to solve a complex technology, data or information challenge.

Closing Date

August 18, 2026

Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.


At Baillie Gifford, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Turkey.

This role offers the opportunity to design and build the foundation of an AI-native operating environment used across a global organization.
You will create scalable infrastructure that enables intelligent agents to operate reliably, securely, and transparently.
The position combines advanced AI engineering, platform development, governance, and automation to solve complex operational challenges.
You will own the architecture, execution layer, evaluation systems, and tooling required to make AI workflows trustworthy.
Working in a fully remote and highly autonomous environment, you will influence how teams adopt and benefit from AI at scale.
This opportunity is ideal for an engineer who enjoys building foundational systems, solving open-ended problems, and shaping the future of AI-powered work.

Accountabilities

The AI Platform Engineer will be responsible for building and operating the infrastructure that enables reliable, measurable, and governed AI systems across the organization.

  • Design, build, and maintain the AI execution platform, including event-triggered workflows, model-agnostic runtimes, durable state management, human review processes, rollback mechanisms, and comprehensive run logging.
  • Own the architecture decisions required to bring AI agent systems into production and ensure the platform operates reliably at scale.
  • Develop the evaluation layer that determines whether AI systems are safe, accurate, and ready for production use.
  • Create golden test suites, behavioral evaluations, safety checks, and CI gates that prevent unreliable AI capabilities from being deployed.
  • Build and manage a portfolio of AI agents supporting business workflows such as reporting, drafting, analysis, triage, and knowledge management.
  • Develop meta-level systems that monitor agent performance, identify improvements, and continuously enhance the platform.
  • Implement governance mechanisms directly into the platform, including risk tiers, least-privilege permissions, tool access controls, audit logging, and human approval workflows.
  • Ensure high-risk AI actions are technically restricted through system design rather than relying only on policies or prompts.
  • Design responsible communication systems that optimize notifications, minimize interruptions, and increase user trust and adoption.
  • Build platform tooling, including validators, compilers, context distribution systems, and integrations across repositories and collaboration environments.
  • Create data pipelines and reporting systems that measure AI adoption, operational impact, maturity levels, and return on investment.
  • Instrument AI workflows to track usage, efficiency gains, costs, and measurable business value.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is an experienced AI platform engineer with a strong background in production-grade AI systems, infrastructure ownership, and reliable software engineering practices.

    • Proven experience building and deploying production LLM agent systems used by real users, beyond prototypes or demonstrations.
    • Strong understanding of AI evaluation methodologies, including golden datasets, behavioral assertions, judge criteria, safety testing, and automated quality gates.
    • Experience designing and implementing reliable AI workflows where correctness, traceability, and governance are critical.
    • Deep API integration experience with business systems and experience creating MCP servers.
    • Strong infrastructure engineering skills using Python, cloud platforms such as GCP, cloud data warehouses, and infrastructure-as-code tools.
    • Ability to independently design, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production systems end to end.
    • Experience with LLM observability, tracing, cost tracking, and transforming AI execution data into actionable insights.
    • Strong understanding of security principles, access controls, permissions management, and system-level risk prevention.
    • Experience building internal platforms, developer tools, or automation systems that achieved strong adoption among non-engineering teams.
    • Strong product mindset and ability to design AI experiences that respect user attention and build trust.
    • Experience working with agentic development tools and the ability to explain workflows, permissions, approval points, logging strategies, and lessons learned from failures.
    • Public contributions such as open-source AI frameworks, MCP servers, evaluation tools, or technical writing in AI reliability are considered a strong advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world.
      • Remote-first culture with coworking support through a WeWork membership or coworking allowance.
      • Employee equity ownership program.
      • Technology allowance to create an ideal home office setup with equipment of your choice.
      • Comprehensive health benefits, including full employee health insurance coverage and dependent coverage support.
      • Annual company off-site gatherings focused on collaboration, connection, and team building.
      • Flexible and asynchronous work environment built on trust and autonomy.
      • Annual professional development budget for courses, books, conferences, and learning opportunities.
      • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team across multiple countries and cultures.
      • Chance to contribute to open-source-driven products used by a large developer community.
      • High-impact role with significant ownership over AI infrastructure strategy and execution.

title: IT 협업도구 관리자
description:
About

서브원 서비스는 국내는 물론 해외의 다양한 기업 고객들이 방문해 수백만 종 이상의 상품을 구매하고 있는 B2B 전문 커머스 서비스입니다.

우리 CTO 조직은 고객향 메인홈부터 물류를 포함한 여러 백엔드 서비스까지 서비스 전체의 정책을 수립하고 사내외 여러 부서와 소통하는 역할을 합니다.

우리 서비스의 다양한 요소들을 이해하고 서비스가 빠르게 성장할 수 있도록 필요한 기능과 프로세스를 기획하고 구축합니다.
또한 회사 전체가 더 나은 생산성을 가지도록 업무와 프로세스를 개선하는 역할도 수행합니다.

Responsibilities

[담당 업무]

Smart & Digital Workplace Manager는 사내에서 운영하는 다양한 협업·생산성 도구를 기반으로 전사 구성원이 보다 효율적으로 일할 수 있는 Digital Workplace 환경을 설계하고 운영하는 역할입니다.

Slack, Confluence, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 등의 협업 환경을 체계적으로 관리하고, 전사 활용 수준을 높이기 위한 거버넌스, 정책, Best Practice 및 변화관리 체계를 구축합니다.

특히 현재 진행 중인 Microsoft 365에서 Google Workspace로의 전사 전환 프로젝트를 주도적으로 수행하며, 도입·마이그레이션부터 전사 변화관리, 사용자 교육, 안정화까지 전 과정을 경험할 수 있습니다.

또한 전사적으로 추진되고 있는 AX(AI Transformation) 활동과 연계하여 AI 기반 업무환경을 구축하고 고도화하는 다양한 프로젝트에 참여하게 됩니다.


[주요 업무]

1) AI 기반 Digital Workplace 및 AX
• AI 기반 업무환경 구축을 위한 신규 기술 및 서비스 검토
• 사내 AI 활용을 위한 협업도구 및 업무환경 고도화
• 전사 AX(AI Transformation) 프로젝트 참여 및 관련 과제 수행
• AI와 협업도구를 결합한 업무 생산성 향상 Use Case 발굴 및 확산



2) SaaS 협업·생산성 도구 운영 및 고도화
• Slack, Confluence, Google Workspace 등 주요 SaaS 협업·생산성 도구의 전사 운영
• 라이선스 및 계정 관리, 사용자 Onboarding/Offboarding 및 Provisioning 운영
• 협업도구 활용 정책 및 Governance 수립·운영
• 사내 사용자 VOE(Voice of Employee) 및 기술 문의 대응
• 사용 현황 및 데이터를 기반으로 한 활용도 분석 및 개선 과제 도출
• 신규 SaaS 도구 검토, PoC 기획 및 전사 Roll-out 주도
• 조직별 Best Practice 발굴 및 전사 확산

3) Identity & Access Management 운영
• IDP(Identity Provider) 기반 SSO 및 인증 체계 운영
• 조직 구조 및 인사정보와 연계한 사용자 Provisioning 정책 관리
• 입사·퇴사·부서이동 등 계정 Lifecycle 관리
• SaaS 서비스별 접근 권한 및 계정 운영 정책 관리
• 보안성과 사용자 편의성을 고려한 Identity Governance 개선



4) M365 Google Workspace 전환 프로젝트
• Google Workspace 전사 전환 및 Migration 계획 수립·실
• 전환 대상 및 서비스별 Migration 전략 수립
• 전사 변화관리(Change Management) 기획 및 실행
• 전사 커뮤니케이션 및 사용자 교육 (GWS 벤더사 협업)
• 전환 과정에서 발생하는 기술·운영 이슈 관리 및 해결
• 전환 이후 안정화 및 상시 운영체계 구축
• 기존 Microsoft 365/Teams 환경의 단계적 축소 및 운영 최적화 (~2027년 1분)



5) IT 계약 및 비용 관리
• 협업도구 및 IDP 관련 벤더 계약 검토 및 갱신
• SaaS 라이선스 사용 현황 분석 및 최적화
• 서비스별 비용 구조 및 사용 효율 분석
• 중복 서비스 및 불필요한 라이선스 최소화를 통한 IT 비용 최적화

Requirements

• IDP(Identity Provider) 운영 경험
-SSO 설정 및 운영

-계정 Lifecycle 관리
• 전사 규모의 Change Management 및 사용자 커뮤니케이션 경험
• IT 서비스 계약 및 라이선스 관리 경험
• IT 운영 비용 분석 및 최적화 경험

Preferred

Benefits

title: Social- og sundhedshjælpere til Hjemmeplejen, Distrikt 4
description:
Nu har du en unik mulighed for at blive en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor vi sparrer og lærer af hinanden, og hvor fagligheden er høj samtidig med, at arbejdsmiljøet og kollegaskabet er i top med masser af grin og fællesskab.

Vi er på udkig efter to nye kolleger til vores dygtige team i Distrikt 4 i Hjemmeplejen i Høje-Taastrup Kommune. I vores arbejde sætter vi fokus på at skabe tryghed, respekt og livskvalitet for vores borgere, og vi har brug for kolleger, der deler denne vision.

Distrikt 4 er en gruppe medarbejdere bestående af SOSU-hjælpere, SOSU-assistenter, ufaglærte og rengøringsmedarbejdere. Vi er vidt forskellige og er stolte af at være en gruppe med plads til alle. Det er en naturlig del af vores hverdag at følge op på hinanden og sikre, at alle kan følge med i dagens planer og har det godt.

Vi er ambitiøse og gode til at lære af hinanden og lære fra os, så vi kan give vores borgere den bedst mulige pleje og udvikle os sammen. Vi er ikke bange for at tale om problemerne og løser dem sammen. Samtidig har vi plads til grin og mødes til fælles middag eller andre sociale arrangementer.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En meningsfuld og varieret arbejdsdag
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og efteruddannelse
  • Et støttende og engageret arbejdsmiljø med fokus på trivsel
  • Engagerede kolleger og høj faglighed
  • Weekendvagt hver 3. weekend

Vi har et tæt sammenhold og godt humør, og vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen i gruppen, hvor vi har fokus på en god onboarding, og hvor du bl.a. får en makker og en grundig introduktion, så du hurtigt bliver en del af arbejdspladsen.

Sammen med et dedikeret team vil du bidrage til at opretholde en høj standard for faglighed, et godt arbejdsmiljø og trivsel blandt borgerne. Du handler reflekteret, arbejder ud fra en rehabiliterende tilgang og tager hensyn til den enkeltes behov og ønsker.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper
  • Har kendskab til omsorgssystemet Cura og FSIII
  • Har erfaring fra hjemmeplejen eller lignende det er dog ikke et krav
  • Har en anerkendende tilgang til både borgere, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere
  • Er empatisk, ansvarsbevidst og har gode kommunikationsevner
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt såvel som i teams
  • Er fleksibel og har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt
  • Er mødestabil

Vi glæder os til at tage imod dig og få dig godt ombord.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder Pooja Rani på 30163936 – du kan også sende en besked, så ringer Pooja dig op.

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt 37 timer om ugen med weekendvagt hver 3. uge. Ansættelse pr. 1. oktober 2026 med mulighed for tidligere start.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst samt principperne i Ny Løn. Vi indhenter straffeattester samt referencer fra tidligere ansættelser i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Vi holder til på Taastrupgårdsvej 28 A, 2630 Høje-Taastrup.

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 23. august 2026

Vi afholder løbende samtaler.

Ansøgning, CV, uddannelsesbevis og evt. anden relevant dokumentation sendes via kommunens rekrutteringssystem.

title: BESS Project Engineer
description:
Drive the energy transition by providing sustainable technological solutions through our digital platform, facilitating from planning to contract tendering to implementation of renewable energy systems in real estate and industrial companies. We enable our customers to increase the economic efficiency and CO2 balance of their properties while minimizing technical, commercial, and energy risks.

To strengthen our Operations team, we are looking for an BESS Project Engineer who will contribute to the analysis of energy data, support the development of AI-based price and energy forecasts, and generate actionable insights through the analysis of operational and financial performance. Join this energy revolution and help us transform energy supply in a sustainable and economically viable way!

Tasks

  • Assess and document battery potential across enshift’s project pipeline.
  • Carry out technical and commercial feasibility studies for BESS projects.
  • Develop battery sizing, installation, grid-connection and operating concepts.
  • Manage battery projects from initial assessment and offer preparation through contracting, technical planning, execution and commissioning.
  • Define requirements and support the selection of BESS, EMS and medium-voltage station solutions.
  • Coordinate customers, utilities, authorities, suppliers, installers and internal project teams.

Requirements

  • Technical university degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or a related field.
  • Professional experience in renewable-energy, electrical-infrastructure or energy-storage projects.
  • Good understanding of electrical systems, grid connections and technical project delivery.
  • Experience with BESS, medium-voltage systems, EMS integration or project commissioning is an advantage.
  • Fluent German and English; French or Italian would be an advantage.
  • Structured and proactive personality with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Resilience and flexibility to succeed in a fast-growing, international environment.

Benefits

  • An attractive salary package and exciting development opportunities
  • Further training in renewable energies and project management
  • A dynamic, innovative environment with short decision-making processes and plenty of creative freedom
  • The opportunity to play an active role in the energy transition and make a real impact

title: Pædagoger til Børnehuset Abildvej, Dagtilbudsområde Midt-Vest
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe trygge, udviklende og meningsfulde hverdage for børn – i et børnehus, hvor faglighed, fællesskab og nysgerrighed går hånd i hånd?

Børnehuset Abildvej søger 2 pædagoger til faste stillinger med ansættelse pr. 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter. Stillingerne er pt. i vores børnehaveafdeling, men du skal kunne se dig selv som en del af hele huset. Vi søger dig, der har lyst til at bringe din pædagogiske faglighed i spil i en hverdag med liv, nærvær og stærke børnefællesskaber – og som trives med at være en del af et team, hvor vi sammen udvikler praksis og hjælper hinanden videre.

Hos os får du en arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor vi er optagede af kvalitet i læringsmiljøerne, børnenes deltagelsesmuligheder og den gode relation mellem børn og voksne. Vi har brug for kollegaer, der kan se muligheder, tage ansvar og bevare ro og overblik, når hverdagen kalder på fleksibilitet og fælles løsninger.

Vores værdier i hverdagen

I Børnehuset Abildvej bygger vores pædagogiske praksis på nærvær, fællesskab, ansvarlighed og faglig nysgerrighed. Vi tror på, at børn udvikler sig bedst i trygge relationer og i fællesskaber, hvor de bliver set, hørt og mødt med positive forventninger. Derfor arbejder vi bevidst med at skabe en hverdag, hvor både børn og voksne oplever tillid, deltagelsesmuligheder og lyst til at lære sammen.

Vi er en del af Dagtilbudsområde Midt-Vest, som består af 7 daginstitutioner, dagplejen, en obs.- og behandlingsgruppe samt et §32-tilbud. Obs.- og behandlingsgruppen og §32-tilbuddet er fysisk placeret på samme matrikel som Børnehuset Abildvej, hvilket giver os gode muligheder for et tæt, fagligt og meningsfuldt samarbejde på tværs.

I hverdagen lægger vi vægt på, at du er nærværende, anerkendende og tydelig i din tilgang – både i mødet med børn, forældre og kollegaer.

Du bliver en aktiv del af planlægningen og organiseringen af dagligdagen, hvor vi sammen skaber rammer, der inviterer børnene til deltagelse, leg og læring ud fra deres forudsætninger. Vi arbejder med planlagte læringsforløb med fokus på trivsel, udvikling og stærke børnefællesskaber – og på, at alle børn oplever at høre til.

Vi arbejder ud fra børnesynet: ”Børn gør det godt, hvis de kan”. Det betyder, at vi som voksne tager ansvar for at justere os, være nysgerrige på barnets intentioner og tilpasse vores krav og forventninger, så børnene får de bedste muligheder for at lykkes.

Hos os får du

  • En hverdag i en institution i udvikling – hvor vi sammen skaber stærke læringsmiljøer og har blik for høj pædagogisk kvalitet.
  • Et mangfoldigt børnehus med et stærkt fællesskab – hvor du møder glade børn, engagerede forældre og hjælpsomme kollegaer.
  • Et hus med mange forskellige kompetencer – og en kultur, hvor vi er åbne, nysgerrige og gerne prøver nye idéer og pædagogiske tiltag af.
  • Plads til både faglig og personlig udvikling – med sparring i hverdagen, tid til refleksion og fælles faglige drøftelser, hvor din stemme tæller.
  • Et tæt teamsamarbejde – hvor vi passer på hinanden, hjælper hinanden videre og har fokus på trivsel, faglighed og en god tone i hverdagen.
  • Faglige møder og refleksionsrum – hvor vi i fællesskab udvikler praksis, deler erfaringer og følger op på det, vi aftaler.
  • Gode fysiske rammer og mange muligheder – både inde og ude, så vi kan understøtte børnenes leg, læring og fællesskaber på forskellige måder.
  • Indflydelse på pædagogiske prioriteringer – og plads til, at du kan bringe dine idéer i spil, så vi sammen kan forme en meningsfuld og tryg hverdag for børnene.

Vi håber, at du

  • Har lyst til at indgå i et tillidsskabende og professionelt samarbejde, hvor vi deler viden, lærer af hinanden og udvikler os i hverdagen.
  • Er nærværende, nysgerrig og omsorgsfuld – og møder både børn og voksne med en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang.
  • Tager aktivt del i planlægning og gennemførelse af pædagogiske aktiviteter, der tager afsæt i den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan – og i det, børnene er optagede af.
  • Trives i et åbent og anerkendende forældresamarbejde, hvor vi ser forældrene som vigtige medspillere i barnets trivsel, læring og udvikling.
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og kan lide at arbejde i team – og bidrager aktivt til fællesskabet omkring kerneopgaven.
  • Er motiveret for at arbejde med KVALID, hvis du ikke allerede kender redskabet – vi hjælper dig godt i gang.
  • Bringer din faglighed tydeligt i spil i arbejdet med børnene og har blik for at skabe trygge rammer, hvor alle børn får mulighed for at lykkes.
  • Er nysgerrig på både din egen og andres pædagogiske praksis – og har lyst til at reflektere og udvikle dig sammen med os.

Vil du gerne se vores hus og høre mere om os, inden du sender din ansøgning, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Lene Dahl på telefon 24 94 70 56.

Vi skal gøre opmærksom på, at løngennemsnittet for stillingerne er 36.429 kr. (37 timer pr. uge). Lønnen vil kunne afvige fra det oplyste, afhængig af erfaring og personalige kompetencer.

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelse.

Kan du se dig selv i et børnehus, hvor faglighed, fællesskab og børnenes trivsel er i centrum, så håber vi, at du har lyst til at sende os din ansøgning. Vi glæder os til at høre, hvem du er, hvad du brænder for, og hvordan du har lyst til at bidrage til hverdagen i Børnehuset Abildvej.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 18. august 2026. Vi forventer at holde samtaler d. 26. august 2026.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, Kaakonpojan päiväkoti
description:
Haluatko asteen verran paremman työpaikan? Tulepa töihin Oulun kaupungin varhaiskasvatukseen!
Meillä tutkitusti viihdytään työssä: saat kannustavat ja innostavat työkaverit ja esihenkilön. Saat kehittyä ja kouluttautua, ja halutessasi pääset myös työkiertoon. Olemme aina kansallisen kehittämisen kärjessä. Meistä alkaa oululainen yhtenäisen kasvun ja opin polku. Tule lapsiystävälliseen Ouluun tekemään kulttuuri-ilmastonmuutosta!

Haettavana on VARHAISKASVATUKSEN OPETTAJAN vakinainen tehtävä Kaakonpojan päiväkodissa.

Kaakonpojan päiväkoti sijaitsee Kaakkurin koulun yhteydessä, hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella. Päiväkodissamme on viisi lapsiryhmää ja ympärillä mahtavat palvelut ja monipuolinen luonto, jotka rikastavat toimintaamme: kirjasto, metsät, leikkipuistot, urheilukenttä, ladut ja koulu. Päiväkotimme toiminnan kulmakivet ovat neljä ällää eli leikki, liikunta, lukeminen ja laulaminen. Tulevien vuosien painopisteinä ovat erityisesti osallisuuden, leikki- ja ulkopedagogiikan kehittäminen. Olemme mukana Liikuttavat Lapset -hankkeessa.

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan tehtävä sijoittuu työsuhteen alkaessa 5-6-vuotiaiden ryhmään. Opettaja vastaa varhaiskasvatustoiminnan sekä esiopetuksen suunnittelusta, arvioinnista ja kehittämisestä yhdessä toisen varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan sekä muun tiimin kanssa. Tiivis yhteistyö varhaiserityisopettajan kanssa sekä esi- ja alkuopetuksen välinen yhteistyö kuuluvat olennaisesti työhön.

Kaakonpojassa pääset mukaan iloiseen työyhteisöön, jossa voit hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi ja osaamistasi pedagogiikkaan intohimoisesti suhtautuvan uudistuneen johtotiimin tukemana!

Saat mahdollisuuksia kehittää omaa osaamistasi niin arjen työssä kuin monipuolisten henkilöstökoulutusten ja omaehtoisen opiskelun kautta. Oulun kaupungilla on tarjolla monipuolisia urapolkuja ja mahdollisuuksia edetä tai vaihtaa tehtäviä kaupungin sisällä. Lisäksi tuemme työhyvinvointia kattavilla työsuhde-eduilla, kuten liikunta- ja kulttuuriedulla, henkilöstöalennuksilla sekä tuella työmatkoihin.

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018 26§) mukainen kelpoisuus huomioiden varhaiskasvatuslain 540/2018 henkilöstöä koskevan siirtymäsäännöksen (75§) mukaiset hakijat. Kasvatustieteen kandidaatin tutkintoon edellytetään sisältyvän varhaiskasvatuksen tehtävään ammatillisia valmiuksia antavat opinnot tai sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkintoon varhaiskasvatukseen ja sosiaalipedagogiikkaan suuntautuneet vähintään 60 opintopisteen laajuiset opinnot.

Eduksi luetaan esiopetuskelpoisuus, ymmärrys leikistä työtapana, osallisuuden ja positiivisen pedagogiikan tuntemus sekä kehittämismyönteinen työote.

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan tehtäväkohtainen palkka muodostuu tasopalkkajärjestelmän sekä osaamisen ja vastuun tasojen mukaisesti 2929,39 € - 3042,60 € välille. Varsinainen palkka koostuu tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta ja mahdollisista muista OVTES:n mukaisista tasolisistä.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Tartuntatautilain 55 §:n mukaan työnantajan vastuulla on vaatia ennen töiden aloittamista työntekijältä ja harjoittelijalta/opiskelijalta luotettava selvitys siitä, ettei tämä sairasta hengityselinten tuberkuloosia. Selvitys tehdään ennen työsopimuksen tekemistä.

Tehtävässä käytetään kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tehtävää haetaan ensisijaisesti sähköisellä hakulomakkeella. Mikäli hakemusta ei ole mahdollista jättää sähköisesti, toimita hakemus osoitteeseen Oulun kaupungin kirjaamo, PL 71, 90015 Oulun kaupunki, käyntiosoite Kansankatu 55A. Kirjallisessa hakemuksessa on mainittava tehtäväkohtainen diaarinumero OUKA/10509/2026. Hakemus on toimitettava 18.8.2026 klo 16.15 mennessä.

title: Chefværter/Lukkeansvarlige søges til vores mellemlederteam i Bowl'n'Fun Thisted
description:
Har du en drøm om at blive eller være leder? Er du klar til at skabe rammerne for at vores gæster får en unik oplevelse? - se nærmere her.

Vil du:

  • Lede andre, have ansvar og samtidig servicere vores glade og forventningsfulde gæster?
  • Være en del af Danmarks største bowling- og forlystelseskæde, hvor godt humør, gode oplevelser og sammenhold er nøgleord, der beskriver vores hverdag?
  • have din hverdag på en anderledes arbejdsplads, hvor gæsten har mulighed for at kombinere forlystelser og spisning og samtidig være i centrum under hele besøget?

Så er det muligvis dig, vi leder efter!

Bliv en del af Bowl´n´Fun & Maximum

Bowl´n´Fun & Maximum er Danmarks største bowling- og forlystelseskæde med 20 centre. Alle centre har en restaurant, The Grill, og flere kan tilbyde Laser Hero, Escape Room og Happie´s legeland. Du skaber en god relation til gæsterne, og sammen med teamet i centret, sikrer du at I altid har glade og tilfredse gæster. Du leder, motiverer og inspirerer dine kollegaer og vigtigst af alt - er et godt forbillede.

Du skal være nærværende og synlig udadtil

Som chefvært kommer du til at gå forrest og have ansvaret på din vagt. Du skal derfor have et godt overblik og en struktureret tilgang til dine opgaver. Du skal være tilstede i centret, så gæsterne kender dit ansigt. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er serviceminded, smilende og imødekommende. Du skal sætte en ære i, at sikre gæsterne får en service, så vi bliver deres "top of mind" ved valg af spise- og oplevelsessted.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

At blive en del af Danmarks største bowling- og forlystelseskæde i en stilling, hvor du sammen med dine kollegaer forventes at skabe unikke resultater, som kan ses og mærkes. At blive en del af en flad organisation med fokus på gensidig feedback i et harmonisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi passer på hinanden. En arbejdsplads hvor der er mulighed for udvikling. Flere tiltalende personalegoder.


Som chefvært skal du:

  • Sikre at gæsterne får den absolut bedste oplevelse
  • Tjekke gæsterne ind og afslutte regninger
  • Du skal servicere vores gæster i baren, ved banerne og i restauranten.
  • Være med til at sikre god trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø i centret
  • Være med til oplæring af nye medarbejdere
  • Være klar på at gå forrest og være synlig, både overfor de øvrige medarbejdere samt gæsterne i centret
  • Åbne og lukke centeret
  • Ad Hoc opgaver

Om dig:

  • Du har tidligere været vant til at have ansvar, gerne fra restaurations- eller servicebranchen
  • Du er ikke bange for at tage ansvar og gå forrest
  • Du er selvstændig
  • Du er topsælgeren, der sætter gæsterne i centrum
  • Du har overblik og besidder evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når det går stærkt
  • Du kan lide at arbejde i et team
  • Du er fleksibel og træder til når behovet opstår
  • Du sætter pris på en varieret arbejdsdag med skiftende arbejdstider og weekendvagter
  • Du kan arbejde både i dagstimer og aftentimer alle ugens dage.

Der er tale om en deltidsstilling på 20-25 timer om ugen med mulighed for flere timer i højsæson.

title: Recovery Motivator
description:
Overview

Recovery Motivator

Worksop, Nottinghamshire | Full Time | Fixed Term until 20 May 2027

Turn lived experience into hope for someone else.

Sometimes, the person who makes the biggest difference is someone who understands.

This is a role built on connection and shared understanding.

As a Recovery Motivator, you’ll be a welcoming and consistent presence within our Worksop service, supporting people affected by drug and alcohol use, as well as their families, carers and wider support networks.

You’ll draw on your own lived experience to help people feel understood, connect with the right support and believe that positive change is possible.

This role is designed to support someone taking their first steps into employment with Change Grow Live. You’ll receive training, supervision and ongoing support to develop your confidence, knowledge and skills.

The opportunity

You’ll be a trusted and approachable point of contact within the service and across the local community.

You’ll welcome people without judgement, listen to what matters to them and help them find the services, recovery networks and community resources that can support their next step.

You’ll also work alongside colleagues, partners and peer networks to strengthen community engagement, support service user involvement and help create recovery-focused activities and groups.

This role is about using your experience to help others feel heard, supported and able to move forward.

Where you’ll work

Location: Worksop, NottinghamshireContract Type: Fixed term until 20 May 2027Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week

Please note: Full-time hours at Change Grow Live are 37.5 hours per week. For part-time roles, the salary and any associated payments will be pro rata based on contracted hours.

Responsibilities

What you’ll be doing

You’ll:

  • Welcome and engage with people accessing the service.
  • Support individuals and families to identify their goals and find the right support.
  • Build links with mutual aid, peer-support and local community groups.
  • Help plan and facilitate recovery and wellbeing activities.
  • Reach people who may feel isolated or disconnected from mainstream services.
  • Promote service user involvement and peer-led opportunities.
  • Record information accurately and contribute to meetings, training and supervision.
  • Represent Change Grow Live positively across the Worksop community.

About you

You don’t need to have worked as a Recovery Motivator before.

What matters is your lived experience, motivation and ability to connect with people in an authentic and respectful way.

You’ll be:

  • Passionate about recovery and supporting others.
  • Compassionate, empathetic and non-judgemental.
  • A confident communicator who can build positive relationships.
  • Enthusiastic about community engagement and peer support.
  • Able to use your own initiative while contributing to a supportive team.
  • Comfortable maintaining confidentiality and professional boundaries.
  • Willing to learn and develop through training and supervision.

Lived experience of drug and/or alcohol use is central to this role and will help you bring understanding, credibility and hope to the people you support.

Take your next step with us

At Change Grow Live, we believe lived experience brings valuable insight, connection and hope.

You’ll join a team that will support your development while giving you the opportunity to use your experience to make a meaningful difference within your community.

Our values—Be open. Be compassionate. Be bold.—guide everything we do. If they reflect the way you work, we’d love to hear from you.

A note about using AI in your application

AI can be a really helpful tool when putting together your application, and we're happy for you to use it. However, what we're most interested in is you.

We want to understand your experiences, achievements and strengths, so please make sure your application reflects your own story and clearly shows how you meet the essential criteria and the impact you've made in previous roles.

There's no need to write in a particular style. The strongest applications are those that are authentic, specific and clearly demonstrate your skills, experience and potential.

We look forward to learning more about you.

We reserve the right to close this opportunity early if we receive a high number of applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. For applicants with time-limited visas, unfortunately, we are unable to support new visa applications or extensions. More information about eligible roles and occupations can be found here: Skilled Worker visa: Overview - GOV.UK

Please note that we are not accepting applications from recruitment agencies for this vacancy. Direct applications only.

Salary Range (pro rata if part time)

CGL SPOT (20) (£26,296.03 - £26,296.03)

ILW / OLW /Fringe

N/A - Outside London Weighting Area

Closing Date

title: Site Reliability Engineer in Network Infrastructure
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer in Network Infrastructure based in United Kingdom.

This role offers the opportunity to strengthen the reliability and scalability of critical network infrastructure supporting advanced cloud and AI platforms. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will help design, automate, and operate the systems that enable high-performance digital services at scale. You will focus on building resilient environments, improving observability, and creating safer operational processes across complex network architectures. Working closely with network and platform engineering teams, you will transform operational challenges into long-term solutions through automation and engineering excellence. This position combines software development, infrastructure expertise, and reliability engineering in a fast-moving international environment. You will have significant ownership and the chance to influence the future of large-scale cloud infrastructure.

Accountabilities:

As a Site Reliability Engineer in Network Infrastructure, you will be responsible for improving the reliability, performance, and operational maturity of large-scale network systems. You will combine engineering practices with operational expertise to ensure critical infrastructure remains secure, scalable, and efficient.

  • Define and manage reliability objectives for network services, including SLIs, SLOs, availability targets, and error budgets where applicable.
  • Drive reliability improvements across network infrastructure, including services, site readiness, inter-site connectivity, and operational processes.
  • Own incident response activities, lead technical investigations, conduct postmortems, and implement long-term solutions to prevent recurring issues.
  • Build and improve observability systems through meaningful metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and faster troubleshooting workflows.
  • Design safer infrastructure change processes through automation, CI/CD workflows, testing environments, staged deployments, rollback strategies, and auditability.
  • Collaborate closely with network engineers and platform teams to improve system operability and integrate reliability practices into technical designs.
  • Automate operational workflows and continuously improve infrastructure management processes.
  • Contribute to building scalable and resilient network environments that support growing cloud workloads.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has strong experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure operations, and network systems. You are comfortable working with complex production environments, debugging challenging technical issues, and developing automation to improve reliability and efficiency.

    • Strong knowledge of production Linux environments and a structured approach to troubleshooting complex systems.
    • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including control plane and data plane concepts, latency, packet loss, and failure domains.
    • Experience operating high-availability systems and continuously improving their reliability over time.
    • Ability to write and maintain automation and infrastructure software, with experience in Go preferred and Python welcomed.
    • Experience with modern infrastructure tooling, including Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD systems, and container platforms.
    • Strong engineering mindset with the ability to balance operational stability, automation, and continuous improvement.
    • Experience with high-throughput traffic systems such as load balancers, tunneling, decapsulation, NAT64, or similar technologies is a plus.
    • Knowledge of low-level networking performance optimization, including eBPF/XDP, DPDK, perf/ftrace, or Linux kernel networking internals is advantageous.
    • Experience building safe network delivery pipelines, including testing environments, staged rollouts, automated validation, and drift detection is beneficial.
    • Familiarity with large-scale network observability and telemetry solutions is considered a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation package.
      • Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
      • Flexible working environment with a strong focus on ownership and autonomy.
      • Opportunity to work on impactful cloud and AI infrastructure projects.
      • Collaborative culture with experienced international engineering teams.
      • Exposure to cutting-edge technologies in networking, reliability engineering, and cloud platforms.
      • Opportunity to contribute to systems shaping the future of AI infrastructure.
      • Fast-paced environment focused on innovation, meaningful impact, trust, and professional growth.

title: Platform Governance Specialist
description:
Get to Know the Team

The Platform Governance team at Grab is responsible for operationalising policies and closing the feedback loop between users and the platform. We convert platform policies into scalable, auditable workflows and ensuring those workflows are executed accurately. Our team is currently on a AI transformation journey, where ticket resolution is done autonomously. You will play a direct role in keeping that model honest and making our operations more efficient.

You will report to Manager, Platform Quality & Experience; this role is based at 1 First Avenue.

Get to Know the Role

This is a hands-on role at the core of Grab's Operations team. You will own two critical functions: quality assurance of AI-generated outputs, and process improvement across the workflows. If you enjoy picking apart how things work and rebuilding them better, this role will suit you well.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Execute a QA/QC audit framework for AI-generated ticket responses, evaluating accuracy, policy adherence, tone, and resolution quality against defined standards, using this to improve AI model.
  • Map existing operational workflows end-to-end; identify bottlenecks, manual steps, and failure points; propose and implement more efficient and automated alternatives.
  • Build and maintain process documentation (SOPs, decision trees, and workflow guides) that supports both human agents and the AI model.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • A minimum of 3 years' experience in operations, business process improvement, project management, quality assurance, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and process thinking: able to break down a process, spot what's broken, and design a fix that holds at scale.
  • Familiarity with AI tools or automation platforms is a plus; intellectual curiosity about how AI works and where it fails is a must.
  • Basic SQL is an advantage for pulling data to support QA findings and process diagnostics.
  • Clear, structured written communication: you will produce documentation that both humans and AI systems depend on.

Life at Grab

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Lead Level Designer - Hole.io
description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

This position is fully remote CET ±2h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on , one of Voodoo's top games.

Role

We're looking for a talented Lead Level Designer to be a hands-on level designer for our mobile casual game , and also to eventually supervise and mentor a team of level designers . You will work with and define our custom-level editor in Unity to create fun and engaging levels. You’ll be:

  • Collaborating with our creative team to plan a level progression and difficulty curve aligned with both the player and business needs

  • Using Unity and proprietary tools for hands-on designing of innovative and varied 3D levels that appeal to a global audience and showcase our unique gameplay & art style

  • Eventually, scaling and managing the Level Design team, planning the workload & supervising the output quality of a small team of level designers, providing mentorship when needed

  • Defining level design guidelines tailored to the needs of our game and audience, in order to deliver content that offers a seamless, engaging gameplay experience with the highest quality in the most efficient way possible

  • Defining and iterating the specs of Level Design tools that improve the level design workflow and/or quality

  • Keeping up-to-date documentation of all levels, level progressions and ongoing level-related AB tests

  • Contributing actively with ideas for new game mechanics, level assets and level themes to ensure continuity, cohesion and gameplay variety and deliver an ongoing assortment of immersive environments, interactive elements, and challenging obstacles

  • Working closely with our team of artists, animators, and programmers to ensure level designs are fully realized

  • Testing and balancing levels and level progressions, taking into account player feedback and data to ensure they are fun, fair, and in line with our high-quality standards

  • Ensuring your designs adhere to technical constraints and opportunities presented by our game engine

Profile

  • At least 5 years of proven experience in Level Design for 3D games, with a portfolio demonstrating your ability to create engaging, fun levels

  • Strong Unity knowledge

  • Strong understanding of game design principles, particularly within the casual genre

  • Experience, or a genuine interest, in leading and mentoring a team from the ground up

  • Experience in continuous, data-driven level balancing and tweaking

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a creative approach to design challenges

  • Strong communication skills, able to work effectively within a team and explain your ideas clearly

Nice to have

  • Experience designing open-world, outdoors 3D environments

  • Experience leading and mentoring a small team of Level Designers

  • A degree in game design, computer science, or a related field would be beneficial

Benefits

  • Best-in-class compensation

  • Other benefits according to the country you resident
