title: Senior SDET
description:
About Us
Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

Join the award‑winning Sophos XGS Firewall team as a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) and help shape the future of network security. Recognized in the 2025 CRN® ARC Awards—including Product Innovation and Support across both Enterprise and SMB Network Security—Sophos XGS is a globally trusted platform used by over 600,000 organizations worldwide. This is an opportunity to work on a high‑performance firewall platform, redefining secure connectivity through cutting‑edge automation and scalable test frameworks.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test for the control plane, you will lead the design and development of the software, infrastructure, and processes required to validate our next‑generation control plane. You will own the end‑to‑end test strategy, with a strong focus on APIs, functionality, scale, performance, security, and other non‑functional areas. The role involves driving early design and API specification reviews, building and evolving test automation, and adopting modern tools to achieve high quality standards.

You will work closely with Development, Quality Engineering, and Support teams, collaborating with engineers across Bangalore, Vancouver, Pittsburgh, and Ahmedabad in a globally distributed, high‑impact engineering organization.

What you will do

Quality & Test Strategy Ownership

  • Own and drive the end‑to‑end test strategy for the firewall control plane, ensuring comprehensive coverage across functionality, APIs, scale, performance, interoperability, and security.
  • Define quality goals, test approaches, and success metrics aligned with shift‑left quality principles.
  • Ensure strong requirements, code, and solution‑level coverage throughout the development lifecycle.

    • Automation & Framework Development

    • Design, develop, and enhance test automation frameworks, libraries, and tools using Python‑based technologies.
    • Lead API, CLI, and system‑level automation for complex networking solutions.
    • Drive adoption of automation for non‑functional, performance, and security testing.

      • Collaboration & Execution

      • Actively participate in design and architecture reviews, representing quality expectations early in the development cycle.
      • Work closely with Development and QE teams on triage, debugging, impact analysis, and fix verification.
      • Partner with Support and field teams to investigate production issues, collect logs, reproduce issues, and validate fixes in lab environments.

        • Mentorship & Continuous Improvement

        • Mentor and guide junior engineers on complex features, new technologies, and advanced test approaches.
        • Research, evaluate, and introduce new testing tools, techniques, and best practices to continuously improve quality and efficiency.
        • Develop a strong understanding of the Sophos product portfolio, validating end‑to‑end customer solutions involving multiple networking products (Firewalls, Switches, Routers).

What you will bring

  • 8–12 years of overall experience, with strong hands‑on focus on test automation of over 6 years.
  • Solid experience testing networking products such as Firewalls, Switches, Routers, and management software.
  • Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals (L2/L3) and application‑level protocols.
  • Proven experience in test automation using Python (Robot Framework or similar), with a focus on building reusable libraries.
  • Hands‑on experience with API testing (REST and gRPC), including authentication mechanisms, using tools like Postman and programmatic approaches.
  • Experience across the full Quality Engineering lifecycle: functional, integration, non‑functional, performance, and security testing.
  • Strong debugging skills, including log analysis and system‑level issue investigation.
  • Working knowledge of Linux systems, kernel concepts, and networking stacks.
  • Experience with traffic generators such as BreakingPoint and related automation APIs.

    • Preferred / Nice to Have

    • Familiarity with security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Nexus).
    • Experience testing both hardware appliances and virtual images.
    • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure.
    • Experience working in Agile development environments.
    • Exposure to AI‑assisted tools for test automation, code generation, review, or productivity improvement.

title: Strandhjem søger en social- og sundhedsassistent eller pædagog til en fast stilling på 34 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026.
description:
Stillingen indeholder dag-, aften- og døgnvagter samt som udgangspunkt arbejde hver 3. weekend.

Hvem er vi?

Strandhjem er ikke bare et botilbud – det er et hjem.

Her bor 16 voksne med psykiske lidelser, som har brug for støtte, tryghed og nærvær i en hverdag, hvor relationer betyder alt. Mange af vores beboere har boet på Strandhjem i størstedelen af deres liv, og flere af vores medarbejdere har ligeledes arbejdet her i mange år. Det fortæller noget om den kultur og det fællesskab, vi har.

Vi arbejder ud fra en miljøterapeutisk og helhedsorienteret tilgang, hvor vi ser hele mennesket. Vi tror på, at udvikling sker gennem trygge relationer, meningsfulde aktiviteter og et fællesskab, hvor alle har en plads.

Vores medarbejdergruppe består af pædagoger, pædagogiske assistenter, social- og sundhedsassistenter, 1 sygeplejerske, 2 aktivitetsmedarbejdere, 1 kok og teknisk servicepersonale. Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af fagligheder, fordi vi ved, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab.

Hvad bliver dine opgaver?

Som en del af medarbejdergruppen bliver du en vigtig støtte i beboernes hverdag og en central medspiller i deres udvikling og trivsel.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

🧠 Indgå aktivt i den miljøterapeutiske indsats og skabe struktur, tryghed og relationer.

🤝 Være kontaktperson for et antal beboere og samarbejde med pårørende samt eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

📋 Dokumentere og udarbejde statusbeskrivelser i Cura og Sensum Bosted.

💊 Varetage medicinhåndtering indenfor kompetenceområdet, hvis du er social- og sundhedsassistent, herunder dispensering og intramuskulære injektioner mm.

👣 Understøtte beboernes psykiske, fysiske og sociale udvikling.

🎒 Deltage i ferier, udflugter og aktiviteter samt de pædagogiske måltider.

🔄 Bidrage på tværs af huset og hjælpe kolleger, når hverdagen kalder på det – hos os løfter vi i flok.

🎓 Medvirke til at skabe et godt læringsmiljø for elever

Hvem er du?

Du er enten uddannet pædagog eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og du har erfaring fra psykiatrien – eller en stærk interesse for området.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Har erfaring med eller interesse for socialpsykiatri og miljøterapeutisk arbejde.

• Er god til at skabe tillidsfulde relationer og møder mennesker med respekt, ro og nysgerrighed.

• Kan bevare overblikket i en hverdag, hvor to dage sjældent er ens.

• Trives i et tværfagligt samarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

• Arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

• Har lyst til at blive en del af Strandhjem og være med til at udvikle vores fælles kultur.

Vi vægter menneskelighed, engagement og personlighed lige så højt som erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har hjertet med i det, du gør.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

• En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, nærvær og humor.

• Et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

• Grundig introduktion og gode muligheder for sparring.

• Løbende supervision og kompetenceudvikling.

• Stor indflydelse på hverdagen og mulighed for at sætte dine kompetencer i spil.

• Arbejdsgiverbetalt sundhedsforsikring.

• En arbejdsplads, hvor relationer og tid sammen med beboerne prioriteres højt.

Praktisk information

🕒 34 timer om ugen

📆 Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026.

🕰️ Arbejdstid: Dag-, aften- og døgnvagter samt som udgangspunkt arbejde hver 3. weekend.

💰 Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende aftale.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Forstander Christina Schnuchel, tlf. 24 40 08 82/chsc@strandhjem.dk

eller

viceforstander Jens Abild, tlf. 24 40 41 73/ jesa@strandhjem.dk

Sådan søger du

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til chsc@strandhjem.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23. august 2026 kl. 23.59

Samtaler afholdes i uge 35.

🌼 Hos Strandhjem tror vi på, at de bedste rammer for vores beboere skabes af medarbejdere, der trives.

Måske er det dig, vi glæder os til at byde velkommen.

title: Applications Development Architect
description:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

India Hybrid: Noida/Hyderabad/Bangalore/Gurgaon

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Noida/Bengaluru (3 to4 times/week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

Job Description-

Key Responsibilities

  • Incident Management – Triage issues, perform root cause analysis, and lead war rooms for critical outages while maintaining SLOs

  • Deployment Operations – Deploy applications using Kubernetes, Helm charts, and service mesh; execute pre/post validations and manage traffic switching strategies

  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement end-to-end observability with Datadog/Splunk; correlate API anomalies with infrastructure signals and build actionable alerting

  • Security & Compliance – Maintain hardened GCP base AMIs to minimize CVEs, manage security exceptions, rotate credentials, and meet cyber metrics

  • Support & Escalation – Participate in shift rotations, provide L2/L3 support, and communicate incident status to stakeholders

Required Qualifications

  1. Cloud & Container Expertise – 4+ years hands-on experience with GCP and Kubernetes administration, including Helm and service mesh

  2. Monitoring & Observability – Proficiency with Datadog, Splunk, CloudWatch, or Grafana for building dashboards, setting up alerts, and correlating infrastructure signals

  3. Incident Management – Proven experience with ITIL/ITSM processes, on-call rotations, root cause analysis, and production troubleshooting in high-availability environments

  4. Security & Compliance – Knowledge of GCP security best practices, vulnerability management, secrets rotation, and compliance frameworks

  5. CI/CD & Deployment – Experience with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI; familiar with blue-green/canary deployments and pre/post validation strategies

  6. Networking & Troubleshooting – Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, load balancers, VPC networking, and ability to debug complex distributed system issues

Equal Opportunity Employer

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We will only use the information you provide to process your application and to produce tracking statistics. Since we do not request personal data deemed sensitive, we ask you to abstain from sharing that information with us.

title: Software Craftsperson/Java/Angular
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Craftsperson/Java/Angular based in Mexico.

This role is designed for engineers who are passionate about building high-quality, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.
The position combines strong Java backend expertise with modern Angular frontend development in a collaborative engineering environment.
You will work with advanced development practices, including Extreme Programming, test-driven development, and continuous delivery.
By embracing AI-powered engineering workflows, you will help accelerate development while maintaining strong standards of quality and craftsmanship.
This opportunity is ideal for developers who value technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.

Accountabilities

The Software Craftsperson will take ownership of feature development and contribute to building reliable software products through disciplined engineering practices and close collaboration.

  • Own feature-level design, development, testing, and delivery across backend and frontend applications.
  • Build clean, maintainable, and scalable software using modern engineering principles and best practices.
  • Develop backend services using Java while applying strong object-oriented programming concepts and design patterns.
  • Create responsive and scalable frontend applications using Angular and TypeScript.
  • Participate in product teams that manage the full development lifecycle, from technical decisions to production delivery.
  • Apply Extreme Programming practices such as pair programming, continuous integration, continuous delivery, and test-first development.
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and stakeholders to deliver solutions aligned with business and user needs.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, identify issues early, and enhance engineering workflows.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated code to ensure correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to engineering improvements, knowledge sharing, and mentoring within the team.
  • Participate in modern DevOps practices, including CI/CD workflows and collaborative software development processes.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a software engineer with strong Java and Angular experience, a passion for software craftsmanship, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative remote environment.

    • 3+ years of professional experience developing applications with Java.
    • Strong knowledge of Java fundamentals, object-oriented programming, design principles, and design patterns.
    • Experience working with Java frameworks such as Micronaut or Spring.
    • Solid understanding of Java Collections, multithreading concepts, and Hibernate ORM.
    • Experience using build tools such as Gradle or Maven.
    • Ability to write effective unit tests using JUnit.
    • Hands-on experience developing scalable applications with Angular and TypeScript.
    • Strong understanding of Angular concepts, including components, state management, data binding, routing, directives, and pipes.
    • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
    • Experience working with relational databases and fundamental SQL concepts.
    • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices.
    • Knowledge of Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP), RxJS, Microsoft Azure, observability, and monitoring practices is a plus.
    • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Augment, or Claude Code.
    • Ability to apply prompt engineering techniques and assess AI-generated code quality.
    • Strong ownership mindset, communication skills, curiosity, and commitment to continuous improvement.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, remote-first work environment with structured flexibility.
      • Opportunity to work with modern engineering practices focused on software craftsmanship and AI-native development.
      • Twice-yearly in-person coworking sprints with travel expenses covered.
      • Annual team retreat with covered travel costs.
      • Dedicated learning and development budget.
      • Conference participation and speaking sponsorship opportunities.
      • Comprehensive medical and term insurance coverage.
      • Employee-friendly leave policies.
      • Home office support fund.
      • Collaborative culture focused on learning, experimentation, and technical excellence.

title: Senior Software Engineer | Language Products | Full-Stack
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the Media Translation team. This is the heart of DeepL. You will be building and expanding our flagship translation products—the core engines that power everything from our consumer web translator to our Enterprise Customization Hub (Glossaries, Translation Memory, and Style Rules) and complex multimedia localization flows.

We are shifting gears from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers just to implement UI tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries who obsess over the user experience and the business impact of their code . You will build the interfaces and backend systems that allow a global enterprise to maintain their brand voice across 100+ languages effortlessly, while keeping the experience simple enough for a casual user.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the Core Experience End-to-End: You will architect and build complex, user-facing features across our primary translation products . Whether you are building the UI for the Customization Hub, engineering the backend logic to parse and translate complex document formats (PDF, Word, PowerPoint) without losing formatting, or integrating DeepL directly into enterprise workflows, you own the outcome.

  • Build for "Consumer-Grade" Enterprise: You will solve a unique product challenge: building an interface that feels instant and magical for a B2C user, but is powerful enough to handle the complex, multi-party collaboration and localization workflows required by enterprise teams.

  • Architect for Ambiguity: You will make high-stakes technical decisions regarding state management, API integrations, and performance. You don't wait for perfect requirements; you prototype, measure user friction, and iterate fast .

  • Bridge the Gap: You are bilingual in "Engineering" and "Business." You will collaborate closely with Research, Product, and Design teams to translate complex AI constraints into an intuitive UX . You will help win market trust by building transparency and performance metrics directly into the product.

  • AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving.


Qualities we look for

  • A "Product-First" Mindset: You care deeply about who uses your software. You ask "Why are we building this?" before writing a line of code. You measure success by user adoption and reduced friction, not just pull requests merged.

  • Full-Stack Fluency: You're a full-stack engineer whose strengths lean heavily backend, with hands-on experience in C# and Python, and you're comfortable with JavaScript-based rendering and front-end work when needed.

  • High Agency & Bias for Action: You don't wait for permission. If you see a performance bottleneck in the translation flow, you profile it. If the documentation for a new API is missing, you write it . You are comfortable unblocking yourself and your team.

  • A "System Thinker" for UI/UX: You understand that a simple UI often hides massive backend complexity. You know how to design systems that handle large document states, manage complex terminology rules (Glossaries), and maintain high performance in the browser.

  • Bonus points if you have: experience with visual/image processing models for document analysis, prior work on OCR or document layout understanding, experience integrating with legacy enterprise systems such as SAP, or experience building products for both B2C and enterprise customers.

A Note on Our Hiring Process: DeepL hires for the Company, not just a specific team. We operate a Unified Engineering Pipeline. If you pass our bar, we will match you to the highest-priority role that fits your skillset—whether that is in Core Product, Platform, Voice, or Enterprise. We prioritize "Missionaries" who want to solve the biggest problems, wherever they live in the stack.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JL1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: Servicetekniker till Eltel Networks!
description:
Eltel söker nu en engagerad servicetekniker som vill vara med och bygga morgondagens kommunikationsnät. Hos Eltel får du möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste tekniken inom fiberoptik och bidra till att skapa robusta och högpresterande nätverk för personer i hela landet.

Om tjänsten

Eltel arbetar med att planera, bygga, ansluta och underhålla kommunikationsnät. Det görs på uppdrag av operatörer, nätägare, myndigheter och statliga verk. Som ledare av utvecklingen inom infranätindustrin är Eltel stolta över att kunna skapa värde för sina kunder och för samhället i stort, genom att kombinera kunskap och kompetens med en praktisk inställning till arbete.

Eltel söker nu en servicetekniker till sitt team för att fortsätta att bygga ut kommunikationsnätet i Sverige. Du arbetar tätt med en annan tekniker för att kunna stötta varandra i arbetet och bidra med bästa möjliga lösning för respektive projekt. Du erbjuds en stor portion av eget ansvar och samarbetar tätt med andra tekniker, projektörer och projektledare.

Denna roll är säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer längre fram i processen.

Du erbjuds

  • En roll där du får arbeta med frihet under ansvar samtidigt som du får driva och utveckla arbetet
  • En mentor under din första tid som vägleder, stöttar och lär upp
  • Nya, fräscha lokaler med tillgång till både stor gemensam matsal, gym och bastu

Arbetsuppgifter

  • Byte av switchar och kretskort
  • Felsökning, reperation och service samt underhåll av vägsidans tekniska infrastruktur
  • Installation och underhåll av fastighetsnät
  • Utföra service och underhåll på vägsidans tekniska infrastruktur.
  • Jour arbete förekommer i denna roll

Vi söker dig som

  • Erfarenhet av arbete med switchar och kretskort
  • Erfarenhet av arbete av vägsidans tekniska infratsruktur
  • B-körkort med manuell växellåda
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Erfarenhet av arbete på hög höjd och med skylift
  • Utbildning i arbete på väg
  • Kunskap kan erhållas genom utbildning, erfarenhet eller att vara självlärd

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

Vi ser att du är kommunikativ och gillar att samarbeta med kollegor och personer utanför organisationen. Det är viktigt att har ett säkerhetstänk och är ordningsam för att arbeta på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Pricing & Tender Assistant
description:
Your role at Veezu:

As a Home to School Pricing Assistant, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end pricing and submission process for all Local Authority home-to-school tenders. This role will play a critical part in securing new business by ensuring accurate, competitive, and timely tender submissions across a range of procurement portals.

You’ll be the central point of ownership for pricing strategy, submission quality and compliance - escalating commercial competitiveness with operational viability. You will need to be a highly organised individual who can keep track of multi tenders across various geographical locations, ensure documentation is sent and received in a timely manner and always ensure completion of business essential documentation.

Please note: this is a part time position (20h per week)


Who are Veezu?

Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

What you’ll do:

Tender Management

  • Managing and coordinating the full tender submission process for Local Authority home-to-school transport contracts.

  • Prepare, review and submit pricing proposals via multiple procurement portals (e.g. Proactis, ADAM, YORTender).

  • Analyse tender requirements, specification and pricing structures to ensure full compliance.

  • Track all tenders and their outcomes, providing insight into win/loss performance to refine future bids.

  • Track no bid tenders to help identify shortages of resources within areas.

  • Work closely with CAH and Account Managers to notify in a timely manner of awards

  • Continuously review and improve pricing processes, tools, and submission quality

  • Support the businesses HTS Strategy – by highlighting resource issues.

  • Provide support on additional pricing exercises as and when required by the commercial team, including PTS/NHS Tenders and private tenders.

Integration

  • Work closely with the M&A/ Integration team to ensure a smooth transition for tendered routes within an acquisition.

  • Work closely with Head of Bids and Tenders to ensure new Frameworks and portals are accessible straight away, enhancing growth opportunities

  • Adopt a strong handover process to ensure key information is communicated. Ensuring all stakeholders are communicated with.

General

  • Support members of the wider Group Commercial team as and when required.

Compliance

  • Understand the Veezu Safety First approach and behave accordingly.

  • Understand the Veezu Data Principles and behave accordingly.

  • Understand the Passenger Terms & Conditions.

  • Understand the Corporate Account Customer Terms & Conditions.

  • Undertake all mandatory training.

  • Maintain information security to a recognised required standard in line with business needs.

  • You are committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance.

  • Ensure legal and contractual compliance.

What you’ll need:

  • Strong and polite communication skills both on the phone, in person and by email.

  • Ability to multitask and prioritise projects.

  • Must be team focused.

  • Guide commercial operations in your region, supporting the execution of the Group commercial strategy.


Where you’ll be:

This role is flexible in terms of location; however, the successful candidate must be located within one of Veezu’s existing hub locations. These are:

Barnsley, Barry, Bath, Bridgend, Bristol, Cambridge, Cardiff, Chesterfield, Chippenham, Cwmbran, Derby, Doncaster, Hodge House, Hull, Huntingdon, Ipswich, Leeds, Luton, Manchester, Newport, Page Moss, Portsmouth, Sheffield, Shrewsbury, Solihull, St Helens, Swindon, Telford, Wigan, Wolverhampton, and York.

Veezu is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment, welcoming applications from all backgrounds, experiences, and communities.

title: Director, Enterprise Architect
description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define enterprise architecture strategy across business and technology domains, aligning business capabilities, application landscape, data/AI platforms, and cloud infrastructure into a cohesive, outcome-driven architecture.
  • Partner with business leaders and domain architects to map business capabilities and value streams to enabling technologies, ensuring technology investments directly support business growth, efficiency, and innovation goals.
  • Lead application and platform architecture evolution, driving modernization of legacy systems, rationalization of the application portfolio, and adoption of scalable, API-first and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Establish balanced hybrid and multi-cloud architectures, aligning cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), SaaS/PaaS solutions, and on-prem environments to enable agility, resilience, and cost-effective scale.
  • Drive cross-domain architecture standards and reference models spanning applications, integration, data/AI, security, and infrastructure—ensuring consistency while enabling flexibility for business innovation.
  • Translate business strategy into executable architecture roadmaps, prioritizing initiatives across business capability gaps, application modernization, and platform investments with clear ROI and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead enterprise architectural governance (ARB/STARC) to guide design decisions, resolve trade-offs across business and technology domains, manage exceptions, and ensure alignment to risk, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Champion data and AI as core enterprise capabilities, enabling semantic layer adoption, intelligent automation, and agentic workflows as part of the broader architecture strategy.
  • Drive value realization and technical debt reduction, continuously measuring architecture effectiveness, business impact, and simplification of the technology estate.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, application/platform architecture, and/or technology strategy in large global organizations

title: Tapahtumatyöntekijöitä, Lahti
description:
Haemme tapahtumatyöntekijöitä ravintola-alalle Lahden Pelicansin kotiotteluihin kaudelle 2026-2027!

Haluaisitko työskennellä tapahtumien ytimessä ja olla mukana luomassa unohtumattomia otteluelämyksiä? Etsimme reippaita ja asiakaspalveluhenkisiä tapahtumatyöntekijöitä kaudelle 2026-2027. Tapahtumassa on useita työskentelypisteitä kioskeista vippiin ja näihin saat perehdytyksen ennen ottelun alkua.

Työtehtävät:

• kassatyöskentely, myynti, asiakaspalvelu, tuotteiden esillepano sekä annosten esivalmistelu
• siisteyden ylläpitäminen ja pisteestä huolehtiminen yhdessä työkavereiden kanssa

Tarjoamme:

• joustavan työn esimerkiksi opiskeluiden ohelle
• palkka marava TES 13,70€/h-15,04€/h tai sopimuksen mukaan huomioiden aikaisempi kokemus

Odotamme sinulta:

• aikaisempaa kokemusta ravintola-alalta mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä, asenne ratkaisee
• kykyä itsenäiseen työhön ajottain nopeatempoisessa ympäristössä
• hyviä asiakaspalvelutaitoja ja valmiutta työskennellä kauden aikana kotiotteluissa
• hygeniapassia sekä suomen kielen taitoa

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan ja tapahtumia on tarjolla ensi vuoden puolelle asti, otteluohjelman löydät verkosta. Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana!

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten tai soita Amikon Mika p. 0504632668/mika.niemi@amiko.fi ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

title: Software Craftsperson/Java/Angular
description:

This role is designed for engineers who are passionate about building high-quality, maintainable, and scalable software solutions.
You will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.

You will work with advanced development practices, including Extreme Programming, test-driven development, and continuous delivery.
By embracing AI-powered engineering workflows, you will help accelerate development while maintaining strong standards of quality and craftsmanship.

title: L1 Operations Engineer
description:
L1 Operations Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Experience Required: 0 – 2 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time | Shift-Based (24x7 Rotational)


About Zybisys

Zybisys is a technology company that helps banks, financial institutions, and FinTech businesses build and run secure, reliable, and high-performance technology platforms. We work closely with some of India's leading stock brokers to manage their cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, platform operations, and observability. With deep expertise in the Capital Markets domain, we focus on simplifying complex technology, improving operational resilience, and helping our customers innovate with confidence.

Job Description

The L1 Operations Engineer is the first line of defence in Zybisys's 24x7 managed cloud operations. This role is responsible for continuous monitoring of multi-region Azure cloud and hybrid on-premises infrastructure, timely triage of alerts, first-line incident response, and ensuring all issues are accurately logged, prioritised, and escalated within SLA thresholds.


This is a shift-based operational role requiring strong attention to detail, disciplined runbook execution, and clear communication during incidents. The ideal candidate is technically curious, process-oriented, and comfortable working across cloud monitoring tools, ITSM platforms, and infrastructure dashboards in a fast-paced managed services environment.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Monitoring & Alert Management

· Perform continuous 24x7 monitoring of Azure cloud and hybrid datacenter infrastructure using Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, and related observability dashboards.

· Triage incoming alerts — assess severity, validate against known patterns, and determine whether to resolve at L1 or escalate to L2 within defined SLA thresholds.

· Execute approved runbooks and SOPs for all known alert categories; document actions taken for every incident with accurate timestamps and observations.

· Monitor health and availability of compute (VMs), storage, network links, VPN tunnels, and platform services across cloud and on-premises environments.

· Track sFlow and NetFlow dashboards for network traffic anomalies; flag unusual patterns to the L2 team for deeper investigation.




Incident Logging & ITSM Management

· Log all incidents, service requests, and alerts in the ITSM platform with complete and accurate details — symptoms, affected components, priority, and initial actions taken.

· Update ticket status throughout the incident lifecycle; ensure no incident is left without a current status update beyond the defined response window.

· Coordinate with L2 engineers during escalations — provide clear handover notes including timeline, alert context, initial diagnostics, and business impact assessment.

· Follow the priority matrix strictly: P1 (15 min), P2 (30 min), P3 (4 hr), P4 (8 hr) response and escalation thresholds.

Platform & Service Health Checks

· Execute scheduled shift health checks across all managed platforms — Azure resources, on-premises servers, network devices, security appliances, and employee services.

· Verify availability and performance of core services: DNS, DHCP, NTP, Active Directory, and M365 platform components.

· Monitor security platform dashboards (firewalls, EDR, proxy services) for health status and alert flags; escalate anomalies per defined procedures.

· Review Azure Cost Management dashboards for unusual consumption spikes and flag to the lead for review.

Routine Operations & Maintenance Support

· Execute scheduled batch jobs, backup verifications, replication checks, and housekeeping tasks as per the operational calendar.

· Support L2 and Specialist engineers during planned maintenance windows, patch cycles, and change activities — providing monitoring coverage and rollback readiness.

· Validate post-change infrastructure health after every approved change; raise a flag immediately if anomalies are detected post-implementation.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

· Maintain precise shift handover reports — open tickets, ongoing incidents, recent changes, and watch-items for the next shift.

· Contribute to the knowledge base by documenting recurring alert patterns, resolution steps, and workarounds for L1-resolvable issues.

· Flag gaps in runbooks or SOPs to the operations lead so that documentation is continuously improved.

Required Skills & Experience

Cloud & Infrastructure Fundamentals

· 2 – 5 years of experience in IT operations, infrastructure support, or cloud managed services.

· Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure: Azure Portal navigation, VM status checks, resource monitoring, and basic troubleshooting using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.

· Hands-on familiarity with Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) and Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) — service management, log file reading, process monitoring, and basic fault diagnosis.

· Understanding of hybrid infrastructure models — on-premises datacenter integrated with Azure cloud via ExpressRoute or VPN.

· Basic familiarity with storage concepts: disk performance thresholds, capacity monitoring, backup job status, and replication health checks.

Monitoring & Observability Tools

· Experience reading and interpreting Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards — understanding panel thresholds, alert states, and trend data.

· Familiarity with Azure Monitor alerts and Log Analytics at a basic level — understanding alert rules, severity levels, and affected resources.

· Ability to read sFlow or NetFlow traffic dashboards for high-level network health assessment.

· APM dashboard familiarity — understanding response time trends, error rates, and service health indicators from tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or Azure Application Insights.

Networking Fundamentals

· Good understanding of core networking concepts: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NTP, VLANs, and basic routing.

· Practical diagnostic skills: ping, traceroute, nslookup, netstat — to perform first-level connectivity checks and provide meaningful diagnostics to L2.

· Familiarity with VPN tunnel health monitoring and firewall status dashboards at an operational level.

ITSM & Process Discipline

· Experience working with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Zoho Desk, Freshservice, or equivalent) for incident logging, ticket updates, and escalation workflows.

· Understanding of ITIL incident management concepts — priority, impact, urgency, escalation paths, and SLA tracking.

· Ability to follow runbooks and SOPs precisely and consistently, including under pressure during major incident scenarios.

· Clear and concise written communication for incident tickets, shift handover notes, and escalation summaries.

Soft Skills & Work Style

· Comfortable working in a 24x7 rotational shift environment including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays.

· High attention to detail — accurate logging, precise documentation, and consistent process adherence.

· Team-oriented with a proactive attitude toward learning and improving operational knowledge.

· Ability to stay calm and systematic during high-pressure P1/P2 incident scenarios.

Certification (Preferred)

title: Main Planner
description:
The Opportunity

Hitachi Energy, Components is seeking a Main Planner to join our team.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with our production planners, operational buyers, sales and order team to ensure that we optimize our capacity over multiple production lines creating most possible customer value.

You will play a key role in developing and implementing best-practice routines, be a part of our company’s sales and operation planning.

This is an opportunity to make a real impact by driving operational excellence, supporting sustainability goals, and contributing to the continued success of Hitachi Energy in the global energy industry.

  • Monitor delivery performance and proactively identify and address deviations, with daily and weekly reporting to management
  • Establish a structured approach to demand forecasting in close collaboration with sales team and internal transformer factories.
  • Coordinate planning activities for large and complex projects.
  • Create and maintain a structured approach for capacity reservation.
  • Define and implement planning principles
  • Act as a backup resource and coach for our planning teams

Your background

  • Degree in Logistics, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience involving production planning.
  • Strong expertise in SAP and advanced proficiency in materials planning and scheduling.
  • Proven ability to see the big picture, not looking at one process but rather on how several processes interact and see opportunities for improvement and setting best practices from a company perspective.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

What we offer

  • Flexible working time
  • Health care and wellness allowance
  • Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
  • Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
  • Various trainings and education supporting employee development​

More about us

Join Hitachi Energy and work in a team that is dedicated to creating a future where innovative digital technologies allow greater access to cleaner energy!
